examples: Use the proper tool for the job.
That is not the proper way to ask.
semantic_expansions: 适当的/正确的：正是这场合专该有的那一种
真正的：名实相符、对得上的
words.recall_hint: proprius（专属的）→ 正对得上这场合的那一种

words.root_logic: propr（自己的）+ -ty → 归自己名下之物；也指物本身专有的性状
words.origin: 古法语 propriete，来自拉丁语 proprietas（所有权、特性）← proprius
words.native_definition: a thing owned; land and buildings; a quality belonging to something
words.core_concept: what stands under one's own name, or a trait belonging to a thing alone – 记在自己名下之物，或某物独有的性状
words.core_image: 文书上写明这几间屋归他名下；铁遇火会红，这是铁自带的脾性
examples: All his property passed to his son.
Salt has the property of preserving food.
semantic_expansions: 财产/房产：记在自己名下之物
特性：某物专有、别物没有的性状
words.recall_hint: propr（自己的）+ -ty → 归自己名下之物，及物自带的性状

words.root_logic: exter（外）+ -ior（对照级）→ 两边相比更靠外的那一面
words.origin: 拉丁语 exterior（较外的），exterus（在外的）的比较级
words.native_definition: the outer surface or appearance of something
words.core_concept: the further-out of the two faces – 里外一比，更靠外的那一面
words.core_image: 手掌沿墙抹过去，摸到的是朝着风雨的那一面
examples: The exterior walls need painting.
Beneath his calm exterior he was furious.
semantic_expansions: 外部的/外表：里外相比更靠外的那一面
words.recall_hint: exter（外）+ -ior（对照级）→ 更靠外的那一面

words.root_logic: inter（内）+ -ior（对照级）→ 两边相比更靠里的那一面
words.origin: 拉丁语 interior（较内的），interus（在内的）的比较级
words.native_definition: the inside part of something; the inland part of a country
words.core_concept: the further-in of the two faces – 里外一比，更靠里的那一面
words.core_image: 推门进去，脚步声在四壁之间来回撞
examples: The car has a leather interior.
They travelled into the interior.
semantic_expansions: 内部的/内部：里外相比更靠里的那一面
内地：一国之中更靠里、离海更远的那片
words.recall_hint: inter（内）+ -ior（对照级）→ 更靠里的那一面

words.root_logic: deterior（更差，比较级）+ -ate（使/变）→ 一路往更差那头去
words.origin: 晚期拉丁语 deteriorare（使变坏），来自 deterior（较差的，de- 的比较级）
words.native_definition: to become progressively worse
words.core_concept: sliding step by step toward the worse of the two – 一步步滑向两者中更差那一头
words.core_image: 墙面一年比一年斑驳，去年补的那块今年又鼓起来
examples: Her health deteriorated over the winter.
Relations between them deteriorated fast.
semantic_expansions: 恶化/变坏：一路滑向更差那一头
退化：同一方向上功能一路走低
words.recall_hint: deterior（更差）+ -ate → 往更差那头一路去

words.root_logic: mod（量度）+ -er- + -ate → 守在刻线之内的 → 不过火
words.origin: 拉丁语 moderatus（有节制的），moderare（节制）的过去分词 ← modus
words.native_definition: average in amount or degree; not extreme
words.core_concept: staying inside the line, never brimming over – 停在刻线之内，不满溢出来
words.core_image: 水倒到刻线就收手，杯子没溢也不见底
examples: Take moderate exercise every day.
He holds moderate political views.
semantic_expansions: 适度的/中等的：停在刻线之内、不过量
温和的：主张同样不走极端
words.recall_hint: mod（量度）+ -ate → 守在刻线之内、不过火

words.root_logic: mod（量度）+ -ify（使…）→ 把尺度调一调 → 修改、使缓和
words.origin: 拉丁语 modificare（限定、调整），来自 modus＋facere（做）
words.native_definition: to change something slightly, especially to improve it
words.core_concept: shifting the line a little rather than remaking the vessel – 把那道刻线挪一点，而非另造一只杯
words.core_image: 把刻线往下挪了半分，别处一概没动
examples: They modified the design slightly.
She modified her tone when he objected.
semantic_expansions: 修改/调整：把尺度挪动一点
使缓和：把话或态度的分寸往回收一点
words.recall_hint: mod（量度）+ -ify → 把那道刻线挪一点

words.root_logic: com-（合）+ mod（量度）+ -ity → 合于尺度、便于计量买卖之物
words.origin: 拉丁语 commoditas（便利、合宜），来自 commodus（合尺度的）← com＋modus
words.native_definition: a thing bought and sold, especially a basic good
words.core_concept: goods cut to a common measure so they can be traded – 按公认尺度计量、可拿去交易之物
words.core_image: 秤上一斤一斤过，按同一把尺子记价开单
examples: Coffee is a global commodity.
Water became a scarce commodity.
semantic_expansions: 商品/日用品：按公认尺度计量、可供买卖之物
words.recall_hint: com-（合）+ mod（量度）→ 合于尺度、可计量买卖之物

words.root_logic: qual（何种性质）+ -ity → 是什么成色 → 品质；也指人身上的特质
words.origin: 拉丁语 qualitas（性质、属性），来自 qualis（何种）
words.native_definition: how good something is; a feature someone or something has
words.core_concept: what kind a thing turns out to be when looked at closely – 细看之下，它到底是什么成色
words.core_image: 对着光看那块料，纹理密实，一眼便知与别的不同
examples: The quality of the cloth is excellent.
Patience is her best quality.
semantic_expansions: 质量/品质：细看之下是什么成色
特质：人或物身上那一样别处没有的性质
words.recall_hint: qual（何种性质）+ -ity → 到底是什么成色

words.root_logic: qual（何种性质）+ -ify（使…）→ 使成色够得上 → 具备资格；也指给话加限定
words.origin: 中世纪拉丁语 qualificare（定其性质），来自 qualis＋facere（做）
words.native_definition: to reach the required standard; to limit a statement
words.core_concept: coming up to the mark that the kind requires – 成色达到那一档所要求的线
words.core_image: 料子送去过筛，够得上那道线的才盖印放行
examples: She qualified as a doctor last year.
He qualified his praise with one caution.
semantic_expansions: 取得资格/合格：成色够上所要求那道线
限定：给话加一道界线，缩住它的适用范围
words.recall_hint: qual（何种性质）+ -ify → 使成色够上那道线

words.root_logic: qualify（使够格）+ -ation → 够格这件事，及作凭据的那纸；也指附加的限定
words.origin: 中世纪拉丁语 qualificatio，来自 qualificare
words.native_definition: an official record of passing an exam; a skill making one suitable; a limiting remark
words.core_concept: the proof that one came up to the mark, or the limit set on a claim – 够上那道线的凭据，或给话加的那道界
words.core_image: 抽屉里那张盖了印的纸，写明他过了那道线
examples: She has a teaching qualification.
He agreed, with one qualification.
semantic_expansions: 资格/学历：够上那道线的凭据
限定条件：给话加的那道界
words.recall_hint: qualify（使够格）+ -ation → 够格的凭据，或所加的那道界

words.root_logic: pro-（按照）+ portio（份）→ 按份切分后各占的那一份 → 比例
words.origin: 拉丁语 proportio（比例），来自 pro portione（按份而言）；portio（份）与 pars/partis（部分）同源，故归 pars 一族
words.native_definition: a part considered in relation to the whole; the right relation between parts
words.core_concept: how large a share one piece takes of the whole – 一块在整体里占多大的一份
words.core_image: 圆饼切开，每人手里那块占整张多大，一眼比得出来
examples: A large proportion of the class agreed.
The columns are pleasing in proportion.
semantic_expansions: 比例：一份占整体多大
部分：切出来的那一份本身
均衡：各份之间大小相称
words.recall_hint: pro-（按照）+ portio（份）→ 各占整体的那一份

words.root_logic: in-（落到…上）+ cid（落下）+ -ent → 落到日常里头的那一桩
words.origin: 拉丁语 incidens（落在上头的），来自 incidere ← in＋cadere（落下）
words.native_definition: an event, especially an unpleasant or unusual one
words.core_concept: the one thing that came down into an otherwise plain day – 落进平常日子里的那一桩
words.core_image: 路当中忽然砸下一样东西，行人全停下来看
examples: The incident was reported to the police.
No one was hurt in the incident.
semantic_expansions: 事件/事变：落进平常日子里的那一桩
words.recall_hint: in-（落到上）+ cid（落下）→ 落进日子里的那一桩

words.root_logic: incident（落下之事）+ -ence → 落下来的频密程度 → 发生的多寡
words.origin: 拉丁语 incidentia，来自 incidere（落到上头）
words.native_definition: the rate at which something happens, especially something unwanted
words.core_concept: how thickly such fallings come down over a stretch – 一段里头落下多密
words.core_image: 雨点打在窗台上，一阵密一阵疏，数得出快慢
examples: The incidence of the disease has fallen.
There is a high incidence of theft here.
semantic_expansions: 发生率/发生频率：这类事落下来的密度
words.recall_hint: incident（落下之事）+ -ence → 落下来有多密

words.root_logic: incidental（顺带落下的）+ -ly → 顺着话头落下来一句 → 顺便说
words.origin: 英语 incidentally，来自 incidental ← incident
words.native_definition: used to add a remark not connected to the main point
words.core_concept: a word that drops in alongside, not the thing one came to say – 顺着旁边落下来的一句，不是正题
words.core_image: 话说到一半，他顺口带出一句不相干的
examples: Incidentally, I saw her yesterday.
The two met quite incidentally.
semantic_expansions: 顺便说：顺着话头旁落下来的一句
偶然地：不是安排好、恰巧落下的
words.recall_hint: incidental（顺带落下）+ -ly → 顺着旁边落下一句
collocations: incidentally, S + V —— 顺便说一句
incidentally mentioned —— 顺带提到

words.root_logic: kyklos（圆圈）→ 转回原处的一整圈 → 周期；也指骑那两个轮子
words.origin: 拉丁语 cyclus，来自希腊语 kyklos（圆圈、轮）
words.native_definition: a set of events repeating in the same order; to ride a bicycle
words.core_concept: one full turn that ends where it started – 转满一圈、终点又是起点
words.core_image: 四季走一遍，又回到落第一场雪的那几天
examples: The washing machine has a short cycle.
She cycles to work every day.
semantic_expansions: 周期/循环：转满一圈又回到起点
骑车：踩着轮子转圈前行
words.recall_hint: kyklos（圆圈）→ 转回原处的一整圈

words.root_logic: bi-（二）+ cycl（轮）+ -e → 两个轮子的车
words.origin: 法语 bicycle，由拉丁 bi-（二）＋希腊 kyklos（轮）合成，19 世纪造词
words.native_definition: a vehicle with two wheels that one pedals
words.core_concept: the frame that rides on two turning circles – 架在两个转圈之物上的车
words.core_image: 前后两个圈一齐转起来，人就跟着往前走
examples: He rode his bicycle to school.
Her bicycle has a broken chain.
semantic_expansions: 自行车/脚踏车：架在两个转圈之物上的车
words.recall_hint: bi-（二）+ cycl（轮）→ 两个轮子的车

words.root_logic: re-（再）+ cycl（转一圈）+ -e → 让它再转一圈回来 → 回收再用
words.origin: 英语 recycle，由 re-＋cycle 合成，20 世纪随环保用语普及
words.native_definition: to treat used material so it can be used again
words.core_concept: sending a thing round the loop once more instead of dropping it – 让用过之物再走一圈回来，而不是丢掉
words.core_image: 旧瓶子送回炉里，出来时又是一只能用的
examples: We recycle paper and glass at home.
These bottles can be recycled.
semantic_expansions: 回收/再利用：让用过之物再转一圈回来
words.recall_hint: re-（再）+ cycl（转圈）→ 让它再走一圈回来

words.root_logic: largus（宽绰有余）→ 体量占得开、不局促
words.origin: 古法语 large，来自拉丁语 largus（丰足的、宽绰的）
words.native_definition: of considerable size or extent
words.core_concept: taking up room with margin left over – 占得开、周围还留着余地
words.core_image: 两臂张开也抱不住那截树身
examples: They live in a large house.
A large number of people came.
semantic_expansions: 大的/大量的：占得开、有余裕而不局促
words.recall_hint: largus（宽绰有余）→ 占得开、不局促

words.root_logic: en-（使…）+ large（宽绰）→ 使它占得更开 → 扩大、放大
words.origin: 古法语 enlargier（放宽），由 en-＋large ← 拉丁语 largus
words.native_definition: to make something bigger, or to become bigger
words.core_concept: pushing the edges out so there is more room within – 把边往外推，里头就更宽绰
words.core_image: 照片一角被拉到满幅，原先看不清的纹路露了出来
examples: They plan to enlarge the kitchen.
Please enlarge this photograph.
semantic_expansions: 扩大/放大/增大：把边往外推、使更宽绰
words.recall_hint: en-（使）+ large（宽绰）→ 把边往外推

words.root_logic: large（大部分）+ -ly → 占着大头地 → 主要、多半
words.origin: 英语 largely，来自 large 加副词后缀 -ly
words.native_definition: mostly; to a great extent
words.core_concept: the side that takes up most of the whole – 占了整体大头的那一边
words.core_image: 天平一头压得低低的，另一头只剩一点
examples: The project was largely successful.
His account is largely accurate.
semantic_expansions: 主要地/大部分/多半：占着整体大头的那一边
words.recall_hint: large（大部分）+ -ly → 占着大头地
collocations: largely ignored/unchanged/responsible —— 大体上、主要是，接过去分词或形容词是它最常见的位置
largely due to / largely because of sth —— 主要由于，用来指出占大头的那个原因
largely a matter of sth —— 主要是某一方面的事，把整件事归到一头上；与 mostly 的分工是它论比重、mostly 论件数与次数

words.root_logic: maior（更大的）→ 相比之下更要紧的；名词指主修的那一门
words.origin: 拉丁语 maior（更大的），magnus（大）的比较级
words.native_definition: greater in size or importance; a student's main subject
words.core_concept: the thicker branch the others hang off – 别的枝都挂在它上头的那一根
words.core_image: 顺着树身往上看，最粗那根撑住了大半个树冠
examples: This is a major problem for us.
She chose history as her major.
semantic_expansions: 主要的/重大的：相比之下更大更要紧的那一方
专业：所修各门里作主干的那一门
words.recall_hint: maior（更大的）→ 别的都挂在它上头的那一根

words.root_logic: major（更大的）+ -ity → 更大的那一部分 → 多数
words.origin: 法语 majorité，来自中世纪拉丁语 maioritas ← maior
words.native_definition: the greater number or part of a group
words.core_concept: the side that has the greater count – 数下来更多的那一边
words.core_image: 举手一数，一边的手明显比另一边密
examples: The majority voted in favour.
A majority of students agreed.
semantic_expansions: 大多数/多数：数下来更多的那一边
words.recall_hint: major（更大的）+ -ity → 数下来更多那一边

words.root_logic: maior（更大）→ maiestas（尊大）→ 令人仰视的气派；亦作君主尊称
words.origin: 古法语 majeste，来自拉丁语 maiestas（威严、尊大）← maior
words.native_definition: impressive dignity or grandeur; a title for a king or queen
words.core_concept: the bearing of one seated higher than all present – 坐得比在场所有人都高的那份气派
words.core_image: 台阶尽头那个座位高出一截，底下的人都得抬头看
examples: The mountains rose in silent majesty.
Her Majesty will arrive at noon.
semantic_expansions: 威严/壮丽：令人须仰视的那份气派
陛下：以此气派作君主的尊称
words.recall_hint: maior（更大）→ maiestas（尊大）→ 令人仰视的气派

words.root_logic: numer（数目）+ -ous（多…的）→ 数目多的
words.origin: 拉丁语 numerosus（数目多的），来自 numerus（数目）
words.native_definition: existing in great numbers; many
words.core_concept: so many that the counting runs long – 点起来要数好一阵
words.core_image: 屋檐下的燕子一排接一排，数到后头就乱了
examples: She has numerous friends abroad.
We met on numerous occasions.
semantic_expansions: 许多的/众多的：数目多、点起来要数好一阵
words.recall_hint: numer（数目）+ -ous（多…的）→ 数目多的

words.root_logic: numer（数目）+ -ical（…的）→ 用数目表示的、按数计的
words.origin: 英语 numerical，来自中世纪拉丁语 numericus ← numerus
words.native_definition: expressed in numbers; relating to numbers
words.core_concept: set down as counts rather than words – 记成数目而非文字
words.core_image: 表格里每一栏都换成了阿拉伯记号，一列列排下去
examples: Put the files in numerical order.
The numerical results agree with theory.
semantic_expansions: 数字的/数值的：以数目记下、按数计的
words.recall_hint: numer（数目）+ -ical → 以数目记下的

words.root_logic: in-（不）+ numer（数）+ -able（可…的）→ 数不过来的
words.origin: 拉丁语 innumerabilis（数不清的），来自 in-＋numerare（计数）← numerus
words.native_definition: too many to be counted
words.core_concept: more than the fingers can keep up with – 手指跟不上、点不完
words.core_image: 沙从指缝里漏下去，颗数根本跟不上
examples: He made innumerable attempts.
Innumerable stars filled the sky.
semantic_expansions: 数不清的/无数的：多到点不过来
words.recall_hint: in-（不）+ numer（数）+ -able → 数不过来的

words.root_logic: apo-（离开、退开）+ log（说辞）→ 退一步把话说开 → 认过的说辞
words.origin: 希腊语 apologia（辩解、答辩），来自 apo（离）＋logos（话语）
words.native_definition: a statement saying one is sorry for a fault
words.core_concept: stepping back and putting the fault into words – 退一步，把自己的不是说出口
words.core_image: 他往后退了半步，把话头接过来，承认是自己没办好
examples: He offered a sincere apology.
She made no apology for her view.
semantic_expansions: 道歉/歉意：退一步把自己的不是说出口
辩解：同样是把话说开，为自己申说
words.recall_hint: apo-（退开）+ log（说辞）→ 退一步把话说开

words.root_logic: apology（认过的说辞）+ -ise（使、行）→ 把那番话说出来
words.origin: 希腊语 apologizesthai（申说），来自 apologia ← apo＋logos
words.native_definition: to say that one is sorry for a fault
words.core_concept: putting the stepping-back into actual words – 把那退一步的意思真说出口
words.core_image: 他站起来，当着众人把那句话讲了出来
examples: He apologised for being late.
She refused to apologise.
semantic_expansions: 道歉/认错：把退一步认过的话说出口
words.recall_hint: apology（认过说辞）+ -ise → 把那番话说出口

words.root_logic: bio-（生命）+ -logy（条理、学科）→ 讲清生命之理的那门学问
words.origin: 希腊语 bios（生命）＋logos（条理）合成，19 世纪造词
words.native_definition: the scientific study of living things
words.core_concept: the account given of how living things work – 把活物的道理说清的那一套
words.core_image: 从一片叶脉讲到血液怎么走，条理一路排下来
examples: She teaches biology at the college.
Marine biology is his field.
semantic_expansions: 生物学：把活物的道理说出条理的那门学问
words.recall_hint: bio-（生命）+ -logy（条理）→ 讲清生命之理的学问

words.root_logic: positum（被放置的）→ 沿路安置的驿站 → 邮政；被安置的位子 → 职位
words.origin: 古法语 poste，来自意大利语 posta ← 拉丁语 posita/ponere（放置）；驿站本义是「沿途置马之处」。门柱义的 post 另出拉丁 postis，不在此族
words.native_definition: the system that carries letters; a job or official position
words.core_concept: a station set along the way, and by extension a place one is set in – 沿途安置的那一站，引申为人被安在的位子
words.core_image: 沿路每隔一程设一处，换马换人，信件一路递下去
examples: Send it by post, not by email.
She applied for a teaching post.
semantic_expansions: 邮政/邮件：靠沿途置站接力递送的那套
职位：人被安置进去的那个位子
words.recall_hint: positum（被放置的）→ 沿途置站 → 邮政；被安的位子 → 职位

words.root_logic: post（驿站接力）+ -age（费用）→ 走这套接力所付的钱
words.origin: 英语 postage，由 post ← 拉丁语 ponere（放置）加 -age 构成
words.native_definition: the money charged for sending something by post
words.core_concept: what one pays for the relay of stations to carry it – 为那套接力递送付的钱
words.core_image: 柜台上称过重量，贴上几枚小纸片才收下
examples: Postage costs have gone up again.
The price includes postage.
semantic_expansions: 邮费/邮资：为沿途接力递送所付的钱
words.recall_hint: post（驿站接力）+ -age（费用）→ 走这套递送付的钱

words.root_logic: positura（放置的样子）→ 身体摆放的姿态
words.origin: 法语 posture，来自意大利语 postura ← 拉丁语 positura（安放、位置）← ponere
words.native_definition: the way a person holds their body; an attitude taken up
words.core_concept: how the body is set and held in place – 身体被摆放、端住的那个样子
words.core_image: 他把背挺直、肩往后收，整个人的架子就稳住了
examples: Good posture prevents back pain.
The country took a defensive posture.
semantic_expansions: 姿势/体态：身体摆放端住的那个样子
姿态：对外摆出的那副架势
words.recall_hint: positura（放置的样子）→ 身体摆放端住的样子

words.root_logic: friskaz（未腐、不咸）→ 还保着刚来时那副样子
words.origin: 古英语 fersc（不咸的、未腐的），来自原始日耳曼语 *friskaz
words.native_definition: newly made or obtained; not stale; not salty
words.core_concept: keeping the state it had at the very start – 还守着刚出来时那个状态
words.core_image: 刚出炉的那一块掰开，热气往上冒
examples: Buy fresh bread every morning.
She went out for some fresh air.
semantic_expansions: 新鲜的：还是刚出来时那个样子
清新的：气息不闷不浊
淡水的：不带盐味的那种水
words.recall_hint: friskaz（未腐、不咸）→ 还守着刚来时的状态

words.root_logic: re-（重新）+ fresh（未走味）→ 把那副刚来时的样子找回来
words.origin: 古法语 refreschier（使变凉爽），由 re-＋fresche ← 法兰克语，同出 *friskaz
words.native_definition: to make someone feel less tired; to update something
words.core_concept: bringing a thing back to the state it started in – 把它拉回刚出来时那个状态
words.core_image: 洗过脸再坐下，人像换了一个
examples: A cold drink will refresh you.
Refresh the page to see the change.
semantic_expansions: 使恢复精神：把人拉回刚开始时那股劲
刷新：把画面拉回最新那一版
words.recall_hint: re-（重新）+ fresh（未走味）→ 拉回刚来时的状态

words.root_logic: refresh（使恢复）+ -ment → 使人回过劲来的那份东西
words.origin: 古法语 refreschissement，来自 refreschier ← 同出 *friskaz
words.native_definition: a light snack or drink; the act of making one feel less tired
words.core_concept: the small thing taken to get one's edge back – 拿来把劲头找回来的那一点东西
words.core_image: 半路歇脚，喝下那一杯，脚步又轻了
examples: Refreshments will be served at noon.
He paused for refreshment.
semantic_expansions: 点心/饮料：拿来把劲头找回的那点东西
恢复精神：找回劲头这件事本身
words.recall_hint: refresh（使恢复）+ -ment → 把劲头找回的那份东西

words.root_logic: re-（再）+ gard（看守）→ 再把目光投过去 → 看待；引申为敬重、问候
words.origin: 古法语 regarder（注视），由 re-＋garder（看守）← 法兰克语 *wardon
words.native_definition: to think of someone in a particular way; respect; greetings
words.core_concept: turning the eyes back onto a thing and holding a view of it – 把目光再投回去，并就此存下一个看法
words.core_image: 他把灯又转回那一处，端端地照了好一会儿
examples: She is regarded as an expert.
Give my regards to your parents.
semantic_expansions: 看待/认为：把目光投过去并存下一个看法
尊重：目光里带着分量
问候：把这份目光托人带过去
words.recall_hint: re-（再）+ gard（看守）→ 再把目光投过去

words.root_logic: regard（投目看待）的分词转介词 → 目光所对着的那件事
words.origin: 英语 regarding，regard 的现在分词转作介词
words.native_definition: about; concerning a particular matter
words.core_concept: pointing at the very thing the eyes are turned on – 直指目光正对着的那一桩
words.core_image: 灯光圈住的就是要谈的那一处，旁的都在暗里
examples: I wrote to him regarding the delay.
Regarding costs, we need more data.
semantic_expansions: 关于/至于：目光正对着的那一桩事
words.recall_hint: regard（投目）+ -ing → 目光所对着的那件事
collocations: regarding + n —— 关于、至于，书面正式，常用来引出信函话题
with/in regard to sth —— 同义的短语形式，公文里更常见
as regards sth —— 同义，注意 regards 带 s 且后面不加 to
regarding vs concerning —— 两者用法几乎相同，都限书面，前者中性、后者略硬

words.root_logic: regard（投目留意）+ -less（无…）→ 不往那边看 → 不顾、照样做
words.origin: 英语 regardless，由 regard＋-less（缺乏）构成
words.native_definition: without paying attention to something; anyway
words.core_concept: walking on without turning the eyes to what stands there – 眼睛不往那边转，照样往前走
words.core_image: 旁边有人喊他，他连头都没偏，脚步没停
examples: He went ahead regardless of the risk.
We must finish it regardless.
semantic_expansions: 不顾/不管：目光不往那边转
无论如何：不管那边有什么，照样进行
words.recall_hint: regard（投目留意）+ -less（无）→ 不往那边看，照样走
collocations: regardless of + n/doing —— 不管、无论，后接名词或动名词，不能直接接从句
主句 + regardless —— 副词单用置于句末，表照样进行，后面不接宾语
regardless of whether + 从句 —— 要接从句时得加 whether 或 what 这层壳
irregardless —— 非标准形式，正式写作里一律用 regardless

words.root_logic: regul（直尺）+ -ar（…的）→ 合着尺子来的 → 匀齐、按时
words.origin: 拉丁语 regularis（合于准尺的），来自 regula（直尺）
words.native_definition: happening at even intervals; usual; evenly shaped
words.core_concept: coming out even because each was laid to the same rod – 每一个都照同一把尺来，故彼此齐整
words.core_image: 砖缝一道道对齐，间距都照同一把尺量过
examples: He is a regular customer here.
Take regular breaks while working.
semantic_expansions: 规则的：处处合着同一把尺、匀齐
定期的/经常的：时间上也按尺子等距排开
words.recall_hint: regul（直尺）+ -ar → 合着同一把尺、故齐整

words.root_logic: regul（直尺）+ -ate（使…）→ 拿尺子把它校到位 → 调节、管束
words.origin: 晚期拉丁语 regulare（按准尺处理），来自 regula
words.native_definition: to control the rate or level of something; to govern by rules
words.core_concept: holding a thing to the rod and trimming it to fit – 拿尺子比着，把它修到合线
words.core_image: 旋钮往回拧半圈，指针就落回刻线上
examples: A thermostat regulates the temperature.
New laws regulate online sales.
semantic_expansions: 调节/控制：拿尺子比着把它校到合线
管理：用成套准绳去管束
words.recall_hint: regul（直尺）+ -ate → 拿尺子把它校到位

words.root_logic: regulate（按尺校准）+ -ion → 立成条款的那把尺，及校准这件事
words.origin: 晚期拉丁语 regulatio，来自 regulare ← regula
words.native_definition: an official rule; the act of controlling something
words.core_concept: the rod written down so all must be laid against it – 把那把尺写成条款，人人都得比着它
words.core_image: 墙上钉着一张表，每条都写明该照哪道线来
examples: Safety regulations must be followed.
The regulation of prices is disputed.
semantic_expansions: 规章/条例：写成条款、人人须比着的那把尺
调节：按尺校准这件事本身
words.recall_hint: regulate（按尺校准）+ -ion → 写成条款的那把尺

words.root_logic: hērōs（受尊崇的勇士）→ 因胆识受人传颂的人；也指故事里的主角
words.origin: 拉丁语 heros，来自希腊语 hērōs（半神的勇士）
words.native_definition: a person admired for courage; the chief character in a story
words.core_concept: the one whose deed the others keep retelling – 事迹被旁人一再讲起的那个人
words.core_image: 火堆边的人又提起他，那一关闯得众人服气
examples: He was hailed as a hero.
The hero of the novel is a doctor.
semantic_expansions: 英雄：因胆识被一再传颂的人
男主角：故事里被讲述的那个中心人物
words.recall_hint: hērōs（受尊崇的勇士）→ 事迹被一再讲起的人

words.root_logic: hero（被传颂者）+ -ic（…的）→ 够得上被传颂的那种
words.origin: 希腊语 hērōikos（属于勇士的），来自 hērōs
words.native_definition: very brave; showing great courage
words.core_concept: of the kind that gets retold afterwards – 属于事后会被人讲起的那一种
words.core_image: 他冲进去那一下，后来被人反复说起
examples: She made a heroic effort to save him.
It was a heroic act of defiance.
semantic_expansions: 英勇的/英雄的：够得上事后被人传颂的那种
words.recall_hint: hero（被传颂者）+ -ic → 够得上被传颂的那种

words.root_logic: hero（被传颂者）+ -ine（阴性）→ 女性的那一位；也指故事女主角
words.origin: 希腊语 hērōinē（女勇士），hērōs 的阴性形
words.native_definition: a woman admired for courage; the chief female character in a story
words.core_concept: the woman whose deed the others keep retelling – 事迹被旁人一再讲起的那位女性
words.core_image: 那家人至今说起她夜里背人出来的事
examples: She became a national heroine.
The heroine escapes in the last act.
semantic_expansions: 女英雄：因胆识被传颂的女性
女主角：故事里被讲述的那位女性中心人物
words.recall_hint: hero（被传颂者）+ -ine（阴性）→ 女性的那一位

words.root_logic: jour（日）+ -nal → 按日记下的册子 → 日志；引申为定期出的刊物
words.origin: 古法语 jornal（每日的记事），来自拉丁语 diurnalis ← diurnus（一日的）
words.native_definition: a daily record of events; a magazine on a special subject
words.core_concept: the book that takes one entry per day – 一天记一笔的那本册子
words.core_image: 每晚睡前写一行，一年下来那本厚了一截
examples: She keeps a journal of her travels.
The paper appeared in a medical journal.
semantic_expansions: 日志/日记：按日记下的那本册子
期刊：同样按期出的那类刊物
words.recall_hint: jour（日）+ -nal → 一天记一笔的那本册子

words.root_logic: journal（按日的刊）+ -ist（司此业者）→ 替这类刊物采写的人
words.origin: 法语 journaliste，来自 journal ← 拉丁语 diurnus
words.native_definition: a person who writes news for papers, radio, or television
words.core_concept: the one who fills the daily pages – 把那按日出的版面填起来的人
words.core_image: 他赶在天黑前把稿子发回去，好赶上明早那一版
examples: The journalist interviewed both sides.
She trained as a journalist.
semantic_expansions: 记者/新闻工作者：替按日出的刊物采写的人
words.recall_hint: journal（按日的刊）+ -ist → 替它采写的人

words.root_logic: jour（日）+ -ney → 本指一天能走完的路程，后泛指整趟行程
words.origin: 古法语 jornee（一天的路程、一天的活），来自 jour（日）← 拉丁语 diurnus
words.native_definition: an act of travelling from one place to another
words.core_concept: as far as one gets between sunup and dark, extended to the whole trip – 天亮到天黑能走的那一段，后指整趟
words.core_image: 清早动身，日头落时到了下一个镇子
examples: The journey takes about three hours.
They set out on a long journey.
semantic_expansions: 旅程/行程：本指一天走完的路，后指整趟路途
旅行：走这段路这件事
words.recall_hint: jour（日）+ -ney → 一天能走完的路，引申为整趟

words.root_logic: metron（量度）→ 定作标准的那一段长；诗里指音步的节拍
words.origin: 法语 mètre，来自希腊语 metron（量具、音步）
words.native_definition: a unit of length equal to 100 centimetres; the rhythm of verse
words.core_concept: the one length agreed on as the yardstick – 公认拿来当准的那一段长
words.core_image: 地上那道标线到下一道，正好是定死的一段
examples: The room is four metres wide.
The poem is written in strict metre.
semantic_expansions: 米：公认作准的那一段长
韵律：诗句里按拍子量出的节奏
words.recall_hint: metron（量度）→ 定作标准的那一段长

words.root_logic: metr（量度）+ -ic（…的）→ 按这套尺度来的
words.origin: 法语 métrique，来自希腊语 metrikos（关于量度的）← metron
words.native_definition: relating to the system based on metres and grams
words.core_concept: belonging to the one agreed set of measures – 属于那一套公认尺度的
words.core_image: 秤和尺换成同一套标法，各处报出的数才对得上
examples: Britain uses metric units now.
Convert the figures to metric.
semantic_expansions: 公制的/度量的：按那一套公认尺度来的
words.recall_hint: metr（量度）+ -ic → 按这套尺度来的

words.root_logic: sym-（syn- 一同）+ metr（量度）+ -y → 两边照同一尺量得一样 → 对称
words.origin: 希腊语 symmetria（同一尺度、匀称），来自 syn（一同）＋metron（量度）
words.native_definition: the quality of having two halves that match exactly
words.core_concept: both sides coming out equal when laid to the same measure – 拿同一把尺量两边，数一样
words.core_image: 蝴蝶合起翅膀，左右两片严丝合缝地叠在一起
examples: The building has perfect symmetry.
There is a pleasing symmetry to the design.
semantic_expansions: 对称/匀称：两边照同一尺量出来一样
words.recall_hint: sym-（一同）+ metr（量度）→ 两边量得一样

words.root_logic: placere（使中意）→ 让对方合意；作副词时是「若合你意」的省说，即请
words.origin: 古法语 plaisir（使满意），来自拉丁语 placere（使中意、讨喜）
words.native_definition: to make someone glad; used politely to ask for something
words.core_concept: bringing a thing round to what the other finds agreeable – 把事情做到对方合意那一步
words.core_image: 他把茶端到手边，对方眉头一松
examples: It pleased her to hear the news.
Please close the door behind you.
semantic_expansions: 使高兴/使满意：做到对方合意那一步
请：说话时以「若合你意」相求
words.recall_hint: placere（使中意）→ 做到对方合意；「若合你意」即请

words.root_logic: please（使合意）+ -ant（正…的）→ 正让人合意的
words.origin: 古法语 plaisant（讨喜的），plaisir 的现在分词 ← 拉丁语 placere
words.native_definition: enjoyable; giving a feeling of satisfaction
words.core_concept: of the kind that sits well with whoever meets it – 遇上的人都觉得受用的那种
words.core_image: 屋里温度刚好，坐下来谁都不想起身
examples: We had a pleasant evening together.
She has a pleasant manner.
semantic_expansions: 令人愉快的/宜人的：正让人合意受用的
友善的：待人的样子也让人合意
words.recall_hint: please（使合意）+ -ant → 正让人合意的

words.root_logic: please（使合意）+ -ure（名词）→ 合意时心里那份受用
words.origin: 古法语 plaisir（快乐），本是动词不定式用作名词 ← 拉丁语 placere
words.native_definition: a feeling of happy satisfaction; something that gives this
words.core_concept: what one feels when a thing lands just right – 事情正合意时心里那份受用
words.core_image: 他听完往椅背上一靠，脸上的紧绷散了
examples: Reading gives him great pleasure.
It is a pleasure to meet you.
semantic_expansions: 乐趣/愉快：正合意时心里那份受用
荣幸：把此事当作合意之事来说的客气话
words.recall_hint: please（使合意）+ -ure → 合意时心里那份受用

words.root_logic: consuetudo（惯常）→ 一地长年照做的成例；按成例缴的税即关税一义
words.origin: 古法语 costume，来自拉丁语 consuetudo（惯常）← consuescere（习惯于）
words.native_definition: a way of behaving long established in a place; duties paid on imports
words.core_concept: what a place has done so long that it now counts as proper – 一地做久了、如今被认作该那么做的事
words.core_image: 每年这天各家都摆一样的供品，谁也说不清是从哪辈起的
examples: It is a local custom to bring flowers.
The goods were held at customs.
semantic_expansions: 习俗/惯例：一地长年照做、被认作该如此的事
关税：旧时按成例向过境货物征收的那笔
words.recall_hint: consuetudo（惯常）→ 做久成例；按例缴的税即关税

words.root_logic: custom（成例）+ -ary（…的）→ 照成例来的、素来如此的
words.origin: 拉丁语 consuetudinarius（依惯例的），来自 consuetudo
words.native_definition: according to what is usually done
words.core_concept: following the groove already worn in – 顺着早被踩出来的那道沟走
words.core_image: 他照素来的做法先斟茶再落座，一步没差
examples: It is customary to tip the driver.
He took his customary seat by the window.
semantic_expansions: 习惯上的/惯常的：顺着早已踩出的那道沟来
words.recall_hint: custom（成例）+ -ary → 顺着旧沟、素来如此

words.root_logic: custom（惯常照顾）+ -er（人）→ 惯常上门买东西的那个人
words.origin: 英语 customer，来自 custom（惯常光顾）← 拉丁语 consuetudo
words.native_definition: a person who buys goods or services from a shop or business
words.core_concept: the one who keeps coming back to the same counter – 一趟趟回到同一个柜台的那个人
words.core_image: 掌柜一抬头就知道他要哪一样，来的回数太多了
examples: The shop has many regular customers.
A customer complained about the delay.
semantic_expansions: 顾客/客户：惯常回到同一处买东西的人
words.recall_hint: custom（惯常光顾）+ -er → 一趟趟回来的那个人

words.root_logic: favere（善待、偏袒）→ 给某一边的好意；也指为人做的那件方便事
words.origin: 古法语 favour，来自拉丁语 favor（好意、青睐）← favere
words.native_definition: kind approval or support; a kind act done for someone
words.core_concept: the good will turned toward one side – 朝某一边送去的那份好意
words.core_image: 他把手一挥，众人的掌声全往那一边去了
examples: Could you do me a favor?
The plan found favor with the board.
semantic_expansions: 恩惠：为人做的那件方便事
赞成/偏爱：心朝某一边送去的好意
words.recall_hint: favere（善待偏袒）→ 朝某一边送去的好意

words.root_logic: favor（好意）+ -able（可…的）→ 带着好意的、于我有利的
words.origin: 拉丁语 favorabilis（讨喜的、有利的），来自 favor ← favere
words.native_definition: showing approval; helpful and likely to bring advantage
words.core_concept: with the wind leaning one's own way – 风向偏在自己这一边
words.core_image: 风顺着帆往前推，船比预定快了半日
examples: The weather was favorable for sailing.
She gave a favorable reply.
semantic_expansions: 赞同的：带着好意的
有利的/顺利的：势头偏在自己这一边
words.recall_hint: favor（好意）+ -able → 好意所向、势头偏向自己

words.root_logic: favor（偏爱）+ -ite（受…的）→ 得那份偏爱最多的
words.origin: 意大利语 favorito（受宠者），来自 favorire ← 拉丁语 favere
words.native_definition: liked more than all others of the same kind
words.core_concept: the one the leaning always settles on – 那份偏心总落在它头上
words.core_image: 一柜子的杯子，他伸手拿的永远是同一只
examples: This is my favorite song.
Blue is her favorite color.
semantic_expansions: 最喜欢的/最爱的：偏心总落在它头上的那一个
words.recall_hint: favor（偏爱）+ -ite → 偏心总落在它头上

words.root_logic: pingere（涂色）→ 敷到面上的那种颜色；也指作画这件事
words.origin: 古法语 peint（涂过的），peindre 的过去分词 ← 拉丁语 pingere
words.native_definition: coloured liquid put on a surface; to make a picture with colour
words.core_concept: the colour laid on, and the laying of it – 敷上去的那层色，以及敷色这件事
words.core_image: 刷子在板上来回一趟，后头的木纹就看不见了
examples: The door needs a fresh coat of paint.
She paints in oils.
semantic_expansions: 油漆/颜料：敷到面上的那层色
绘画：把色敷成图这件事
words.recall_hint: pingere（涂色）→ 敷到面上的那层色及敷色之事

words.root_logic: paint（敷色）+ -er（人）→ 干敷色这活的人：作画的或刷漆的
words.origin: 英语 painter，来自 paint ← 拉丁语 pingere
words.native_definition: a person who paints pictures, or who paints buildings as a job
words.core_concept: the one whose work is laying colour on – 以敷色为活计的那个人
words.core_image: 他蹲在梯子下调色，桶边一圈干了的痕
examples: The painter finished the portrait.
We hired a painter for the kitchen.
semantic_expansions: 画家：以敷色作画为业的人
油漆工：以敷色刷面为业的人
words.recall_hint: paint（敷色）+ -er → 干敷色这活的人

words.root_logic: paint（敷色）+ -ing → 敷色所成之物，及敷色这门事
words.origin: 英语 painting，来自 paint 的动名词 ← 拉丁语 pingere
words.native_definition: a picture made with paint; the art or act of painting
words.core_concept: what the laid colour has become – 那层色最后成了的样子
words.core_image: 框子里那一幅挂上墙，颜色厚得能看出笔痕
examples: The painting hangs in the hall.
She studied painting in Paris.
semantic_expansions: 画作：敷色所成的那一幅
绘画：敷色成图这门事本身
words.recall_hint: paint（敷色）+ -ing → 敷色所成之物与其事

words.root_logic: ex-（出来）+ peri（试）+ -ence → 亲身试过后留下来的那点本事
words.origin: 拉丁语 experientia（试验所得），来自 experiri（亲身试过）
words.native_definition: knowledge or skill gained by doing something; an event one lives through
words.core_concept: what stays with one after having tried it – 试过之后留在身上的那点东西
words.core_image: 手在水里试过几回，伸进去就知道够不够烫
examples: She has years of teaching experience.
It was a frightening experience.
semantic_expansions: 经验：亲身试过后留下的本事
体验/经历：亲身走过的那一遭
words.recall_hint: ex-（出来）+ peri（试）→ 试过后留在身上的东西

words.root_logic: ex-（出来）+ peri（试）+ -ment → 特意安排的一次试，看会出什么
words.origin: 拉丁语 experimentum（试验、检验），来自 experiri
words.native_definition: a scientific test done to find out what happens
words.core_concept: a trying set up on purpose to see what comes out – 特意摆开来试一次，看结果怎样
words.core_image: 两只杯子只差一样条件，摆在一处等着看分别
examples: They ran the experiment three times.
The experiment confirmed her theory.
semantic_expansions: 实验/试验：特意安排的一次试，用来看结果
words.recall_hint: ex-（出来）+ peri（试）+ -ment → 特意摆开试一次

words.root_logic: experiment（试一次）+ -al（…的）→ 尚在试的、拿来试的
words.origin: 英语 experimental，来自 experiment ← 拉丁语 experiri
words.native_definition: based on new methods not yet proved; used for testing
words.core_concept: still at the trying stage, not yet settled – 还在试的阶段，尚未定下来
words.core_image: 那台机器还摆在台上，参数天天改
examples: The treatment is still experimental.
They set up an experimental farm.
semantic_expansions: 实验的/试验性的：还在试、尚未定下来的
words.recall_hint: experiment（试一次）+ -al → 还在试的阶段

words.root_logic: planus（平面）→ 画在平面上的图样 → 打算、方案；动词即谋划
words.origin: 法语 plan（平面图），来自拉丁语 planus（平的）
words.native_definition: a detailed proposal for doing something; a drawing seen from above
words.core_concept: the layout drawn flat before anything is built – 动工之前先摊在平面上画出来的那套
words.core_image: 桌上铺开一张图，每一处都先在纸上定好位置
examples: We made a plan for the weekend.
The architect showed us the floor plan.
semantic_expansions: 计划/方案：动工前先在平面上定下的那套
平面图：从上方看、摊平画出的那张图
words.recall_hint: planus（平面）→ 先摊平画出来的那套

words.root_logic: planus（平的）→ 平面；机翼是平展的面，故 aeroplane 截短为 plane；刨子是找平的工具
words.origin: 拉丁语 planus（平的）；飞机义来自 aeroplane（aer 空气＋planus 平面）的截短
words.native_definition: a flat surface; an aircraft; a tool for smoothing wood
words.core_concept: a face with no rise in it, and things named for such a face – 没有起伏的那个面，以及以此得名之物
words.core_image: 推子沿着木头走过去，凸起的一层卷成花掉在地上
examples: Draw two lines on the same plane.
Our plane landed on time.
semantic_expansions: 平面：没有起伏的那个面
飞机：因平展机翼得名（aeroplane 截短）
刨子：把面找平的那件工具
words.recall_hint: planus（平的）→ 无起伏的面，及因此得名之物

words.root_logic: ex-（出来）+ plan（平）+ -ation → 把褶子摊平摊开 → 讲清楚的那番话
words.origin: 拉丁语 explanatio（阐明），来自 explanare（摊平、讲清）← ex＋planus
words.native_definition: a statement that makes something clear or gives a reason
words.core_concept: smoothing the folds out until the whole thing lies plain – 把褶皱一一摊开，整件事平平摆着
words.core_image: 他把揉皱的那张纸一点点抹平，字才认得出来
examples: He gave no explanation for the delay.
Her explanation satisfied everyone.
semantic_expansions: 解释/说明：把褶皱摊平、让人看清那番话
解释的理由：摊平之后露出来的原委
words.recall_hint: ex-（出来）+ plan（平）→ 把褶子摊开讲清

words.root_logic: planta（幼苗）→ 长在土里的活物；动词是把苗按进土里。厂房义由「设置安放」引申
words.origin: 古英语 plante 借自拉丁语 planta（幼苗），动词 plantare（栽种）
words.native_definition: a living thing that grows in soil; a factory; to put in the ground to grow
words.core_concept: the shoot set into soil, and by extension anything set in place to work – 按进土里的那株苗，引申为安置到位以运作之物
words.core_image: 苗根塞进坑里，土一踩实，叶子第二天就抬起来了
examples: Water the plants every morning.
They plant rice in early summer.
semantic_expansions: 植物：按进土里长起来的活物
种植：把苗按进土里这件事
工厂：由「安置到位以运作」引申而来的厂房
words.recall_hint: planta（幼苗）→ 按进土里的苗；引申为安置到位之物

words.root_logic: plant（栽种）+ -ation → 成片栽种的那块地
words.origin: 拉丁语 plantatio（栽种），来自 plantare ← planta
words.native_definition: a large area where crops such as tea or rubber are grown
words.core_concept: ground where the setting-in was done row upon row – 一垄接一垄都按进苗去的那片地
words.core_image: 一垄接一垄望不到头，每株间距都一样
examples: He works on a tea plantation.
The plantation covers two hundred acres.
semantic_expansions: 种植园/人造林：成片按苗栽下的那块地
words.recall_hint: plant（栽种）+ -ation → 成片栽下苗的那块地

words.root_logic: trans-（转移）+ plant（栽）→ 起出来栽到别处 → 移栽；医学上指移植器官
words.origin: 拉丁语 transplantare（移栽），来自 trans＋plantare ← planta
words.native_definition: to move a plant to another place; to move an organ into another body
words.core_concept: lifting what was set in one spot and setting it into another – 把按在这处的起出来，按到那处去
words.core_image: 带着根土整株起出来，挪到新坑里再踩实
examples: We transplanted the seedlings today.
He received a heart transplant.
semantic_expansions: 移栽：把苗起出来栽到别处
移植：同一动作用在器官上
words.recall_hint: trans-（转移）+ plant（栽）→ 起出来按到别处

words.root_logic: polit（城邦公事）+ -ics（…之学/之事）→ 争夺与处置公共事务这一摊
words.origin: 希腊语 politika（城邦事务），来自 politikos ← polis（城邦）
words.native_definition: the activities of government and of gaining power in it
words.core_concept: the wrangling over what the whole city should do – 围着「全城该怎么办」争出来的那一摊事
words.core_image: 广场中央吵成一片，各方都想让自己那套算数
examples: He went into politics at thirty.
Office politics wore her down.
semantic_expansions: 政治/政治学：处置公共事务这一摊及其学问
权术：为在其中占上风而使的手段
words.recall_hint: polit（城邦公事）+ -ics → 争夺处置公事这一摊

words.root_logic: polit（城邦公事）+ -ical（…的）→ 与公共事务、权力相关的
words.origin: 希腊语 politikos（关于城邦的），来自 polis
words.native_definition: relating to government or public affairs
words.core_concept: belonging to what the whole city argues over – 属于全城要争议的那类事
words.core_image: 这件事一摆上广场，各方立刻按立场分了边
examples: It became a political issue overnight.
She has strong political views.
semantic_expansions: 政治的/政党的：属于城邦公共事务与权力的
words.recall_hint: polit（城邦公事）+ -ical → 属于公共事务的

words.root_logic: politic（城邦公事）+ -ian（司此业者）→ 以处置公共事务为业的人
words.origin: 英语 politician，来自 politic ← 希腊语 polis
words.native_definition: a person whose job is in government or seeking elected office
words.core_concept: the one who stands in the square and speaks for a side – 站到广场上替一方开口的那个人
words.core_image: 他登上台阶开口，底下的人分头喝彩与嘘声
examples: The politician avoided the question.
She is a career politician.
semantic_expansions: 政治家/政客：以处置公共事务为业、替一方发声的人
words.recall_hint: politic（城邦公事）+ -ian → 以处置公事为业的人

words.root_logic: prae-（在前）+ sent（在）→ 正在眼前的 → 出席的、当下的；引申为送到眼前之物
words.origin: 拉丁语 praesens（在眼前的），praeesse（在前）的现在分词
words.native_definition: in this place now; happening now; a gift given to someone
words.core_concept: standing here where one can be seen – 就站在这儿、看得见的那个状态
words.core_image: 点到名字，那人在后排应了一声抬起手
examples: All the students were present.
She gave him a birthday present.
semantic_expansions: 出席的：人就在眼前这儿
现在的：时间上正在眼前的这一段
礼物：拿到人眼前递过去的那件
words.recall_hint: prae-（在前）+ sent（在）→ 正在眼前的

words.root_logic: present（在眼前）+ -ence → 人在此处这件事；引申为身上那股压得住场的气派
words.origin: 拉丁语 praesentia（在场），来自 praesens ← praeesse
words.native_definition: the state of being in a place; an impressive manner
words.core_concept: the fact that one is here rather than away – 人在此而不在别处这个事实
words.core_image: 他一进门，满屋的说话声就低了半度
examples: Your presence is required at the meeting.
She has real stage presence.
semantic_expansions: 出席/存在：人或物就在此处这件事
气度：在场时压得住场面的那股劲
words.recall_hint: present（在眼前）+ -ence → 人在此处这件事

words.root_logic: present（当下）+ -ly → 就眼下而言；也表「过一会儿就」
words.origin: 英语 presently，来自 present ← 拉丁语 praeesse
words.native_definition: at the present time; soon, after a short while
words.core_concept: at the point one is standing on, or just past it – 就在所站的这一刻，或刚过这一刻
words.core_image: 他说了句稍等，转身进屋，没几步又折回来了
examples: He is presently working abroad.
The doctor will see you presently.
semantic_expansions: 目前：就眼下这一刻而言
不久/很快：刚过眼下这一刻就到
words.recall_hint: present（当下）+ -ly → 就眼下这一刻，或刚过这一刻
collocations: be presently + doing sth —— 目前正在，与进行时连用是美式常用的那一义
will + do sth + presently —— 不久就会，与将来时连用是英式旧义，位置多在句末
Presently, + 主句 —— 句首时是英式叙述里的过了一会儿，与 soon 同义

words.root_logic: pro-（众人前）+ fess（承认）+ -ion → 当众声明自己所执的那门业 → 职业
words.origin: 拉丁语 professio（公开声明、所执之业），来自 profiteri
words.native_definition: a paid job needing special training; an open declaration
words.core_concept: the calling one names aloud as one's own – 当众说出「我干这一行」的那门业
words.core_image: 他报出自己那一行，众人便知他受过哪套训练
examples: She entered the legal profession.
He made a profession of loyalty.
semantic_expansions: 职业/专业：当众声明所执、需专门训练的那一行
声明：把立场当众说出口这件事
words.recall_hint: pro-（众人前）+ fess（承认）→ 当众说出所执的那门业

words.root_logic: profess（当众讲明）+ -or（人）→ 在讲堂上当众讲学的人
words.origin: 拉丁语 professor（公开讲授者），来自 profiteri
words.native_definition: a teacher of the highest rank at a university
words.core_concept: the one who stands up and expounds before all – 站到众人前讲说的那个人
words.core_image: 他站上讲台，把那套道理从头讲给满堂人听
examples: The professor published a new study.
She was made professor at forty.
semantic_expansions: 教授：在讲堂上当众讲学、位阶最高的教师
words.recall_hint: profess（当众讲明）+ -or → 站到众人前讲说的人

words.root_logic: pro-（沿着）+ fil（线）+ -e → 沿边描出的那条线 → 侧影；引申为人物概况
words.origin: 意大利语 profilo（侧影、轮廓），来自 profilare ← pro＋filum（线）
words.native_definition: a side view of someone's face; a short description of a person
words.core_concept: the single line left when an edge is traced – 沿着边描一遍后剩下的那条线
words.core_image: 灯打在墙上，只剩一条贴着脸缘的黑边
examples: He was photographed in profile.
Her profile appeared in the magazine.
semantic_expansions: 侧面/轮廓：沿边描出的那条线
简介：把人的要点勾出一条轮廓
words.recall_hint: pro-（沿着）+ fil（线）→ 沿边描出的那条线

words.root_logic: pro-（合乎）+ sper（所盼）→ 事情合着所盼往好处走 → 兴旺
words.origin: 拉丁语 prosperare（使顺利），来自 prosperus（合所盼的）← pro＋spes（希望）
words.native_definition: to succeed and do well, especially financially
words.core_concept: moving along just as one had hoped it would – 一路照着所盼的样子往前走
words.core_image: 铺子头一年只两三个客，第三年桌子摆到了门外
examples: The business prospered under her care.
Few crops prosper in dry soil.
semantic_expansions: 兴旺/繁荣/成功：事情顺着所盼一路往好处走
words.recall_hint: pro-（合乎）+ sper（所盼）→ 照所盼的样子走下去

words.root_logic: prosper（兴旺）+ -ity → 兴旺这个状态 → 繁荣、富足
words.origin: 拉丁语 prosperitas（顺利、昌盛），来自 prosperus
words.native_definition: the state of being successful and having plenty of money
words.core_concept: the condition of things having gone as hoped – 事情已照所盼走成的那个局面
words.core_image: 满仓的粮堆到梁下，院里车马进出不断
examples: The country enjoyed years of prosperity.
They shared in the town's prosperity.
semantic_expansions: 繁荣/富足/兴旺：事情已照所盼走成的那个局面
words.recall_hint: prosper（兴旺）+ -ity → 已照所盼走成的局面

words.root_logic: prosper（兴旺）+ -ous（…的）→ 正处在兴旺里的
words.origin: 拉丁语 prosperus（顺利的、合所盼的），来自 pro＋spes
words.native_definition: successful and having plenty of money
words.core_concept: standing in the state that hope aimed at – 正站在所盼的那个局面里
words.core_image: 他家门前石阶新换过，仓房也添了一间
examples: It is a prosperous farming region.
He came from a prosperous family.
semantic_expansions: 繁荣的/富裕的/成功的：正处在所盼那个局面里的
words.recall_hint: prosper（兴旺）+ -ous → 正处在所盼局面里的

words.root_logic: quart（第四）+ -er → 四份中的一份；引申为一年的四分之一、城中一区
words.origin: 古法语 quartier，来自拉丁语 quartarius（四分之一）← quartus
words.native_definition: one of four equal parts; three months of a year; a district of a town
words.core_concept: the single piece left when a whole is cut in four – 整体切成四块后取的那一块
words.core_image: 横竖各一刀，取走其中一块，手里正好是整张的一份
examples: Cut the apple into quarters.
Sales rose in the final quarter.
semantic_expansions: 四分之一：整体分四份后的一份
季度：一年切成四份后的一份
地区：城中划出的那一块
words.recall_hint: quart（第四）+ -er → 整体切四块后的那一块

words.root_logic: quartus（第四）→ 一加仑的四分之一，作容量单位
words.origin: 古法语 quarte，来自拉丁语 quarta（第四份）← quartus
words.native_definition: a unit of liquid measure equal to a quarter of a gallon
words.core_concept: the measure that is one of four in a gallon – 一加仑分作四份中的一份
words.core_image: 壶里的奶倒满四回，正好把大桶灌平
examples: Add a quart of milk to the pan.
The recipe calls for two quarts of water.
semantic_expansions: 夸脱：等于一加仑四分之一的容量单位
words.recall_hint: quartus（第四）→ 一加仑的四分之一

words.root_logic: quarter（季度）+ -ly（每…的）→ 每季一次的
words.origin: 英语 quarterly，来自 quarter ← 拉丁语 quartus
words.native_definition: happening or produced once every three months
words.core_concept: coming round once in each of the four parts of a year – 一年四份里各来一回
words.core_image: 账本一年结四回，每回隔三个月
examples: The company files quarterly reports.
She receives a quarterly payment.
semantic_expansions: 季度的/每季一次的：一年四份里各来一回
words.recall_hint: quarter（季度）+ -ly → 一年四份里各来一回

words.root_logic: con-（仔细）+ sider（星象）→ 像看星象那样反复审量 → 考虑；引申为认为
words.origin: 拉丁语 considerare（细察星象、审量），来自 con＋sidus（星）
words.native_definition: to think about something carefully; to regard in a certain way
words.core_concept: going over the signs one by one before settling – 定夺前把各处一一对过
words.core_image: 他抬头把满天的星位挨个对过，才开口说话
examples: Please consider my proposal.
She is considered an expert.
semantic_expansions: 考虑/顾及：像对星位那样一一审量
认为：审量之后得出的看法
words.recall_hint: con-（仔细）+ sider（星象）→ 像看星象那样反复审量

words.root_logic: consider（审量）+ -able（值得…的）→ 值得专门审量的 → 相当大的
words.origin: 中世纪拉丁语 considerabilis（值得注意的），来自 considerare
words.native_definition: great in amount, extent, or importance
words.core_concept: big enough to be worth going over carefully – 大到值得专门拿来审量一遍
words.core_image: 报上来的数目不小，掌事的把册子翻了两遍
examples: They spent a considerable sum.
She has considerable influence here.
semantic_expansions: 相当大的/可观的：大到值得专门审量一遍
重要的：因分量重而须审量
words.recall_hint: consider（审量）+ -able → 大到值得专门审量

words.root_logic: consider（审量）+ -ation → 审量这件事；也指审量时须顾到的那一项、体谅
words.origin: 拉丁语 consideratio（细察、审量），来自 considerare
words.native_definition: careful thought; a factor to be taken into account; thoughtfulness
words.core_concept: the going-over itself, and each thing weighed in it – 审量这件事本身，及其中每一项须顾到的
words.core_image: 他把册子摊在灯下，一条条对过去，末了还问了句家里方便不方便
examples: The plan is under consideration.
He showed great consideration for others.
semantic_expansions: 考虑：审量这件事本身
考虑因素：审量时须顾到的那一项
体谅：顾到旁人处境的那份心
words.recall_hint: consider（审量）+ -ation → 审量这件事及所顾各项

words.root_logic: re-（再）+ stor（立起）→ 把倒下的重新立回原样 → 修复、恢复
words.origin: 古法语 restorer，来自拉丁语 restaurare（重新立起）← re＋staurare
words.native_definition: to bring something back to its former state; to give back
words.core_concept: putting a thing back up as it stood before – 把它照原先那样重新立回去
words.core_image: 散架的柜子一块块拼回去，扶正后又能立稳
examples: They restored the old church.
Power was restored within the hour.
semantic_expansions: 修复/恢复：把它照原先那样重新立回去
归还：把原属他人之物放回原处
words.recall_hint: re-（再）+ stor（立起）→ 照原样重新立回去

words.root_logic: instaurare（备置）→ 备下存着的物资 → 储备；存放之处即店铺
words.origin: 古法语 estor（储备、供给），来自 instaurare（备置、重立）
words.native_definition: a supply kept for future use; a shop; to keep for later
words.core_concept: what is laid in and kept standing ready – 备下来、一直搁着待用的那批东西
words.core_image: 米袋一层层码到墙根，够撑过整个冬天
examples: Store the grain in a dry place.
She works at a grocery store.
semantic_expansions: 储存/储备：备下搁着待用的那批东西
商店：存放货物待售的那个处所
words.recall_hint: instaurare（备置）→ 备下待用之物；存物之处即店

words.root_logic: store（备存）+ -age → 存放这件事，及存放的地方与费用
words.origin: 英语 storage，来自 store ← 拉丁语 instaurare
words.native_definition: the keeping of things until needed; space for this
words.core_concept: the keeping-in-readiness, and the room it takes – 备着待用这件事，及所占的地方
words.core_image: 阁楼腾出半间，箱子摞起来到房梁
examples: We put the boxes into storage.
The phone has 128GB of storage.
semantic_expansions: 储存/存放：备着待用这件事
储藏空间：为此腾出的那块地方
words.recall_hint: store（备存）+ -age → 备着待用这件事及其处所

words.root_logic: re-（回）+ ceive（接住）→ 把递来的接到手里
words.origin: 古法语 receivre，来自拉丁语 recipere（收取）← re＋capere（抓取）
words.native_definition: to be given or sent something; to take delivery of
words.core_concept: closing the hand on what has been sent one's way – 把送到跟前的东西接进手里
words.core_image: 门口递进来一个包裹，他伸手接过，签了字
examples: She received a letter this morning.
The hotel receives guests all year.
semantic_expansions: 收到/接受：把送来的接进手里
接待：把来客接进门
words.recall_hint: re-（回）+ ceive（接住）→ 把递来的接到手里

words.root_logic: de-（脱开正道）+ ceive（接住）→ 让人接住的是假的 → 欺骗
words.origin: 古法语 deceivre，来自拉丁语 decipere（诱骗）← de＋capere（抓取）
words.native_definition: to make someone believe something that is not true
words.core_concept: handing over something false for the other to take as real – 递过去一件假的，让对方当真接下
words.core_image: 他把掺了水的那壶递过去，对方没尝出来
examples: He deceived his own family for years.
Do not let appearances deceive you.
semantic_expansions: 欺骗/蒙骗：递过去假的让人当真接下
误导：使人接住的判断偏了道
words.recall_hint: de-（脱开正道）+ ceive（接住）→ 让人接下假的

words.root_logic: con-（收进）+ ceive（接住）→ 接进来在里头成形 → 构想；亦指怀胎
words.origin: 古法语 conceivre，来自拉丁语 concipere（收纳、孕育）← con＋capere
words.native_definition: to form an idea in the mind; to become pregnant
words.core_concept: taking a thing in and letting it take shape inside – 接进来，让它在里头长成形
words.core_image: 那个念头一进脑子就慢慢长出了轮廓
examples: She conceived the plan on the train.
They could not conceive a child.
semantic_expansions: 构想/设想：接进来在心里长成形
怀孕：同一个「接进来使成形」用在孕育上
words.recall_hint: con-（收进）+ ceive（接住）→ 接进来在里头成形

words.root_logic: per-（彻底）+ ceive（接住）→ 把外来讯息完整接住 → 察觉
words.origin: 古法语 perceivre，来自拉丁语 percipere（察知）← per＋capere
words.native_definition: to become aware of something through the senses; to regard in a certain way
words.core_concept: catching what comes in fully enough to know it – 把送进来的接得够全，于是知道了
words.core_image: 风里那点异味被他一下接住，立刻回头看
examples: She perceived a change in his tone.
He is perceived as a fair judge.
semantic_expansions: 察觉/感知：把外来讯息接得够全而知晓
看待：接住之后认定成某个样子
words.recall_hint: per-（彻底）+ ceive（接住）→ 把讯息接得够全

words.root_logic: capt（抓取）+ -ure → 一把抓到手里 → 捕获；引申为把景象留住
words.origin: 法语 capture，来自拉丁语 captura（捕获）← capere（抓取）
words.native_definition: to catch a person or animal; to record or preserve something
words.core_concept: closing the hand on what was loose – 把在外头的一把抓进手里
words.core_image: 网一收，方才还在跳的那条被兜住了
examples: The escaped animal was captured at dawn.
The photo captured her expression.
semantic_expansions: 捕获/夺取：一把抓到手里
捕捉：把稍纵即逝的景象留住
words.recall_hint: capt（抓取）+ -ure → 一把抓到手里

words.root_logic: capt（抓取）+ -ive → 已被抓住、脱不了身的那个
words.origin: 拉丁语 captivus（被俘的），来自 captus（capere 的过去分词）
words.native_definition: a person kept as a prisoner; held and unable to leave
words.core_concept: the one already in the closed hand – 已经落在合起来那只手里的人
words.core_image: 绳子系在木桩上，那人整夜没能挪出那个圈
examples: The captives were released at last.
He was held captive for a month.
semantic_expansions: 俘虏/被囚者：已被抓住、脱不了身的那个
words.recall_hint: capt（抓取）+ -ive → 已被抓住脱不了身的

words.root_logic: parti（份）+ cip（取）+ -ate → 领走自己那一份 → 加入其中
words.origin: 拉丁语 participare（分享、参与），来自 pars（份）＋capere（取）
words.native_definition: to take part in an activity or event
words.core_concept: taking up one's own share of a joint doing – 在共做的事里领走属于自己那一份
words.core_image: 几个人各领一段绳，一头一个攥着往上拉
examples: She participates in every rehearsal.
Only members may participate.
semantic_expansions: 参加/参与：在共做之事里领走自己那一份
words.recall_hint: parti（份）+ cip（取）→ 领走自己那一份

words.root_logic: participate（领份加入）+ -ant（人）→ 领了一份、在其中的那个人
words.origin: 拉丁语 participans，participare 的现在分词
words.native_definition: a person who takes part in something
words.core_concept: the one holding a share of the work – 手里攥着一份活的那个人
words.core_image: 名单上每个名字后头都跟着一段分给他的活
examples: Each participant received a badge.
Twelve participants signed up.
semantic_expansions: 参与者/参加者：领了一份、身在其中的人
words.recall_hint: participate（领份加入）+ -ant → 领了一份的那个人

words.root_logic: parti（份）+ -cle（小）→ 份里最小的那一点
words.origin: 拉丁语 particula（小部分），pars 的指小形
words.native_definition: an extremely small piece of matter
words.core_concept: the smallest share a thing can be broken into – 一物能分到的最小那一份
words.core_image: 光柱里浮着数不清的细屑，一粒一粒看得见
examples: Dust particles hung in the light.
There is not a particle of truth in it.
semantic_expansions: 微粒/粒子：份里最小的那一点
极少量：小到只剩一点点的那个量
words.recall_hint: parti（份）+ -cle（小）→ 份里最小的那一点

words.root_logic: particul（小份）+ -ar（…的）→ 单指其中那一份的 → 特定的；引申为挑剔
words.origin: 拉丁语 particularis（属于部分的），来自 particula
words.native_definition: specific rather than general; hard to please
words.core_concept: singling out one share instead of the whole – 从整体里只指定那一份
words.core_image: 他从一摞里单挑出那一份，别的都不看
examples: This particular case is different.
He is particular about his coffee.
semantic_expansions: 特定的：从整体里只指定那一份
挑剔的：只肯要合意那一份
详情：逐份说清的那些条目
words.recall_hint: particul（小份）+ -ar → 只指定其中那一份

words.root_logic: a-（ad- 朝）+ part（份）→ 各归各份 → 分处两边
words.origin: 古法语 a part（各自一边），来自拉丁语 ad partem（朝各份）
words.native_definition: separated by a distance; into pieces
words.core_concept: each share standing off on its own – 各份各占一边，中间空着
words.core_image: 两只箱子摆在屋子两头，中间空出一大片
examples: They stood ten metres apart.
The old chair fell apart.
semantic_expansions: 分开/相隔：各份各占一边
除外：把那一份单撇出去不算
words.recall_hint: a-（朝）+ part（份）→ 各归各份、分处两边
collocations: apart from sth —— 除…之外，双向：既能撇开不算，也能表除此还有；美式说法是 aside from
tell A and B apart —— 分辨两者，固定搭配，此处不能换成 aside
fall apart / take sth apart —— 散掉、拆开，此处是分成各片
ten metres apart / two years apart —— 相隔，接在量度之后说距离或时差

words.root_logic: apart（各归各份）+ -ment → 整栋被隔出来的那一户
words.origin: 法语 appartement，来自意大利语 appartamento ← a parte（各自一边）
words.native_definition: a set of rooms in a building, used as one home
words.core_concept: the share a building is divided into – 整栋房子分出来的那一份
words.core_image: 一层楼被墙隔成几户，各有各的门
examples: They rent an apartment downtown.
Her apartment is on the third floor.
semantic_expansions: 公寓/套房：整栋房子隔出来的那一份
words.recall_hint: apart（各归各份）+ -ment → 隔出来的那一户

words.root_logic: dia-（穿过）+ meter（量度）→ 穿过圆心量出的那条长
words.origin: 希腊语 diametros（横贯的线），来自 dia（穿过）＋metron（量度）
words.native_definition: a straight line passing through the centre of a circle
words.core_concept: the length measured straight across through the middle – 从中间穿过去量出的那一段长
words.core_image: 一条线从圆边穿过正中，抵到对面那一点
examples: The circle has a diameter of ten centimetres.
Measure the diameter of the pipe.
semantic_expansions: 直径：穿过圆心量出的那条长
words.recall_hint: dia-（穿过）+ meter（量度）→ 穿过正中量出的长

words.root_logic: para-（旁）+ meter（量度）→ 旁边立起的量尺 → 划定范围的那个量
words.origin: 希腊语 para（旁）＋metron（量度），经近代科学用语入英语
words.native_definition: a limit or boundary that defines the scope of something
words.core_concept: the rod set alongside to mark how far a thing may go – 旁边立一根尺，定住它能走多远
words.core_image: 旋钮定在几个刻度上，机器只在这几档之内动
examples: Set the parameters before running the test.
We must work within these parameters.
semantic_expansions: 参数/参量：旁边立起、用来定量的那个尺度
界限：这把尺划出的可行范围
words.recall_hint: para-（旁）+ meter（量度）→ 旁立一尺定住范围

words.root_logic: thermo-（热）+ meter（量度）→ 量热的那件器具
words.origin: 希腊语 thermos（热）＋metron（量度），17 世纪造词
words.native_definition: an instrument for measuring temperature
words.core_concept: the tool that puts a number on how hot a thing is – 把冷热读成数字的那件器具
words.core_image: 玻璃管里那道细红线随冷热上下爬
examples: The thermometer read thirty degrees.
Put the thermometer under your arm.
semantic_expansions: 温度计/体温计：把冷热量成数字的那件器具
words.recall_hint: thermo-（热）+ meter（量度）→ 量热的器具

words.root_logic: geo-（地）+ metr（量度）+ -y → 本是量地之术，后成研究形与空间的学问
words.origin: 希腊语 geōmetria（测地术），来自 gē（地）＋metron（量度）
words.native_definition: the branch of mathematics dealing with shapes and space
words.core_concept: what began as measuring the ground and grew into the study of shape – 起于量地，后来专研形状与空间
words.core_image: 拿绳量地，边长与夹角一一记下
examples: She teaches geometry to first-years.
The geometry of the roof is complex.
semantic_expansions: 几何学：起于量地、后专研形状空间的学问
几何结构：某物在形状上的排布
words.recall_hint: geo-（地）+ metr（量度）→ 起于量地的形状之学

words.root_logic: centi-（百分之一）+ metre（米）→ 一米的百分之一
words.origin: 法语 centimètre，由拉丁 centum（百）＋希腊 metron（量度）合成
words.native_definition: a unit of length equal to one hundredth of a metre
words.core_concept: one of the hundred parts a metre is cut into – 一米均分成百份里的一份
words.core_image: 尺子上一米被均分成一百格，取其中一格
examples: The line is four centimetres long.
Cut two centimetres off the end.
semantic_expansions: 厘米/公分：一米均分成百份后的一份
words.recall_hint: centi-（百分之一）+ metre（米）→ 一米的百分之一

words.root_logic: tractare（反复拉扯、处置）→ 把事拉到手上处置 → 对待、医治
words.origin: 古法语 traitier，来自拉丁语 tractare（处理），trahere（拉）的反复体
words.native_definition: to behave toward someone in a certain way; to give medical care
words.core_concept: drawing a matter to hand and dealing with it – 把事拉到手边，一样样处置
words.core_image: 他把那件事拉到手边，一条一条过
examples: They treated her with respect.
The doctor treated his wound.
semantic_expansions: 对待：把事或人拉到手边如此处置
治疗：把病拉到手上处置
款待：以酒食待客这般处置
words.recall_hint: tractare（拉到手上处置）→ 对待、医治

words.root_logic: treat（处置、商议）+ -y → 商议处置之后立下的文书
words.origin: 古法语 traité，来自拉丁语 tractatus（处理、论述）← tractare
words.native_definition: a formal agreement between countries
words.core_concept: what two sides set down after drawing the matter out together – 两方把事拉到一处议定后写下的那纸
words.core_image: 两方被拉到一张桌前，谈定的每条都写进纸里
examples: The treaty was signed in Vienna.
Both sides honoured the treaty.
semantic_expansions: 条约/协定：两方议定后写下的那纸文书
words.recall_hint: treat（商议处置）+ -y → 议定后立下的文书

words.root_logic: re-（往回）+ treat（拉）→ 把自己往回拉 → 撤退；名词亦指退居之所
words.origin: 古法语 retrait（退回），来自拉丁语 retrahere（拉回）← re＋trahere
words.native_definition: to move back from a position; a quiet place to withdraw to
words.core_concept: drawing oneself back from where one stood – 把自己从原处往回拉
words.core_image: 队伍把自己往后拉，一步步离开那道坡
examples: The army retreated at nightfall.
She spends August at a mountain retreat.
semantic_expansions: 撤退/后退：把自己往回拉离原处
静居处：退到那里图个清静的地方
words.recall_hint: re-（往回）+ treat（拉）→ 把自己往回拉

words.root_logic: sign（记号）+ -ature → 亲手画下、认作己出的那道记号
words.origin: 中世纪拉丁语 signatura（盖印），来自 signare（标记）← signum（记号）
words.native_definition: a person's name written by themselves; a distinctive mark
words.core_concept: the mark one draws to own a thing as one's own – 亲手画下、用以认领的那道记号
words.core_image: 他在末尾落下自己那道熟手的笔迹，认作己出
examples: Put your signature at the bottom.
The dish is the chef's signature.
semantic_expansions: 签名/签字：亲手画下用以认领的记号
标志性特征：一眼就认得出是谁的那个标记
words.recall_hint: sign（记号）+ -ature → 亲手画下认作己出的记号

words.root_logic: signi（记号）+ fic（做）+ -ance → 做下记号的缘由 → 意义、分量
words.origin: 拉丁语 significantia（含意），来自 significare（示意）← signum＋facere
words.native_definition: the meaning of something; its importance
words.core_concept: why the mark was made there in the first place – 当初为什么在那儿划下记号
words.core_image: 那道刻痕反复被人提起，才显出当初为何划它
examples: The date has special significance.
They stressed the significance of the find.
semantic_expansions: 意义：做下这记号的缘由
重要性：这缘由分量有多重
words.recall_hint: signi（记号）+ fic（做）→ 划下记号的缘由

words.root_logic: signi（记号）+ fic（做）+ -ant → 值得划记号的 → 重要、显著
words.origin: 拉丁语 significans，significare 的现在分词
words.native_definition: large or important enough to be noticed
words.core_concept: worth putting a mark against – 够得上被划一道记号的
words.core_image: 满页里只有那一处被划了记号，看的人都停在那儿
examples: There was a significant rise in costs.
It is a significant step forward.
semantic_expansions: 重要的/显著的：够得上被划一道记号的
有意义的：这记号背后有缘由可讲
words.recall_hint: signi（记号）+ fic（做）→ 值得划下记号的

words.root_logic: strictus（拉紧的）→ 绷到不留余地 → 严格
words.origin: 拉丁语 strictus（拉紧的），stringere（拉紧）的过去分词
words.native_definition: demanding exact obedience; allowing no exception
words.core_concept: drawn so tight that no slack is left – 绷到一丝松都不留
words.core_image: 绳子拉到最紧，连一点回弹的余地都没有
examples: The school has strict rules.
He is strict about deadlines.
semantic_expansions: 严格的/严厉的：绷到不留一丝余地
words.recall_hint: strictus（拉紧的）→ 绷到不留余地

words.root_logic: re-（往回）+ strict（拉紧）→ 往回收紧 → 把范围缩小
words.origin: 拉丁语 restrictus，restringere（拉回束紧）的过去分词 ← re＋stringere
words.native_definition: to keep something within limits; to reduce what is allowed
words.core_concept: pulling the cord back so the circle grows smaller – 绳往回收，能动的圈越缩越小
words.core_image: 绳往回一收，能走动的那圈跟着小了一半
examples: They restricted access to the site.
Her diet restricts salt.
semantic_expansions: 限制/约束：往回收紧、把可动范围缩小
words.recall_hint: re-（往回）+ strict（拉紧）→ 往回收紧范围

words.root_logic: di-（分开）+ strict（拉紧）→ 用界线圈紧的一块 → 辖区
words.origin: 中世纪拉丁语 districtus（管辖范围），来自 distringere ← dis＋stringere
words.native_definition: an area of a town or country, often an official division
words.core_concept: the patch a boundary has been drawn tight around – 被界线圈紧的那一块地面
words.core_image: 界线一圈拉起来，圈内归一处管
examples: She grew up in the old district.
The school district covers three towns.
semantic_expansions: 地区/行政区：被界线圈紧、归一处管的那块地面
words.recall_hint: di-（分开）+ strict（拉紧）→ 界线圈紧的一块

words.root_logic: planus（平的）→ 表面无起伏 → 不加修饰的、一望便知的；名词指平地
words.origin: 古法语 plain，来自拉丁语 planus（平的）
words.native_definition: simple and without decoration; easy to understand; a large flat area
words.core_concept: a surface with nothing raised on it to catch the eye – 面上不起花样，一眼扫得到底
words.core_image: 一张白桌面从这头看到那头，什么摆件都没有
examples: She wore a plain grey dress.
It is plain that he was lying.
semantic_expansions: 朴素的：面上不加花样
清楚的：摊得平、一眼看到底
平原：地面无起伏的那一片
words.recall_hint: planus（平的）→ 面上不起花样、一眼见底

words.root_logic: ex-（出来）+ plain（平）→ 把褶皱摊平摊开 → 讲清楚
words.origin: 拉丁语 explanare（摊平、阐明），来自 ex＋planus（平的）
words.native_definition: to make something clear by describing it in detail
words.core_concept: smoothing the folds out so the whole lies open – 把折起来的一层层摊开，全貌就露出来
words.core_image: 他把揉成一团的那张纸一点点抹开，字迹才连得起来
examples: Please explain how it works.
She explained her reasons at length.
semantic_expansions: 解释/说明/阐明：把褶皱摊平、使人看清
words.recall_hint: ex-（出来）+ plain（平）→ 把褶子摊开讲清

words.root_logic: aero-（空气）+ plane（平面）→ 靠平展翼面浮在空气里的那件东西
words.origin: 法语 aéroplane，由希腊 aēr（空气）＋拉丁 planus（平面）合成
words.native_definition: a vehicle with wings and engines that flies through the air
words.core_concept: the craft held up by two flat faces pressed against the air – 靠两片平展的面撑住空气而浮起的器械
words.core_image: 两侧那两片薄薄的面一斜，整个机身就抬了起来
examples: The aeroplane took off on time.
He has never been on an aeroplane.
semantic_expansions: 飞机：靠平展翼面撑住空气而飞的器械
words.recall_hint: aero-（空气）+ plane（平面）→ 靠平展翼面浮起

words.root_logic: polis（城邦）→ politia（城邦治理）→ 维持城中秩序的那班人
words.origin: 法语 police，来自拉丁语 politia（治理）← 希腊语 politeia ← polis（城邦）
words.native_definition: the official force that keeps order and enforces the law
words.core_concept: the body charged with keeping the city's order – 受命看住全城秩序的那班人
words.core_image: 街口那几个人一站，闹哄哄的人群自己让出条路
examples: The police arrived within minutes.
She called the police at once.
semantic_expansions: 警察/警方：受命维持城中秩序的那班人
words.recall_hint: polis（城邦）→ politia（治理）→ 维持城中秩序者

words.root_logic: police（维持秩序者）+ man（人）→ 其中一名
words.origin: 英语复合词 police＋man，police ← 拉丁语 politia ← 希腊语 polis
words.native_definition: a male member of the police force
words.core_concept: one man out of the body that keeps order – 看守秩序那班人里的一名男性
words.core_image: 路口那一位抬手一比，车流就停住了
examples: A policeman directed the traffic.
The policeman took down her name.
semantic_expansions: 警察/男警：维持秩序那班人里的一名男性
words.recall_hint: police（维持秩序者）+ man → 其中一名

words.root_logic: polis（城邦）→ politia（治理）→ 治理所定的那套方针
words.origin: 古法语 policie（治理），来自拉丁语 politia ← 希腊语 politeia ← polis
words.native_definition: a plan of action agreed by a government or organization
words.core_concept: the settled course by which a body is run – 治事者定下来照办的那条路子
words.core_image: 议事厅定下一条，往后各处照着这条办
examples: The government changed its policy.
Read your insurance policy carefully.
semantic_expansions: 政策/方针：治事所定、往后照办的那条路子
保单：把承保条款定死的那纸文书
words.recall_hint: polis（城邦）→ politia（治理）→ 所定的方针

words.root_logic: metro-（mētēr 母）+ polit（城邦）+ -an → 属于母城、大城的
words.origin: 晚期拉丁语 metropolitanus，来自希腊语 mētropolis（母城）← mētēr（母）＋polis（城邦）；与 metron（量度）无关，上一批从 metron 名下剔除是对的
words.native_definition: relating to a large city and the area around it
words.core_concept: belonging to the mother-city that other towns grew out of – 属于那座生出周边诸镇的母城
words.core_image: 地铁线从那座大城摊开，一路连出去几十个镇子
examples: He works for the metropolitan council.
It is a metropolitan area of ten million.
semantic_expansions: 大都市的/大城市的：属于那座生出周边诸镇的母城
words.recall_hint: metro-（母）+ polit（城邦）→ 属于母城、大城的

words.root_logic: spect（看）+ -acular → 值得停下来看的 → 壮观
words.origin: 拉丁语 spectaculum（可观之物），来自 spectare（观看）← specere（看）
words.native_definition: very impressive to look at; strikingly great
words.core_concept: the sight that stops the eye and holds it – 让眼睛停住、挪不开的那种景象
words.core_image: 转过山口，眼前那一片让所有人都收住了脚
examples: The view was spectacular.
She made a spectacular recovery.
semantic_expansions: 壮观的/惊人的：让眼睛停住挪不开的那种
words.recall_hint: spect（看）+ -acular → 值得停下来看的

words.root_logic: spect（看）+ -rum → 呈给眼睛看的那一整条 → 光谱、范围
words.origin: 拉丁语 spectrum（显现、影像），来自 specere（看）
words.native_definition: the band of colours light splits into; a full range of related things
words.core_concept: the whole band laid out for the eye to run along – 摊开来让眼睛一路扫过去的那一整条
words.core_image: 光穿过棱镜，摊出一条从红到紫的带子
examples: Sunlight splits into a spectrum.
Opinions cover the whole spectrum.
semantic_expansions: 光谱：光摊开成的那一条色带
范围/系列：同类事物摊开成的整条幅面
words.recall_hint: spect（看）+ -rum → 呈给眼睛的那一整条

words.root_logic: de-（往下）+ spise（看）→ 从上往下看 → 鄙视
words.origin: 古法语 despis-，来自拉丁语 despicere（俯视、轻蔑）← de＋specere（看）
words.native_definition: to feel a strong dislike and lack of respect for
words.core_concept: looking down on a thing from above – 眼光自上往下落在那物上
words.core_image: 他下巴一抬，眼光从鼻梁上头扫过去
examples: He despised their dishonesty.
She despises gossip of any kind.
semantic_expansions: 鄙视/轻视：眼光自上往下落在那物上
words.recall_hint: de-（往下）+ spise（看）→ 从上往下看

words.root_logic: ir-（不）+ respect（回看顾及）+ -ive → 不回头看那一头 → 不顾、无论
words.origin: 英语 irrespective，由 ir-＋respective ← 拉丁语 respicere（回看）← re＋specere
words.native_definition: not taking something into account; regardless of
words.core_concept: walking on without turning the eye back to it – 眼睛不往那边回一下，照旧往前
words.core_image: 旁边情形如何他一眼没回，脚步照原样走
examples: Open to all, irrespective of age.
It applies irrespective of cost.
semantic_expansions: 不顾的/无论的：眼睛不回看那一头，照旧进行
words.recall_hint: ir-（不）+ respect（回看）→ 不回头看那一头

words.root_logic: bio-（生命）+ graph（写）+ -y → 把一个人一生写下来的那本
words.origin: 希腊语 bios（生命）＋graphein（书写），17 世纪造词
words.native_definition: the written story of a person's life
words.core_concept: one life set down on paper from start to end – 把一个人从头到尾写在纸上
words.core_image: 从出生那页翻到最后一页，全是同一个人的事
examples: She wrote a biography of her father.
The biography runs to 600 pages.
semantic_expansions: 传记：把一个人一生写下来的那本
words.recall_hint: bio-（生命）+ graph（写）→ 把一生写下来

words.root_logic: biblio-（书）+ graph（写）+ -y → 把所引各书列写出来的那一份
words.origin: 希腊语 biblion（书）＋graphein（书写）
words.native_definition: a list of the books and sources used in a piece of work
words.core_concept: the roll of every book one leaned on, written out – 把倚仗过的书一本本写成清单
words.core_image: 论文末尾几页，一行一本地列着看过的书
examples: Add the sources to your bibliography.
The bibliography lists forty titles.
semantic_expansions: 参考书目/文献目录：把所引各书列写出来的那一份
words.recall_hint: biblio-（书）+ graph（写）→ 把所引各书列写出来

words.root_logic: geo-（地）+ graph（写）+ -y → 把大地描写下来的那门学问
words.origin: 希腊语 geōgraphia（描写大地），来自 gē（地）＋graphein（书写）
words.native_definition: the study of the earth's surface, climate, and peoples
words.core_concept: putting the face of the land down on paper – 把大地的样貌描到纸上
words.core_image: 山川河道一笔笔画进图里，纸上就成了那片地
examples: She teaches geography at the school.
The geography of the region is rugged.
semantic_expansions: 地理/地理学：把大地样貌描写下来的那门学问
地形：某地起伏走势的那副样貌
words.recall_hint: geo-（地）+ graph（写）→ 把大地描到纸上

words.root_logic: tele-（远）+ graph（写）→ 把字写到远处去的那套装置
words.origin: 法语 télégraphe，由希腊 tēle（远）＋graphein（书写）合成，19 世纪造词
words.native_definition: a system for sending messages over distance by electric signal
words.core_concept: writing that lands far from the hand that made it – 手在此处落笔，字却出现在远处
words.core_image: 这头按下几下长短，那头纸带上就吐出一串记号
examples: The news came by telegraph.
He sent a telegraph from the port.
semantic_expansions: 电报/电报机：把字送到远处去的那套装置
words.recall_hint: tele-（远）+ graph（写）→ 把字写到远处去

words.root_logic: premere（压）→ preinte（压出的痕）→ 压出字迹 → 印刷
words.origin: 古法语 preinte（压痕），来自 preindre ← 拉丁语 premere（压）
words.native_definition: to produce text or pictures by pressing ink onto paper
words.core_concept: the mark left where something was pressed down – 压下去之后留在那儿的痕
words.core_image: 版子往纸上一压，抬起来时字就留住了
examples: They printed a thousand copies.
Print your name in capitals.
semantic_expansions: 印刷/印：压下去把字留在纸上
字迹：压出来的那些痕
words.recall_hint: premere（压）→ 压出痕迹 → 印刷

words.root_logic: blue（蓝）+ print（压印）→ 蓝底压印出的图 → 蓝图、方案
words.origin: 英语复合词 blue＋print；旧时晒图工艺出蓝底白线，print ← 拉丁语 premere
words.native_definition: a technical drawing of a plan; a detailed scheme
words.core_concept: the pressed-out drawing everything is built from – 压印出来、照着它造的那张图
words.core_image: 摊开那张蓝底的图纸，每根梁的位置都标着
examples: The architect showed us the blueprint.
This is a blueprint for reform.
semantic_expansions: 蓝图/设计图：压印出来、照着施工的那张图
方案：同样作依据的那套设想
words.recall_hint: blue（蓝）+ print（压印）→ 蓝底压印的图

words.root_logic: re-（往回）+ press（压）+ -ion → 往回压住 → 镇压、压抑
words.origin: 拉丁语 repressio，来自 reprimere（压回）← re＋premere（压）
words.native_definition: the act of keeping something down by force or by will
words.core_concept: pressing a thing back down so it cannot rise – 把往上冒的按回去，不许起来
words.core_image: 刚要抬头的那一下被一只手按了回去
examples: The repression of protest drew criticism.
Years of repression left their mark.
semantic_expansions: 镇压：用力把动作按回去
压抑/抑制：把情绪或冲动按住不许冒头
words.recall_hint: re-（往回）+ press（压）→ 往回按住不许起

words.root_logic: posit（放定）+ -ive → 已经放定、不再摇摆的 → 确定的、肯定的
words.origin: 拉丁语 positivus（明定的），来自 positus（ponere 的过去分词）
words.native_definition: certain and confident; showing agreement; greater than zero
words.core_concept: set down firmly so it no longer wavers – 已经放定，不再来回移动
words.core_image: 他把那枚棋子按在格里松手，再没挪动过
examples: She has a positive attitude.
The test came back positive.
semantic_expansions: 肯定的/确定的：已经放定、不再摇摆
积极的：心气上同样是定住往前的那一头
words.recall_hint: posit（放定）+ -ive → 放定了不再摇摆

words.root_logic: de-（向下）+ posit（放）→ 往下放好搁着 → 存放、押金
words.origin: 拉丁语 depositum（寄存物），来自 deponere（放下）← de＋ponere
words.native_definition: to put something somewhere for safe keeping; money paid as security
words.core_concept: setting a thing down and leaving it in keeping – 往下放好，就搁在那儿托人看着
words.core_image: 他把袋子往柜台里一放，换回一张凭条
examples: She deposited the cash at the bank.
We paid a deposit on the flat.
semantic_expansions: 存放/存款：往下放好交人看着
押金：先放下作担保的那笔钱
words.recall_hint: de-（向下）+ posit（放）→ 放下搁着托管

words.root_logic: quest（寻求）+ -ion → 为求答案而发出的那一句
words.origin: 古法语 question，来自拉丁语 quaestio（询问）← quaerere（寻找、探求）
words.native_definition: a sentence asked in order to get information; a matter in doubt
words.core_concept: the sentence sent out to fetch an answer back – 抛出去、指望换回一个答案的那句话
words.core_image: 他抛出一句，屋里几个人都抬头等着谁接
examples: She asked a difficult question.
There is no question of his honesty.
semantic_expansions: 问题/询问：为求答案而发出的那一句
疑问：尚未有着落、悬着的那一处
words.recall_hint: quest（寻求）+ -ion → 为求答案发出的那句

words.root_logic: question（问）+ -naire（成套）→ 排成一套发出去的问句
words.origin: 法语 questionnaire，来自 question ← 拉丁语 quaerere
words.native_definition: a printed list of questions used to gather information
words.core_concept: a run of asked sentences set out in order to be answered – 一整串问句排开等人逐条作答
words.core_image: 纸上一行一行都留着空格，等着人挨着填
examples: Please fill in the questionnaire.
We sent questionnaires to 200 people.
semantic_expansions: 问卷/调查表：排成一套、发出去等人逐条作答的问句
words.recall_hint: question（问）+ -naire（成套）→ 排成一套的问句

words.root_logic: ac-（ad- 朝）+ quisit（求得）+ -ion → 求而得之 → 获得、所得之物
words.origin: 拉丁语 acquisitio（获得），来自 acquirere（取得）← ad＋quaerere（求）
words.native_definition: the act of getting something; a thing obtained
words.core_concept: what the seeking finally brings into hand – 一路求下来，终于拿到手的那个
words.core_image: 找了半年，终于把那件东西拿到手里
examples: The acquisition took two years.
The painting is her latest acquisition.
semantic_expansions: 获得：求而终于拿到手
收购：以此手段把公司或资产求到手
所得物：求来的那件东西
words.recall_hint: ac-（朝）+ quisit（求得）→ 求而得之

words.root_logic: pro-（往前）+ gress（走）→ 一步步往前 → 进展
words.origin: 拉丁语 progressus（前行），来自 progredi（前进）← pro＋gradi（走）
words.native_definition: movement forward or improvement over time
words.core_concept: one step set down ahead of the last – 一步落在上一步前头
words.core_image: 脚印一个接一个往前排，回头看已走出一段
examples: We are making good progress.
The work progressed slowly.
semantic_expansions: 进展/进步：一步步落在前头、往前推
前进：脚步实际向前那一动
words.recall_hint: pro-（往前）+ gress（走）→ 一步落在前头

words.root_logic: progress（前行）+ -ive → 一路往前走的 → 渐进的、主张改革的
words.origin: 英语 progressive，来自 progress ← 拉丁语 progredi
words.native_definition: happening gradually; favouring reform and new ideas
words.core_concept: keeping the steps coming one after another – 步子一个接一个不停下来
words.core_image: 水位一格一格往上抬，每天都比前一天高一点
examples: The disease is progressive.
She holds progressive views.
semantic_expansions: 渐进的：步子一个接一个不停下来
进步的：主张往前走、求改革的那一头
words.recall_hint: progress（前行）+ -ive → 步子接连不停

words.root_logic: con-（一同）+ gress（走）→ 各方走到一处 → 集会、国会
words.origin: 拉丁语 congressus（会合），来自 congredi（走到一起）← con＋gradi（走）
words.native_definition: a formal meeting; the national law-making body of some countries
words.core_concept: steps from many directions ending in one room – 各路脚步走到同一间屋里
words.core_image: 各地的人一路赶来，最后都进了同一间厅
examples: The congress meets every autumn.
Congress passed the bill.
semantic_expansions: 代表大会/会议：各方走到一处开的会
国会：由此制度化而成的立法机构
words.recall_hint: con-（一同）+ gress（走）→ 各方走到一处

words.root_logic: litter（字母、文字）+ -ature → 用文字写成的那一整片 → 文学、文献
words.origin: 拉丁语 litteratura（书写、学问），来自 littera（字母）
words.native_definition: written works valued as art; the writings on a subject
words.core_concept: the body of what has been set down in letters – 用文字写下来、积成的那一整片
words.core_image: 架上一层层排开，全是用字写成的东西
examples: She studies French literature.
Read the literature on the topic first.
semantic_expansions: 文学/著作：用文字写成、可当艺术看的那些作品
文献：某一题目下写下来的全部材料
words.recall_hint: litter（文字）+ -ature → 用文字写成的那一整片

words.root_logic: con-（一同）+ fer（带）+ -ence → 各方把话带到一处 → 会议
words.origin: 中世纪拉丁语 conferentia，来自 conferre（聚拢、商议）← con＋ferre（带）
words.native_definition: a formal meeting for discussion, often lasting days
words.core_concept: everyone carrying their piece to the same table – 各人把自己那份话带到同一张桌上
words.core_image: 几十个人从各处赶来，把手里的材料摊到一张桌上
examples: The conference lasts three days.
She spoke at an international conference.
semantic_expansions: 会议/会谈：各方把话带到一处商议
研讨会：以此形式专议某题目的那种会
words.recall_hint: con-（一同）+ fer（带）→ 各方把话带到一处

words.root_logic: circum-（绕）+ fer（带）+ -ence → 绕一圈带过去的那条线 → 周长
words.origin: 拉丁语 circumferentia（绕行的线），来自 circumferre（环绕）← circum＋ferre
words.native_definition: the distance around the edge of a circle
words.core_concept: the line carried all the way round back to its start – 绕着边一路带回起点的那条线
words.core_image: 笔沿着圆边走一整圈，回到落笔那一点
examples: Measure the circumference of the trunk.
The lake is 5 km in circumference.
semantic_expansions: 圆周/周长：绕边一路带回起点的那条线
words.recall_hint: circum-（绕）+ fer（带）→ 绕一圈带回起点

words.origin: 英语 interference，来自 interfere ← 古法语 s'entreferir（互击）← 拉丁 inter＋ferire
words.native_definition: the act of getting involved where one is not wanted; disruption of a signal
words.core_concept: something carried in between so the two can no longer meet cleanly – 有东西插进中间，两头就接不干净了
words.core_image: 两人正说着，第三个人的声音插进中间，谁也听不清了
examples: He resented her interference.
Radio interference spoiled the broadcast.
semantic_expansions: 干涉/妨碍：把自己插到中间去搅一脚
干扰：信号里插进杂物、传不干净
words.recall_hint: inter-（在中间）+ fer（带）→ 插到中间搅一脚
words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词处理：ferire（击打）一支库中仅此一词，不足以开根；与 ferre（带、拿去）不同源，勿混

words.root_logic: ob-（挡在前）+ struct（垒）→ 在通路上垒起东西 → 堵住
words.origin: 拉丁语 obstruere（堵塞），来自 ob（对面、挡）＋struere（堆叠）
words.native_definition: to block a path or prevent something from happening
words.core_concept: piling something up across the way so nothing gets through – 在通路上垒起一堆，谁也过不去
words.core_image: 巷口垒起半人高的砖，车马到此只能折返
examples: A fallen tree obstructed the road.
He was charged with obstructing justice.
semantic_expansions: 阻塞/阻碍：在通路上垒起东西、使过不去
words.recall_hint: ob-（挡在前）+ struct（垒）→ 在路上垒起一堆

words.root_logic: obstruct（垒起挡路）+ -ion → 挡路这件事，或挡路的那个东西
words.origin: 拉丁语 obstructio，来自 obstruere ← ob＋struere
words.native_definition: something that blocks a way; the act of blocking
words.core_concept: the pile that stands across the way, and the placing of it – 横在路上的那一堆，及垒它这件事
words.core_image: 清障车开来，把横在道中的那一堆一点点搬开
examples: Remove any obstruction from the pipe.
He was fined for obstruction.
semantic_expansions: 障碍物：横在路上的那一堆
阻碍/妨碍：垒起它、使人过不去这件事
words.recall_hint: obstruct（垒起挡路）+ -ion → 挡路之物与其事

words.root_logic: infra-（在下）+ structure（垒起之物）→ 垒在底下托住上面的那一套
words.origin: 英语 infrastructure，由拉丁 infra（在下）＋structura（构造）← struere 合成
words.native_definition: the basic systems such as roads and power that a country needs
words.core_concept: what is built underneath to hold everything else up – 垒在底下、托住上面全部的那一层
words.core_image: 路面之下埋着管线与地基，上面的楼才立得住
examples: The country invested in infrastructure.
Cloud infrastructure supports the service.
semantic_expansions: 基础设施/基础架构：垒在底下托住上层全部的那一套
words.recall_hint: infra-（在下）+ structure（垒起之物）→ 垒在底下托住上面

words.root_logic: elektr（琥珀）+ -on（粒）→ 带那种「琥珀之力」的最小粒
words.origin: 英语 electron，1891 年由 electric＋-on 造出；electric ← 希腊语 elektron（琥珀），琥珀摩擦后能吸引轻物，电现象由此得名
words.native_definition: a very small particle carrying a negative charge
words.core_concept: the smallest bearer of the force amber showed when rubbed – 琥珀摩擦所显那股力的最小承载者
words.core_image: 琥珀在布上擦几下，碎纸屑就往它上头扑
examples: Electrons orbit the nucleus.
The beam is a stream of electrons.
semantic_expansions: 电子：带负电、体积极小的那种粒子
words.recall_hint: elektr（琥珀）+ -on（粒）→ 带琥珀之力的最小粒

words.root_logic: electron（电子）+ -ic（…的）→ 靠电子工作的
words.origin: 英语 electronic，来自 electron ← 希腊语 elektron（琥珀）
words.native_definition: using or relating to devices that work by controlling electrons
words.core_concept: working by steering those smallest bearers of charge – 靠驾驭那些最小带电粒来运作
words.core_image: 板子上细如发丝的线路一通，屏就亮了
examples: She reads electronic books.
All records are now electronic.
semantic_expansions: 电子的/电子化的：靠驾驭电子来运作的
words.recall_hint: electron（电子）+ -ic → 靠电子工作的

words.root_logic: tribuere（分给、缴纳）→ 按份缴上去的那笔 → 贡赋；引申为致敬之礼
words.origin: 拉丁语 tributum（贡赋），来自 tribuere（分配、缴纳）
words.native_definition: something said or given to show respect; a payment made by one state to another
words.core_concept: the share handed up in acknowledgement – 按份呈上去、表示认这份情的东西
words.core_image: 各家按份把谷物送到城门，一车车登记入册
examples: The concert was a tribute to her teacher.
The city paid tribute to the empire.
semantic_expansions: 贡品：按份呈上去的那笔
致敬/颂词：把心意按份呈上，同一个「奉上」动作
words.recall_hint: tribuere（分给、缴纳）→ 按份呈上去的东西

words.root_logic: con-（一同）+ tribut（分给）+ -ion → 各人拿出自己那份凑到一处
words.origin: 拉丁语 contributio，来自 contribuere（共同出资）← con＋tribuere
words.native_definition: something given to help achieve something; a payment to a common fund
words.core_concept: each hand putting its share into the same pile – 各人把自己那份放进同一堆里
words.core_image: 桌上那只匣子，来的人各投一份进去
examples: Her contribution was decisive.
He made a small contribution to the fund.
semantic_expansions: 贡献：拿出自己那份凑到共同一处
捐款/投稿：同一动作用在钱或文稿上
words.recall_hint: con-（一同）+ tribut（分给）→ 各出一份凑到一处

words.root_logic: hospit（待客）+ -al → 本指收留旅人之所，后专指收治病人的地方
words.origin: 中世纪拉丁语 hospitale（客舍、济贫院），来自 hospes（主/客）；hospes 与 hostis 同出原始印欧语 *ghos-ti-，本族收待客那一支
words.native_definition: a place where sick or injured people are treated
words.core_concept: the house that takes in whoever arrives needing care – 接纳前来求治者的那处屋舍
words.core_image: 门开着，抬进来的人一个个被接下、安置到床位上
examples: She was taken to hospital by ambulance.
He works at the city hospital.
semantic_expansions: 医院：本为收留旅人之所，后专指收治病人的地方
words.recall_hint: hospit（待客）+ -al → 接纳来者的那处屋舍

words.root_logic: hospit（待客）+ -ality → 待客这件事、那份周到
words.origin: 拉丁语 hospitalitas（好客），来自 hospes（主/客）← *ghos-ti-
words.native_definition: friendly and generous treatment of guests
words.core_concept: the care put into receiving whoever comes – 接待来者时使出的那份周到
words.core_image: 客人一进门，茶水与坐处都已备下
examples: Thank you for your hospitality.
The hotel is known for its hospitality.
semantic_expansions: 好客/招待/款待：接待来者时使出的那份周到
words.recall_hint: hospit（待客）+ -ality → 待客那份周到

words.root_logic: consuetudo（成例、惯常）→ 一地惯常的穿戴 → 服装、戏装
words.origin: 法语 costume，来自意大利语 costume（习俗、装束）← 拉丁语 consuetudo（惯常）；与 custom 同源，一支走「习俗」义，一支走「装束」义
words.native_definition: clothes worn to look like someone else, or typical of a place or period
words.core_concept: what a place has long been in the habit of wearing – 一地长年惯常穿戴的那一套
words.core_image: 戏班箱子里那几套按老样式裁的衣裳，年年照旧
examples: She wore a bear costume.
The dancers appeared in traditional costume.
semantic_expansions: 服装/民族服装：一地惯常穿戴的那一套
戏装：照旧样式备下、供扮演穿的那身
words.recall_hint: consuetudo（成例）→ 惯常的穿戴 → 服装

words.root_logic: ac-（ad- 朝）+ custom（成例）+ -ed → 已入成例的 → 习惯了的
words.origin: 英语 accustomed，来自 accustom ← 古法语 acostumer ← 拉丁语 consuetudo
words.native_definition: familiar with something through long experience; usual
words.core_concept: worn into the groove until it feels ordinary – 走顺了那道沟，做起来不觉费力
words.core_image: 同一条路走了几十年，脚自己知道往哪拐
examples: She is accustomed to early starts.
He took his accustomed seat.
semantic_expansions: 习惯的/惯常的：已走顺那道沟、做来不觉费力
words.recall_hint: ac-（朝）+ custom（成例）+ -ed → 已入成例的

words.root_logic: re-（再）+ present（放到眼前）→ 再把它摆到眼前 → 代表、表现
words.origin: 拉丁语 repraesentare（再现、呈现），来自 re＋praesentare ← praesens ← praeesse
words.native_definition: to act on behalf of someone; to stand for or depict something
words.core_concept: putting a thing before the eyes again in another's stead – 替某方再把它摆到眼前
words.core_image: 他替全村上台开口，村里人虽不在场，话却在场
examples: She represents her country abroad.
This graph represents last year's sales.
semantic_expansions: 代表：替某方把其意再摆到眼前
表现/象征：把事物再呈到眼前来指代它
words.recall_hint: re-（再）+ present（放到眼前）→ 替人再摆到眼前

words.root_logic: represent（代表）+ -ative → 受托来代表的那个人或物
words.origin: 英语 representative，来自 represent ← 拉丁语 repraesentare ← praeesse
words.native_definition: a person chosen to act or speak for others; typical of a group
words.core_concept: the one sent to stand before others in their stead – 被派去替众人站到台前的那个
words.core_image: 各车间推一个人出来，那人往台前一站，说的是全班的意思
examples: Each class elects a representative.
This sample is representative of the whole.
semantic_expansions: 代表/代理人：受托替众人站到台前的那个
有代表性的：拿它就能指代整体的
words.recall_hint: represent（代表）+ -ative → 受托代表的那个
