keep in touch with sb —— 保持联络，让接触一直连着不断线
keep track of sth —— 掌握某事的动向，track 是脚印，一路跟着记下不丢
keep + adj —— 保持某状态，此处是系动词，如 keep quiet / keep still，状态不许掉回去

words.decomposable_note: 早期借词，经古英语或中古英语阶段传入，词形已归化，无可拆的词缀
words.origin: 古英语 cetel ← 早期借入的拉丁语 catillus（小盆）← catinus（深盆）
words.native_definition: a covered metal pot with a spout for boiling water
words.core_concept: a spouted pot made for boiling – 专为烧开水做的带嘴容器
words.core_image: 灶上那只金属容器盖子开始跳，嘴里喷出一道白汽，声音越来越尖
examples: Put the kettle on for tea.
The kettle whistled on the stove.
semantic_expansions: 水壶：烧水时坐在灶上的那只带嘴器皿
烧水壶：同一样东西，强调它是用来把水烧开的

words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本身即词根，无拉丁词缀可拆
words.origin: 古英语 cǣg（开锁之物），更早词源不明
words.native_definition: a shaped piece for opening a lock, or something that makes a thing work
words.core_concept: the shaped bit that lets you in – 让你进得去的那片带齿的东西
words.core_image: 一小片金属，边上啃出几个缺口，插进去一转，里头咔一声
examples: He lost the key to the back door.
Timing is the key to this dish.
semantic_expansions: 钥匙：插进锁孔、一转就开的那片金属
关键：整件事的锁眼，对上它就通
键：手指按下去就起作用的那一格

words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本身即词根，无拉丁词缀可拆
words.origin: 中古英语 key（键）+ board（板），字面「排满键的板子」
words.native_definition: a set of keys arranged on a board for typing or playing
words.core_concept: a board laid out with keys to press – 一板子按键排在一起
words.core_image: 一整块板子上排满方格，十指落下去噼啪响成一片
examples: She spilled coffee on her keyboard.
He runs his hands over the keyboard.
semantic_expansions: 键盘：敲字用的那一整排方格
琴键：乐器上排成一行、按下出声的那些

words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本身即词根，无拉丁词缀可拆
words.origin: 中古英语 kiken，可能出自古诺尔斯语，更早词源不明
words.native_definition: to strike with the foot, or a sudden thrust of the leg
words.core_concept: driving something away with the foot – 用脚把东西送出去
words.core_image: 他后腿一甩，鞋尖砸在球上，球贴着草皮蹿了出去
examples: He kicked the ball into the net.
The rifle kicks against your shoulder.
semantic_expansions: 踢：脚扫出去打在东西上
踹：同一动作使足了劲，直着送出
后坐力：枪像被脚蹬了一下那样往后顶

words.root_logic: jungere（套到一处）→ 把两边接上，或自己并进去
words.origin: 古法语 joindre ← 拉丁语 jungere（接合）
words.native_definition: to connect two things; to become a member of a group
words.core_concept: bringing two ends together until they hold as one – 把两头凑到一处，直到它们成一体
words.core_image: 两截管子对上口，箍一紧就再拔不开
examples: Join the two wires together.
She joined the club last spring.
semantic_expansions: 连接/接合：把两头凑到一处使成一体
加入：把自己并进那一群里
words.recall_hint: jungere（套到一处）→ 把两边接上

words.root_logic: junctus（已接合的）→ 两段相接的那一处 → 关节、接头
words.origin: 古法语 jointe ← 拉丁语 junctus（jungere 的过去分词）
words.native_definition: a place where two parts meet and can move; shared between two
words.core_concept: the spot where two pieces meet and still bend – 两段相接、又还能弯的那一处
words.core_image: 两根骨头搭在一处，中间那点能屈能伸
examples: He injured his knee joint.
They made a joint decision.
semantic_expansions: 关节/接头：两段相接又能活动的那一处
共同的：两方套在同一副轭里、一起承担
words.recall_hint: junctus（已接合）→ 两段相接的那一处

words.root_logic: junct（接合）+ -ion → 几条道接到一处的那个点 → 交汇处
words.origin: 拉丁语 junctio（接合）← jungere（接合）
words.native_definition: a place where roads or railway lines meet
words.core_concept: the point several ways run into and become one – 几条路跑到一处、并成一条的那个点
words.core_image: 三条道跑到一处并成一条，中间立着一根杆
examples: Turn left at the next junction.
The junction was closed for repairs.
semantic_expansions: 交汇处/路口：几条道接到一处的那个点
枢纽：多条线路在此并接的要地
words.recall_hint: junct（接合）+ -ion → 几条道接到一处的点

words.root_logic: jus（法）+ dicere（说）→ judex（宣法的人）→ 依准断定
words.origin: 古法语 juger ← 拉丁语 judicare ← judex（法官）← jus（法）＋dicere（说）
words.native_definition: to form an opinion after weighing evidence; a person who decides in court
words.core_concept: the one who reads the scale and says which way it went – 看着秤，说出它偏向哪边的那个
words.core_image: 两边的说法都听完，他抬头说出偏向哪一边
examples: Do not judge by appearance.
The judge dismissed the case.
semantic_expansions: 判断/评判：依准衡量后说出结论
法官：受命做此事的那个人
words.recall_hint: jus（法）+ dicere（说）→ 依准断定的人

words.root_logic: jurare（按法起誓）→ 起过誓来断案的那一组人
words.origin: 盎格鲁法语 juree ← 拉丁语 jurata（起誓者）← jurare（起誓）← jus（法）
words.native_definition: a group of people who decide a verdict in court
words.core_concept: the several sworn in to read the scale together – 一齐起过誓、共同看秤的那几个人
words.core_image: 十二个人挨着坐一排，手按在书上说完同一句话
examples: The jury reached a verdict.
She served on a jury last year.
semantic_expansions: 陪审团/评审团：起誓后共同评断的那一组人
words.recall_hint: jurare（按法起誓）→ 起誓断案的那组人

words.root_logic: just（合于法）+ -ice → 该给谁的就给谁 → 公正
words.origin: 古法语 justice ← 拉丁语 justitia（公正）← justus（合法的）← jus（法）
words.native_definition: fair treatment; the system of law
words.core_concept: the scale coming to rest level, neither side favoured – 秤停在正中，两边谁也不占便宜
words.core_image: 两份东西各放一边，指针不偏不倚停在中线
examples: She fought for justice.
The case went to the justice system.
semantic_expansions: 公正/正义：秤停在正中、该给谁给谁
司法：把这套准则落实下来的那一整套
words.recall_hint: just（合于法）+ -ice → 该给谁就给谁

words.root_logic: just（合于法）+ -ify（使…）→ 说明它站得住 → 证明正当
words.origin: 古法语 justifier ← 晚期拉丁语 justificare ← justus（合法的）＋facere（做）
words.native_definition: to show that something is right or reasonable
words.core_concept: putting weight on your side until the scale tips your way – 往自己这边添分量，直到秤偏过来
words.core_image: 他把一件件依据摆到自己那盘里，秤慢慢压了过去
examples: Can you justify that cost?
Nothing justifies such cruelty.
semantic_expansions: 证明正当/为…提供理由：添够分量使秤偏向自己
辩解：为已做之事补上这份分量
words.recall_hint: just（合于法）+ -ify → 说明它站得住

words.root_logic: ex-（出）+ it（ire 行走）→ 走出去的那个口
words.origin: 拉丁语 exitus（出去、出口）← exire（出去）← ex＋ire（行走）
words.native_definition: a way out of a place; the act of leaving
words.core_concept: the gap you step through on the way out – 往外走时跨过的那个口
words.core_image: 绿灯亮着的那扇门后头是台阶，人一个个跨出去
examples: The exit is at the back.
He made a quiet exit.
semantic_expansions: 出口：往外走时跨过的那个口
退场/离开：跨出去这个动作本身
words.recall_hint: ex-（出）+ it（行走）→ 走出去的那个口

words.root_logic: in-（进入）+ it（行走）+ -al → initium（迈进的第一步）→ 最初的
words.origin: 拉丁语 initialis（起头的）← initium（开始）← inire（进入）← in＋ire（行走）
words.native_definition: existing at the beginning; the first letter of a name
words.core_concept: the first foot set down inside the door – 进门后落下的第一只脚
words.core_image: 刚跨进来那一步印在灰上，后面的脚印都在它前头
examples: My initial reaction was surprise.
Sign with your initials here.
semantic_expansions: 最初的/开头的：进门后落下的第一只脚
首字母：名字最前头那一个字
words.recall_hint: in-（进入）+ it（行走）→ 迈进的第一步

words.root_logic: initium（第一步）+ -ate（使…）→ 走出第一步 → 发起
words.origin: 拉丁语 initiare（开始、引入）← initium ← inire（进入）← in＋ire
words.native_definition: to cause something to begin; to admit someone into a group
words.core_concept: taking the one step that starts the rest moving – 迈出那一步，后面的才跟着动
words.core_image: 他先走了一步，原地站着的人这才跟上
examples: They initiated a new program.
He was initiated into the order.
semantic_expansions: 发起/开始：迈出那第一步使其余跟着动
使入会：引某人跨进那个圈子
words.recall_hint: initium（第一步）+ -ate → 走出第一步

words.root_logic: ex-（出）+ issue（ire 行走）→ 走出来的那一批 → 发行；引申为待处理之事
words.origin: 古法语 issue（出去、结果）← 拉丁语 exire（出去）← ex＋ire（行走）
words.native_definition: an important topic; a set of copies published at one time; to send out
words.core_concept: what comes walking out of the door, batch by batch – 一批批从门里走出来的那些
words.core_image: 印好的一摞从后门一批批运出来，封面日期都一样
examples: This is a serious issue.
The magazine issues monthly.
semantic_expansions: 问题/议题：摆到面前待处理的那一桩
期号/发行：一批批出门的那些印本
words.recall_hint: ex-（出）+ issue（行走）→ 走出来的那一批

words.root_logic: co-（一起）+ her（黏住）+ -ent → 各部分黏成一体、说得通的
words.origin: 拉丁语 cohaerens（连在一起的）← cohaerere ← com＋haerere（黏住）
words.native_definition: logically connected and easy to follow
words.core_concept: the parts stuck together so tightly the whole holds – 各部分黏得够牢，整体拎起来不散
words.core_image: 几段话前后咬着，抽掉哪一段后面都接不上
examples: She gave a coherent account.
The argument is not coherent.
semantic_expansions: 连贯的/条理清楚的：各部分黏成一体、拎起来不散
words.recall_hint: co-（一起）+ her（黏住）→ 各部分黏成一体

words.root_logic: co-（一起）+ hes（黏住）+ -ive → 能把彼此黏住的
words.origin: 英语 cohesive，来自拉丁语 cohaesus（cohaerere 的过去分词）← haerere
words.native_definition: sticking together well; forming a united whole
words.core_concept: what makes the pieces hold to one another – 使各块相互黏着的那份力
words.core_image: 湿沙攥成一团松手不散，干沙一松就漏下去
examples: They are a cohesive team.
Wet clay is more cohesive.
semantic_expansions: 有黏性的：能把彼此黏住的
团结的：一群人同样相互黏着不散
words.recall_hint: co-（一起）+ hes（黏住）+ -ive → 能相互黏住的

words.root_logic: in-（在内）+ her（黏住）+ -ent → 黏在里头拿不掉的 → 固有的
words.origin: 拉丁语 inhaerens（附着于内的）← inhaerere ← in＋haerere（黏住）
words.native_definition: existing as a natural and permanent part of something
words.core_concept: stuck so deep inside that removing it would break the thing – 黏在里头，要取出来就得把那东西拆了
words.core_image: 花纹是烧进瓷胎里的，擦不掉也磨不去
examples: Risk is inherent in the job.
It has an inherent weakness.
semantic_expansions: 固有的/内在的/天生的：黏在里头取不出来的那部分
words.recall_hint: in-（在内）+ her（黏住）→ 黏在里头拿不掉

words.root_logic: haes（卡住不动）+ -itate（反复）→ 反复卡在那儿 → 迟疑
words.origin: 拉丁语 haesitare（卡住、结巴）← haerere（黏住、卡住）的反复体
words.native_definition: to pause before doing something because of doubt
words.core_concept: the foot that lifts and comes back down in the same spot – 脚抬起来又落回原处，没往前挪
words.core_image: 他手伸到一半停住，收回来又伸出去
examples: She hesitated before answering.
Do not hesitate to ask.
semantic_expansions: 犹豫/迟疑：脚抬起又落回原处，反复卡在那儿
words.recall_hint: haes（卡住）+ -itate（反复）→ 反复卡在那儿

words.root_logic: de-（离开）+ fend（击）→ 把来的击开、使它离远 → 防御
words.origin: 古法语 defendre ← 拉丁语 defendere（挡开、保护）← de＋fendere（击）
words.native_definition: to protect from attack; to argue in support of
words.core_concept: the arm put up so the blow lands somewhere else – 手臂架上去，那一下就落到别处
words.core_image: 他抬臂一格，砸下来的那下偏到了肩外
examples: They defended the city for weeks.
She defended her decision.
semantic_expansions: 保卫/防御：把来的击开使其落到别处
辩护：同样是把冲自己来的话挡开
words.recall_hint: de-（离开）+ fend（击）→ 把来的击开

words.root_logic: defend（挡开）+ -ce → 挡这件事，及用来挡的那一套
words.origin: 古法语 defense ← 拉丁语 defensa ← defendere（挡开）← de＋fendere
words.native_definition: the act of protecting; something that protects
words.core_concept: whatever is put between you and the blow – 架在自己与那一下之间的东西
words.core_image: 土墙、壕沟、拒马一层层排在前头
examples: The country spends much on defence.
He spoke in his own defence.
semantic_expansions: 防御/防务：挡这件事及用来挡的那一套
辩护：法庭上替自己挡的那番话
words.recall_hint: defend（挡开）+ -ce → 挡这件事及所用之物

words.root_logic: defence 的截短 → 拦在四周挡人畜的那道栅
words.origin: 中古英语 fens，defence 的截短形 ← 拉丁语 defendere（挡开）
words.native_definition: a barrier of wood or wire around a piece of land
words.core_concept: the line of stakes that keeps what is outside outside – 一排桩子把外头的挡在外头
words.core_image: 一排木桩钉进土里，中间拉着铁丝，牛走到那儿就停
examples: They built a fence around the yard.
The horse jumped the fence.
semantic_expansions: 篱笆/栅栏/围栏：拦在四周、把外头挡在外头的那道
words.recall_hint: defence 截短 → 拦在四周挡人畜的那道栅

words.root_logic: frons（额头）→ 朝前的那一面 → 前部、正面
words.origin: 古法语 front（额、正面）← 拉丁语 frons（额头）
words.native_definition: the side that faces forward; the most forward part
words.core_concept: the face that meets you first as you come up – 你走近时先碰到的那一面
words.core_image: 屋子朝街那一面开着窗，背面只有一道墙
examples: Sit at the front of the bus.
Troops moved up to the front.
semantic_expansions: 前面/正面：朝前、先碰到的那一面
前线：两军相对时朝前的那一面
words.recall_hint: frons（额头）→ 朝前的那一面

words.root_logic: front（正面）+ -ier → 一国朝外那条边 → 边境；引申为未开之域
words.origin: 古法语 frontiere（前沿）← front ← 拉丁语 frons（额头、正面）
words.native_definition: the border between two countries; the edge of what is known
words.core_concept: the outermost line a land turns toward the world – 一片地朝外顶着的那条最外的线
words.core_image: 界桩一路排到山脊，过了那道线就是别处
examples: They crossed the frontier at night.
It is a new frontier in medicine.
semantic_expansions: 边境/边疆：一国朝外顶着的那条最外线
前沿：知识或技术顶到的那条边
words.recall_hint: front（正面）+ -ier → 朝外顶着的那条边

words.root_logic: con-（相对）+ front（额面）→ 额头对额头 → 正面相对
words.origin: 法语 confronter ← 中世纪拉丁语 confrontare ← com＋frons（额头）
words.native_definition: to face someone or something difficult directly
words.core_concept: turning to put your forehead against the other's – 转过身把自己的额头对上对方的
words.core_image: 他没有绕开，转过身直接站到那人跟前
examples: She confronted him about the lie.
We must confront the problem.
semantic_expansions: 面对/对抗：转身把额头对上对方，不绕开
使对质：把两方拉到面对面
words.recall_hint: con-（相对）+ front（额面）→ 额头对额头

words.root_logic: in-（进入）+ vade（迈步）→ 迈进别人的地界 → 侵入
words.origin: 拉丁语 invadere（侵入）← in＋vadere（迈步而行）
words.native_definition: to enter a place by force; to crowd into somewhere
words.core_concept: the foot coming down inside a line it had no right to cross – 脚落在本不该越过的那条线里侧
words.core_image: 界桩还立在那儿，一队人已经踩进了桩子里边
examples: The army invaded at dawn.
Tourists invade the town each July.
semantic_expansions: 侵略/侵入：迈进本不该进的地界
涌入：大批人同样跨进来占满
words.recall_hint: in-（进入）+ vade（迈步）→ 迈进别人地界

words.root_logic: invade（侵入）+ -sion → 侵入这件事
words.origin: 拉丁语 invasio ← invadere（侵入）← in＋vadere
words.native_definition: an act of entering by force; an unwelcome intrusion
words.core_concept: the whole of that crossing, once it has happened – 跨进来这件事整个算下来
words.core_image: 第二天清早，界内已经全是别处来的脚印
examples: The invasion began in spring.
It was an invasion of privacy.
semantic_expansions: 入侵/侵犯：迈进本不该进之处这件事
words.recall_hint: invade（侵入）+ -sion → 侵入这件事

words.root_logic: e-（ex- 出）+ vade（迈步）→ 迈出去脱身 → 躲开
words.origin: 拉丁语 evadere（逃出）← ex＋vadere（迈步而行）
words.native_definition: to escape or avoid something, often by cleverness
words.core_concept: stepping out through the gap before the hand closes – 手合上之前先迈出那道缝
words.core_image: 追到墙角却没人，只有一扇半开的小门
examples: He evaded the question.
She evaded capture for months.
semantic_expansions: 逃避/回避：手合上之前先迈出那道缝
躲开：同一动作用在具体的追捕上
words.recall_hint: e-（出）+ vade（迈步）→ 迈出去脱身

words.root_logic: fabula（讲出来的话）← fari（说）→ 讲给人听的那种短故事
words.origin: 古法语 fable ← 拉丁语 fabula（谈话、故事）← fari（说）
words.native_definition: a short story with a moral, often about animals
words.core_concept: the tale that exists only in the telling – 只靠口说才存在的那个故事
words.core_image: 老人一开口讲那只狐狸，孩子们就不出声了
examples: He read the fable aloud.
That story is pure fable.
semantic_expansions: 寓言/传说：靠口说流传的那种短故事
虚构之事：因此指不实之说
words.recall_hint: fabula（讲出来的话）← fari（说）→ 口说的故事

words.root_logic: fabula（故事）+ -ous → 像故事里那样的 → 惊人的、极好的
words.origin: 拉丁语 fabulosus（传说中的）← fabula（故事）← fari（说）
words.native_definition: extremely good; so great as to seem made up
words.core_concept: the kind of thing you would only expect to hear in a tale – 只该在故事里听到的那种
words.core_image: 端上来那一桌，客人先说了句「这哪像真的」
examples: The meal was fabulous.
He has fabulous wealth.
semantic_expansions: 极好的/惊人的：好到像只该在故事里听到
传说中的：本义，出自故事的
words.recall_hint: fabula（故事）+ -ous → 像故事里那样的

words.root_logic: in-（不）+ fant（fari 的现在分词 fans 说）→ 还不会说话的那个 → 婴儿
words.origin: 古法语 enfant ← 拉丁语 infans（不会说话的）← in-（不）＋fari（说）的现在分词
words.native_definition: a very young child, especially one not yet walking
words.core_concept: the one who has everything to say and no words yet – 什么都想表达、却还没有话的那个
words.core_image: 他张着嘴使劲出声，但那些声音还拼不成词
examples: The infant slept through the night.
Infant care takes patience.
semantic_expansions: 婴儿/幼儿：还不会说话的那个
words.recall_hint: in-（不）+ fant（说）→ 还不会说话的那个

words.root_logic: flos（花）→ 植株开出来的那一朵
words.origin: 古法语 flour ← 拉丁语 flos/floris（花）
words.native_definition: the coloured part of a plant that produces seeds
words.core_concept: the part a plant puts out when it has strength to spare – 植株攒足了劲才推出来的那一处
words.core_image: 枝上那处颜色一天天张开，花瓣一层压着一层
examples: She picked a yellow flower.
The tree flowers in April.
semantic_expansions: 花：植株开出来的那一朵
开花：推出那一朵这个动作
words.recall_hint: flos（花）→ 植株开出的那一朵

words.root_logic: flos（花、最好的部分）→ fleur de farine（面之精）→ 面粉
words.origin: 中古英语 flour（面之精），与 flower 同词分化 ← 拉丁语 flos（花、精华）
words.native_definition: powder made from ground wheat, used for baking
words.core_concept: the finest layer sifted out of the ground grain – 磨过的谷里筛出来的最细那一层
words.core_image: 粗的留在筛上，落下来的那层白得发亮
examples: Add two cups of flour.
She dusted the board with flour.
semantic_expansions: 面粉：磨过的谷里筛出的最细那一层，本义即「面之精」
words.recall_hint: flos（精华）→ fleur de farine（面之精）→ 面粉

words.root_logic: flor（花）+ -ish → 开到最盛 → 兴旺、茁壮
words.origin: 古法语 florir ← 通俗拉丁语 florire ← 拉丁语 florere（开花）← flos（花）
words.native_definition: to grow well; to be successful and thriving
words.core_concept: the moment a thing puts out everything it has – 一物把攒下的劲全推出来那一刻
words.core_image: 那株移过来第二年就窜高一截，枝上密密都是花
examples: The business flourished.
Plants flourish in this soil.
semantic_expansions: 茁壮成长/兴旺/繁荣：把攒下的劲全推出来、开到最盛
words.recall_hint: flor（花）+ -ish → 开到最盛

words.root_logic: heres（继承人）→ 依法接过家产的那个人
words.origin: 古法语 eir ← 拉丁语 heres（继承人）；英语拼写的 h 是后来照拉丁语补的，不发音
words.native_definition: a person legally entitled to inherit property or a title
words.core_concept: the one named to receive when the holder lets go – 持有者松手时，被指名接住的那个
words.core_image: 文书上写着那个名字，老人一走东西就归他
examples: He is the sole heir.
The heir to the throne was crowned.
semantic_expansions: 继承人/嗣子：持有者松手时被指名接住的那个
words.recall_hint: heres（继承人）→ 依法接过家产的那个人

words.root_logic: herit（继承）+ -age → 一代代传下来的那一份
words.origin: 古法语 heritage ← heriter ← 晚期拉丁语 hereditare（继承）← heres
words.native_definition: traditions and buildings passed down from earlier generations
words.core_concept: what each generation hands on without being asked to – 每一代自然而然交下去的那一份
words.core_image: 老屋、老手艺、老规矩，都是上一辈没说什么就留下的
examples: The town protects its heritage.
Music is part of her heritage.
semantic_expansions: 遗产/文化遗产：一代代传下来的那一份
传统：其中无形的那部分
words.recall_hint: herit（继承）+ -age → 一代代传下来的那份

words.root_logic: in-（进入）+ herit（继承）→ 接进自己名下 → 继承
words.origin: 古法语 enheriter ← 晚期拉丁语 inhereditare ← in＋heres（继承人）
words.native_definition: to receive property or a quality from someone before you
words.core_concept: the thing coming into your hands because it left another's – 因为别人松了手，它才落进你手里
words.core_image: 钥匙从那只手落进这只手，屋子从此归后者
examples: She inherited the house.
He inherited his father's temper.
semantic_expansions: 继承：因别人松手而落进自己手里
遗传：性状同样由上一代传下来
words.recall_hint: in-（进入）+ herit（继承）→ 接进自己名下

words.root_logic: jocus（戏言）→ 说出来逗人笑的那句
words.origin: 拉丁语 jocus（玩笑、戏言）
words.native_definition: something said or done to make people laugh
words.core_concept: the line said only for the laugh it gets – 只为博一声笑而说的那句
words.core_image: 他把最后半句一压低，满桌人先是静了一下才笑
examples: He told a bad joke.
She takes a joke well.
semantic_expansions: 玩笑/笑话：只为博一声笑而说的那句
words.recall_hint: jocus（戏言）→ 说出来逗人笑的那句

words.root_logic: jocus（玩物）→ 古法语 jouel（小玩赏物）→ 宝石
words.origin: 古法语 jouel（小玩物、饰件）← 拉丁语 jocus（玩笑、玩物）
words.native_definition: a precious stone; something highly valued
words.core_concept: the small bright thing kept only to be looked at – 留着只为看的那一小件亮东西
words.core_image: 绒布上那一点在灯下转个角度就换一种光
examples: The crown holds many jewels.
This book is a jewel.
semantic_expansions: 宝石/珠宝：留着只为看的那一小件亮东西
珍品：以此喻极可贵之物
words.recall_hint: jocus（玩物）→ jouel（小玩赏物）→ 宝石

words.root_logic: jewel（宝石）+ -ry（成套）→ 成套的饰件
words.origin: 古法语 juelerye ← jouel ← 拉丁语 jocus（玩物）
words.native_definition: rings, necklaces, and similar ornaments worn on the body
words.core_concept: the small bright things put on the body to be seen – 戴在身上、供人看的那些亮小件
words.core_image: 抽屉里一格一格摆着，戴出去时挑那么一两件
examples: She wore silver jewelry.
The jewelry was locked away.
semantic_expansions: 珠宝/首饰：戴在身上供人看的那些亮小件
words.recall_hint: jewel（宝石）+ -ry（成套）→ 成套的饰件

words.root_logic: dran（做）→ drama（做出来的那一场）→ 戏剧
words.origin: 晚期拉丁语 drama ← 希腊语 drama（一场演出）← dran（做、行动）
words.native_definition: a play for theatre or television; an exciting series of events
words.core_concept: the doing put on a raised floor so all can watch – 摆到台上、让所有人看着的那一番做
words.core_image: 幕布拉开，台上的事一件件当着众人做出来
examples: She studies modern drama.
The trial was full of drama.
semantic_expansions: 戏剧/剧本：摆到台上做给人看的那一场
戏剧性事件：现实里像那一场一样起伏的事
words.recall_hint: dran（做）→ drama（做出来的那一场）

words.root_logic: drama（一场演出）+ -ic → 像台上那一场的 → 引人注目的、剧烈的
words.origin: 拉丁语 dramaticus ← 希腊语 dramatikos ← drama ← dran（做）
words.native_definition: sudden and noticeable; relating to plays
words.core_concept: of the kind that makes every head turn, as on a stage – 属于「一动就满座回头」那一类
words.core_image: 价钱一夜之间翻了一倍，第二天所有人都在说这事
examples: Prices rose dramatically.
She has dramatic talent.
semantic_expansions: 剧烈的/引人注目的：一动就满座回头那种
戏剧性的：属于台上那一场的
words.recall_hint: drama（一场演出）+ -ic → 像台上那一场

words.root_logic: drastikos（见效猛的）← dran（做）→ 下手重、来得急的
words.origin: 希腊语 drastikos（有力的、见效的）← dran（做、行动）
words.native_definition: extreme and sudden, often severe in effect
words.core_concept: the kind of doing that leaves no room for halfway – 那种做法不留半途，一下到底
words.core_image: 他没有慢慢调，直接把整套换掉了
examples: They took drastic measures.
A drastic change was needed.
semantic_expansions: 激烈的/极端的/彻底的：下手重、不留半途的那种做法
words.recall_hint: drastikos（见效猛）← dran（做）→ 下手重的

words.root_logic: factio（做法、做成的样式）← facere（做）→ 一时通行的做法与样式
words.origin: 古法语 fachon（式样）← 拉丁语 factio（做、样式）← facere（做）
words.native_definition: a popular style of clothing or behaviour; a way of doing something
words.core_concept: the way of making that everyone happens to follow this season – 这一季众人恰好都照着做的那个样式
words.core_image: 街上的裁法今年忽然都改成一个走向，去年那种没人做了
examples: Short coats are back in fashion.
He did it in his own fashion.
semantic_expansions: 时尚/流行式样：一时通行的那种做法与样式
方式：做一件事所取的那个做法
words.recall_hint: factio（做法、样式）← facere（做）→ 通行的样式

words.root_logic: fais（facere 做）+ -ible（可…的）→ 做得成的 → 可行的
words.origin: 古法语 faisable（可做的）← faire ← 拉丁语 facere（做）
words.native_definition: possible to do or achieve
words.core_concept: the plan that survives the question can this actually be done – 经得住「这真做得成吗」一问的那个方案
words.core_image: 把工序一步步排下来，发现每一步都真办得到
examples: The plan seems feasible.
It is not feasible in one week.
semantic_expansions: 可行的/行得通的：经得住「真做得成吗」一问的那种
words.recall_hint: fais（做）+ -ible（可…的）→ 做得成的

words.root_logic: facsimile（fac simile 做得一样）的截短 → 传过去的那份复本
words.origin: 英语 fax 是 facsimile 的截短；facsimile ← 拉丁语 fac simile（做成相像的）← facere（做）
words.native_definition: a copy of a document sent over a phone line
words.core_concept: the copy made to come out the same at the far end – 在远处那头做出来、要求一模一样的复本
words.core_image: 这头把纸吃进去，那头一张一模一样的吐出来
examples: Send it by fax today.
The fax never arrived.
semantic_expansions: 传真/传真件：在远处做出来、要求一模一样的复本
words.recall_hint: facsimile（fac simile 做得一样）截短 → 传过去的复本

words.root_logic: debere（本该有却不在手上）← de＋habere（持有）→ 该给的、到期的
words.origin: 古法语 deu（debvoir 的过去分词）← 拉丁语 debere（欠）← de＋habere（持有）
words.native_definition: owed as a debt or obligation; expected at a certain time
words.core_concept: what is on the books to be handed over, and the day it falls – 账上写着该交出去的那份，及该交的那天
words.core_image: 本子上记着日子，翻到那一页就知道该给了
examples: The rent is due on Friday.
The train is due at six.
semantic_expansions: 应付的/到期的：账上该交出去的那份及其期限
预期的：按约该到的那个时候
words.recall_hint: debere（本该有却不在手）← de＋habere → 该给的

words.root_logic: due（该给的）+ -ty → 该做的那一份 → 职责；也指该缴的那笔税
words.origin: 盎格鲁法语 duete ← deu（该给的）← 拉丁语 debere ← de＋habere（持有）
words.native_definition: something one is obliged to do; a tax on goods
words.core_concept: the share of work that is owed, not chosen – 分给你、非做不可的那一份，不是你挑的
words.core_image: 值班表上那格写着他的名字，轮到就得在那儿
examples: It is your duty to report it.
They paid duty on the import.
semantic_expansions: 职责/义务：分给你、非做不可的那一份
关税：进出货物该缴的那笔
words.recall_hint: due（该给的）+ -ty → 该做的那一份

words.root_logic: en-（使）+ devoir（该做之事）→ 把该做的当成自己的事去尽力 → 努力
words.origin: 中古英语 endeveren，由 en-＋古法语 deveir（本分）← 拉丁语 debere ← de＋habere
words.native_definition: to try hard to do something
words.core_concept: taking what is owed as one's own and pushing at it – 把该做的那份认作自己的，往上使劲
words.core_image: 他把那份本不属他的活也接了过来，一样往前推
examples: She endeavored to finish on time.
It was a worthy endeavor.
semantic_expansions: 努力/尽力/尝试：把该做的认作自己的、往上使劲
words.recall_hint: en-（使）+ devoir（该做之事）→ 当作己事去尽力

words.root_logic: en-/in-（使）+ sure（无忧）→ 先出一笔把后顾之忧买掉 → 投保
words.origin: 英语 insure 是 ensure 的分化形 ← 古法语 enseurer ← 拉丁语 securus（无忧）← se-＋cura（挂心）
words.native_definition: to arrange for money to be paid if loss or damage happens
words.core_concept: paying a little now so the big loss is not yours to carry – 先付一点，把那笔大损失从自己肩上挪走
words.core_image: 每月扣掉一小笔，出事那天赔的是另一方
examples: They insured the house against fire.
Is the car insured?
semantic_expansions: 投保/为…保险：先付一点，把大损失从自己肩上挪走
words.recall_hint: in-（使）+ sure（无忧）→ 出钱买掉后顾之忧

words.root_logic: grev（gravis 重）→ 压在心上那份沉 → 悲痛
words.origin: 古法语 grief（苦难）← grever（压重）← 拉丁语 gravare ← gravis（重的）
words.native_definition: very great sadness, especially after a death
words.core_concept: the weight that settles on the chest and does not lift – 压在胸口、久久不散的那份沉
words.core_image: 他坐着没说话，肩往下垮着，像有东西压在上头
examples: She was overcome with grief.
Time eases grief.
semantic_expansions: 悲痛/悲伤：压在胸口久久不散的那份沉
words.recall_hint: grev（重）→ 压在心上那份沉

words.root_logic: in-（不）+ ert（ars 技艺、本事）→ 没本事动起来 → 惰性
words.origin: 拉丁语 inertia（无能、懒惰）← iners（无技艺的）← in-（不）＋ars（技艺）
words.native_definition: a tendency to stay unchanged; resistance to being moved
words.core_concept: the state of a thing that will not start moving on its own – 一物自己不会动起来的那个状态
words.core_image: 推第一下最费劲，一旦动起来反倒不用那么使力
examples: The body has great inertia.
Bureaucratic inertia slowed reform.
semantic_expansions: 惯性/惰性：一物自己不会动起来的那个状态
不作为：把这份不动用在人或机构上
words.recall_hint: in-（不）+ ert（技艺、本事）→ 没本事动起来

words.root_logic: credere（信托）→ creantare（许诺、应承）→ 应允给出 → 授予
words.origin: 古法语 granter（应允）← creanter ← 通俗拉丁语 credentare ← 拉丁语 credere（信托）
words.native_definition: to agree to give or allow something formally
words.core_concept: handing over what was asked because you take the asker at their word – 信得过对方所求，就把那份给了
words.core_image: 他把申请翻了一遍，抬头说了句可以，笔一签就批了
examples: The city granted permission.
She won a research grant.
semantic_expansions: 授予/准予：信得过所求便把那份给出
补助金：这样给出的那笔钱
words.recall_hint: credere（信托）→ creantare（应承）→ 应允给出

words.root_logic: fundere（倒出）→ futilis（一倒就漏的容器）→ 白费的
words.origin: 拉丁语 futilis（易漏的、无用的）← fundere（倒出、流泻）
words.native_definition: having no useful result; pointless
words.core_concept: the leaky jar you keep filling that never holds anything – 一只漏的罐，一直往里倒却始终装不住
words.core_image: 水一勺勺倒进去，底下同时往外淌，怎么倒都不满
examples: It was a futile attempt.
Further talks proved futile.
semantic_expansions: 无用的/徒劳的：像一只漏的罐，倒进去也留不住
words.recall_hint: futilis（一倒就漏的容器）← fundere（倒出）

words.root_logic: grammar（学问、法术书）的苏格兰语变体 → 施在人身上的那层魅 → 魅力
words.origin: 苏格兰语 glamer，为 grammar（旧时兼指法术之学）的变体 ← 希腊语 grammatikē ← graphein（刻写）
words.native_definition: an attractive and exciting quality
words.core_concept: the sheen laid over a thing so the eye will not look past it – 覆在一物上、叫人目光挪不开的那层光
words.core_image: 灯一打上去，本来平常的那身衣裳忽然亮得扎眼
examples: The city has a certain glamor.
She was drawn by the glamor of fame.
semantic_expansions: 魅力/诱惑力/光彩：覆在一物上、叫人目光挪不开的那层
words.recall_hint: grammar（旧兼指法术之学）的变体 ← graphein（刻写）

words.root_logic: in-（向内）+ cline（klinein 倾斜）→ 朝一边斜过去 → 倾向
words.origin: 拉丁语 inclinare（使倾斜）← in＋clinare ← 希腊语 klinein（倾斜）
words.native_definition: to lean or slope; to tend toward an opinion
words.core_concept: the surface tipped so things roll one way, not the other – 面一斜，东西就只往那一边滚
words.core_image: 板子一头垫高，珠子全滚到低的那边去了
examples: The path inclines steeply here.
I incline to agree with you.
semantic_expansions: 倾斜/斜坡：面朝一边斜过去
倾向：心里同样偏向某一边
words.recall_hint: in-（向内）+ cline（倾斜）→ 朝一边斜过去

words.root_logic: di-（分开）+ vorce（vertere 转）→ 各自转开 → 离婚
words.origin: 古法语 divorce ← 拉丁语 divortium（分离）← divertere（转开）← dis＋vertere（转）
words.native_definition: the legal ending of a marriage; a complete separation
words.core_concept: two who had faced each other turning away – 本来对着的两人各自转开身
words.core_image: 两人在桌两边签完字，起身朝相反方向走出门
examples: They filed for divorce.
There is a divorce between theory and practice.
semantic_expansions: 离婚：本来对着的两人各自转开
分离：两者之间同样转开、不再相接
words.recall_hint: di-（分开）+ vorce（转）→ 各自转开

words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本身即词根，无拉丁词缀可拆
words.origin: 中古英语 kide ← 古诺斯语 kið（小山羊）← 原始日耳曼语 *kidjom；十六世纪起用来称人的幼崽
words.native_definition: a child, a young goat, or to tease someone playfully
words.core_concept: a young one, still at play – 还在闹的那个幼小的
words.core_image: 个头刚到大人腰间，一路蹦跳，还不停地问为什么
examples: The kids ran out into the yard.
Don't be angry, I was only kidding.

words.decomposable_note: 借自梵语，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.root_logic: i-（不）+ gnor（认得出）→ 装作认不出这件事 → 不予理会
words.origin: 拉丁语 ignorare（不认识、不理）← in-（不）＋ gnoscere（认识）
words.native_definition: to pay no attention to someone or something on purpose
words.core_concept: acting as though one does not recognize what is plainly there – 明明在那儿，却装作认不出
words.core_image: 桌上那封信摆了三天，他每次经过都不往那边看一眼
examples: Don't ignore the warning signs.
She ignored him at the party.
semantic_expansions: 忽视：明知在那儿却不去看，重在不理会
不理：对人不作回应
无视：当作不存在，重在完全不放进眼里
words.recall_hint: i-（不）+ gnor（认得出）→ 装作认不出那件事

words.root_logic: i-（不）+ gnor（认得出）+ -ant（…的）→ 认不出、不晓得的
words.origin: 拉丁语 ignorans（不知的），ignorare 的现在分词 ← in-（不）＋ gnoscere（认识）
words.native_definition: lacking knowledge or awareness of something
words.core_concept: being the one who cannot recognize what others already do – 别人都认出来了，只有他认不出
words.core_image: 满桌人都在笑，只有他没听懂，也跟着笑了两声
examples: He is ignorant of the facts.
Don't be so ignorant about it.
semantic_expansions: 无知的：认不出、也没学过，重在缺知识
不知道的：这一件事上没被告知
愚昧的：长期认不出，带贬意
words.recall_hint: i-（不）+ gnor（认得出）+ -ant → 认不出那件事的

words.root_logic: nobilis（可认得出的、有名的）← gnoscere（认识）→ 众人都认得的那一家 → 出身高、品格高
words.origin: 古法语 noble ← 拉丁语 nobilis（有名的、显贵的）← gnoscere（认识）
words.native_definition: belonging to a high social class; having fine personal qualities
words.core_concept: the one whose name the whole room already knows – 名字一出口，满屋人都认得的那个
words.core_image: 他一报出姓氏，满屋人都停下来看他
examples: He came from a noble family.
That was a noble act.
semantic_expansions: 贵族的/贵族：众人都认得的那一家及其成员，即出身显贵
高尚的：由「众人认得、名声在外」转到品格上，够得上被称道
words.recall_hint: nobilis（可认得出的、有名的）← gnoscere（认识）→ 名字一出满屋人都认得

words.root_logic: de-（加重）+ ny（negare 说不）→ 一口咬定不是、不给
words.origin: 古法语 denier ← 拉丁语 denegare（坚决说不）← de-（加重）＋ negare（说不）
words.native_definition: to say that something is not true; to refuse to give something
words.core_concept: saying no to whatever is held out in front of one – 对递到面前的那件事说不
words.core_image: 照片摆到他面前，他看了两眼，说那不是他
examples: He denied all the charges.
They were denied entry to the hall.
semantic_expansions: 否认：对一句陈述说不，说它不成立
拒绝：对一个请求说不，即不给
否定：对整件事说不，重在推翻
words.recall_hint: de-（加重）+ ny（说不）→ 一口咬定不是、不给

words.root_logic: deny（说不）+ -al（名词）→ 把「说不」这一下当作一件事
words.origin: 英语 denial，来自 deny ← 古法语 denier ← 拉丁语 denegare ← negare（说不）
words.native_definition: a statement that something is not true; a refusal to give something
words.core_concept: the act of saying no, taken as a thing in itself – 「说不」这一下本身，当成一件事看
words.core_image: 发布会上他只念了一句话就下台，说没有这回事
examples: He issued a flat denial.
Her denial convinced no one.
semantic_expansions: 否认/否定：说某事不成立这一下
拒绝：说不给这一下
words.recall_hint: deny（说不）+ -al → 把说不这一下当作一件事

words.root_logic: nega（说不）+ -tive（…性的）→ 站在说不那一边的
words.origin: 拉丁语 negativus（表否认的）← negare（说不）
words.native_definition: expressing refusal or disagreement; less than zero; showing that something is not present
words.core_concept: standing on the no side of the thing – 站在「不」那一边
words.core_image: 问他行不行，他每一条都摇头，一条都没点过头
examples: His answer was negative.
The test came back negative.
semantic_expansions: 否定的：明确说不，与说是相对
负面的：说不那一边引申为坏的那一边
消极的：整个态度都偏在说不这边，不肯往前
阴性的：检验说「没有」，即那样东西不在
words.recall_hint: nega（说不）+ -tive → 站在说不那一边的

words.root_logic: nutrix（奶妈）← nutrire（喂养）→ 喂着、看着的那个人 → 照看病人的人
words.origin: 古法语 norrice（奶妈）← 晚期拉丁语 nutricia ← 拉丁语 nutrire（喂养）
words.native_definition: a person trained to care for sick people; to care for someone who is ill
words.core_concept: the one who feeds and watches over the helpless – 喂着、守着那个自己顾不了自己的人
words.core_image: 她一夜起了四回，换水、量体温，把药一口口送下去
examples: She works as a nurse.
He nursed his wife for years.
semantic_expansions: 护士：喂药看护病人的那个人
保姆：早期义，喂养看顾小孩的那个人
照料：这个人所做的那件事本身
words.recall_hint: nutrix（奶妈）← nutrire（喂养）→ 喂着守着的那个人

words.root_logic: norrir（喂养）← nutrire（喂养）→ 供上它长起来要的东西
words.origin: 古法语 norriss-（norrir 的词干，喂养）← 拉丁语 nutrire（喂养）
words.native_definition: to give a living thing the food it needs to grow and stay healthy
words.core_concept: putting in what a living thing needs so it thickens and grows – 把活物长起来要的东西送进去
words.core_image: 盆里那株天天浇一遍，叶子一层层厚起来
examples: Milk nourishes a growing child.
She nourished a hope of return.
semantic_expansions: 滋养：供上食物养分，使强健
养育：同一动作用在人身上，供着长大
怀有：把一个念头养着不断供着，久了不散
words.recall_hint: norrir（喂养）← nutrire（喂养）→ 供上长起来要的东西

words.root_logic: nutritura（喂养这件事）← nutrire（喂养）→ 一年年供着、看着，让它成形
words.origin: 古法语 norreture ← 晚期拉丁语 nutritura（喂养）← 拉丁语 nutrire（喂养）
words.native_definition: to care for and encourage the growth of someone or something
words.core_concept: the long feeding and tending that makes a thing turn out – 一年年供着照看，把它带成形
words.core_image: 那株苗从屋里搬到院里，浇水剪枝，几年后高过了墙
examples: Parents nurture their children.
Talent needs careful nurture.
semantic_expansions: 培养：长期供着照看，使能力成形
养育：供吃供住带大，重在把人带起来
教养：这一路带下来在人身上留下的样子
words.recall_hint: nutritura（喂养）← nutrire → 一年年供着看着，让它成形

words.root_logic: lapsus（滑了一下）← labi（滑）→ 手一松滑开的那一下 → 小差错、失效
words.origin: 拉丁语 lapsus（滑倒、差错）← labi（滑）
words.native_definition: a small mistake or failure; a passing of time; to become no longer valid
words.core_concept: the small slip where the hold was let go – 握着的那一下松开，东西滑开
words.core_image: 话说到一半，那个名字忽然想不起来了
examples: He had a lapse of memory.
Her insurance lapsed last month.
semantic_expansions: 失误：注意力滑开一下造成的小错
流逝：时间从手里一段段滑走
失效：约定滑出有效期，不再算数
间隔：两件事之间滑过去的那一段
words.recall_hint: lapsus（滑了一下）← labi（滑）→ 手一松滑开的那一下

words.root_logic: e-（出）+ lapse（滑）→ 一段时间从手里滑出去
words.origin: 拉丁语 elabi（溜走、滑出），过去分词 elapsus ← e-（出）＋ labi（滑）
words.native_definition: to pass by, said of a period of time
words.core_concept: a stretch of time sliding out and gone – 一段时候从手里滑出去，没留下痕迹
words.core_image: 抬头看钟，指针不知什么时候已经挪了两格
examples: Three hours elapsed before he woke.
Two weeks elapsed with no news.
semantic_expansions: 流逝/消逝：一段时候从手里滑出去、不再回来
words.recall_hint: e-（出）+ lapse（滑）→ 一段时候从手里滑出去

words.root_logic: col-（一起）+ lapse（滑）→ 各处一齐往下滑，整个下来
words.origin: 拉丁语 collapsus（一齐倒下），collabi 的过去分词 ← com-（一起）＋ labi（滑）
words.native_definition: to fall down suddenly; to fail completely
words.core_concept: every support letting go at the same moment – 各处支撑在同一刻一齐松开
words.core_image: 屋顶那几根梁一齐往下沉，整片瓦跟着落地，尘土腾起来
examples: The old bridge collapsed last night.
The company collapsed within a year.
semantic_expansions: 倒塌：各处一齐往下滑，房子整个下来
崩溃：同一画面用在人或系统上，撑不住了
垮台：一个组织或政权整个下来
瓦解：本来连着的各块一齐散开
words.recall_hint: col-（一起）+ lapse（滑）→ 各处一齐往下滑，整个下来

words.root_logic: mobile vulgus（易被推动的众人）的截短 ← movere（推动）→ 一推就动、拦不住的那群
words.origin: 英语 mob 是拉丁语短语 mobile vulgus（易动的民众）的截短 ← mobilis ← movere（移动、推动）
words.native_definition: a large disorderly crowd of people
words.core_concept: a crowd that shifts all at once when pushed – 被一推就整片挪动、各人不再自主的那群
words.core_image: 广场上人越挤越多，前排一喊，后面整片跟着往一个方向涌
examples: An angry mob gathered outside.
The mob broke the shop windows.
semantic_expansions: 暴民：一推就动、失了约束的那群人
乌合之众：临时凑起、没有主张的那群
一群人：中性用法，只取聚在一处这一层
words.recall_hint: mobile vulgus（易被推动的众人）的截短 ← movere（推动）

words.root_logic: mob（movere 移动）+ -ile（能…的）→ 挪得动的
words.origin: 拉丁语 mobilis（可移动的）← movere（移动）
words.native_definition: able to move or be moved easily
words.core_concept: made so it can be shifted without taking it apart – 不用拆开就能挪走
words.core_image: 这台机器底下装了四个轮子，一个人推着就能换地方
examples: He works from a mobile office.
The clinic is fully mobile.
semantic_expansions: 移动的/可移动的：挪得动、不固定在一处
流动的：人或资源在各处之间挪得动
words.recall_hint: mob（移动）+ -ile（能…的）→ 挪得动的

words.root_logic: mobile（挪得动的）+ -ize（使…）→ 把停着的弄动起来
words.origin: 法语 mobiliser ← mobile ← 拉丁语 mobilis ← movere（移动）
words.native_definition: to organize people or resources so that they are ready to act
words.core_concept: getting what stood still to start moving together – 把原先停着的一齐弄动起来
words.core_image: 一通电话打出去，散在各处的人几小时内都到了场
examples: The country mobilized its army.
They mobilized support for the plan.
semantic_expansions: 动员：把人召起来投入行动
调动：把资源从各处挪到用得上的地方
组织起来：先编排再让其一齐动
words.recall_hint: mobile（挪得动的）+ -ize（使…）→ 把停着的弄动起来

words.root_logic: movimentum（动一下）← movere（移动）→ 天平偏一下的那一瞬 → 极短的一段
words.origin: 拉丁语 momentum（动的那一下、瞬间）← movere（移动）
words.native_definition: a very short period of time; a particular point in time
words.core_concept: the single tip of the scale, over before it is named – 天平偏过去那一下，短到刚察觉就没了
words.core_image: 天平上添了一粒沙，指针偏了一下就停住了
examples: Wait here for a moment.
At that moment the lights went out.
semantic_expansions: 时刻：某件事发生的那一个点
瞬间：短到只够偏一下的那一段
片刻：同样短的一段，用在等待上
words.recall_hint: movimentum（动一下）← movere → 天平偏一下的那一瞬

words.root_logic: momentum（动的那一下）← movere（移动）→ 已经动起来的东西自带的那股劲
words.origin: 拉丁语 momentum（推动力、动量）← movere（移动）
words.native_definition: the force that a moving object has; the ability to keep making progress
words.core_concept: what a thing already in motion carries with it – 已经动起来的东西身上带着的那股劲
words.core_image: 球从坡上滚下来，越滚越快，伸手已经拦不住
examples: The ball gained momentum downhill.
The campaign lost momentum.
semantic_expansions: 动量：物体因质量与速度带着的那股劲
势头：事情已经动起来、自己往前的那股劲
推动力：这股劲加在别的事上，把它带着走
words.recall_hint: momentum（动的那一下）← movere → 动起来的东西自带的那股劲

words.root_logic: magnus（大）+ -fy（使…）→ 使它看起来更大
words.origin: 拉丁语 magnificare（使变大、推崇）← magnus（大）＋ -ficare（使…，构词后缀）
words.native_definition: to make something appear larger; to make something seem more important than it is
words.core_concept: making the thing take up more space than it really does – 让那样东西占的地方比实际更大
words.core_image: 一片玻璃悬在纸上，底下的字撑满了整个圈
examples: This lens magnifies ten times.
Don't magnify a small problem.
semantic_expansions: 放大：让它在眼里占的地方变大
夸大：同一动作用在事情的分量上，说得比实际重
words.recall_hint: magnus（大）+ -fy（使…）→ 使它显得更大

words.root_logic: maximus（最大的，magnus 的最高级）→ 到顶那一档，再上不去
words.origin: 拉丁语 maximum（最大之物），maximus（最大的）的中性形 ← magnus（大）
words.native_definition: the greatest amount or degree that is possible or allowed
words.core_concept: the line above which nothing more is allowed to go – 那一道刻线，越过去就不许了
words.core_image: 量杯侧面刻着一道线，水到那道就不能再添
examples: The maximum speed is 80 km/h.
We need a maximum of ten people.
semantic_expansions: 最大量/最高限度：能到或允许到的那一档，再上不去
最大的：处在那一档上的
words.recall_hint: maximus（最大的）← magnus（大）→ 到顶那一档

words.root_logic: maior（更大的、居长的）→ 一城里位分最大的那个人
words.origin: 古法语 maire ← 拉丁语 maior（更大的、年长的）← magnus（大）
words.native_definition: the person elected to lead the government of a town or city
words.core_concept: the one who stands at the middle of the town's affairs – 一城的事上位分最大、站在正中的那个
words.core_image: 剪彩时他站在正中间，别人都退开半步
examples: The mayor opened the new bridge.
She was elected mayor last year.
semantic_expansions: 市长/镇长：一城或一镇里位分最大、主事的那个人
words.recall_hint: maior（更大的、居长的）→ 一城里位分最大的那个

words.root_logic: ob-（朝向）+ ey（audire 听）→ 朝着那句话听，听了就照做
words.origin: 古法语 obeir ← 拉丁语 oboedire（听命）← ob-（朝向）＋ audire（听）
words.native_definition: to do what someone in authority tells you to do
words.core_concept: hearing the word and letting the body follow it – 那句话进了耳朵，身子就照着动
words.core_image: 话音刚落，队里的人一齐转向左边
examples: Soldiers must obey their officers.
You should obey the rules.
semantic_expansions: 服从：对人照着做，不问自己愿不愿
遵守：对规则照着做
听从：重在把那句话听进去再照办
words.recall_hint: ob-（朝向）+ ey（听）→ 朝着那句话听，听完照做

words.root_logic: mes-（坏）+ chief（caput 头、结局）→ 事情落到坏的那一头
words.origin: 古法语 meschief（不幸、坏结局）← meschever ← mes-（坏）＋ chief（头、结局）← 拉丁语 caput（头）
words.native_definition: behaviour that causes small troubles or annoyance; harm or damage
words.core_concept: the way a thing turns out when it comes to a bad head – 一件事最后落到不好的那一头
words.core_image: 几个孩子把邻居的门牌拧反了，蹲在墙角看谁先发现
examples: The boys were up to mischief.
The storm did great mischief.
semantic_expansions: 恶作剧：故意闹出小乱子，让事情往坏的那头走
淘气：常做这类事的性子，分量轻
损害：真落到坏结局，即造成的实际坏处
words.recall_hint: mes-（坏）+ chief（头、结局）→ 事情落到坏的那一头

words.root_logic: ma（我的）+ dame（domina 女主人 ← domus 家）→ 我的女主人 → 对女子的敬称
words.origin: 法语 madame（我的夫人）← ma（我的）＋ dame ← 拉丁语 domina（女主人）← domus（家）
words.native_definition: a polite form of address used for a woman
words.core_concept: the courtesy word for the woman of the house – 对当家那位女子说话时先出口的那个称呼
words.core_image: 门口那人脱帽退开半步，先说了一句才让路
examples: Good evening, madame, this way please.
The letter was addressed to madame.
semantic_expansions: 夫人：把对方当作一家之主的女主人来称
女士/太太：同一敬称推广到一般场合
words.recall_hint: ma（我的）+ dame（女主人 ← 家）→ 对当家女子的称呼

words.root_logic: of-（朝、对着）+ fend（击）→ 一下撞到人身上
words.origin: 拉丁语 offendere（撞上、触犯）← ob-（朝向）＋ -fendere（击）
words.native_definition: to make someone feel upset or angry; to break a rule or law
words.core_concept: the blow that lands on the other instead of being kept off – 那一下没挡在外头，直接撞到对面身上
words.core_image: 那句话出口时对面的人脸色一沉，手里的杯子放下了
examples: I hope I didn't offend you.
He offended against the law.
semantic_expansions: 冒犯/得罪：话或举动撞到人身上，让人不快
违犯：同一动作撞到的是规则那条线
words.recall_hint: of-（朝、对着）+ fend（击）→ 一下撞到对面身上

words.root_logic: lega（结盟）← ligare（绑）→ 几方被一纸约绑在一起
words.origin: 意大利语 lega（同盟）← 拉丁语 ligare（捆、绑）；与 lex（法）无关
words.native_definition: a group of people or teams joined together by agreement; a level of quality
words.core_concept: several parties tied by one paper so they move as one – 几方被同一纸约系住，往后一起行动
words.core_image: 十几支队签了同一份章程，赛程和赏罚都照那张纸走
examples: They joined the football league.
He is in a different league.
semantic_expansions: 联盟/联合会：几方被一纸约系在一起的那个团体
等级：同一团体内按强弱分出的层，因而引申为水平档次
words.recall_hint: lega（结盟）← ligare（绑）→ 几方被一纸约绑在一起

words.root_logic: mēkhanē（装置）→ 几件零件配起来，通上力就替人做活
words.origin: 法语 machine ← 拉丁语 machina ← 希腊语 mēkhanē（装置、器械）
words.native_definition: a device with moving parts that uses power to do work
words.core_concept: parts fitted together and given power so the work happens – 零件配起来通上力，活就自己做成了
words.core_image: 皮带带着几个齿轮转，那只木箱被一点点抬了上去
examples: The machine stopped working suddenly.
He repairs farm machines.
semantic_expansions: 机器/机械：零件配成、通上力替人做活的那个东西
机构：一套人事像零件一样咬合运转，故借用同一画面
words.recall_hint: mēkhanē（装置）→ 零件配起来通上力就替人做活

words.root_logic: minutus（弄小了的）← minus（更小）→ 把整桌拆成一条条细列出来
words.origin: 法语 menu（详细清单）← 形容词 menu（细小的）← 拉丁语 minutus（弄小的）← minus（更小）
words.native_definition: a list of dishes available in a restaurant; a list of options on a screen
words.core_concept: the whole broken down into small single lines to pick from – 整个拆成细细一条条，供人一条条挑
words.core_image: 桌上那张纸从上到下印着一条条，每条后面跟一个数
examples: Ask the waiter for the menu.
Choose an item from the menu.
semantic_expansions: 菜单：一家馆子能做的菜细列成条
选单：屏上把可做的事细列成条，同一画面
words.recall_hint: minutus（弄小的）← minus（更小）→ 拆成一条条细列出来

words.root_logic: nativus（天生的）← nasci（出生）→ 还是出生时那个样子，没被世事改过
words.origin: 法语 naïf / naïve（天生的、朴质的）← 拉丁语 nativus（天生的）← nasci（出生）
words.native_definition: showing a lack of experience, so believing things too easily
words.core_concept: still just as one came into the world, untouched by dealings – 还是出生时那个样子，没被世事磨过
words.core_image: 别人说什么她都点头，钱都递过去了才觉出不对
examples: She was naive to trust him.
That is a naive question.
semantic_expansions: 天真的：还保持着出生时那样，未经世事
幼稚的：同样的状态，但已到了该懂事的年纪
轻信的：因为没经历过，别人说什么都照单收下
words.recall_hint: nativus（天生的）← nasci（出生）→ 还是出生时那个样子

words.root_logic: ob-（迎面）+ vi（via 路）+ -ous（…的）→ 横在路当中的 → 谁走过都看得见
words.origin: 拉丁语 obvius（迎面挡在路上的）← ob-（朝向）＋ via（路）
words.native_definition: easy to see or understand because it is right in front of you
words.core_concept: the thing lying across the road, which no passer-by can miss – 横在路当中，走过的人一个也躲不开
words.core_image: 路当中横着一块大石头，走这条路的人没一个能绕开没看见
examples: The answer was obvious to everyone.
He made an obvious mistake.
semantic_expansions: 明显的/显而易见的：横在路当中，谁走过都看得见
words.recall_hint: ob-（迎面）+ vi（路）+ -ous → 横在路当中，谁走过都看得见

words.origin: 拉丁语 abdomen（腹部、下腹），更早词源不明，一说与 abdere（藏起来）有关，未有定论
words.native_definition: the part of the body between the chest and the hips, holding the stomach and bowels
words.core_concept: the soft body cavity below the chest – 胸腔下面那段软的体腔
words.core_image: 医生手掌压在胸口下面那片软处，一按就问疼不疼
examples: The doctor pressed gently on his abdomen.
A sharp pain spread across her abdomen.
semantic_expansions: 腹部：胸与髋之间那一段，装着胃和肠
下腹：同一段的偏下部位，说得更具体
words.decomposable_note: 拉丁借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.origin: 中古英语 aknowen（认得、承认，← 古英语 cnāwan 知道）后加 -ledge（仿 knowledge 的尾巴）而成
words.native_definition: to accept or admit that something is true, or to say that you have received something
words.core_concept: to let it be seen that you know – 让人看见你已经知道了
words.core_image: 他抬了下手，示意那句话说的是他，屋里的人都看见了
examples: She acknowledged that the plan had failed.
He acknowledged her help in the preface.
semantic_expansions: 承认：把知道的事摆到明面上，不再回避
致谢：明说某人帮过忙，把功劳点出来
确认收到：告诉对方东西已经到手
words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本身即词根，无拉丁词缀可拆

words.origin: 古英语 æfterweard（æfter 在后 + -weard 朝向）← 原始日耳曼语
words.native_definition: at a later time, following the thing just mentioned
words.core_concept: at a point past the thing just told – 在刚说的那件事往后
words.core_image: 电影散场，灯亮起来，观众才三三两两站起来说话
examples: We had dinner and talked afterward.
She apologized afterward, but the damage was done.
semantic_expansions: 后来：时间上落在前一件事后头
之后：同一层意思，紧接着前文
随后：紧跟着发生，间隔很短
words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本身即词根，无拉丁词缀可拆
collocations: 主句 + afterward —— 后来、之后，副词置于句末最常见，后面不接宾语
afterwards —— 英式多加 -s，美式多用 afterward，两者意思相同
soon/shortly afterward —— 不久之后，前面加程度词指明间隔长短
after + n/从句 —— after 是介词或连词，必须带成分；afterward 是副词单用，不能说 afterward the meeting

words.origin: 古法语 ample ← 拉丁语 amplus（宽大的、宏大的）
words.native_definition: enough or more than enough in size, amount or degree
words.core_concept: more space or amount than the need takes up – 比用得着的还多出一截
words.core_image: 行李箱合上还剩一层空档，再塞两件毛衣也压得住
examples: There is ample time to finish the report.
The old house has ample room for guests.
semantic_expansions: 充足的：数量够用还有余
宽敞的：地方大，摆开还空着
大量的：着眼于数目多
words.decomposable_note: 拉丁借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.origin: 古法语 amuser（a- ＋ muser 发呆、出神地盯着），muser 更早词源不明；与缪斯女神那一支无关
words.native_definition: to make someone smile or laugh, or to keep someone pleasantly occupied
words.core_concept: to hold attention so pleasantly that time slips by – 把注意力愉快地占住
words.core_image: 孩子看着杯口冒起的泡泡笑出声，一下午没喊过闷
examples: His silly voices amused the whole class.
She amused herself with old photo albums.
semantic_expansions: 逗笑：直接把人惹得笑起来
娱乐：让人过得愉快，不限于笑
消遣：拿点事把闲下来的时间填上
words.decomposable_note: 经法语入英语的借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.origin: 中古英语 anger（苦恼、痛楚）← 古诺斯语 angr（悲伤）← 原始日耳曼语 *angaz（狭窄、憋闷）
words.native_definition: a strong feeling of displeasure at something wrong or unfair
words.core_concept: heat rising in the chest at something unfair – 遇到不公时胸口顶上来的那股热
words.core_image: 他把杯子往桌上一放，声音比说话还响，脖子那片红上来
examples: His voice shook with anger.
The decision angered thousands of workers.
semantic_expansions: 愤怒：那股强烈的情绪本身
生气：日常说法，程度轻一些
激怒：动词用法，把这股情绪引到别人身上
words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本身即词根，无拉丁词缀可拆

words.origin: 古英语 æppel（果子，尤指苹果）← 原始日耳曼语 *aplaz
words.native_definition: a round fruit with firm white flesh and a red, green or yellow skin
words.core_concept: a firm round tree fruit that snaps when bitten – 咬得出脆响的圆形树上果子
words.core_image: 咬下去一声脆响，切面很快泛黄，中间几粒黑籽
examples: She packed an apple in his lunch box.
The tree behind the shed still bears fruit.
words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本身即词根，无拉丁词缀可拆

words.origin: 中古英语 on side（在旁边），由 a-（在，← 古英语 on）与 side（边，← 古英语 sīde）合成
words.native_definition: to one side and out of the way, or a remark made quietly to one person
words.core_concept: moved off the middle, over to the edge – 从当中挪到边上
words.core_image: 他把碗碟往桌边推了推，腾出当中一块地方摊开图纸
examples: He stepped aside to let her pass.
The actor delivered the line as an aside.
semantic_expansions: 在旁边：位置落在边上，不在中间
到一边：动作上挪开，让出地方
旁白：戏里压低声音说给一个人或观众听的话
words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本身即词根，无拉丁词缀可拆
collocations: set/put sth aside —— 把某物放到一边，也指专门留出时间或钱
aside from sth —— 等于 apart from，除…之外，美式里更常用
step aside / move aside —— 让开，引申为让出位置
say sth as an aside —— 作名词，压低声音说的一句，戏里的旁白

words.origin: 中古英语 awk（反的、拧着的，← 古诺斯语 afugr 转过去的）＋ -ward（朝向）
words.native_definition: causing difficulty or embarrassment, or moving in a clumsy way
words.core_concept: turned the wrong way, so nothing goes smoothly – 拧着的，怎么弄都不顺
words.core_image: 两人在窄楼道里让来让去，谁都没走过去，话也接不上
examples: There was an awkward silence at the table.
The box is an awkward shape to carry.
semantic_expansions: 尴尬的：场面不自在，人不知怎么办才好
笨拙的：动作不协调，做不利索
难处理的：东西或事情别扭，不好对付
words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本身即词根，无拉丁词缀可拆

words.origin: 由 back（后面，← 古英语 bæc）与 ground（地面、底子，← 古英语 grund）合成，本指画面靠后的那一层
words.native_definition: the part behind the main subject, or a person's past experience and training
words.core_concept: the layer sitting behind the thing you look at – 你正看的东西后面那一层
words.core_image: 照片里人站得清楚，后头那排屋顶和树影虚成一片
examples: The mountains form a dramatic background.
Her background is in civil engineering.
semantic_expansions: 背景：画面或场景里靠后的那部分
出身经历：一个人身后带着的来路与训练
幕后：事情后面不摆到明面上的那一层
words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本身即词根，无拉丁词缀可拆

words.origin: 古英语 bæcweard（bæc 背、后 + -weard 朝向）← 原始日耳曼语
words.native_definition: directed towards the rear, or slow to develop
words.core_concept: facing or moving the way your back points – 朝着背对的那一头去
words.core_image: 她没转身，脚跟先探出去一步，手在身后摸着栏杆
examples: He took a step backward in surprise.
The village remained backward for decades.
semantic_expansions: 向后的：方向朝着身后那一侧
落后的：发展跟不上，停在后头
倒退的：本来往前，现在反着走
words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本身即词根，无拉丁词缀可拆
collocations: step backward —— 向后退
backward and forward —— 来回地

words.origin: 古法语 beauté（← 通俗拉丁语 bellitas ← 拉丁语 bellus 好看的）入英语作 beauty，再加日耳曼后缀 -ful
words.native_definition: pleasing to look at, listen to, or think about
words.core_concept: so pleasing to the senses that attention stops on it – 好到让人的注意力停住
words.core_image: 她一进门，几桌人的话头都停了半拍，眼睛跟着走
examples: The sunset over the lake was beautiful.
She has a beautiful singing voice.
semantic_expansions: 美丽的：看着就叫人移不开眼，多说人和景
优美的：形态或声音舒展好听
极好的：夸做得漂亮，不关外貌
words.decomposable_note: 拉丁借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.origin: 由 black（黑，← 古英语 blæc）与 board（板，← 古英语 bord）合成
words.native_definition: a dark smooth surface on a wall that you write on with chalk
words.core_concept: a dark wall panel written on in white dust – 墙上那块用白粉末写字的暗色板面
words.core_image: 老师抬手一擦，白粉末在光柱里飘起来，底下只剩半行字
examples: The teacher wrote the date on the blackboard.
Someone had drawn a cat in the corner.
words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本身即词根，无拉丁词缀可拆

words.origin: 十六世纪苏格兰边地语：black（黑）＋ mail（← 古诺斯语 mál 约定、贡赋），本指向劫掠者交的保命钱
words.native_definition: the crime of demanding money by threatening to reveal something damaging
words.core_concept: money squeezed out by holding a secret over someone – 拿着别人的短处逼他掏钱
words.core_image: 桌上摊着一张照片，来人不提钱，只说下周还来一趟
examples: He was arrested for blackmail last year.
She refused to be blackmailed into silence.
semantic_expansions: 敲诈：以揭发相威胁，索要钱财
胁迫：不一定为钱，逼人照自己的意思办
words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本身即词根，无拉丁词缀可拆

words.origin: 中古英语 blok ← 古法语 bloc（木墩）← 中古荷兰语 blok（树干截段）← 原始日耳曼语
words.native_definition: a solid piece of hard material, or to stop something from passing
words.core_concept: a solid lump set in the way – 一整块实心的东西堵在那儿
words.core_image: 一截木梁横在门口，推不动，人只能绕另一头走
examples: They live three blocks from here.
A fallen tree blocked the road.
semantic_expansions: 街区：街道切出来的一整片地面
大块：木头石头之类整整一坨的料
阻塞：动词用法，横在通路上让东西过不去
words.decomposable_note: 早期借词，经古英语或中古英语阶段传入，词形已归化，无可拆的词缀

words.origin: 古英语 cildhād（cild 孩子 + -hād 身份、状态，后作 -hood）← 原始日耳曼语
words.native_definition: the period of a person's life when they are a child
words.core_concept: the early stretch of a life, before growing up – 一个人长大之前那段日子
words.core_image: 抽屉底下压着一张小学作业本，铅笔字歪歪扭扭，扉页贴着糖纸
examples: He spent his childhood by the sea.
Childhood memories came back all at once.
semantic_expansions: 童年：从记事到少年那一段光景
幼年：更靠前的一截，年纪更小
words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本身即词根，无拉丁词缀可拆

words.origin: 中古英语 clok ← 中古荷兰语 clocke（钟）← 中世纪拉丁语 clocca（铃、钟），更早或出自凯尔特语
words.native_definition: a device that shows the time, not carried on the person
words.core_concept: a standing device that ticks the hours off – 摆着不动、一格一格数着时辰的器具
words.core_image: 夜里静下来，走针的声音一格一格，隔着墙也听得见
examples: The clock in the hall struck twelve.
She set the clock ten minutes fast.
semantic_expansions: 时钟：摆着或挂着显示时间的器具
挂钟：挂在墙上的那一种，说得更具体
words.decomposable_note: 早期借词，经古英语或中古英语阶段传入，词形已归化，无可拆的词缀

words.origin: 由 copy（← 古法语 copie ← 拉丁语 copia 抄本、丰富）与 right（权利，← 古英语 riht）合成，十八世纪成词
words.native_definition: the legal right to be the only one who may reproduce a work
words.core_concept: the sole legal claim to reproduce a work – 独家复制某作品的法定资格
words.core_image: 书末尾那行小字写着年份和公司名，别人翻印就得先来问
examples: The publisher owns the copyright to both books.
Copying the images breaks copyright.
semantic_expansions: 版权：印制发行方面的独家权利
著作权：作者对自己作品所持的那份权利
words.decomposable_note: 早期借词，经古英语或中古英语阶段传入，词形已归化，无可拆的词缀

words.origin: 中古英语 core（果实中心），更早词源不明；或与古法语 cor（心）有关，未有定论
words.native_definition: the central or most important part of something
words.core_concept: the hard middle left when the outside is gone – 外头吃光后剩下的那个硬中心
words.core_image: 啃到中间就剩一根硬芯，捏在手里，籽还硌手
examples: Safety is at the core of the design.
He tossed the apple core into the bin.
semantic_expansions: 核心：事物最当中、最要紧的那部分
果核：水果中间那截硬的
要点：一段话或一件事剥到最后剩下的那点
words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本身即词根，无拉丁词缀可拆

words.origin: 古英语 dohtor ← 原始日耳曼语 *dohter
words.native_definition: someone's female child
words.core_concept: the girl a person has brought into the world – 一个人生下来的那个女孩
words.core_image: 那姑娘考完试推门进来，先喊了一声，然后把书包扔沙发上
examples: Their daughter is studying medicine.
She looks just like her mother did.
words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本身即词根，无拉丁词缀可拆

words.origin: 由 day（← 古英语 dæġ）与 light（← 古英语 lēoht）合成，中古英语已见
words.native_definition: the natural light of day, or the time when it is light
words.core_concept: the light the sky gives while the sun is up – 太阳在天上时天空给的那份亮
words.core_image: 窗帘一拉开，屋里的灯就显得多余了，桌面亮得能看见浮尘
examples: The room looks better in daylight.
We set off before daylight.
semantic_expansions: 日光：那种自然的亮本身
白昼：天亮着的那段时间
words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本身即词根，无拉丁词缀可拆

words.origin: 古法语 delaier（搁着不办），第二成分说法不一，更早词源不明
words.native_definition: to make something happen later than planned, or the time lost by this
words.core_concept: a planned moment pushed further off – 本该到的时候被往后推开
words.core_image: 站牌上的时刻改了三回，行李堆在脚边，等的人越来越多
examples: Heavy snow delayed the morning flights.
There was a two-hour delay at the border.
semantic_expansions: 延误：该到没到，白耗掉的那段时间
推迟：主动把事情挪到更晚
延期：把定好的日子整个往后改
words.decomposable_note: 经法语入英语的借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.origin: dispatch 的异体拼法，十六世纪经西班牙语 despachar 或意大利语 dispacciare 入英语，更早词源有争议
words.native_definition: to send someone or something off to a place, or to deal with a task quickly
words.core_concept: to get a thing moving out without hanging about – 不拖着，把东西或人打发出去
words.core_image: 单子一签就装箱上车，当天出门，第二天回条就送回来了
examples: The company despatched two engineers at once.
Goods are despatched within three working days.
semantic_expansions: 派送：把人或货打发到某地去
发送：着眼于东西离手运出
迅速处理：把事情三下两下办完
words.decomposable_note: 借自西班牙语，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.origin: 古英语 dēofol ← 晚期拉丁语 diabolus ← 希腊语 diabolos（进谗言的人）
words.native_definition: the most powerful evil spirit, or a wicked or mischievous person
words.core_concept: the whisperer who talks you into the wrong thing – 在耳边劝你走歪路的那位
words.core_image: 画上那位长着角和尾巴，蹲在人耳边低声说话，笑得很好看
examples: He looked as if he had seen the devil.
That little devil hid my glasses again.
semantic_expansions: 魔鬼：最厉害的那个恶灵
恶人：坏得出名的人

words.native_definition: the facts and understanding a person has gained

A laser cut the steel plate cleanly.

words.native_definition: at a time after the present or after something else
words.core_concept: a point further along the same line – 同一条线上更靠后的那个点

words.origin: 拉丁语 Latinus（拉丁姆的）← Latium（罗马所在的那一带平原），指该地的语言及后来用其派生语言的族群

words.core_concept: the sound that breaks out when something is funny – 忍不住时冲出来的那阵声音

His joke brought laughter from everyone.
semantic_expansions: 笑声：那种声音本身

He showed leadership during the crisis.

领导地位：处在带头的那个位置
领导才能：能把人带起来的那份本事

words.origin: 古法语 randon（急冲、乱跑）← randir（疾行）← 法兰克语 *rant（奔跑），日耳曼语源经法语入英

words.origin: 古法语 ranc（一排、行列）← 法兰克语 *hring（环、圈），日耳曼语源；另有古英语 ranc（高壮的）表「茂密、难闻」一义

排名：按高低把人摆进各格
列：本义那一排本身

鲁莽的：同一毛病更冲，不管拦不拦得住

原始的：数据或情绪未经收拾，也这么说

words.origin: 古法语 rasour ← raser（刮、削）← 通俗拉丁语 rasare ← 拉丁语 radere（刮、剃）；英语同族另只 erase 一词

words.origin: 古诺尔斯语 rotinn（腐坏的）进入中古英语，与 rot 同支
words.native_definition: decayed and no longer fit to use or eat
words.core_concept: already gone soft and foul – 已经败透了
words.core_image: 箱底那几个塌成褐色的糊，表面还起了一层白毛
examples: Throw away those rotten potatoes.
We had rotten weather all week.
semantic_expansions: 腐烂的：东西已经败坏发软出味
糟糕的：借来说事情坏得让人不想碰
words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本身即词根，无拉丁词缀可拆

words.origin: 古英语 rūh（毛糙的、多毛的）← 原始日耳曼语 *rūhaz
words.native_definition: having an uneven surface, or not gentle and not exact
words.core_concept: uneven, not smoothed down – 不平，没磨过
words.core_image: 手掌在没刨过的木板上一抹，几处毛刺挂住了皮
examples: The wall felt rough under her hand.
He made a rough guess at the cost.
semantic_expansions: 粗糙的：表面不平，摸着挂手
粗略的：只做了个大概，没打磨细处
粗暴的：待人做事不加收拾，硬碰硬
words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本身即词根，无拉丁词缀可拆

words.origin: 中古英语 rousen，原为猎人术语，指把伏着的猎物惊起，来自盎格鲁法语，更早词源不明
words.native_definition: to wake someone or stir up strong feeling
words.core_concept: startle out of stillness – 把伏着不动的惊起来
words.core_image: 草丛里一脚踩下去，伏着的野兔猛地弹起来窜出十步
examples: The noise roused him from a deep sleep.
Her speech roused the tired crowd.
semantic_expansions: 唤醒：把睡着的人弄起来
激起：把沉着的情绪惊动起来
words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本身即词根，无拉丁词缀可拆

words.origin: 排列义来自古英语 rāw（一列）← 原始日耳曼语；划船义另出古英语 rōwan，两义同形不同源
words.native_definition: a line of things or people side by side, or to move a boat with oars
words.core_concept: things set side by side in a line – 挨着排成一条
words.core_image: 二十把椅子挨着摆成一条直线，头一把和末一把正好对着门框
examples: They sat in the front row.
He rowed us across the lake.
semantic_expansions: 一排：并排放成一条的那些东西
划船：另一支来源，坐着用桨把船拉动
words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本身即词根，无拉丁词缀可拆

words.origin: 中古英语 rubben，可能来自低地德语 rubben（擦、磨）
words.native_definition: to move something over a surface with pressure
words.core_concept: press and move back and forth – 压着来回动
words.core_image: 拿布压着桌上那块印子来回推，木头发热，印子淡了一圈
examples: She rubbed the window until it shone.
He rubbed his hands to keep warm.
semantic_expansions: 擦：压着来回动把表面弄净
搓：两面互相压着来回动
摩擦：这样接触时相互的那份阻力
words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本身即词根，无拉丁词缀可拆

words.origin: 中世纪拉丁语 rubinus ← 拉丁语 rubeus（红的）；该族在考研词表内只有这一个词，不足以单开词根
words.native_definition: a deep red precious stone
words.core_concept: a hard stone glowing dark red – 透着暗红的硬石
words.core_image: 戒面上那颗石头对着灯举起来，透出一片沉沉的血色
examples: She wore a ring set with a ruby.
The wine was almost ruby in the glass.
semantic_expansions: 红宝石：那种暗红透光的贵石
深红色：借这块石头说的那种红
words.decomposable_note: 拉丁借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.origin: 古法语 rude ← 拉丁语 rudis（未加工的、粗糙的）；该族在考研词表内只有这一个词，不足以单开词根
words.native_definition: not polite and showing no respect
words.core_concept: not smoothed by manners – 没经过打磨的糙
words.core_image: 话没说完他就转身走了，门在后头撞出很大一声
examples: It was rude to leave without a word.
He made a rude remark about her cooking.
semantic_expansions: 无礼的：不顾场面上该有的分寸
粗野的：举动不加收拾，硬碰硬
words.decomposable_note: 拉丁借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.origin: 斯堪的纳维亚语支，与瑞典语 rugg（乱毛）同源，原指毛糙的厚布
words.native_definition: a thick piece of woven material covering part of a floor
words.core_concept: thick woven mat underfoot – 脚底下那块厚毛布
words.core_image: 厚厚一块毛布铺在床边，脚踩上去毛陷下去一点，抬脚又鼓回来
examples: A wool rug lay beside the bed.
She wrapped a rug around her knees.
semantic_expansions: 小地毯：铺在地上一小块的那种
毛毯：同样的厚毛布，也能盖在身上
words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本身即词根，无拉丁词缀可拆

words.origin: 古法语 ruine ← 拉丁语 ruina（崩塌）← ruere（倒下、崩落）；该族在考研词表内只有这一个词，不足以单开词根
words.native_definition: to damage something so badly that it cannot be used, or what is left after collapse
words.core_concept: brought down past saving – 塌到救不回来
words.core_image: 一杯水泼在摊开的画稿上，颜色化成一片浑，纸也起了皱
examples: Rain ruined the whole harvest.
We walked among the ruins of the temple.
semantic_expansions: 毁坏：把东西弄坏到不能再用
废墟：塌下来以后剩的那一片
words.decomposable_note: 经法语入英语的借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.origin: 古英语 rinnan / iernan（跑、流）← 原始日耳曼语
words.native_definition: to move quickly on foot, or to keep something working
words.core_concept: keep going without stopping – 一直动着不停下
words.core_image: 两脚交替离地，胸口起伏，路边的树一棵接一棵往后闪
examples: She runs three miles every morning.
He runs a small bookshop.
semantic_expansions: 跑：两脚快换着往前移
运转：机器一直动着不停
经营：一摊事由你看着，让它一直转下去
words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本身即词根，无拉丁词缀可拆
collocations: run into sb/sth —— 偶然碰上某人、也指撞上或遇上麻烦，不是刻意去找；run across sth 同此义，into 是走着走着正撞进对方的路线
run out of sth —— 把某物用完，主语是人；run out 的主语是东西本身，如 The money ran out，两者不可混
run over sb/sth —— 车从身上轧过去，也指把稿子快速过一遍，over 是从上方整个掠过
run a company / run a business —— 经营、管理，让整个摊子持续转起来，此处与跑无关
in the long run —— 从长远看，把时间拉成一条长跑道，run 此处是名词
run for president —— 竞选某职位，for 引出所奔向的那个位子

words.origin: 古法语 rural ← 拉丁语 ruralis ← rus（田野、乡下）；该族在考研词表内只有这一个词，不足以单开词根
words.native_definition: relating to the countryside rather than the town
words.core_concept: out where the fields are – 在田地那一边
words.core_image: 客车开出去四十分钟，两边只剩麦地、水塘和几间矮房
examples: Many rural schools have closed.
They moved to a rural area last spring.
semantic_expansions: 乡村的：城镇以外那一片的
田野的：着眼于那里的地与庄稼
words.decomposable_note: 经法语入英语的借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.origin: 盎格鲁法语 russher（推开、逼退）← 古法语 ruser，更早词源不明
words.native_definition: to move or act very fast, with no time to spare
words.core_concept: go fast with no time left – 快得来不及从容
words.core_image: 电梯门一开人全挤出去，有人边走边把袖子塞进外套
examples: Don't rush your breakfast.
He got caught in the evening rush.
semantic_expansions: 冲：一下子快速过去
匆忙：做事赶着，留不出余地
高峰：大家都赶着的那一段时候
words.decomposable_note: 经法语入英语的借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.origin: 古英语 rūst（铁锈）← 原始日耳曼语，与 red（红）同支
words.native_definition: the reddish brown coating that forms on iron in damp air
words.core_concept: iron turning red in damp air – 铁在潮气里泛红
words.core_image: 门轴上结了一层红褐的粉皮，指甲一刮就掉，底下是坑
examples: Rust had eaten through the gate.
The tools rusted in the wet shed.
semantic_expansions: 铁锈：铁上结出的那层红褐皮
生锈：铁一点点变成那层皮的过程
words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本身即词根，无拉丁词缀可拆

words.origin: 中古英语 ruth（怜悯，← 古英语 hrēowan 使痛悔）加否定后缀 -less 构成
words.native_definition: showing no pity at all in pursuing a goal
words.core_concept: carrying no pity at all – 一点怜悯也不带
words.core_image: 他把跟了十年的老员工名字划掉，笔没停一下就翻到下一页
examples: She is ruthless in business dealings.
The ruthless attack shocked the village.
semantic_expansions: 无情的：下手时不顾对方难处
残忍的：狠到让人看着难受
words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本身即词根，无拉丁词缀可拆

words.origin: 古英语 sacc ← 拉丁语 saccus ← 希腊语 sakkos（粗布袋），更早出自闪语
words.native_definition: a large bag of coarse cloth for grain or coal
words.core_concept: coarse cloth bag holding a load – 装货的粗布袋
words.core_image: 粗布口袋装满土豆，扛上肩时接缝处绷得发白
examples: He carried a sack of rice upstairs.
Two managers were sacked last month.
semantic_expansions: 麻袋：粗布缝的那种大口袋
解雇：从「让他收拾东西装袋走人」来的说法
words.decomposable_note: 早期借词，经古英语或中古英语阶段传入，词形已归化，无可拆的词缀

words.origin: 古英语 sæd（吃饱的、厌足的）← 原始日耳曼语 *sadaz，经「饱到发沉」转出沉重、忧伤义
words.native_definition: feeling unhappy and heavy in the heart
words.core_concept: weighed down in the heart – 心里沉甸甸的
words.core_image: 她放下电话就那么坐着，一直盯着凉掉的那杯茶不说话
examples: She looked sad all through dinner.
It is sad that nobody came.
semantic_expansions: 悲伤的：心里压着，提不起劲
难过的：同一种沉，说得轻些
words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本身即词根，无拉丁词缀可拆

words.root_logic: unus（一）→ unio（独头的一整个）→ 一层层裹成的那一颗
words.origin: 古法语 oignon ← 拉丁语 unio（属格 unionis：一整个、独头的那颗），罗马农人拿它称独头蒜
words.native_definition: a round vegetable with many layers and a strong smell
words.core_concept: a bulb grown as one layered ball – 一层层裹成一个球的那种根菜
words.core_image: 一层裹一层的球，刀切下去眼睛就开始发酸流泪
examples: She chopped an onion for the soup.
Fry the onions until soft.
semantic_expansions: 洋葱：一层层裹成一整颗、辣眼睛的那种菜
葱头：同一样东西，说的是它圆鼓鼓的那颗

words.root_logic: unus（一）→ uncia（十二分之一，一个小单位）→ 秤上最小的那一格
words.origin: 古法语 unce ← 拉丁语 uncia（十二分之一，一个单位），罗马的一磅分十二份，inch 亦出此词
words.native_definition: a unit of weight equal to about 28 grams; a very small amount
words.core_concept: the smallest single notch on the scale – 秤上最小的那一个刻度
words.core_image: 秤盘上放一枚小铜片，指针只挪了一格，轻得几乎压不住手
examples: Add two ounces of butter.
He showed not an ounce of fear.
semantic_expansions: 盎司：约二十八克的那个重量单位
一点点：少到只够一格，多用于说连这么点都没有

words.root_logic: unus（一）+ animus（心气）→ 众人一条心
words.origin: 拉丁语 unanimus（同心的）← unus（一）+ animus（心、气）
words.native_definition: agreed on by everyone, with nobody against it
words.core_concept: all minds turned the same way – 所有人的心朝着同一个方向
words.core_image: 举手表决，一屋子人的手全举起来，没有一只按下去
examples: The committee vote was unanimous.
They were unanimous in praising her.
semantic_expansions: 全体一致的：屋里每个人都站同一边，没有反对的
一致同意的：这一致落在同意上，表决时全票通过

words.root_logic: uni-（unus 一）+ -fy（使成为）→ 使合成一个
words.origin: 晚期拉丁语 unificare（使成一体）← unus（一）+ -ficare（使成为）
words.native_definition: to bring separate parts together so they work as one
words.core_concept: to make many run as one – 把好几份弄成一份来运作
words.core_image: 几家小铺子打通了门板，挂上同一块招牌，从外面看就是一家
examples: The king unified the warring tribes.
One rule unifies the two systems.
semantic_expansions: 统一：把分散的几方并到一处、归到同一套规矩下
使成一体：并过之后彼此不再分开，当一个整的来用

words.root_logic: unus（一）→ unio（并成一个）→ 合起来之后的那个整体
words.origin: 古法语 union ← 晚期拉丁语 unio（属格 unionis：合为一体）← unus（一）
words.native_definition: the act of joining together, or a group formed by joining
words.core_concept: separate parts made into one body – 分开的几份并成一个身子
words.core_image: 两条河在山口汇到一处，往下游只剩一道水面
examples: The workers formed a union.
Their union lasted forty years.
semantic_expansions: 联合：并到一处这件事本身
工会：工人并成一处、替大家说话的那个组织
联盟：几方长期并在一处的那种安排

words.root_logic: unus（一）→ unicus（只此一个）→ 独此一份，再无第二
words.origin: 法语 unique ← 拉丁语 unicus（唯一的、独一个的）← unus（一）
words.native_definition: being the only one of its kind
words.core_concept: the only one of its kind anywhere – 同类里只有这一个，别处没有
words.core_image: 一屋子瓶子长得一样，只有那只釉色歪了，别处再找不出第二只
examples: Every single fingerprint is unique.
The town has a unique charm.
semantic_expansions: 独一无二的：世上只此一件，找不出第二件
独特的：不必真只有一件，但那个特点别处没有

words.root_logic: unus（一）→ unitas（一个整的）→ 算作一个来数的那一份
words.origin: 16 世纪造词，仿拉丁语 unitas（一个整体）而成，用来译欧几里得的「可数的一」← unus（一）
words.native_definition: a single thing or amount counted as one whole
words.core_concept: one whole taken as the thing you count – 拿来当一个整的来点数的那份
words.core_image: 货架上一排牛奶，一盒算一份，点数时就这么一盒一盒数
examples: The book has twelve short units.
Price is given per unit.
semantic_expansions: 单位：计量时定下的那一份，如一米一克
单元：整套东西里划出的一段，如课本的一章
部件：整机里能单独拆出来算一个的那块

words.root_logic: unus（一）→ unire（使成一个）→ 并到一处成一个
words.origin: 拉丁语 unire（使合为一）的过去分词 unitus ← unus（一）
words.native_definition: to join together, or to act together as one
words.core_concept: to come into one from many – 从好几份走到一份
words.core_image: 几股细线捻到一处，成了一根，再拉不断
examples: The threat united the villagers.
They united to fight the plan.
semantic_expansions: 联合：几方并到一处，一同行动
团结：并在一处之后彼此不散，劲往一个方向使
合并：两方并成一方，原来的界线取消

words.root_logic: unus（一）→ unitas（成为一个的状态）→ 许多份合成一个
words.origin: 拉丁语 unitas（属格 unitatis：一体、合一）← unus（一）
words.native_definition: the state of being joined together or acting as one
words.core_concept: many parts holding as one thing – 许多份撑成一样东西
words.core_image: 拔河的一队人同时后仰，绳子那头看过去像一个人在拉
examples: The team showed real unity.
He called for national unity.
semantic_expansions: 统一：分开的部分并到一处、不再各行其是的那个状态
团结：人心不散，做事的劲朝一个方向
整体：从外面看只见一样东西，看不出是拼起来的

words.root_logic: unus（一）+ versus（转成的）→ universus（合成一整个）→ 一个不落全算在内
words.origin: 古法语 universel ← 拉丁语 universalis ← universus（合成一整个的）← unus（一）+ versus（转成的）
words.native_definition: true of or applying to everyone and everywhere
words.core_concept: holding everywhere with nothing left out – 处处都算得上，一个不落
words.core_image: 同一张表格发到各国，格式一模一样，谁拿到都照着填
examples: Clean water is a universal need.
The rule is not universal.
semantic_expansions: 普遍的：到哪里都成立，不限某地某人
通用的：一样东西各处都能用，不必换
全体的：说的是所有人所有件，没有例外

words.root_logic: unus（一）+ versus（转成的）→ universum（合成一整个的那全部）→ 无边无际的那一整个
words.origin: 古法语 univers ← 拉丁语 universum（全部合成的那一个）← universus ← unus（一）+ versus（转成的）
words.native_definition: all of space and everything that exists in it
words.core_concept: everything there is taken as one whole – 所有存在的东西合起来算一个
words.core_image: 夜里躺在田里往上看，黑的那一片没有边，什么都在里头
examples: The whole universe keeps expanding.
She wondered how the universe began.
semantic_expansions: 宇宙：星辰与空间合起来的那个没有边的整体
万物：同一个整体，说的是里头装着的所有东西

words.root_logic: unus（一）→ universitas（合成一体的那群人）→ 师生结成的一个整体
words.origin: 中世纪拉丁语 universitas（结成一体的团体，本指师生行会）← universus ← unus（一）
words.native_definition: a place where students study for degrees after school
words.core_concept: teachers and students bound into one body – 教的人和学的人结成的一个团体
words.core_image: 一片连着的楼和草坪，年轻人夹着书从这栋走到那栋
examples: She teaches at a small university.
He left university after one year.
semantic_expansions: 大学：能授学位、中学之后去读的那种学校
高等学府：同一类地方，说的是它在学制里的层级

words.root_logic: laxare（松开）→ laissier（撂下不管）→ 把手里的地方撂给别人用一段
words.origin: 盎格鲁法语 les ← 古法语 laissier（撂下、让出）← 拉丁语 laxare（松开）
words.native_definition: a contract letting someone use property for a fixed time
words.core_concept: to let go of what you hold, for a set time – 把手里的撂给别人，讲定多久
words.core_image: 房东把钥匙推过桌面，纸上写明用到哪一天，这期间他不再进那扇门
examples: They signed a two-year lease.
He leased the shop to her.
semantic_expansions: 租约：讲明让出多久、收多少的那份契
租期：同一份契里划出的那段时间

words.root_logic: re-（往回）+ lax（laxare 松开）→ 把绷起来的那股劲送回去
words.origin: 拉丁语 relaxare（放松、松开）← re-（回）+ laxare（松开）
words.native_definition: to become less tense, or to make a rule less strict
words.core_concept: to let the pulled-tight go back – 让绷紧的退回原样
words.core_image: 攥了一晚的笔终于放下，肩膀往椅背上一沉
examples: Sit down and relax for a while.
The rules were relaxed last year.
semantic_expansions: 放松：身上或心里那股绷着的劲退掉
松弛：肌肉或皮不再绷紧，垮下来一点
放宽：把管得死的条文往松处挪

words.root_logic: re-（接着）+ lay（laxare 放开）→ 放开手里的，交给接手的那一个
words.origin: 古法语 relaier（放开新犬接替）← re-（再）+ laier ← 拉丁语 laxare（松开）
words.native_definition: a race or process in which each one passes on to the next
words.core_concept: the first lets go as the next takes hold – 前一个松手，后一个接住
words.core_image: 前一个人把棍子塞进后一个人手里，自己立刻慢下来喘气
examples: She ran the final relay leg.
He relayed the message to me.
semantic_expansions: 接力：几人一段段跑、手手相交的那种赛
转达：把话从一个人手里递到另一个人
中继：中间那一站，把信号接过来再送出去

words.root_logic: re-（回）+ lease（laxare 松开）→ 手一松，让它走
words.origin: 古法语 relessier ← 拉丁语 relaxare（松开）← laxare（松开）
words.native_definition: to set free, or to let something out to the public
words.core_concept: to open the hand and let it go – 手一开，任它出去
words.core_image: 铁门推开一条缝，人从里头走出来，锁挂在旁边开着
examples: They released the birds at dawn.
The band released a new album.
semantic_expansions: 释放：把关着的人或物放走
放开：手上不再攥着，也用于放开管制
发布：把攥在手里没公开的东西放出去给众人

words.root_logic: laxare（放开）→ relaisser（撂下不带走）→ 咽下之后撂在嘴里的那一点
words.origin: 古法语 reles（残留的那点味）← relaisser（撂下、留下）← 拉丁语 relaxare ← laxare（松开）
words.native_definition: great enjoyment of something, or a spicy sauce eaten with food
words.core_concept: what stays behind after the mouthful – 一口咽下去之后留在嘴里的那点
words.core_image: 咽下去之后嘴里还留着一股，人闭着眼又回想了一遍
examples: He ate with obvious relish.
She relished the quiet evening.
semantic_expansions: 滋味：吃过之后留在嘴里的那股味
享受：把那点留下的味细细尝，引申为乐在其中
佐料：拌在菜里专为出那股味的酱

words.root_logic: salvus（完好）→ 古法语 sauf → 没伤着、也碰不着的状态
words.origin: 古法语 sauf ← 拉丁语 salvus（未受伤的、完好的）
words.native_definition: not in danger and not hurt; a strong box for valuables
words.core_concept: whole, and out of harm's reach – 囫囵着，且伤不着
words.core_image: 孩子从街上跑进院里，母亲把门闩上，外头的车声就隔在门外
examples: The children are safe at home.
He locked the papers in a safe.
semantic_expansions: 安全的：处在伤害到不了的地方
平安的：走过一段险处而人没损，多说结果
保险箱：厚铁做的柜，让里头的东西也处在伤害之外

words.root_logic: salvus（完好）→ salvitas（完好的状态）→ 不会伤着的那个状态
words.origin: 古法语 sauveté ← 中世纪拉丁语 salvitas ← salvus（完好的）
words.native_definition: the state of being free from danger or harm
words.core_concept: the condition of nothing being able to hurt you – 伤害碰不到你的那个状态
words.core_image: 工人下井前先把绳扣在腰上，扣好才敢往下踩
examples: Check the safety of the ladder.
They worried about her safety.
semantic_expansions: 安全：不会受伤、不会出事的那个状态
平安：人事过后没损没伤，偏说结果
保险装置：机器上专防出事的那个部件

words.root_logic: salvus（完好）→ salus（安好）→ salutare（问一声安好）→ 抬手道一声安好
words.origin: 拉丁语 salutare（问候、致敬）← salus（属格 salutis：安好、健康），与 salvus（完好的）同支
words.native_definition: to greet someone with a formal gesture of respect
words.core_concept: to wish another's wholeness aloud – 当面道一声你安好
words.core_image: 士兵右手一抬贴到帽檐，脚跟并拢，眼睛直看着对面
examples: The soldiers saluted the flag.
He raised his glass in salute.
semantic_expansions: 敬礼：抬手贴帽檐那套规定动作
致敬：用动作或话把看重之意表出来
问候：见面时道一声安好

words.root_logic: salvus（完好）→ salvare（使完好）→ salvatio（救回这件事）→ 从毁里被拉回完好
words.origin: 古法语 salvacion ← 晚期拉丁语 salvatio（拯救）← salvare（使完好）← salvus（完好的）
words.native_definition: the act of being saved from harm, ruin, or sin
words.core_concept: being pulled back from ruin into wholeness – 从要毁的地方被拉回到完好
words.core_image: 船斜得快翻了，上头抛下一条绳，人抓住被一寸寸拉上去
examples: They prayed quietly for salvation.
That loan was our salvation.
semantic_expansions: 救赎：宗教里灵魂从罪里被救回
拯救：从要毁的境地把人或物拉回来
救星：把人拉回来的那个人或那件事

words.root_logic: salvus（完好）→ salvare（使完好）→ 使它保住不损
words.origin: 古法语 sauver ← 晚期拉丁语 salvare（使完好、使不失）← salvus（完好的）
words.native_definition: to keep someone or something from harm or loss
words.core_concept: to keep it whole instead of losing it – 让它保住，别损掉
words.core_image: 他一手把人从水里拽上岸，另一只手还攥着那袋没花掉的钱
examples: He saved the boy from drowning.
She saves half her wages.
semantic_expansions: 救：把人或物从要毁的地方拉出来
储存：把东西留住不动，日后还在
节省：本要花掉的没花，留了下来

words.root_logic: insula（岛）→ insulatus（做成岛的）→ 四周围断，什么也过不去
words.origin: 拉丁语 insulatus（做成岛的）← insula（岛）
words.native_definition: to cover something so heat, sound, or electricity cannot pass
words.core_concept: to ring it round so nothing crosses – 四周围死，什么都过不来
words.core_image: 电线外面裹一层胶皮，手按上去一点也不打手
examples: They insulated the roof last winter.
Rubber insulates the copper wire.
semantic_expansions: 隔绝：四周围住，让外头的东西过不来
绝缘：围的是电，让电流走不出去
保温：围的是热，让热跑不掉

words.root_logic: insula（岛）→ 古法语 isle → 水里那一小块地
words.origin: 古法语 isle ← 拉丁语 insula（岛）；英语拼写里那个 s 是后人照拉丁词形补回去的
words.native_definition: a small island, used mostly in names and poems
words.core_concept: a little patch of land ringed by water – 被水围住的一小块地
words.core_image: 一小块地浮在水面上，走一圈用不了几分钟
examples: They sailed to a rocky isle.
The isle lies off the coast.
semantic_expansions: 小岛：面积不大、四面是水的那块地
岛：同一样东西，多见于地名与诗里的旧称

words.root_logic: insula（岛）→ 意大利语 isolato（成了岛的）→ 把它弄成四面不连的一块
words.origin: 意大利语 isolato（成了岛的、孤立的）← 拉丁语 insula（岛），经法语 isolé 进英语
words.native_definition: to keep someone or something apart from others
words.core_concept: to make it an island, joined to nothing – 弄成一座岛，跟谁都不连
words.core_image: 病人被推进单独一间，门关上，外头的人只在玻璃后头看
examples: They isolated the sick birds.
Scientists isolated the new virus.
semantic_expansions: 隔离：把人或物单独关开，不让接触
孤立：让它跟周围断了往来，独自一个
分离出：从混在一起的东西里把那一样单挑出来

words.root_logic: paene（几乎）+ insula（岛）→ 差一点就成岛的那块地
words.origin: 拉丁语 paeninsula ← paene（几乎）+ insula（岛）
words.native_definition: a piece of land almost surrounded by water
words.core_concept: land that fell just short of being an island – 差一点就断成岛的那块地
words.core_image: 一条地从岸上伸进海里，三面是水，只剩根上一截连着
examples: They drove down the peninsula.
The peninsula juts into the sea.

words.root_logic: poena（罚、要赔的那笔账）→ 古法语 peine（受的那份罪）→ 身上或心里那一下难受
words.origin: 古法语 peine（刑罚、苦）← 拉丁语 poena（罚、赔命的那笔账）
words.native_definition: an unpleasant feeling in the body or mind
words.core_concept: what the body is made to pay – 身上被讨去的那一笔
words.core_image: 他弯下腰去，手按在膝盖上，牙关咬着不出声
examples: She felt a sharp pain in her side.
It pained him to say no.
semantic_expansions: 疼痛：身上某处传来的那股难受
痛苦：同一股难受落在心里
使痛苦：让人心里受这股难受

words.root_logic: pain（poena 罚出来的那点难受）+ -ful（满是）→ 满是那股难受
words.origin: pain（苦）＋ -ful（满是……的）合成，中古英语造词 ← 拉丁语 poena（罚）
words.native_definition: causing pain in the body or distress in the mind
words.core_concept: full of what hurts – 满是让人难受的那股
words.core_image: 伤口一挨到水就往回缩，整条胳膊跟着一抖，脸也皱起来
examples: The injection was quite painful.
It was a painful decision.
semantic_expansions: 疼的：身上一碰就难受
痛苦的：心里那份难受，如做不下的决定
令人难受的：让旁人看着也不好受

words.root_logic: poena（罚）→ poenalis（关于罚的）→ 判下来要付的那一笔
words.origin: 中世纪拉丁语 poenalitas ← 拉丁语 poenalis（关于罚的）← poena（罚）
words.native_definition: a punishment for breaking a rule or law
words.core_concept: the price set for breaking a rule – 犯了规就得付的那笔
words.core_image: 哨子一响，裁判指着球门前那个点，全场人都退到线外
examples: The penalty for late payment is steep.
He scored from the penalty.
semantic_expansions: 处罚：违规之后加在身上的那一下
罚款：那一下算成钱
罚球：球场上判给对方的那一脚或一投

words.root_logic: poena（罚）→ punire（施罚）→ 照那笔账讨回来
words.origin: 古法语 punir ← 拉丁语 punire（惩罚）← poena（罚）
words.native_definition: to make someone suffer for doing something wrong
words.core_concept: to collect the price for a wrong – 把做错事那笔账讨回来
words.core_image: 打碎玻璃的孩子被叫到墙角站着，一晚上不许出门
examples: The school punished him for cheating.
They were punished quite harshly.
semantic_expansions: 惩罚：因做错事而让人吃苦头
处罚：按规矩定下的那种惩罚
重创：打得很惨，多用于比赛或战事

words.root_logic: de-（郑重地）+ dic（dicare 宣告）→ 当众说明这一样归谁
words.origin: 拉丁语 dedicare（宣告归属、献出）的过去分词 dedicatus ← de-（郑重）+ dicare（宣示归于）
words.native_definition: to give your time or work to something, or to name a work in someone's honour
words.core_concept: to say aloud whose this is – 当众说出这归谁
words.core_image: 新桥落成，桥头牌子上刻着一个人的名字，从此这桥就算他的
examples: She dedicated her life to teaching.
The book is dedicated to his mother.
semantic_expansions: 奉献：把时间精力全交给某事
致献：正式宣告某物归于某人或某事
题献：在书上写明这本给谁

words.root_logic: in-（朝着）+ dic（dicare 指明说出）→ 指给你看在哪儿的那样东西
words.origin: 拉丁语 index（属格 indicis：指示者、食指）← indicare（指出）← in-（朝）+ dicare（宣示）
words.native_definition: an alphabetical list at the back of a book, or a number showing change
words.core_concept: the finger that points to where it is – 那根指着东西在哪儿的手指
words.core_image: 翻到书最后几页，词一条条排着，后面跟着页码
examples: Look it up in the index.
The price index rose again.
semantic_expansions: 索引：书后按字母排的条目，指到页码
指数：一个数，指出物价或水平的高低变动
目录：列出内容在哪一处的那张表

words.root_logic: in-（朝着）+ dicare（宣示）→ 朝那一处点明，让人看见
words.origin: 拉丁语 indicare（指出、宣示）的过去分词 indicatus ← in-（朝）+ dicare（宣示）
words.native_definition: to show, point out, or make something clear
words.core_concept: to point at it so others see – 朝那处一指，让人看见
words.core_image: 他没说话，抬手往门那边一指，屋里人都跟着看过去
examples: The sign indicates the way out.
Her face indicated real surprise.
semantic_expansions: 表明：把情况摆明，让人知道
指出：把某一点单挑出来说
示意：不说话，用动作让人看懂

words.root_logic: idein（看见）→ idea（看见时现出的那个形）→ 心里现出的那个形
words.origin: 拉丁语 idea ← 希腊语 idea（形相、样子）← idein（看见）
words.native_definition: a thought or plan that forms in the mind
words.core_concept: the shape that forms in the mind – 心里现出来的那个形
words.core_image: 洗澡时忽然停住，手上还举着毛巾，眼睛看着一处不动
examples: She had a better idea.
The idea came to him suddenly.
semantic_expansions: 想法：心里冒出来的那一个念头
主意：那个念头指向该怎么做
概念：把一类东西归成的那个形，如时间的概念

words.root_logic: idea（心里那个形）+ -al（合于……的）→ 合于心里那个形的
words.origin: 晚期拉丁语 idealis（只存于形相的）← 希腊语 idea（形相）← idein（看见）
words.native_definition: best possible, exactly what is wanted; a standard one aims at
words.core_concept: matching the shape held in mind – 跟心里那个形一模一样
words.core_image: 图纸上画的那间屋，尺寸角度处处对得上，盖出来的总差一点
examples: This is the ideal spot for camping.
She fell short of her ideal.
semantic_expansions: 理想的：正好合上心里所要的那个样子
完美的：一点不差，挑不出短处
理想：心里立着的那个样子，用来当准头

words.root_logic: idea（观念）+ -logy（一套条理）→ 一套成系统的观念
words.origin: 法语 idéologie ← 希腊语 idea（形相、观念）+ -logia（学说）
words.native_definition: a set of beliefs held by a group, especially in politics
words.core_concept: ideas built into one system – 观念搭成的一整套
words.core_image: 墙上刷着几行口号，屋里人说话都从那几行里挑词
examples: The party changed its ideology.
He rejected that whole ideology.
semantic_expansions: 意识形态：一群人共守的那套政治观念
思想体系：同一套观念，说的是它自成条理的结构

words.root_logic: passare（迈步、经过）→ pas（跨出的一段）→ 跨出的那一步，以及跨得多快
words.origin: 古法语 pas（步子）← 拉丁语 pandere（张开）的过去分词，本指两腿张开跨出的那一段
words.native_definition: the speed of walking or doing something; a single step
words.core_concept: how far one stride goes and how fast they come – 一步跨多远、跟得多密
words.core_image: 队伍走得又快又匀，后面的人得小跑才跟得上
examples: He walked at a steady pace.
She paced the room all night.
semantic_expansions: 步速：单位时间里跨出多少步，引申为做事快慢
一步：跨出去那一段距离
踱步：来回跨来跨去，多因心里不安

words.root_logic: passare（经过）→ passage（通行）→ passagier（过路的那个人）
words.origin: 古法语 passagier（过路的人）← passage（通行）← 晚期拉丁语 passare（经过）
words.native_definition: a person travelling in a vehicle but not driving it
words.core_concept: one carried through, not steering – 被载着过去、不掌方向的那个人
words.core_image: 有人握着票靠窗坐着，窗外的景一直往后退，手不碰方向盘
examples: The bus carried forty passengers.
Passengers must show their tickets.
semantic_expansions: 乘客：坐在车船飞机上被载着走的人
旅客：同一个人，说的是他在旅途上这层身份

words.root_logic: passare（通过）+ port（港口、城门）→ 准你过关口的那份凭据
words.origin: 法语 passeport ← passer（通过，← 晚期拉丁语 passare）+ port（港口、城门）
words.native_definition: an official document allowing you to travel to other countries
words.core_concept: leave to pass through the gate – 准许你从这道门过去
words.core_image: 关口前伸手递过一个小本，对方翻开比着脸看，盖个章又推回来
examples: She renewed her passport last month.
He lost his passport abroad.
semantic_expansions: 护照：出入国境用的那本官方证件
通行凭证：泛指凭它就能过去的东西，如通往成功的敲门砖

words.root_logic: posse（能够）→ potentia（能力）→ potentialis（有那个能而未显出来）
words.origin: 晚期拉丁语 potentialis（有能力的）← potentia（能力）← potens（有力的）← posse（能够）
words.native_definition: a quality that exists but has not yet been developed or shown
words.core_concept: the power a thing has but has not shown – 有那个能，只是还没显出来
