words.native_definition: staying firm in support of a person or cause
words.core_concept: holding to the bond as if bound by law – 守着那道约不松口
words.core_image: 换了三任领班，那条狗还每天守在原来那道门口等
examples: He stayed loyal to the team for years.
Loyal readers kept the small paper alive.
semantic_expansions: 说人不背弃是「忠诚的」；说态度一贯不变是「忠实的」

words.root_logic: loyal（照法条守约的）+ -ty（那种性质）→ 守约不改口这件事本身
words.origin: 古法语 loialte ← loial ← 拉丁语 legalis（照法条的）← lex（属格 legis：法条）
words.native_definition: firm and steady support for someone or something
words.core_concept: the habit of holding to one's bond – 守约不改口的那份性情
words.core_image: 老店关门那天，几个熟客一早就来站在檐下，站到卷帘门落下
examples: Her loyalty to old friends never wavered.
The company rewards loyalty with longer holidays.
semantic_expansions: 说不背弃这件事整体是「忠诚」；偏说心里那份不移的是「忠心」

words.root_logic: privi（私人的）+ lege（lex 法条）→ 单为一个人写的那道法条
words.origin: 拉丁语 privilegium：privus（私人的）+ lex（属格 legis：法条）——专为某一个人立的条文
words.native_definition: a special right given to one person or group
words.core_concept: a statute written for one alone – 单为一人写的条文
words.core_image: 长队排到门口，他掏出一张卡，侧门直接开了，队里的人都看着
examples: Club members enjoy the privilege of free parking.
It was a privilege to work here.
semantic_expansions: 只归少数人的那份权是「特权」；落到日常照顾上是「优待」；轮到自己头上时客气着说是「荣幸」

words.root_logic: modus（量度、限度、办法）→ 定下的那一套做法，照它走就不出界
words.origin: 拉丁语 modus（量度、限度、办法）
words.native_definition: a particular way in which something is done or works
words.core_concept: the set way a thing is done – 定下的那一套做法
words.core_image: 相机上的转盘拨到某一格，快门和光圈就都按那一格的规矩走
examples: Trains are the cheapest mode of travel here.
Switch the phone to silent mode.
semantic_expansions: 单说做一件事走哪条路是「方式」；这套做法固定成型、可反复照办时是「模式」

words.root_logic: modulus（modus 的小尺度）→ 按小一号尺寸做出来的那个样子，照它做大的
words.origin: 意大利语 modello ← 通俗拉丁语 modellus ← 拉丁语 modulus（小尺度）← modus（量度）
words.native_definition: a small copy or a pattern that others are made from
words.core_concept: a scaled pattern others follow – 按尺寸做出的样子，照它做
words.core_image: 桌上一座巴掌大的楼，窗户楼梯都齐，工地照着它砌
examples: He built a model of the bridge.
She models for a local design school.
semantic_expansions: 按尺寸缩小做出的实物是「模型」；拿人当样子照着学是「模范」；给衣裳当样子给人看的人是「模特」；动词把一件事照样子搭出来是「建模」

words.root_logic: modestus（守着分寸的）← modus（量度、限度）→ 不越过那条线
words.origin: 拉丁语 modestus（守分寸的）← modus（量度、限度）
words.native_definition: not boasting, or not large in amount
words.core_concept: keeping inside the line, not over – 守着那条线不越过
words.core_image: 全场鼓掌时他摆摆手，只说这活儿是好几个人一起干的
examples: He is modest about his own success.
They live on a modest income.
semantic_expansions: 说人不把功劳往自己身上堆是「谦虚的」；说数量不出格是「适度的」；说排场不铺张是「朴素的」

words.root_logic: modulus（modus 的小尺度）→ 按统一尺寸做的一小块，块块能对上、能换
words.origin: 拉丁语 modulus（小尺度、小单位）← modus（量度）
words.native_definition: one standard part of a larger system, able to be swapped
words.core_concept: one standard-sized part of a whole – 照统一尺寸做的一块
words.core_image: 机柜里抽出一块板子，换上另一块，尺寸和接口都对得上
examples: Each module can be replaced in minutes.
The course has six modules this term.
semantic_expansions: 拆得下装得上的那一块是「模块」；强调它是整机的一部分时说「组件」；课程里自成一段的是「单元」

words.root_logic: modulus（modus 的小尺度、样式）→ 一个空壳，浆倒进去凝住就成它的样子
words.origin: 古法语 modle ← 拉丁语 modulus（小尺度、样式）← modus（量度）
words.native_definition: a hollow shape that liquid is poured into to set
words.core_concept: the hollow that gives a thing its shape – 决定成品形状的那个空壳
words.core_image: 铁壳里灌进滚烫的浆，等凉透了扣出来，边角和壳里一模一样
examples: Pour the mixture into a round mould.
Hard years moulded his character.
semantic_expansions: 日常那个成形的壳是「模子」；用在金属浇铸上是「铸模」；动词把人或事按某个样子做出来是「塑造」

words.root_logic: centum（一百）→ 一块钱切成一百份，其中的一份
words.origin: 法语 cent ← 拉丁语 centum（一百）
words.native_definition: a coin worth one hundredth of a dollar or euro
words.core_concept: one part in a hundred of the money – 钱的百分之一那一份
words.core_image: 罐子里倒出一把铜的小圆片，数出一百个刚够换一张纸币
examples: The apples cost ninety cents a pound.
He paid the last cent he had.
semantic_expansions: 作货币单位是「分」；指那枚铜片实物是「一分硬币」

words.root_logic: centum（一百）+ gradus（一级、一步）→ 把冰点到沸点之间切成一百级
words.origin: 拉丁语 centum（一百）+ gradus（级、度）——定标时把水的冰点到沸点分成一百等份
words.native_definition: measured on a scale with one hundred steps between freezing and boiling
words.core_concept: a scale cut into a hundred steps – 切成一百级的那把标尺
words.core_image: 温度计上从结冰那道线到冒泡那道线，中间正好切成一百格
examples: Water boils at one hundred degrees centigrade.
Set the oven to two hundred degrees centigrade.
semantic_expansions: 日常说温标是「摄氏的」；照字面讲这套刻度是「百分度的」

words.root_logic: centuria（百人一队）← centum（一百）→ 数满一百的那一段，用在年上
words.origin: 拉丁语 centuria（百人编成的一队、百的一组）← centum（一百）
words.native_definition: a period of one hundred years
words.core_concept: a hundred counted off as one span – 数满一百作一整段
words.core_image: 教堂墙上刻的年份比曾祖父的曾祖父还早，中间隔了几辈都数不清
examples: The church was built four centuries ago.
She lived through most of the century.
semantic_expansions: 划成整段的那一百年是「世纪」；单说这段时长是「百年」

words.root_logic: per（每）+ centum（一百）→ 每一百里占几
words.origin: 拉丁语 per centum（每一百）
words.native_definition: one part in every hundred
words.core_concept: so many in every hundred – 每一百里占的那几份
words.core_image: 一百格的方阵涂黑了十七格，一眼看得出占多大一片
examples: Only three percent of seeds ever sprouted.
Prices rose by ten percent last year.
semantic_expansions: 作单位说每百里的一份是「百分之一」；说占比这件事整体是「百分比」

words.root_logic: intrare（走进去）← intra（在里面）→ 从外头跨进里头
words.origin: 古法语 entrer ← 拉丁语 intrare（走进去）← intra（在里面）
words.native_definition: to come or go into a place
words.core_concept: crossing in from outside – 从外头跨进里头
words.core_image: 玻璃门被推开，风被关在身后，鞋底在地垫上蹭了两下
examples: She entered the room without knocking.
Enter your name in the first box.
semantic_expansions: 跨进一处地方是「进入」；跨进一群人里是「加入」；把字跨进格子里是「输入」

words.root_logic: entr（intrare 走进去）+ -ance（那处、那件事）→ 进去用的那个口，也指进去这一下
words.origin: 古法语 entrance ← entrer（进去）← 拉丁语 intrare（走进去）
words.native_definition: the way into a place, or the act of going in
words.core_concept: the way in, and the going in – 进去的那个口和那一下
words.core_image: 台阶尽头一道拱门，人流从那里挤进去，两边墙上挂着牌子
examples: Wait for me at the main entrance.
His entrance stopped the conversation.
semantic_expansions: 那道口子是「入口」；那一下动作是「进入」；正式场合走进来这件事是「入场」

words.root_logic: entr（intrare 走进去）+ -y → 进去这一下，也指进去后落下的那一条记录
words.origin: 古法语 entree（进入）← entrer ← 拉丁语 intrare（走进去）
words.native_definition: the act of going in, or an item written into a list
words.core_concept: going in, and what the going in leaves written – 进去这一下和留下的那一行
words.core_image: 门房把名字一笔写进本子，那一行落定，人才放进去
examples: No entry without a ticket.
Check the last entry in the log.
semantic_expansions: 那一下动作是「进入」；写进册子里的一行是「条目」；供人进去的那道口子也叫「入口」

words.root_logic: regula（笔直的木尺、准绳）→ 一根直挺挺的长条，横着架起来
words.origin: 古法语 reille（横木、栏条）← 拉丁语 regula（笔直的木尺）
words.native_definition: a long bar of wood or metal fixed in place
words.core_concept: a straight bar fixed in place – 一根架起来的直条
words.core_image: 两条铁条笔直铺出去，枕木一根根压着，远处并成一条线
examples: Do not lean over the rail.
Freight moves by rail across the country.
semantic_expansions: 火车压着走的那两条是「铁轨」；拦在人前的那道横条是「栏杆」；整套轨道连成的运输是「铁路」

words.root_logic: rail（regula 直条，即铁轨）+ road（路）→ 用直条铺出来的那条路
words.origin: 英语 rail（铁轨，← 拉丁语 regula 笔直的木尺）+ road（路）
words.native_definition: a track of rails, and the system of trains running on it
words.core_concept: a road made of straight bars – 直条铺成的路
words.core_image: 两条铁条一路铺到看不见的地方，中间的碎石被压得发亮
examples: The railroad reached this town in 1889.
He worked on the railroad for decades.
semantic_expansions: 连着线路和运营整体说是「铁路」；单指那条轨道设施是「铁道」

words.root_logic: regula（笔直的木尺、准绳）→ 立一根直的当准，众人照它比齐
words.origin: 古法语 reule ← 拉丁语 regula（笔直的木尺、准绳）
words.native_definition: a statement of what may be done, or to govern
words.core_concept: the straight standard all are lined up to – 众人照着比齐的那根准绳
words.core_image: 墙上贴着一张纸，谁做完都要拿它对一遍，对不上就重做
examples: The rules of the game are simple.
That family ruled the island for centuries.
semantic_expansions: 立出来叫大家照办的是「规则」；握着这根准绳管人是「统治」；拿它量一件事并给出结论是「裁定」

words.root_logic: rule（regula 准绳）+ -er（那样东西、那个人）→ 那根尺本身，或手里握着准绳的那个
words.origin: 英语 rule（← 拉丁语 regula 笔直的木尺）+ -er
words.native_definition: a strip used for drawing straight lines, or a person who governs
words.core_concept: the one holding the straight standard – 握着那根准绳的
words.core_image: 透明的塑料条压在纸上，铅笔顺着边走，线才不歪
examples: Draw the line with a ruler.
The ruler ordered a new palace built.
semantic_expansions: 那根实物直条是「尺子」；握着准绳定规矩的人是「统治者」

words.root_logic: con-（彻底）+ fess（fari 一支的 fateri：承认）→ 把压着不说的那句彻底说出口
words.origin: 拉丁语 confiteri（承认）的过去分词 confessus：con-（彻底）+ -fiteri ← fari（说、开口）
words.native_definition: to admit something you were hiding
words.core_concept: speaking out what was held back – 把压着的那句说出口
words.core_image: 在桌子对面坐了半个钟头不出声，忽然抬起头把那件事讲了
examples: He confessed that he had lied.
She finally confessed to taking the money.
semantic_expansions: 只说认下来是「承认」；把过程都讲出来是「坦白」；向神职人员说自己的过失是「忏悔」

words.root_logic: fama（众人传的话）← fari（开口说）→ 众人嘴里都在说的那一份
words.origin: 拉丁语 fama（传闻、名声）← fari（说、开口）
words.native_definition: the state of being known and talked about by many
words.core_concept: what everyone's mouths carry about you – 众人嘴里传着的那一份
words.core_image: 街上走十步被叫住三回，卖水果的都知道他昨天干了什么
examples: The song brought him sudden fame.
She never wanted fame or money.
semantic_expansions: 传开的话本身是「名声」；传得久、传得受敬重是「名望」

words.root_logic: fama（众人传的话）+ -ous（多有的）← fari（开口说）→ 被人说得多的
words.origin: 拉丁语 famosus（多被谈论的）← fama（传闻、名声）← fari（说、开口）
words.native_definition: known about by very many people
words.core_concept: much talked about – 被很多人说着的
words.core_image: 他一进门，屋里说话声低了一截，几个人抬起手机对着他
examples: This town is famous for its cheese.
A famous painter once lived here.
semantic_expansions: 正式说受人公认的是「著名的」；口语说人尽皆知的是「出名的」

words.root_logic: di-（分开各向）+ mens（metiri 量）+ -ion → 一个方向上量出来的那个数
words.origin: 拉丁语 dimensio（量出的尺寸）← dimetiri：di-（分开）+ metiri（量）
words.native_definition: a measurement in one direction, or an aspect of something
words.core_concept: how much a thing measures in one direction – 一个方向上量得的数
words.core_image: 拿卷尺量一只箱子，长、宽、高各记一个数，才说得清它多大
examples: Measure the dimensions of the room first.
This adds a new dimension to the case.
semantic_expansions: 量出的具体数目是「尺寸」；把方向本身当一条轴说是「维度」；挪到抽象事情上，一个可以量的侧面是「方面」

words.root_logic: im-（不）+ mens（metiri 的过去分词 mensus，量过的）→ 量不出来的那么大
words.origin: 拉丁语 immensus（量不出的）：in-（不）+ mensus（metiri 的过去分词，量过的）
words.native_definition: extremely large in size or degree
words.core_concept: too big for any measure to reach – 尺子量不到头
words.core_image: 站在沙丘上转一圈，沙子一直铺到天边，找不着一处头
examples: The desert stretched an immense distance.
She took immense care with it.
semantic_expansions: 说体量大到量不过来是「巨大的」；挪到程度上说是「极大的」

words.root_logic: mensura（量出来的尺寸）← metiri（量）→ 拿尺贴上去，读出它有多少
words.origin: 古法语 mesure ← 拉丁语 mensura（尺寸）← metiri（量）的过去分词 mensus
words.native_definition: to find the size of something, or a step taken to deal with something
words.core_concept: laying a standard against a thing – 拿尺贴上去读数
words.core_image: 卷尺贴着墙拉开，指甲掐住那一格，低头念出上面的数
examples: Measure the width before you cut.
The government took strong measures.
semantic_expansions: 动词拿尺去量是「测量」；量出的结果是「尺寸」；引申到办事上，为对付一件事拿出的那一份分量是「措施」

words.root_logic: ex-（出来）+ ped（pes 脚）+ -ition → 把脚从绊住的东西里解出来，一队人这才走得成
words.origin: 拉丁语 expeditio（出征）← expedire：ex-（出）+ pes（属格 pedis：脚）——把脚从绊索里解出来
words.native_definition: an organized journey made for a purpose
words.core_concept: feet set free so a party can set out – 脚解开了，一队人走得成
words.core_image: 天没亮，一队人背上包在门口清点绳子和帐篷，然后一个跟一个走进雪里
examples: The expedition reached the pole in March.
They joined a small fossil expedition.
semantic_expansions: 军事上出去打的是「远征」；一队人为查看而去的是「探险队」；规模小些、走着去的是「远足」

words.root_logic: pedalis（脚上的）← pes（脚）→ 用脚踩的那一块
words.origin: 拉丁语 pedalis（脚的、一尺长的）← pes（属格 pedis：脚）
words.native_definition: a lever pressed with the foot to work a machine
words.core_concept: the part worked by the foot – 用脚踩的那一块
words.core_image: 鞋底压下去，那块铁往下一沉，链条跟着咬住齿轮转起来
examples: He pressed the brake pedal hard.
She pedalled slowly up the hill.
semantic_expansions: 那块实物是「踏板」；动词一脚一脚踩它是「踩踏板」

words.root_logic: pedester（步行的）← pes（脚）→ 靠脚走的那个人，也指平平无奇像走路一样
words.origin: 拉丁语 pedester / pedestris（步行的）← pes（属格 pedis：脚）
words.native_definition: a person travelling on foot, or dull and ordinary
words.core_concept: going on one's own feet – 靠自己两只脚走的
words.core_image: 车让在斑马线前，一个人拎着袋子低头走过去，鞋底蹭着白漆
examples: A pedestrian was hit at the crossing.
His speech was flat and pedestrian.
semantic_expansions: 走路的那个人是「行人」；说不靠车马只靠脚的是「步行的」；走路比骑马低一等，引申到文章说话上是「平庸的」

words.root_logic: e-（出去）+ mit（mittere 送）→ 把光、声、气送出去
words.origin: 拉丁语 emittere：ex-（出）+ mittere（送、发出）
words.native_definition: to send out light, sound, gas, or the like
words.core_concept: sending a thing out from inside – 从里头把东西送出去
words.core_image: 管口噗地冒出一股白气，边上的灯一亮一灭，嗡嗡响着
examples: The lamp emits a faint blue light.
Factories emit smoke all day.
semantic_expansions: 光和声这类送出来是「发出」；气味热气慢慢往外走是「散发」；把废气废水放出去是「排放」

words.origin: 拉丁语 vallum（营垒的木栅）加表「之间」的前缀构成，本义两道栅墙当中空着的那段
words.native_definition: a space of time or distance between two things
words.core_concept: the gap left between two things – 两样东西之间空着的那段
words.core_image: 两班车之间空着的二十分钟，站台上只剩风和一张飘着的纸
examples: Buses run at ten minute intervals.
There was a long interval between acts.
semantic_expansions: 说两次之间隔多久多远是「间隔」；说中间那段停下不动的是「间歇」；戏剧里两幕之间那段是「幕间休息」
words.decomposable_note: 拉丁借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.origin: 拉丁语 acidus（酸的）← acere（发酸）← acer（尖、锐）——舌头上像被尖东西扎一下
words.native_definition: a sour substance that can eat into metal or stone
words.core_concept: something sharp enough to bite – 尖得能咬进东西里
words.core_image: 一滴透亮的水落在铁片上，冒出细泡，铁面留下一小块麻点
examples: The acid burned a hole in the cloth.
She made an acid remark about it.
semantic_expansions: 那种能腐蚀的东西是「酸」；说味道扎舌头是「酸的」；说话像针一样扎人是「尖刻的」
words.decomposable_note: 拉丁借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.origin: 古法语 aigre（尖、酸、猛）← 拉丁语 acer（尖、锐）——劲头尖得往前冲
words.native_definition: wanting to do something very much
words.core_concept: pointed forward, sharp with wanting – 劲头尖着往前顶
words.core_image: 话还没说完他已经站起来，手按在门把上，身子朝外倾着
examples: The children were eager to start.
He gave an eager nod.
semantic_expansions: 心里想要得厉害是「渴望的」；表现在神情动作上是「热切的」
words.decomposable_note: 拉丁借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.origin: 古英语 cōc（厨子）← 拉丁语 coquus（厨子）← coquere（煮）——早期借入的日常词
words.native_definition: to prepare food with heat, or a person who does this
words.core_concept: putting food to the fire – 把吃的搁到火上
words.core_image: 锅里的油响起来，葱一下去满屋是味，铲子贴着锅底翻了两下
examples: She cooked rice and beans for us.
The cook came out to take orders.
semantic_expansions: 动词说这门手艺整体是「烹饪」；日常说给家里备饭是「做饭」；干这活儿的人是「厨师」
words.decomposable_note: 早期借词，经古英语或中古英语阶段传入，词形已归化，无可拆的词缀

words.origin: 古英语 cycene ← 通俗拉丁语 cocina（拉丁语 coquina，煮东西的地方）← coquere（煮）
words.native_definition: the room where food is prepared
words.core_concept: the room given to cooking – 专管煮东西的那一间
words.core_image: 靠窗一张台面，刀和砧板挨着水槽，抽油烟机上一层薄油
examples: The kitchen smelled of garlic and smoke.
They sat talking in the kitchen.
words.decomposable_note: 早期借词，经古英语或中古英语阶段传入，词形已归化，无可拆的词缀

words.origin: 古法语 mes（端上桌的一道菜）← 晚期拉丁语 missum（端上来的东西）；由「一盘混着的吃食」引申出杂乱一义
words.native_definition: a state of disorder, or to make something dirty and untidy
words.core_concept: a jumbled heap left lying about – 掺在一处堆着的一摊
words.core_image: 桌上摊着吃剩的盘子、拆开的包装和半杯凉茶，找钥匙得先挪三样东西
examples: The kitchen was in a terrible mess.
Do not mess up my papers.
semantic_expansions: 说秩序全乱是「混乱」；说又脏又乱是「脏乱」；动词把本来好的一件事搞坏是「弄糟」
words.decomposable_note: 拉丁借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.origin: 古法语 ariver（靠岸、到达）← 通俗拉丁语 arripare：ad-（到）+ ripa（河岸）——船靠上岸
words.native_definition: the act of reaching a place, or someone who has just come
words.core_concept: coming up to the shore at last – 终于靠上岸
words.core_image: 站台上的人一齐朝那头看，车门开了，第一个人拎着箱子踏下来
examples: We waited for the arrival of the train.
The new arrival cried all night.
semantic_expansions: 到了这件事是「到达」；正式些说是「抵达」；刚到的那个人是「新来的人」
words.decomposable_note: 拉丁借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.origin: 古法语 riviere（河、河岸地）← 通俗拉丁语 riparia（河岸一带）← 拉丁语 ripa（河岸）
words.native_definition: a large natural stream of water flowing to the sea
words.core_concept: water held between two banks – 两岸夹着的那道水
words.core_image: 两道土坡夹着一条浑水，一直流到看不见的地方，岸边泡着半截树根
examples: The river runs through three towns.
They swam across the river at dawn.
semantic_expansions: 单说一条水道是「河」；泛指大小水道整体时说「江河」
words.decomposable_note: 拉丁借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.origin: 古法语 pantaisier（喘不上气）← 通俗拉丁语 pantasiare（梦里憋闷挣气）；再往上与希腊语「使显现」一支有关，但这一义已接不上
words.native_definition: to breathe in quick short breaths after effort
words.core_concept: breathing in fast shallow snatches – 一口接一口地急着吸气
words.core_image: 跑上六楼扶着墙，肩膀一起一伏，喉咙里像有风箱在拉
examples: He panted after running up the stairs.
The dog panted in the heat.
semantic_expansions: 动作本身是「喘气」；连着说这种状态是「气喘」
words.decomposable_note: 拉丁借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.origin: 古法语 roial ← 拉丁语 regalis（王的）← rex（属格 regis：国王）
words.native_definition: belonging to or fit for a king or queen
words.core_concept: belonging to the king – 归国王的
words.core_image: 门口两个卫兵纹丝不动，车上一枚金色徽记，红毯一直铺到台阶顶
examples: The royal family arrived by carriage.
They gave him a royal welcome.
semantic_expansions: 指王的家族是「王室的」；用在挂王室名义的机构上是「皇家的」；借那份气派形容排场是「盛大的」
words.decomposable_note: 经法语入英语的借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.root_logic: rect（regere 导正、理直）→ 古法语 dresser（把东西摆正、整理停当）→ 把身上的布料理齐 → 穿戴；理齐后的那一整件
words.origin: 古法语 dresser（排列整齐、装备好）← 通俗拉丁语 *directiare ← 拉丁语 directus（理直的），出自 regere（导正）
words.native_definition: to put clothes on, or a one-piece outer garment for a woman
words.core_concept: put in order on the body – 把身上收拾停当
words.core_image: 站在镜前把袖口捋平，领子翻正，腰上那道褶子一点点抹开
examples: She wore a blue dress to the ceremony.
He dressed quickly and left the house.
semantic_expansions: 把布料在身上理齐 → 穿衣这个动作
理齐后穿在身上的那一整件 → 连衣裙
不只理齐还添修饰 → 装扮、打扮

words.root_logic: rect（regere 统摄、导正）→ 拉丁语 regalis（王的）→ 古法语 reaume → 一个王发号令管得到的那片地；引申为某人说得上话的那一片
words.origin: 古法语 reaume/realme ← 通俗拉丁语 *regalimen ← 拉丁语 regalis（王的），出自 rex（王），与 regere（统摄）同一词干
words.native_definition: a kingdom, or an area of activity or interest
words.core_concept: the ground one ruler covers – 一位君主管得到的那一片
words.core_image: 地图上一圈墨线围出的地界，线内的赋税都送到同一座城里
examples: The story is set in a distant realm.
That question lies outside the realm of physics.
semantic_expansions: 一个王号令所及的那片地 → 王国
把「所及」抽掉具体的地 → 某学科或事务的领域
再抽一层，只留边界这一意思 → 范围

words.root_logic: rect（regere 导正、治理）+ -men（办法、结果）→ 拉丁语 regimen（治理的那一套办法）→ 掌权的那套班子；也指为身体定下的那套规程
words.origin: 法语 régime ← 拉丁语 regimen（统御、掌舵），出自 regere（导正、治理）
words.native_definition: a system of government, or a fixed course of treatment or living
words.core_concept: a fixed way of steering things – 定下来的那套管法
words.core_image: 墙上贴一张表，几点起床几点吃药几点熄灯，全楼照它走
examples: The old regime collapsed within a month.
Her doctor put her on a strict regime.
semantic_expansions: 掌着国事的那一套人马 → 政权
抽掉「国」只留那套办法 → 制度
把这套办法用到身体上 → 养生法、疗程

words.root_logic: rect（regere 划直、划界）→ 拉丁语 regionem（划出边界的那一片）→ 地面上圈定的一片；也指身上大致的一块
words.origin: 古法语 region ← 拉丁语 regio（属格 regionis：方向、界内之地），出自 regere（划直、导正）
words.native_definition: an area of land, or a part of the body
words.core_concept: a stretch marked off by a line – 用线圈出来的一片
words.core_image: 天气图上用虚线把几个省框在一起，框里同色，框外换色
examples: This region is famous for its wine.
He felt a dull pain in the chest region.
semantic_expansions: 地面上圈出的一整片 → 地区、区域
同样的圈法用在身体上，界限不必精确 → 部位

words.root_logic: re-（回、逐条）+ gerere（携带、载）→ 拉丁语 regesta（一条条载回来记下的东西）→ 那本册子；作动词是把名字载进册子
words.origin: 古法语 registre ← 中世纪拉丁语 registrum/regesta ← 拉丁语 regerere（re-＋gerere：载回、记入）；与 regere（导正）是两个不同的拉丁词，勿混
words.native_definition: to enter a name in an official list, or the list itself
words.core_concept: carry it back onto the list – 把它载回册子上记下
words.core_image: 门口一本厚簿，来人签下姓名和时间，笔迹一行接一行往下排
examples: You must register before using the service.
Her name appears in the parish register.
semantic_expansions: 把名字载进官册这个动作 → 注册
同一动作偏重「记下」这一面 → 登记
载好的那本册子本身 → 名册

words.root_logic: rect（regere 统摄）→ 拉丁语 regnum（王权、王国）→ 古法语 reigne → 坐在发号令的那个位子上；那段坐着的光景
words.origin: 古法语 reigne ← 拉丁语 regnum（王权），出自 rex（王），与 regere（统摄）同一词干；与同音的 rein（缰绳，出自 tenere 握住）不同源
words.native_definition: to rule as king or queen, or the period of such rule
words.core_concept: sit in the seat that gives orders – 坐在发令的那个位子上
words.core_image: 一个人坐在高处，三十年里下面的人都等他先开口
examples: Queen Victoria reigned for over sixty years.
Silence reigned in the empty hall.
semantic_expansions: 坐在那个位子上发号令 → 统治
把「坐着」这段光景单独看 → 在位期
不是人而是一种气氛压住全场 → 盛行、笼罩

words.root_logic: rect（regere 统摄）→ 拉丁语 regalis（王的）→ 古法语 roial ＋ -ty（身份、待遇）→ 属于王的那份身份，及按份额抽给他的那笔钱
words.origin: 古法语 roialte ← roial（王的）← 拉丁语 regalis，出自 rex（王），与 regere 同一词干
words.native_definition: members of a royal family, or a payment made to an owner for each use
words.core_concept: what belongs to the king – 归于王的那一份
words.core_image: 一家人进门从不排队；另外每卖出一本书，账上先划出一小笔送到他们那儿
examples: The hotel once housed European royalty.
She earns royalties from every copy sold.
semantic_expansions: 王这一支的人 → 王室
王这个身份自带的权柄 → 王权
王按份额抽走的那笔钱，后归于著作与专利的所有者 → 版税

words.root_logic: lig（ligare 绑）+ -able（能…的）→ 被绑在某事上、脱不开的；也指老被那事缠上
words.origin: 盎格鲁法语 liable ← 古法语 lier（捆、系）← 拉丁语 ligare（绑）
words.native_definition: legally responsible for something, or likely to do or suffer something
words.core_concept: tied to what follows – 被后果系住脱不开
words.core_image: 合同末尾那行小字把签名的人和后面所有账目系在一处，抽不出手
examples: The company is liable for any damage caused.
Old pipes are liable to burst in winter.
semantic_expansions: 被条款绑在某事上 → 负有法律责任的
绑住的不是责任而是倾向，那事总来缠你 → 易于…的

words.root_logic: ob-（朝向、对着）+ lig（ligare 绑）→ 把人朝某事绑住；松一次绳算给人情面
words.origin: 古法语 obligier ← 拉丁语 obligare（ob-＋ligare：绑向），本指以誓约把人系住
words.native_definition: to make someone do something, or to do someone a favour
words.core_concept: bind someone toward a duty – 把人朝一件事上绑住
words.core_image: 一句允诺出口，绳子就套上了，后面推不掉也躲不开
examples: The law obliges drivers to wear seat belts.
He obliged us by carrying the boxes upstairs.
semantic_expansions: 绑上就脱不开 → 迫使、责成
替人松一次绑，对方欠着这份情 → 使感激
从「欠情」回看施与的一方 → 帮忙、效劳

words.root_logic: re-（重新）+ al-（ad- 朝）+ li（ligare 绑）→ 法语 rallier（把散开的重新绑回一处）→ 重新聚拢；聚拢起来的那一场
words.origin: 法语 rallier ← 古法语 ralier（re-＋alier：结盟）← 拉丁语 alligare（ad-＋ligare：绑到一处）
words.native_definition: to come together again for a common purpose, or a mass meeting
words.core_concept: tie the scattered back together – 把散开的重新系回一处
words.core_image: 队伍被打散后，一声号响，四散的人又往同一面旗底下拢过来
examples: The captain rallied his men before the second half.
Thousands attended the rally in the square.
semantic_expansions: 散了的人重新系回一处 → 集合、召集
系回来之后力气也跟着回来 → 重整、恢复
系在一处的那一场 → 群众集会

words.root_logic: re-（牢牢、反复）+ li（ligare 绑）+ -able（可…的）→ 可以把自己系上去而不会脱的
words.origin: rely（依靠）＋-able；rely ← 古法语 relier ← 拉丁语 religare（re-＋ligare：牢牢绑住）
words.native_definition: able to be trusted to do what is expected
words.core_concept: safe to tie yourself to – 系上去不会脱的
words.core_image: 一根旧绳，每次吊上一整袋水泥都没松过，第二十次仍照样绷住
examples: We need a reliable car for long trips.
His account of the events seems reliable.
semantic_expansions: 绳子够牢，系上去不脱 → 可靠的
用在人身上，话和事都接得住 → 靠得住的

words.root_logic: rely（把自己系上去）+ -ance（这件事）→ 系上去这件事本身
words.origin: rely（依靠）＋-ance；rely ← 古法语 relier ← 拉丁语 religare（牢牢绑住）
words.native_definition: the state of depending on someone or something
words.core_concept: being tied to one support – 整个人系在一处依托上
words.core_image: 全村的水都从那一根管子来，管子一堵，家家都停
examples: The country's reliance on imported oil is growing.
She placed too much reliance on one supplier.
semantic_expansions: 把自己系在某物上不另找 → 依赖
系上去是因为信得过 → 信赖

words.root_logic: re-（牢牢）+ ly（ligare 绑）→ 拉丁语 religare（牢牢系住）→ 把自己系到某人某物上
words.origin: 古法语 relier（重新系紧、集结）← 拉丁语 religare（re-＋ligare：牢牢绑住）
words.native_definition: to depend on someone or something with confidence
words.core_concept: tie yourself to it and hand over the weight – 系上去，再把重量交给它
words.core_image: 过独木桥时一手死死攥住那根横绳，脚下每一步都压在它上面
examples: You can rely on her to finish on time.
Farmers here rely on the summer rain.
semantic_expansions: 把重量交到某物上 → 依靠
交得出去是因为信得过 → 信赖

words.root_logic: an-（无）+ onym（希腊语 onoma 名，与拉丁语 nomen 同一词干）+ -ous → 没有名字挂上去的
words.origin: 希腊语 anonymos（an-＋onyma：无名）经晚期拉丁语 anonymus 入英语；onoma 与拉丁语 nomen（名）同出一个更古的词干
words.native_definition: with a name that is not given or known
words.core_concept: no name attached – 名字这一栏空着
words.core_image: 桌上一封信，只写着收信地址，末尾该签字的地方空着，笔迹也认不出
examples: The donor wished to remain anonymous.
We received an anonymous tip by phone.
semantic_expansions: 名字这一栏留空 → 匿名的
从来就没被叫过名字 → 无名的
名字存在但外人不掌握 → 不知姓名的

words.root_logic: nomin（nomen 名）+ -al（…的）→ 只在名字上如此、里头不作数；小到只够挂个名
words.origin: 拉丁语 nominalis（属于名字的），出自 nomen（名）
words.native_definition: existing in name only, or very small in amount
words.core_concept: only the name is there – 只剩名字挂着
words.core_image: 招牌上还挂着他的姓，店里的事三年没经过他手，工资表上一年一元
examples: He is the nominal head of the company.
They charge a nominal fee for delivery.
semantic_expansions: 名字挂着而实权不在 → 名义上的
数目小到只够意思一下 → 象征性的
把「意思一下」再往下压 → 极小的

words.root_logic: nomin（nomen 名）+ -ate（做…）→ 拉丁语 nominare（叫出名字）→ 把某人的名字报上去
words.origin: 拉丁语 nominare（叫出名字、指名）的过去分词 nominatus，出自 nomen（名）
words.native_definition: to formally suggest someone for a position or prize
words.core_concept: call out a name for a post – 为一个位子报出名字
words.core_image: 会上有人站起来报出一个名字，书记员当场写在黑板最上一行
examples: She was nominated for best actress.
The board nominated him as treasurer.
semantic_expansions: 报出名字候选 → 提名
报出并当场定下 → 任命
不必是人，定某物某日也用 → 指定

words.root_logic: nomen（名）→ 古法语 nom/noun → 语法里专管「叫什么」的那一类词
words.origin: 盎格鲁法语 noun ← 古法语 nom ← 拉丁语 nomen（名字、名称）
words.native_definition: a word that names a person, place, or thing
words.core_concept: the naming kind of word – 专管叫名字的那类词
words.core_image: 课本上一列词，每个都能指着一样东西说「这就是它」，前头添不了「很」
examples: In this sentence, water is a noun.
Children learn nouns before adjectives.

words.root_logic: pro-（代替）+ noun（nomen 名）→ 站在名字的位置上替它的那个词
words.origin: 拉丁语 pronomen（pro-（代）＋nomen（名））经中古法语 pronom 入英语
words.native_definition: a word used in place of a noun
words.core_concept: a stand-in for a name – 替名字站位的那个词
words.core_image: 前一句提过那个人名，后一句就用一个短词把那个位置占住，不再重复
examples: He and it are pronouns.
Try replacing the name with a pronoun.

words.root_logic: dec（decem 十）+ -ade（一批）→ 希腊语 dekas（一批十个）→ 十个年头凑成的那一段
words.origin: 古法语 decade ← 晚期拉丁语 decas（属格 decadis）← 希腊语 dekas（一批十个），与拉丁语 decem（十）同出一个更古的词干
words.native_definition: a period of ten years
words.core_concept: a batch of ten years – 十个年头凑成的一批
words.core_image: 墙上挂历换了十本，最旧那本纸都黄了，摞起来正好一叠
examples: Prices have doubled in the past decade.
He spent a decade abroad.

words.root_logic: decim（decimus 第十，出自 decem 十）+ -al → 以十为一档往上进；点后按十分之一逐级切下去的那种数
words.origin: 中世纪拉丁语 decimalis（属于十分之一的）← 拉丁语 decimus（第十），出自 decem（十）
words.native_definition: based on the number ten, or a fraction written after a point
words.core_concept: counting by tens – 满十进一
words.core_image: 尺子上每大格再切十小格，每小格又能想成再切十份，往右一直细下去
examples: Most countries use the decimal system.
Round the answer to two decimal places.
semantic_expansions: 满十进一这套算法 → 十进的
按十分之一逐级往下切出来的那种数 → 小数

words.root_logic: 拉丁语 duodecim（duo 二＋decem 十）→ 古法语 dozeine → 十再添二，凑成一整批
words.origin: 古法语 dozeine ← douze（十二）← 拉丁语 duodecim（duo（二）＋decem（十））
words.native_definition: a group of twelve
words.core_concept: ten and two in one batch – 十再添二，成一整批
words.core_image: 纸盒里三行四列摆满鸡蛋，盖子一合刚好，买的时候整盒论
examples: She bought a dozen eggs at the market.
Dozens of people waited outside.
semantic_expansions: 十二这个数目 → 十二个
按这个数目论装论卖 → 一打；复数泛指很多

words.root_logic: du-（duo 二）+ plic（折）+ -ate → 拉丁语 duplicare（折成两层）→ 对折一次，两半一模一样
words.origin: 拉丁语 duplicatus（duplicare 的过去分词：加倍、折成两份），由 duo（二）＋plicare（折叠）合成
words.native_definition: to make an exact copy, or one of two identical things
words.core_concept: folded into two alike halves – 对折成一样的两片
words.core_image: 一张纸正中对折，展开后两半的字迹一样，摞起来边线全对齐
examples: Please do not duplicate this file.
Keep a duplicate of the contract.
semantic_expansions: 对折出第二份这个动作 → 复制
折出来的那第二份 → 副本
两半分不出差别 → 完全相同的

words.root_logic: linea（亚麻绳绷紧后留下的一道痕）→ 那道痕本身；沿着它排开的人和字也叫它
words.origin: 古英语 line（绳、索）与古法语 ligne 合流 ← 拉丁语 linea（亚麻细绳、拉直的绳），出自 linum（亚麻）
words.native_definition: a long thin mark, or a row of people or things
words.core_concept: a taut cord's straight mark – 绷紧的绳留下的那一道
words.core_image: 粉笔贴着尺子在地上拖过去，留下笔直的一道白痕，孩子们脚尖顶着它站成一串
examples: Draw a straight line across the page.
A long line formed outside the shop.
semantic_expansions: 绳绷直弹出的那道痕 → 线、线条
沿着那道痕排开的人 → 队列，作动词是排成一列
排开的是字 → 一行

words.root_logic: linea（绷紧的绳留下的一道痕）+ -ar（…的）→ 只沿一道痕往前，不分叉不回头
words.origin: 拉丁语 linearis（属于线的），出自 linea（亚麻细绳、线），本源 linum（亚麻）
words.native_definition: arranged in or following a straight line or single sequence
words.core_concept: along one single thread – 只沿一根往前走
words.core_image: 故事从头讲到尾，中间不拐弯也不插叙，像一根绳从这头拉到那头
examples: The film has a simple linear plot.
Growth was roughly linear over ten years.
semantic_expansions: 顺一根往前不分叉 → 线性的
落到几何上就是不弯 → 直线的

words.root_logic: lin（linum 亚麻）+ -en（由…做成的）→ 亚麻纤维织出来的那种布，及用它做的家什
words.origin: 古英语 linen（用亚麻做的），出自古英语 lin（亚麻）——多认为是早期借自拉丁语 linum（亚麻）
words.native_definition: cloth woven from flax, or household articles made of it
words.core_concept: cloth made of flax – 亚麻织成的布
words.core_image: 浅黄的一块布，手一摸发凉发脆，迎光能看见经纬交错的方格
examples: The tablecloth is made of linen.
Fresh linen was put on every bed.
semantic_expansions: 亚麻纤维织成的那种布 → 亚麻布
拿它做的床单桌布一类 → 家用织品

words.root_logic: line（航线，出自 linea 拉直的绳）+ -er（干这个的）→ 固定沿一条路来回跑的那一艘；也指沿内壁铺的那一层
words.origin: line（线、航线）＋-er；line ← 拉丁语 linea（亚麻细绳、线），出自 linum（亚麻）
words.native_definition: a large ship or aircraft on a regular route, or a lining put inside something
words.core_concept: the one that runs a fixed line – 固定跑一条路的那一个
words.core_image: 码头边泊着一条特别长的白船，每月同一天靠岸，舷梯一放人往下走
examples: They crossed the Atlantic on an ocean liner.
Put a fresh liner in the bin.
semantic_expansions: 沿固定一条路来回跑的船 → 班轮
同样跑固定航路的飞机 → 大型客机
贴着内壁铺的那一层 → 内衬

words.root_logic: banca（钱桌）+ rupt（rumpere 打断）→ 钱桌被砸断，账再也摆不上去 → 还不出钱的
words.origin: 意大利语 banca rotta（被砸断的钱桌）；rotta ← 拉丁语 rupta，出自 rumpere（打断、使断裂）
words.native_definition: unable to pay what is owed, or a person in that state
words.core_concept: the money table smashed – 收钱的桌子被砸断
words.core_image: 市场上那张收钱的木桌被劈成两截，摊主再没人敢把银子放上去
examples: The company went bankrupt last spring.
He was declared a bankrupt in court.
semantic_expansions: 钱桌断了付不出钱 → 破产的
落到人身上 → 破产者
连别的东西也一样空 → 极度缺乏的

words.root_logic: e-（ex- 出来）+ rupt（rumpere 断裂）→ 封住的地方裂开，里头的东西猛地冲出来
words.origin: 拉丁语 eruptus，erumpere（ex-＋rumpere：破而出）的过去分词
words.native_definition: to burst out suddenly and violently
words.core_concept: break open and burst out – 裂开一道口冲出来
words.core_image: 山顶那层硬壳裂开一道口，火光顺着口子直冲上去，山脚的窗玻璃跟着响
examples: The volcano erupted without warning.
Violence erupted after the match.
semantic_expansions: 封住的地方裂开冲出 → 爆发、喷发
不是岩浆而是情绪或冲突 → 突然发作

words.root_logic: rupta（被打断、硬破开的）→ 通俗拉丁语 rupta via（硬开出来的那条道）→ 一条固定走的路
words.origin: 古法语 rute ← 通俗拉丁语 rupta（破开的路），出自拉丁语 rumpere（打断、破开）
words.native_definition: a way taken from one place to another
words.core_concept: a way broken through – 硬破开出来的那条道
words.core_image: 林子里被人踩出一条通道，两边枝条齐齐断在同一个高度
examples: We took the coastal route home.
The bus follows a fixed route.
semantic_expansions: 破开障碍走通的那条道 → 路线、路径
同样固定走的水上或空中一条 → 航线

words.root_logic: route（破开出来的固定一条道）+ -ine → 天天走同一条道，走成了定式
words.origin: 法语 routine（走惯的路数）← route（路线）← 通俗拉丁语 rupta，出自拉丁语 rumpere（打断、破开）
words.native_definition: a fixed and regular way of doing things
words.core_concept: the path worn by walking it daily – 天天走出来的那条定式
words.core_image: 每天七点出门走同一条道，第三百次已经不用看路，脚自己知道在哪拐
examples: Brushing your teeth is part of the morning routine.
This is a routine inspection.
semantic_expansions: 同一条道走成定式 → 例行程序、惯例
作形容词是按定式来的 → 日常的、常规的

words.root_logic: en-（进入）+ joy（gaudium 心里高兴）→ 进到那股高兴里去；也指把某物的好处握在手里
words.origin: 古法语 enjoier（使高兴、享有）← en-（入）＋joie（喜悦）← 拉丁语 gaudia，出自 gaudium（喜悦）
words.native_definition: to take pleasure in something, or to have the benefit of it
words.core_concept: step into the gladness – 进到那股高兴里去
words.core_image: 一碗汤喝到最后一口，还用勺把碗底刮了刮
examples: We enjoyed the concert very much.
Citizens enjoy equal rights under the law.
semantic_expansions: 泡在那股高兴里 → 享受
长期泡着就成了偏好 → 喜爱
把「握着好处」这一面单拿出来 → 享有

words.root_logic: gaudium（心里高兴）的复数 gaudia → 古法语 joie → 那股劲儿涌上来；也指引起它的那件事
words.origin: 古法语 joie ← 拉丁语 gaudia（gaudium 的复数：喜悦）
words.native_definition: great gladness, or a thing that causes it
words.core_concept: gladness welling over – 那股高兴涌上来漫出去
words.core_image: 门一开看见人回来了，手里提的东西掉在地上也顾不上捡
examples: Her face was full of joy.
Gardening is one of his great joys.
semantic_expansions: 涌上来的那股劲儿 → 欢乐、喜悦
引起它的那件事或那个人 → 乐事

words.root_logic: re-（加强）+ joice（gaudium 心里高兴）→ 那股劲儿一直冒到外面，别人也看得见
words.origin: 古法语 rejoir/resjoir（大为高兴）← re-＋joir（高兴）← 拉丁语 gaudere（心里高兴），名词 gaudium
words.native_definition: to feel and show great gladness
words.core_concept: let the gladness show outside – 让那股劲儿冒到外面来
words.core_image: 全镇的人涌到街上，锅碗瓢盆都敲起来，谁碰见谁都要抱一下
examples: The whole village rejoiced at the news.
We rejoiced that no one had been hurt.
semantic_expansions: 冒到外面被人看见 → 欢欣、额手称庆
因为躲过一劫才冒出来 → 庆幸

words.root_logic: nav（navis 船）+ -al（…的）→ 属于战船的，及操这些船的那支军
words.origin: 拉丁语 navalis（船的），出自 navis（船）
words.native_definition: of or relating to a navy or warships
words.core_concept: belonging to the ships of war – 属于战船那一路
words.core_image: 港里一排灰色钢壳船靠着码头，桅上旗子一齐朝同一个方向，甲板上的人列队站着
examples: He served at a naval base for six years.
The naval battle lasted two days.
semantic_expansions: 属于战船本身 → 军舰的
属于操这些船的那支军 → 海军的

words.root_logic: nav（navis 船）+ ig（agere 驱动）+ -ation → 拉丁语 navigare（驱船前行）→ 一边把船开出去一边找准方向
words.origin: 拉丁语 navigatio ← navigare，由 navis（船）＋agere（驱动）合成
words.native_definition: the act of steering a ship or aircraft and finding the way
words.core_concept: drive the ship and find the way – 把船开出去并找准方向
words.core_image: 夜里舵手对着星子和罗盘来回比对，才把船头拨正半格
examples: Navigation is difficult in thick fog.
The plane's navigation system failed.
semantic_expansions: 把船开出去这件事 → 航行
开的时候要找准方向 → 导航
这一整套本事 → 航海术

words.root_logic: navis（船）→ 古法语 navie（一国的船队）→ 一国的战船连人算作一支；这支人身上那种蓝也随之得名
words.origin: 古法语 navie（船队）← 晚期拉丁语 navigia（navigium 的复数：船只），出自 navis（船）
words.native_definition: a country's warships and the people who operate them
words.core_concept: a nation's ships as one force – 一国的船连人算作一支
words.core_image: 一队军舰列成纵队出港，水兵制服是那种近乎发黑的蓝
examples: He joined the navy at eighteen.
She wore a navy coat.
semantic_expansions: 一国的战船连操船的人 → 海军、舰队
这支人制服上那种深蓝 → 藏青色

words.root_logic: plat（与 platea 同出希腊语 platys：宽而平的一片）+ -e → 扁平的一片，用来盛放；也指蒙在表面的那一层薄金属
words.origin: 古法语 plate（扁平的一片）← 中世纪拉丁语 plata（金属薄片），或经通俗拉丁语 *plattus，其构形照希腊语 platys（宽而平的）而来；两者同溯 PIE *plat-（摊开）
words.native_definition: a flat dish, a thin sheet of metal, or to cover with a thin layer of metal
words.core_concept: a broad flat piece – 宽而平的一片
words.core_image: 扁而平的一片瓷，边上抬起一圈浅沿，饭菜都摊在中间那块平面上
examples: She put the fish on a white plate.
The handle is plated with silver.
semantic_expansions: 扁平一片用来盛饭菜 → 盘子
同样扁平但是金属 → 金属板
把这层薄金属蒙到别的东西上 → 电镀

words.root_logic: plat（与 platea 同出希腊语 platys：宽而平的一片）+ -eau（小、块）→ 高处那一大块平地；引申为曲线走平的那一段
words.origin: 法语 plateau ← 古法语 platel（扁平的小盘）← plat（平的）← 通俗拉丁语 *plattus，照希腊语 platys（宽而平的）构形，同溯 PIE *plat-（摊开）
words.native_definition: a large area of high level ground, or a period of no change
words.core_concept: flat ground up high – 高处摊平的一大块
words.core_image: 车爬了一整天，上到顶却是一大片平地，风从四面横着刮过来
examples: The plateau lies three thousand metres above sea level.
Sales have reached a plateau.
semantic_expansions: 高处那一大块平地 → 高原
曲线爬到某处不再往上 → 停滞期

words.root_logic: plat（与 platea 同出希腊语 platys：宽而平的一片）+ form（形状）→ 一块摊平抬高的面；站上去说话，那套主张也叫它
words.origin: 法语 plateforme（plat 平的＋forme 形状）；plat ← 通俗拉丁语 *plattus，照希腊语 platys（宽而平的）构形，forme ← 拉丁语 forma（形状）
words.native_definition: a raised level surface, or the stated aims of a group
words.core_concept: a flat raised surface to stand on – 摊平抬高、供人站的那块面
words.core_image: 比地面高出一截的一条长台，边上一道黄线，人都站在线后头等
examples: The train leaves from platform four.
Housing was central to their platform.
semantic_expansions: 抬高摊平供人站候 → 站台
泛指凡摊平抬高的面 → 平台
站上去讲的那套主张 → 纲领

words.root_logic: alter（两者中的另一个）→ 换成另一个 → 改动
words.origin: 中世纪拉丁语 alterare（使成为另一个）← 拉丁语 alter（两者中的另一个）
words.native_definition: to change something, or to become different
words.core_concept: make it into the other one – 把它弄成另一个样
words.core_image: 裁缝把腰身往里收两指，别处一针没动，穿上身却是另一个样子
examples: We had to alter our plans.
The tailor altered the sleeves for me.
semantic_expansions: 整体变成另一个样 → 改变
只动其中一处 → 改动
专指改衣服的尺寸 → 改衣服

words.root_logic: alter（另一个）+ -native → 另一个可选的那一个 → 替代方案
words.origin: 法语 alternatif ← 中世纪拉丁语 alternativus ← 拉丁语 alternare（轮着来），出自 alter（两者中的另一个）
words.native_definition: another possibility that can be chosen instead
words.core_concept: the other one you could take instead – 你本可以走的那另一条
words.core_image: 路口分出两条道，走上这条，那条的尽头这辈子就到不了
examples: Is there an alternative to surgery?
They offer an alternative route.
semantic_expansions: 可以换着走的那一条 → 替代方案
作形容词即可换的 → 可选的
不走众人那条 → 另类的

words.root_logic: dialis（一日的，出自 diurnus）→ 把一天的时辰刻成一圈的那个面 → 凡刻着数字的圆面；作动词是照着圆面上的数字转
words.origin: 中世纪拉丁语 dialis（一日的），出自拉丁语 dies（日）与 diurnus（一日的）；本指日影盘
words.native_definition: a round face marked with numbers, or to make a telephone call
words.core_concept: a round face where the hours are marked – 把时辰刻成一圈的那个面
words.core_image: 圆面上排一圈数字，手指插进孔里转到底再松开，它自己咔咔转回来
examples: The dial on the old radio still works.
She dialled the number twice.
semantic_expansions: 日影一圈刻出时辰 → 表盘
凡刻着数字的圆面 → 刻度盘
照着圆面上的数字转 → 拨号

words.root_logic: diurnus（一日的）→ 拉丁语 diarium（每日的一份、每日所记）→ 按日一条条记下的那本
words.origin: 拉丁语 diarium（每日的份额、日志），出自 dies（日）与 diurnus（一日的）
words.native_definition: a book in which you record events day by day
words.core_concept: one day, one entry – 一天记一条
words.core_image: 台灯下摊开一本，先写上日期，底下三两行今天发生的事
examples: He kept a diary for thirty years.
Let me check my diary for next week.
semantic_expansions: 按日记下的那些条目 → 日记
装这些条目的那本 → 日记本
同一本用来记以后的日子 → 记事本

words.root_logic: minere（凸出）→ 鼓起来的那块地；登上它即为登、骑
words.origin: 古法语 monter（往上走）← 通俗拉丁语 *montare ← 拉丁语 mons（属格 montis：山）
words.native_definition: to go up onto something, to increase, or to fix in place
words.core_concept: go up onto it – 往上登到它上面去
words.core_image: 一脚踩住马镫，手一撑翻上去坐稳，脚底下的高度一下就起来了
examples: He mounted the horse and rode off.
Pressure on the government is mounting.
semantic_expansions: 往上登到某物上 → 登上、骑上
不是人往上而是数目往上 → 增加
把东西架上去固定住 → 安装

words.root_logic: mount（← minere 凸出的那块地）+ -ain → 从平地鼓起来的那一大块
words.origin: 古法语 montaigne ← 通俗拉丁语 *montanea ← 拉丁语 montanus（山地的），出自 mons（属格 montis：山）
words.native_definition: a very high natural elevation of the earth's surface
words.core_concept: ground heaped up out of reach – 堆起来高到摸不着顶的那块地
words.core_image: 抬头看不到顶，云在半腰横着挂住，人走一天还在脚下那一段
examples: They climbed the mountain in two days.
A mountain of paperwork waited for him.
semantic_expansions: 地面隆起特别高的一块 → 山
连成一串的那些 → 山脉
拿它的体量比喻堆起来的东西 → 大量

words.root_logic: main（manu，← manus 手）+ tain（tenere 握住）→ 手里一直托着不让它塌；话也一样，攥住不松口
words.origin: 古法语 maintenir ← 中世纪拉丁语 manutenere（manu（← manus 手）＋tenere（握住）：手里托住）
words.native_definition: to keep something in good condition, or to insist that something is true
words.core_concept: hold it up by hand – 用手一直把它托住
words.core_image: 屋顶塌了一角，几根柱子从下面撑住不让它继续往下掉，每年还得上一遍油
examples: The government must maintain public order.
He maintains that he never saw her.
semantic_expansions: 一直托住不让它垮 → 维持
托住之外还得修理 → 保养
攥住自己那句话不松 → 坚称

words.root_logic: re-（往回）+ in（tenere 握住）→ 拉丁语 retinere（往回拉住）→ 手里那两条往回一收就能让马停下的皮带
words.origin: 古法语 reine ← 通俗拉丁语 *retina ← 拉丁语 retinere（re-＋tenere：往回拉住）；与同音的 reign（王权，出自 regnum）不同源
words.native_definition: a strap used to control a horse, or to hold something back
words.core_concept: the strap you pull back on – 往回一拉就能收住的那条带子
words.core_image: 手里两条皮带往后一收，马蹄立刻慢下来，头也跟着侧过来
examples: She pulled on the reins to stop the horse.
The bank reined in its lending.
semantic_expansions: 往回拉住马的那条带子 → 缰绳
手里握着这条带子就说得上话 → 控制
不让它跑出界 → 约束

words.root_logic: planus（平的、无起伏）→ 意大利语 piano（平缓、柔和）→ pianoforte（柔—强，指这件乐器轻按轻响重砸重响）→ 截短成 piano
words.origin: 意大利语 piano（柔和）← 拉丁语 planus（平的、无起伏）；全名 pianoforte（柔—强），后截短
words.native_definition: a large keyboard instrument with strings struck by hammers
words.core_concept: the soft-and-loud one – 能轻能重的那件乐器
words.core_image: 黑白键排成一长条，指头轻按几乎没声，同一个键砸下去整间屋子都在响
examples: She has played the piano since she was six.
A piano stood in the corner of the hall.

words.origin: 古法语 nice（愚笨、无知）← 拉丁语 nescius（ne-＋scire：不知道的）；词义此后逐级翻转：无知→挑剔→讲究→怡人，故与 sci（知道）一族之间已传不下可学的联系，不归入该族
words.native_definition: pleasant, agreeable, or kind
words.core_concept: pleasant to be around – 待在旁边让人舒服
words.core_image: 邻居端来一盘还热着的点心，说两句就退出去，把门轻轻带上
examples: We had a nice time at the beach.
It was nice of you to call.
semantic_expansions: 让人觉得舒服的 → 好的、令人愉快的
待人这样就是 → 友善的
words.decomposable_note: 拉丁借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.root_logic: as-（ad- 靠近）+ sist（sistere 立）+ -ance → 站到旁边把力气借出去 → 援助
words.origin: 拉丁语 assistentia ← assistere：ad-（靠近）+ sistere（站立）；sistere 是 stare 的重叠形
words.native_definition: help or support given to someone who needs it
words.core_concept: standing beside someone to take part of the load – 站到旁边替人分担一份重量
words.core_image: 他一个人扛不动那头，另一个走过来托住一角，两人同时把它抬离地面
examples: The charity offers assistance to homeless families.
She walked upstairs without any assistance.
semantic_expansions: 援助：站到旁边把自己的力气借出去
帮助：同一件事在日常小事上的说法

words.root_logic: as-（靠近）+ sist（立）+ -ant（人）→ 站在旁边搭手的那个人 → 助手
words.origin: 拉丁语 assistens（assistere 的现在分词）：ad-（靠近）+ sistere（站立）
words.native_definition: a person whose job is to help someone more senior
words.core_concept: the one standing at your side to hand things over – 站在你旁边随时递东西的那个人
words.core_image: 主刀的手一伸出来，旁边那人早把钳子递到他手心里
examples: He works as a research assistant.
The shop assistant wrapped the gift for us.
semantic_expansions: 助手：站在旁边搭手的那个人
助理：同一个位置写成正式职务名

words.root_logic: con-（一起）+ sist（立）→ 各部分立在一处而互不抵触 → 一致的
words.origin: 拉丁语 consistens（consistere 的现在分词）：con-（一起）+ sistere（站立）——各部分站到同一处
words.native_definition: always behaving or happening in the same way, without contradiction
words.core_concept: parts standing together without knocking into each other – 各部分站在一处而互不冲撞
words.core_image: 同一块板量了三回，尺上停的都是那一格
examples: His story stayed consistent under questioning.
She is consistent in her training habits.
semantic_expansions: 一致的：几处说法立在同一位置，彼此不打架
始终如一的：把同一问法搬到时间上，每一次都立在原处

words.root_logic: con-（一起）+ stitu（statuere 立定）→ 一同立起整体的那一块 → 组成部分
words.origin: 拉丁语 constituens（constituere 的现在分词）：con-（一起）+ statuere（立定）← status（立住的样子）
words.native_definition: one of the parts that make up a whole, or a voter in a district
words.core_concept: one of the pieces standing together to make the whole – 与别的一同立起整体的那一块
words.core_image: 把钟拆开摆一桌，齿轮发条一样不少，合回去才走字
examples: Flour is the main constituent of bread.
He met his constituents on Saturday morning.
semantic_expansions: 组成部分/构成的：与别块一同把整体立起来的那一块
选民：一张张选票立起议员的席位，选区里的人就是这个整体里的一块

words.root_logic: estat（status 立住的状态）→ 一个人立身所凭的那份家底 → 地产
words.origin: 古法语 estat（状况、身份）← 拉丁语 status（站立的状态）；本指一个人立身所凭的身份与家产
words.native_definition: a large area of land with a house on it, or all the money and property someone leaves
words.core_concept: the standing a person has in land and property – 一个人在田产上立住的那份身家
words.core_image: 一道围墙圈住宅子、林子和几片田，从这头走到那头要半天
examples: He inherited a large estate in Kent.
Her estate was divided among three sons.
semantic_expansions: 地产/庄园：立身所凭、有围墙圈住的那片土地
遗产：人走以后留在世上的那一份身家总数

words.root_logic: state（status 立定的邦国）+ -man → 替一国立住方向的人 → 政治家
words.origin: 英语 state（← 拉丁语 status：站立的状态，引申为政体）+ man；指长于治国而非争位的人
words.native_definition: a skilled and respected political leader
words.core_concept: one who holds a whole country steady – 把整个邦国稳稳立住的那个人
words.core_image: 换过三任领袖，他还在台上，讲的仍是二十年以后的事
examples: He is remembered as a great statesman.
The old statesman advised three presidents.
semantic_expansions: 政治家：为一国立定方向的人
国务活动家：同一种人在正式场合的称法

words.root_logic: statu（statuere 立起）+ -e → 被立起来、就那样立着的人形 → 雕像
words.origin: 拉丁语 statua ← statuere（使立起）← status；本义就是「被立起来的那样东西」
words.native_definition: a carved or cast figure of a person or animal
words.core_concept: a figure set upright and left standing – 把一个人形立起来，就那样立着
words.core_image: 广场中央那尊青铜立了一百年，鸽子在他肩上换了几代
examples: A bronze statue stands in the square.
Children climbed onto the stone statue.
semantic_expansions: 雕像：石凿或铜铸的那个立着的人形
塑像：同一样东西按材料换个说法

words.root_logic: status（stare 立住的样子）→ 眼下立在哪一格上 → 地位
words.origin: 拉丁语 status（站立的样子、状态）← stare（站立）
words.native_definition: someone's rank in relation to others, or the current state of something
words.core_concept: where a thing currently stands – 眼下立在哪一格上
words.core_image: 一张座次图，谁坐哪一排早画定了，位置一换满场都看得出
examples: She has achieved high status in the firm.
Please check the status of my order.
semantic_expansions: 地位/身份：人在众人当中立住的那一格
状况：把同一问法用在事情上，它此刻立到了哪一步

words.root_logic: statut（statuere 立定）→ 被正式立下、从此立在那里的一条 → 法规
words.origin: 拉丁语 statutum（statuere 的过去分词中性形：已立定的事项）← status
words.native_definition: a written law passed by a legislature
words.core_concept: a rule set upright and left standing – 被立下来、从此立在那里的一条
words.core_image: 厚册子里一条条编了号，红笔圈住的那条今天起开始管人
examples: The statute was passed last year.
Such acts are forbidden by statute.
semantic_expansions: 法规/条例：正式立下、写进册子的那一条
成文法：与口传的惯例相对，强调它立在纸面上

words.root_logic: super-（在上面）+ stit（stare 立）→ 在道理之上多立出来的一层敬畏 → 迷信
words.origin: 拉丁语 superstitio ← superstare：super-（在上）+ stare（站立）——多出来、立在事理之上的那层敬畏
words.native_definition: a belief that certain acts or objects bring luck, not based on reason
words.core_concept: an extra layer standing above what reason supports – 在道理之上多立出来的一层
words.core_image: 出门非要绕开那块井盖，绕不过去就宁可回屋再坐一会儿
examples: Fear of black cats is a common superstition.
Sailors once held many superstitions.

words.root_logic: al-（ad- 朝）+ lev（levare 使变轻）+ -ate → 把压着的分量卸掉一部分 → 减轻
words.origin: 晚期拉丁语 alleviare：ad-（朝）+ levis（轻的）、levare（举起、使变轻）
words.native_definition: to make pain or a problem less severe
words.core_concept: taking weight off so the load rides lighter – 卸掉一部分分量，担子就轻了
words.core_image: 从背包里抽出两本厚书塞给同伴，肩带立刻松了一截
examples: The pills alleviated her headache within minutes.
New roads alleviate traffic in the old town.
semantic_expansions: 减轻：把压着的分量卸掉一部分
缓解：同一个动作用在痛感或紧张上

words.root_logic: e-（ex- 向上）+ lev（levare 举）+ -ate → 托住往上送 → 举起
words.origin: 拉丁语 elevare：ex-（向上、向外）+ levare（举起）
words.native_definition: to raise something to a higher level or position
words.core_concept: sending a thing up by carrying it – 托住往上送
words.core_image: 千斤顶一下一下压，车身离地面越来越远
examples: Elevate your leg to reduce the swelling.
The win elevated him to national fame.
semantic_expansions: 举起：把东西托着往上送
提升：同一个动作用在水平与程度上
提拔：把人往上送一格

words.root_logic: e-（向上）+ lev（举）+ -or（做这事的东西）→ 一整天只管把人往上送的那个箱子 → 电梯
words.origin: 英语 elevate（← 拉丁语 elevare：ex-＋levare 举起）加 -or；美式称法，英式多作 lift
words.native_definition: a machine that carries people or goods between floors
words.core_concept: the box that does nothing but carry things up – 只管把东西往上送的那个箱子
words.core_image: 铁门一合，脚下轻轻一沉，数字牌从三跳到十七
examples: The elevator stopped between two floors.
Take the elevator to the top floor.
semantic_expansions: 电梯：楼里载人往上送的那个箱子
升降机：同一装置用在货物上的称法

words.root_logic: re-（再）+ lief（levare 使变轻）→ 压着的分量被拿走以后那口气 → 宽慰
words.origin: 古法语 relief ← relever ← 拉丁语 relevare：re-（再）+ levare（举起、使变轻）
words.native_definition: the good feeling when pain or worry stops, or help given to people in need
words.core_concept: the moment the weight comes off – 压着的那份分量被拿走的一刻
words.core_image: 电话里说人已经找到，她坐回椅子，肩膀整个塌下来
examples: She sighed with relief when the phone rang.
Food relief reached the village at dawn.
semantic_expansions: 宽慰/解脱：心上压着的那份分量被拿走的一下
救济：把别人肩上的重担卸掉一部分，送去的粮和钱就是卸掉的那部分

words.root_logic: re-（再）+ lieve（levare 使变轻）→ 把压着的重新托起来 → 减轻，或干脆自己接过来 → 解除
words.origin: 古法语 relever ← 拉丁语 relevare：re-（再）+ levare（举起、使变轻）
words.native_definition: to reduce pain or trouble, or to take over someone's duty
words.core_concept: lifting the weight off, or taking it over oneself – 把压着的托起来，或干脆自己接过来
words.core_image: 值了一夜的人交出钥匙，另一个接过来坐下，他终于能走了
examples: This ointment relieves itching at once.
A fresh guard relieved him at midnight.
semantic_expansions: 减轻：把压着的分量托起来一些
解除：整份都拿掉
接替：那份分量并没消失，是换到自己肩上

words.root_logic: ex-（彻底）+ ecut（sequi 跟随）→ 跟着一件事走到最后一步 → 执行
words.origin: 古法语 executer ← 拉丁语 exsequi（办到底、跟到底），过去分词 exsecutus ← sequi（跟随）
words.native_definition: to carry out a plan or order, or to put someone to death by law
words.core_concept: following a thing through to its last step – 跟着一件事走到最后一步
words.core_image: 清单上八条，他从头一条跟到末一条，每条后面补一个勾
examples: The team executed the plan without delay.
He was executed at dawn.
semantic_expansions: 执行/实施：跟着定好的步骤一路走到底
处死：依判决把刑罚跟到最后一步，这一支出自法律用语

words.root_logic: ex-（彻底）+ ecut（跟随）+ -ive → 管着把事跟到底的那个人 → 主管
words.origin: 中世纪拉丁语 executivus ← 拉丁语 exsequi（办到底）← sequi（跟随）
words.native_definition: a senior person who manages a business, or relating to carrying out decisions
words.core_concept: the one who sees decisions through – 负责把定下的事跟到底的那个人
words.core_image: 会散了，别人回工位，他留下把每条谁做、几号交，一样样交代清楚
examples: She is a senior executive at the bank.
Executive power rests with the president.
semantic_expansions: 主管/高管：管着把事办到底的那个人
执行的：形容那一支只管落实、不管定案的权力

words.root_logic: pur-（pro- 向前）+ sue（sequi 跟随）→ 咬住不放地一路跟下去 → 追赶
words.origin: 盎格鲁法语 pursuer ← 通俗拉丁语 *prosequere ← 拉丁语 prosequi：pro-（向前）+ sequi（跟随）
words.native_definition: to chase someone, or to keep working toward something over time
words.core_concept: staying on something's heels until you have it – 咬住不放，一路跟到手
words.core_image: 猎狗咬着那股气味不松口，前面拐几个弯它就跟几个弯
examples: Police pursued the car for ten miles.
She pursued a career in medicine.
semantic_expansions: 追赶：跟在后头不放，要把人或车追上
追求：跟着的不是人而是一个目标
继续从事：一件事跟着做下去，中间不断

words.root_logic: secundus（sequi 跟随）→ 紧跟在头一个后面的那一个
words.origin: 古法语 second ← 拉丁语 secundus（跟着来的、下一个）← sequi（跟随）
words.native_definition: coming next after the first, or one sixtieth of a minute
words.core_concept: the one that comes right behind the first – 紧跟在头一个后面的那一个
words.core_image: 领奖台上他站旁边那一格，头顶的牌子比中间那块低半头
examples: She finished second in the race.
Wait a second while I lock the door.
semantic_expansions: 第二的：紧跟头一个后面的那一位
秒：一小时先分六十份是分，再分一次得到的那层就是跟着来的下一层
附议：别人先提，自己紧跟着表态赞同

words.root_logic: sue（sequi 跟随）→ 追着一桩说法一路跟进公堂 → 起诉
words.origin: 古法语 suir / sivre（跟随、追讨）← 通俗拉丁语 *sequere ← 拉丁语 sequi（跟随）
words.native_definition: to start a legal case against someone in court
words.core_concept: following a claim all the way into court – 追着一桩说法一路跟进公堂
words.core_image: 修车费谈了半年没结果，他把单据装进信封递进法院
examples: She sued the company for unfair dismissal.
They threatened to sue us for damages.
semantic_expansions: 起诉：追着一件事把对方带上法庭
控告：同一个动作，重在指出对方有错

words.root_logic: re-（回）+ cord（cor 心）→ 把事情送回心里存住 → 记录
words.origin: 古法语 recorder ← 拉丁语 recordari：re-（回）+ cor/cordis（心）——古人以心为记事之处，想起一件事就是把它带回心上
words.native_definition: to store facts or sounds so they can be found later, or an account so stored
words.core_concept: putting a thing back into the heart so it keeps – 把事情送回心里存着，日后还找得出来
words.core_image: 每天收摊后把当天的进出一笔笔写进本子，到年底翻得出来
examples: She recorded every payment in a notebook.
He broke the world record last night.
semantic_expansions: 记录：把发生过的事存住，回头调得出来
纪录：存下来的那些里最高的一条
唱片：把声音存进一张盘，转起来又放得出来

words.root_logic: re-（回）+ cord（心）+ -er → 替人把事存住的那一个 → 录音机
words.origin: 盎格鲁法语 recordour ← 中世纪拉丁语 recordator ← recordari（记在心上）← cor（心）
words.native_definition: a machine that stores sound or images, or an official who keeps records
words.core_concept: whatever keeps things for you so nothing is lost – 替你把东西存住、不让它丢掉的那一个
words.core_image: 桌上小盒亮着一点红，谈了一小时，回头能一句句放出来
examples: Turn on the recorder before the interview begins.
The court recorder read her notes aloud.
semantic_expansions: 录音机：把声音存住、回头放得出来的机器
记录员：做同一件事的人，存的是庭上说过的话

words.root_logic: con-（一同）+ grat（gratus 令人愉快）+ -ulate → 跟着对方一起高兴，还当面说出来 → 祝贺
words.origin: 拉丁语 congratulari：com-（一同）+ gratulari（表示欢喜）← gratus（受欢迎的、令人愉快的）
words.native_definition: to tell someone you are pleased about their success
words.core_concept: joining in someone else's gladness out loud – 跟着别人一起高兴，还要说出来
words.core_image: 名单贴出来，她冲过去握住那人的手一直摇
examples: I congratulated her on passing the exam.
They congratulated him warmly after the match.
semantic_expansions: 祝贺：跟着对方一起欢喜并当面讲出来
道贺：同一件事，重在把这句话送到

words.root_logic: con-（一同）+ grat（令人愉快）+ -ation → 与人同喜时递过去的那句话
words.origin: 拉丁语 congratulatio ← congratulari：com-（一同）+ gratulari（表示欢喜）← gratus（令人愉快的）
words.native_definition: words said to someone to show you are pleased about their success
words.core_concept: the words handed over when you share someone's gladness – 与人同喜时递过去的那句话
words.core_image: 门口堆着七八张卡片，每张翻开都是同一个意思，只是字不一样
examples: Please accept my congratulations on your wedding.
Cards of congratulation filled the table.
semantic_expansions: 祝贺：与人同喜这件事本身
贺词：把这份同喜写成或说成的那几句

words.root_logic: grat（gratus 白送的好意）+ -itude → 把对方那份不要钱的好一直记着 → 感激
words.origin: 中世纪拉丁语 gratitudo ← 拉丁语 gratus（受欢迎的、令人愉快的）
words.native_definition: the feeling of being thankful for what someone has done
words.core_concept: holding on to a kindness that was given free – 把白得的那份好意一直记着
words.core_image: 当年借他钱的人早忘了，他每逢过节还是提两盒东西上门
examples: She expressed her gratitude in a short letter.
He owed a debt of gratitude to his teacher.
semantic_expansions: 感激：记着对方白送的那份好
感恩：同一份心情，重在长久记住并想着报答

words.root_logic: con-（一起）+ sens（sentire 感觉）→ 一屋子人摸到的是同一个点 → 共识
words.origin: 拉丁语 consensus ← consentire：com-（一起）+ sentire（感觉、察觉）
words.native_definition: general agreement among a group of people
words.core_concept: everyone feeling their way to the same point – 各人自己去感，落到的是同一处
words.core_image: 争了两小时，最后一轮举手，屋里没有一只手往下按
examples: The committee reached a consensus after long debate.
There is no consensus on the cause.
semantic_expansions: 共识：众人各自感到而落在同一处
一致意见：这份共同的感觉写成正式结论

words.root_logic: non-（不）+ sense（sentire 感觉、理会）→ 声音到了，里头没有可理会的东西 → 胡说
words.origin: 英语 non-（不）+ sense（← 拉丁语 sensus ← sentire 感觉、察觉）
words.native_definition: words or ideas that have no meaning or are clearly untrue
words.core_concept: sound arriving with nothing in it to take hold of – 声音到了，里头没有可抓的东西
words.core_image: 他讲了五分钟，每个字都听清了，连起来却抓不住一件事
examples: Don't talk nonsense about the money.
The report was dismissed as complete nonsense.
semantic_expansions: 胡说：说出来的话里没有能让人理会的内容
废话：有话没料，听完等于没听
荒唐事：同样的空，落在做法上而不在话上

words.root_logic: sens（sentire 感觉）+ -itive → 别人察觉不到的动静，它也感到 → 敏感的
words.origin: 古法语 sensitif ← 中世纪拉丁语 sensitivus ← 拉丁语 sensus ← sentire（感觉）
words.native_definition: quick to feel or react to small changes, or easily upset
words.core_concept: feeling what most would not notice at all – 旁人根本没察觉的动静，它已经感到
words.core_image: 天平盘里放一根头发，指针就晃出半格
examples: Her skin is sensitive to strong sunlight.
This is a sensitive topic at home.
semantic_expansions: 敏感的：极小的动静也感得到
灵敏的：同一性质用在仪器上，读数跟着微动走
易受伤的：感得太清，一句话就扎进去

words.root_logic: clos（claudere 关）+ -et（小）→ 一扇门关住的那一小块地方 → 壁橱
words.origin: 古法语 closet（小间），是 clos（← 拉丁语 clausum，claudere 的过去分词）的指小形
words.native_definition: a small room or cupboard for storing clothes and things
words.core_concept: a small space shut away behind a door – 一扇门关住的那一小块地方
words.core_image: 走廊尽头那扇窄门推开，里面挂满外套，人进去转身都难
examples: She hung her coat in the closet.
Old shoes filled the hall closet.
semantic_expansions: 壁橱：嵌在墙里、关着门放衣物的那一格
储物间：同一个关起来的小空间，大到人能走进去

words.root_logic: con-（一并）+ clus（claudere 关）+ -ion → 把散着的话头收齐，然后关上门 → 结论
words.origin: 拉丁语 conclusio ← concludere：com-（一并）+ claudere（关闭）——把话头一并收拢关起来
words.native_definition: the end of something, or a judgment reached after thinking
words.core_concept: shutting the door once the parts are gathered in – 各部分收齐了，就把门关上
words.core_image: 谈到末尾，他把散在桌上的纸叠齐推到中间，说就这样定了
examples: They came to the same conclusion independently.
The conclusion of the film surprised everyone.
semantic_expansions: 结论：把各处说法收拢后关上门定下的那一句
结尾：同一个关门动作用在过程上
推断：从手里已有的往下收，收到能关上为止

words.root_logic: curr（currere 跑）+ -iculum → 学的人得从头跑到尾的那一整圈 → 课程
words.origin: 拉丁语 curriculum（跑道、一圈路程）← currere（跑）
words.native_definition: the whole set of courses taught in a school or on a program
words.core_concept: the full track a learner is meant to run – 学的人得从头跑到尾的那一整圈
words.core_image: 墙上贴着三年的格子表，从头一格排到末一格，中间不许空
examples: The school revised its curriculum last year.
Latin is no longer on the curriculum.
semantic_expansions: 课程：要一门门跑完的那一整套
教学大纲：把这一整圈写下来的那张单子

words.root_logic: oc-（ob- 迎面）+ curr（跑）+ -ence → 迎面跑到眼前来的那一下
words.origin: 中世纪拉丁语 occurrentia ← 拉丁语 occurrere：ob-（朝着）+ currere（跑）——迎面跑来
words.native_definition: something that happens, or the fact of something happening
words.core_concept: a thing running up to meet you – 一件事迎面跑到你眼前
words.core_image: 这条路上的追尾一个月三回，住户连门都不出来看了
examples: Such storms are a rare occurrence here.
The occurrence of errors dropped sharply.
semantic_expansions: 事件：迎面撞上来的那一件
发生：不数件数，只说撞上来这回事
出现：同一个动作，重在从没有到露面

words.root_logic: con-（一起）+ fus（fundere 倒）+ -ion → 几样东西倒进一个盆，哪样是哪样都分不出 → 混乱
words.origin: 拉丁语 confusio ← confundere：com-（一起）+ fundere（倒出）——倒到一处搅在一块
words.native_definition: a state in which people do not understand what is happening, or things are mixed up
words.core_concept: things poured into one basin until none can be told apart – 全倒进一个盆，哪样是哪样都分不出
words.core_image: 广播换了三次登机口，一群人拖着箱子在大厅里对着走
examples: The announcement caused confusion among passengers.
There is some confusion over the dates.
semantic_expansions: 混乱：几样东西倒到一处，秩序就没了
困惑：人心里也被倒成一片，抓不住头绪
混淆：两样本该分开的被倒在了一起

words.root_logic: com-（一起）+ merc（merx 货）+ -ial → 围着货物换手长出来的那一摊事 → 商业的
words.origin: 拉丁语 commercium（贸易）：com-（一起）+ merx（属格 mercis：货物）
words.native_definition: relating to buying and selling, or a paid advertisement on radio or television
words.core_concept: everything that gathers around goods changing hands – 围着货物换手这件事长出来的一摊
words.core_image: 一整层楼全租给了店铺，早上八点卷帘门一家家往上拉
examples: The building is used for commercial purposes.
A loud commercial interrupted the film.
semantic_expansions: 商业的：与买进卖出货物有关的
商用的：同一形容词落在用途上，不是自家使唤而是拿来赚钱
广告：广播电视里为卖货插进来的那一段

words.root_logic: merchand（marcheant 贩货的人）+ -ise → 摆出来等人问价的那批东西 → 商品
words.origin: 古法语 marcheandise ← marcheant（商人）← 通俗拉丁语 mercatans ← mercari（买卖）← merx（货物）
words.native_definition: goods that are bought and sold
words.core_concept: the goods themselves, set out to be traded – 摆出来供交换的那批东西本身
words.core_image: 布摊在地上，一样样码开，标签朝上，等人蹲下来翻
examples: The shop sells sports merchandise online.
Damaged merchandise was sent back.
semantic_expansions: 商品：进来再卖出去的那批东西
货物：同一批东西，重在它是要装要运的实物

words.root_logic: di-（dis- 朝各处）+ rect（regere 引成直线）+ -ion → 把线引向哪一边 → 方向
words.origin: 拉丁语 dirigere（引成一条直线）的名词形：dis-（分开、朝各处）+ -rigere（← regere 引导、使直）
words.native_definition: the line along which something moves or points, or an instruction on what to do
words.core_concept: the straight line a thing is guided along – 把东西引着走的那一条直线
words.core_image: 岔路口三块木牌各指一边，脚下的土路却只有一条
examples: The wind changed direction after midnight.
Follow the directions on the packet.
semantic_expansions: 方向：被引出来的那条线朝着哪一边
指示：把该走的那条线讲给别人听
管理：替一群人把线引直，带着他们走

words.root_logic: e-（ex- 向上）+ rect（regere 引直）→ 把歪着的引成直的，一直引到立起来 → 竖立
words.origin: 拉丁语 erigere 的过去分词入英语：ex-（向上）+ -rigere（← regere 引导、使直）
words.native_definition: to build or set something upright, or standing straight up
words.core_concept: guided straight upward until it stands – 被引成直的，一直引到立起来
words.core_image: 四个人扶着旗杆，绳子一收，杆子从斜着变成笔直
examples: They erected a fence around the field.
He sat erect on the wooden bench.
semantic_expansions: 竖立：把躺着或歪着的引直、立起来
建造：立起来的是一整座房或一道墙
直立的：形容已经立成直的那个样子

words.root_logic: champagne（Campania ← campus 平野）→ 拿一片平野的地名当自己的名字 → 只有那儿产的才叫这个
words.origin: 法语 Champagne（法国东北一地区名）← 晚期拉丁语 Campania ← campus（平坦原野）；此酒因产地得名
words.native_definition: a sparkling white wine from one region of northern France
words.core_concept: the wine named after one stretch of open country – 拿一片平野的地名当自己名字的那种酒
words.core_image: 木塞一声顶开，杯壁上一串细泡从底一直冒到口
examples: They opened a bottle of champagne.
Champagne was served after the ceremony.

words.root_logic: ex-（向外）+ cit（citare 唤起、催动）+ -ment → 被叫起来的那股劲在里头翻腾 → 兴奋
words.origin: 英语 excite（← 拉丁语 excitare：ex-（向外）+ citare 唤起、催动）加 -ment
words.native_definition: a strong feeling of eagerness, or a state of lively activity
words.core_concept: the stir called up inside a person – 被叫起来的那股劲在人里头翻腾
words.core_image: 开场前十分钟，看台上的人已经坐不住，脚在铁板上一直踩
examples: The children could not hide their excitement.
Her voice shook with excitement.
semantic_expansions: 兴奋：心里那股被唤起来的劲
激动：同一股劲更急更满，压都压不住
热闹：一群人的这股劲聚在一处的场面

words.root_logic: cred（credere 相信、托付）+ -ential → 让不认识的人也肯信你的那张纸 → 凭证
words.origin: 中世纪拉丁语 credentialis ← credentia（信任、凭信）← 拉丁语 credere（相信、把东西托付出去）
words.native_definition: a document or qualification showing that someone is trusted or qualified
words.core_concept: the paper that makes a stranger willing to trust you – 让不认识的人也肯信你的那张纸
words.core_image: 门口的人伸手要东西，他从内袋抽出一张卡，对方看一眼就让路
examples: She showed her credentials at the gate.
His credentials as a teacher are excellent.
semantic_expansions: 凭证：递出去换取信任的那件东西
资格证明：证明你够格做这件事的那一份
证书：写成正式文件的那一张

words.root_logic: sug-（sub- 从下）+ gest（gerere 携带）+ -ion → 从下方悄悄带上来、轻轻递给人的那个意思 → 建议
words.origin: 盎格鲁法语 suggestioun ← 拉丁语 suggestio ← suggerere：sub-（从下）+ gerere（携带、承载）
words.native_definition: an idea put forward for someone to consider, or a hint of something
words.core_concept: an idea carried up from below and offered quietly – 从下方悄悄带上来、轻轻递到人跟前的那个意思
words.core_image: 会上没人接话，他从桌下递过一张字条，上面只写了两行
examples: Her suggestion saved us two days of work.
There was a suggestion of doubt in his tone.
semantic_expansions: 建议/意见：把想法带上台面供人考虑
暗示：不明说，只把意思带出来一点

words.root_logic: de-（向下）+ cline（clinare 倾斜）→ 顺着斜面往低处走 → 下降；把递来的往旁一偏 → 谢绝
words.origin: 古法语 decliner ← 拉丁语 declinare：de-（向下）+ clinare（使倾斜）；clinare 与希腊语 klinein（倾斜）同出一源
words.native_definition: to become weaker or fewer, or to politely refuse something
words.core_concept: tipping downward, or tilting a thing aside – 顺着斜面往下走，或把递来的往旁一偏
words.core_image: 折线从左肩一路走到右下角，最后两格几乎贴到底线
examples: Sales declined sharply in the second year.
He declined the invitation with thanks.
semantic_expansions: 下降/衰退：顺着那道斜面一路往低处走
谢绝：把递到面前的东西往旁边偏开，不是硬推回去

words.root_logic: mus（Mousa 缪斯）+ -eum（处所）→ 为缪斯那几门技艺留出来的一所屋子 → 博物馆
words.origin: 拉丁语 museum ← 希腊语 mouseion（缪斯的处所，本指学者聚在一处研习的地方）← Mousa（缪斯）
words.native_definition: a building where objects of art, history, or science are kept and shown
words.core_concept: a house kept for the arts the Muses grant – 为缪斯所赐的那几门技艺留出来的一所屋子
words.core_image: 玻璃柜一排排立着，每件东西下面压一张小卡片，走廊里只有脚步声
examples: The museum opens at ten every day.
We spent the afternoon in the science museum.
semantic_expansions: 博物馆：把值得留住的东西集在一处供人看的屋子
展览馆：同一类屋子，重在里头的东西是摆出来给人看的

words.root_logic: ori（oriri 升起）+ -ent（正在）→ 日头正升起来的那一边，拿它当准头 → 定位
words.origin: 古法语 orient ← 拉丁语 oriens（oriri 的现在分词：正升起的，指日出之处）
words.native_definition: to find your position or adjust to a new situation, or the lands of the east
words.core_concept: taking your bearing from where the sun comes up – 拿日头出来的那一边当准头
words.core_image: 拿着地图在陌生街口转了半圈，把纸上的路和脚下的路对上
examples: It took her a week to orient herself.
Ships once sailed to the orient for silk.
semantic_expansions: 东方：日头升起来的那一边
定位：拿那一边当准头，把自己摆正
适应：到了新地方，一点点把自己摆正

words.root_logic: poss（posse 能够）+ -ible + -ly → 落在办得到的范围里，但没说一定 → 可能
words.origin: 英语 possible（← 拉丁语 possibilis ← posse 能够）加 -ly
words.native_definition: perhaps, or by any chance at all
words.core_concept: within what could happen, not what will – 落在办得到的范围里，但没说一定
words.core_image: 他抬头看了看云，说下午出门伞还是带上
examples: She may possibly arrive before noon.
We cannot possibly finish it tonight.
semantic_expansions: 可能/也许：办得到，只是不保证会这样
尽可能：把办得到的这个范围一直用到边上
collocations: cannot possibly + do sth —— 绝不可能，与否定连用是加强语气，不是对可能的否定
as soon as sb possibly can —— 尽快，把办得到的范围用到边上，此处 possibly 修饰 can
may/might possibly + do sth —— 或许会，与情态动词叠用把断言再放软一层
How could sb possibly do sth —— 疑问句里加强，表怎么可能

words.root_logic: qual（qualis 何种成色）+ -itative → 问的是哪一种成色，不是有多少 → 定性的
words.origin: 中世纪拉丁语 qualitativus ← 拉丁语 qualitas（性质）← qualis（何种、什么样的）
words.native_definition: relating to the nature or kind of something rather than its amount
words.core_concept: asking what kind, never how many – 问的是哪一种成色，不是有多少
words.core_image: 两块布不称重也不量尺，只对着光看纹路粗细
examples: The study used qualitative methods only.
This is a qualitative change, not a small one.
semantic_expansions: 定性的：只判成色与种类，不出数目
性质上的：同一个意思用在变化上，变的是种类而不是量

words.root_logic: solu（solvere 解开）+ -ble（可以）→ 放进合适的水里就自己散开 → 可溶的
words.origin: 古法语 soluble ← 晚期拉丁语 solubilis ← 拉丁语 solvere（解开、松开）
words.native_definition: able to be dissolved in liquid, or able to be worked out
words.core_concept: coming undone when put in the right liquid – 放进合适的水里就自己散开
words.core_image: 一勺白粉倒进温水，搅两圈杯底就干净了
examples: Sugar is soluble in warm water.
The problem proved soluble after all.
semantic_expansions: 可溶的：进了液体就散开，结不成块
可解决的：同一个散开用在难题上，缠着的那团能被抽松

words.root_logic: tempt（temptare 试探）+ -ation → 有东西伸过来试一试你顶不顶得住 → 诱惑
words.origin: 古法语 temptacion ← 拉丁语 temptatio ← temptare（试探、考验）
words.native_definition: a strong wish to have or do something you know you should avoid
words.core_concept: something reaching out to test whether you will hold – 有东西伸过来试一试你顶不顶得住
words.core_image: 冰箱门开着，那块蛋糕就在眼前，他站着看了十几秒又关上
examples: She resisted the temptation to reply.
Cheap loans are a real temptation.
semantic_expansions: 诱惑：那股一直来试探你的拉力
引诱：把这股拉力看成别人有意做的动作
诱人的东西：专来试你的那件东西本身

words.root_logic: torm（torquere 拧）+ -ment → 被一圈圈拧紧，还不放开 → 折磨
words.origin: 古法语 torment ← 拉丁语 tormentum（靠扭绞发力的刑具、绞索）← torquere（扭转、拧）
words.native_definition: severe suffering, or to make someone suffer in this way
words.core_concept: being twisted tighter and never let go – 被一圈圈拧紧，还不放开
words.core_image: 疼从后腰起来，一阵一阵拧上去，半夜翻来覆去躺不平
examples: The noise tormented him for weeks.
She lived in torment after the accident.
semantic_expansions: 折磨：一下一下拧着不放的那个动作
痛苦：被拧住的人身上那份感受
纠缠：拧的人反复来，缠着不肯松手

words.root_logic: pre-（prae- 更、在前）+ vail（valere 有力）→ 力气比对方足，最后立住的是这一边 → 占优势
words.origin: 古法语 prevaler ← 拉丁语 praevalere：prae-（更、在前）+ valere（强壮、有力）
words.native_definition: to win in the end, or to be common in a place or time
words.core_concept: being the stronger one, so it is your side that stands – 力气占上头，最后立住的是你这边
words.core_image: 两队拔了十分钟，绳结终于一寸寸挪过白线
examples: Common sense prevailed in the end.
This custom still prevails in the north.
semantic_expansions: 占优势/获胜：力气比对方足，最后压了过去
流行：某个做法在四周力量最大，到处都是它

words.origin: 古法语 corde ← 拉丁语 chorda（琴弦、肠制的弦）← 希腊语 khorde（肠、弦）；与拉丁语 cor（心）同形而不同源，与 chord 是一对同源双式词
words.native_definition: a length of thick string or thin rope, or an insulated electrical wire
words.core_concept: a twisted length strong enough to bind things – 拧成一股、拉得住东西的那一段
words.core_image: 两股麻拧在一起，两头磨得发白，捆过很多回，边上起了毛
examples: He tied the box with a nylon cord.
The lamp cord runs behind the sofa.
semantic_expansions: 绳索/细绳：拧成股的那一段，捆东西用
电线：外面包一层皮的那一根，形状与用法都照着它来
words.decomposable_note: 希腊借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.origin: 古法语 entre-（在中间）+ ferir（击打）← 拉丁语 ferire（打、击中）——两下从中间互击；与表「搬运」的 fer- 一支不同源
words.native_definition: to get involved in something without being asked, or to disturb a signal
words.core_concept: striking in from between so the two no longer meet clean – 从中间插进来打一下，两头就接不干净了
words.core_image: 两人正说着，第三个声音从中间插进来，谁的话都听不完整
examples: Do not interfere in other people's business.
Tall buildings interfere with the signal.
semantic_expansions: 干涉/干预：把自己插到别人中间去搅一脚
干扰：插进来的是杂音杂物，传过去的东西就不干净
words.decomposable_note: 拉丁借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.origin: 中世纪拉丁语 complangere（拍胸哀号）：com-（一同）+ plangere（拍打、击打），经古法语入英语；与表「平」的那一支同形而不同源
words.native_definition: to say that you are unhappy or that something is wrong
words.core_concept: beating the chest so others hear the hurt – 拍着胸口出声，让旁人听见这份不好受
words.core_image: 队排到窗口，他把单子往台面上一拍，声音比刚才高了两度
examples: She complained about the cold soup.
Guests complained to the manager twice.
semantic_expansions: 抱怨：出声说自己不好受
投诉：把这份不好受正式递到管事的人跟前
诉说：说的是身上的病痛苦处
words.decomposable_note: 拉丁借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.origin: 古法语 compleinte（动词 compleindre 的过去分词名词化）← 中世纪拉丁语 complangere：com-（一同）+ plangere（拍打、拍胸哀号）
words.native_definition: a statement that something is wrong, or an illness
words.core_concept: the chest-beating put into words and handed over – 那份拍着胸口的不好受，写成一件递上去的东西
words.core_image: 意见箱里抽出十几张纸，八张写的是同一部电梯
examples: The hotel received three complaints last week.
A chest complaint kept him at home.
semantic_expansions: 抱怨：说出来的那份不好受
投诉：正式递上去的那一件
疾病：身上不舒服的那一处，也是同一种说自己难受
words.decomposable_note: 拉丁借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.root_logic: re-（往回）+ fus（倒）+ -al → 把递来的东西倒回去这件事 → 拒绝
words.origin: 英语 refuse 加 -al；refuse ← 古法语 refuser ← 拉丁语 refundere：re-（往回）+ fundere（倒出）——PIE *ǵʰewd-「倒」那一支
words.native_definition: an act of saying no to something offered or requested
words.core_concept: the no handed back when something is offered – 东西递过来，把不接受原样递回去
words.core_image: 请帖原样退回，信封上另贴一张字条，只有两行客气话
examples: His refusal surprised everyone at the table.
She gave a polite refusal by letter.
semantic_expansions: 拒绝：明确说不接受
谢绝：同一个不接受，说得客气些

words.root_logic: ex-（出去）+ pend（称量）→ expendere：称出银子付出去 → 付出去的那笔量
words.origin: 中世纪拉丁语 expenditura ← 拉丁语 expenditus / expendere：ex（出）＋pendere（称量、付出）
words.native_definition: the total amount of money or effort that is spent
words.core_concept: money weighed out and paid away – 称出来付出去的那一份
words.core_image: 账本最后一行写着这个月从库房里搬出去的银钱总数
examples: The company cut its expenditure last year.
Public expenditure on health rose sharply.
semantic_expansions: 支出：从账上称出去、不再回来的钱
花费：为一件事付出去的钱数
消耗：不只是钱，体力和时间也这么一份份称出去

words.root_logic: ex-（出去）+ pens（称量）→ 称出来交出去的那一笔
words.origin: 古法语 espense（花掉的钱）← 晚期拉丁语 expensa ← 拉丁语 expendere：ex（出）＋pendere（称量）
words.native_definition: the money that something costs you, or a cost you have to bear
words.core_concept: what a thing weighs out of your purse – 一件事从你钱袋里称走的那一份
words.core_image: 出差回来把一叠票据摊在桌上，一张张加起来交给财务
examples: The trip was worth the expense.
She won at the expense of her health.
semantic_expansions: 费用：办一件事要交出去的钱数
开支：一段时间里陆续交出去的那些钱
代价：交出去的不是钱而是别的东西，如健康

words.root_logic: in-（不）+ de-（往下）+ pend（挂）→ 不从别的东西上垂下来
words.origin: 法语 indépendance ← in-（不）＋dépendance ← 拉丁语 dependere：de（往下）＋pendere（挂）
words.native_definition: the state of not being controlled or supported by others
words.core_concept: not hanging from anything else – 不从别的东西上垂下来
words.core_image: 一盏灯自己立在地上，不靠墙，也没从房梁上垂下来
examples: The colony won its independence in 1947.
She values her financial independence.
semantic_expansions: 独立：不挂在别人身上，自己站得住
自主：自己的事自己定，不用等上头点头

words.root_logic: in-（不）+ de-（往下）+ pend（挂）→ 不吊在谁身上的
words.origin: 法语 indépendant ← in-（不）＋dépendant ← 拉丁语 dependens（正挂着的）← dependere
words.native_definition: not relying on or controlled by other people or things
words.core_concept: standing without hanging on another – 不吊在别人身上也站得住
words.core_image: 两根柱子各自扎在土里，抽掉一根，另一根照样站着
examples: She has been independent since she was eighteen.
Two independent teams checked the data.
semantic_expansions: 独立的：不靠别人支撑，自己立着
自主的：自己决定自己的事，不受人指派
无党派的：不挂靠任何一方的旗号

words.root_logic: in-（不）+ dispens（按份称出去、分派，← pendere 称量）+ -able → 这一份免不掉、划不掉
words.origin: 中世纪拉丁语 indispensabilis（不可豁免的）← in-（不）＋dispensare（按份称出、分派）：dis（分开）＋pendere（称量）
words.native_definition: so necessary that you cannot manage without it
words.core_concept: the one share that cannot be weighed away – 唯一不能从分派里划掉的那份
words.core_image: 清点行李时把这一件挑出来放回箱底，别的都能扔
examples: Water is indispensable to life.
She became indispensable to the team.
semantic_expansions: 不可缺少的：抽掉它整件事就散了
必不可少的：非有它不行，找不到替代

words.root_logic: pend（挂）+ -ulum（小东西）→ pendulus：吊着自己晃的那一件
words.origin: 拉丁语 pendulus（悬着的、摆动的）← pendere（悬挂）
words.native_definition: a weight hung from a fixed point that swings freely back and forth
words.core_concept: a weight left hanging so that it swings – 吊在一点上、自己来回晃的一块重物
words.core_image: 一根线吊着铜块，推一下就左右来回，每次都过同一个最低点
examples: The pendulum of the old clock swung slowly.
Public opinion swings like a pendulum.
semantic_expansions: 摆：吊在一点上来回晃动的那件重物
钟摆：钟里靠这个来回来定时间的那一根

words.root_logic: pens（称量）+ -io → pensio：按期称出银子付给你的那一份
words.origin: 古法语 pencion（付款）← 拉丁语 pensio（付款、分期支付）← pendere（称量、付钱）
words.native_definition: money paid regularly to someone who has retired from work
words.core_concept: a fixed amount weighed out to you each period – 每期按定量称给你的那一笔
words.core_image: 每月同一天，柜台里数出同样厚的一叠钞票，交给不再上班的人
examples: He lives on a small pension.
She pays into a pension every month.
semantic_expansions: 养老金：年纪大了以后按期领到的那笔钱
退休金：不再上班后由原单位或国家按期付的钱

words.root_logic: pond（重量，← pendere 称量）+ -er → 把事情放到秤上一遍遍称
words.origin: 古法语 ponderer（衡量）← 拉丁语 ponderare（称重、掂量）← pondus（重量）← pendere（称量）
words.native_definition: to think about something carefully for a long time
words.core_concept: putting a matter on the scales in your head – 把事情放到心里的秤上称
words.core_image: 两个选择摆在眼前，他坐着不动，来回比这个重还是那个重
examples: She pondered the question for a while.
He pondered over what to do next.
semantic_expansions: 沉思：把一件事放在心里久久称量
仔细考虑：一条条比过轻重再定
掂量：在几样里反复比，挑分量合适的那个

words.root_logic: ex-（出）+ pend（称量）→ expendere：称出银子付出去 → 钱和时间都这么一份份付掉
words.origin: 古英语 -spendan（用掉，见于 forspendan）← 拉丁语 expendere：ex（出）＋pendere（称量、付出）
words.native_definition: to pay out money, or to use up time on something
words.core_concept: to weigh out what you have and hand it over – 把自己有的称出来交出去
words.core_image: 手伸进口袋掏出几枚硬币放到柜台上，口袋跟着轻了
examples: They spend too much on food.
We spent the summer by the sea.
semantic_expansions: 花费：把钱称出去交给别人
度过：时间也这么一份份用出去，如过完一个夏天
用尽：把手上那点量全付光

words.root_logic: spec（看）+ -ies → species：看上去的那副样子 → 样子相同的归成一类
words.origin: 拉丁语 species（外观、样子、类别）← specere（看）
words.native_definition: a group of living things that look alike and can breed together
words.core_concept: the look shared by all of one kind – 同一类共有的那副模样
words.core_image: 标本柜同一格里的几只鸟，喙的弧度和羽色几乎一模一样
examples: This species of frog lives only here.
Many species are dying out.
semantic_expansions: 物种：外形相同、彼此能繁育的一群生物
种类：泛指长得一样、被归到一起的一批东西

words.root_logic: speci（样子、类，← specere 看）+ -fic（造成）→ 只落在这一类上，不涉别的
words.origin: 晚期拉丁语 specificus（成一类的）← species（类别、样子）＋-ficus（造成…的）
words.native_definition: clearly stated and applying to one thing only
words.core_concept: pinned to one kind and no other – 只钉在这一类上，不涉其余
words.core_image: 他不说哪天都行，直接伸手指着日历上那一格
examples: Give me a specific example.
The drug works on one specific virus.
semantic_expansions: 具体的：细到能指出是哪一个
特定的：单指这一个，不是同类里随便哪个
明确的：说到位了，不给人猜的余地

words.root_logic: spec（看）+ -men（用来做某事的东西）→ 取出来专给人看的那一件
words.origin: 拉丁语 specimen（用来看的样品、标志）← specere（看）
words.native_definition: a single example of something, taken so that it can be examined
words.core_concept: the one piece taken out to be looked at – 取出来专供人细看的那一件
words.core_image: 玻璃管里封着一小段取下来的东西，贴好标签送去化验
examples: The doctor took a blood specimen.
Each specimen is kept in a jar.
semantic_expansions: 样本：从整体里取一小份拿去查
标本：处理好、长期留着供人看的那件
样品：拿来代表一批货给人过目的一件

words.root_logic: specula（瞭望塔，← specere 看）+ -ate → 站塔上往远处望 → 看不清也先说出个说法
words.origin: 拉丁语 speculari（观察、远望）← specula（瞭望塔）← specere（看）
words.native_definition: to guess about something without enough facts, or to risk money hoping for profit
words.core_concept: watching from a height and guessing at what is far off – 站高处远望，看不清就先下判断
words.core_image: 站在塔顶往远处望，那边只有一团影子，他张口就说那是什么
examples: The papers speculated about her reasons.
He speculated in land and lost money.
semantic_expansions: 推测：证据不全就先给出一个说法
思索：在心里远望，把可能的情形一个个想过
投机：拿钱去赌一个要等很久才见输赢的走势

words.root_logic: su-/sub-（从下往上）+ spic（看，← specere）→ suspicere：暗暗从下往上打量 → 心里存下的那点不放心
words.origin: 盎格鲁法语 suspecioun（后依拉丁语改拼）← 拉丁语 suspicio（暗中打量、猜忌）← suspicere：sub（从下）＋specere（看）
words.native_definition: a feeling that someone has done something wrong, without proof
words.core_concept: a sidelong look that keeps something back – 从底下打量一眼，心里留着一个疑
words.core_image: 他嘴上应着，眼睛却从下往上把对方扫了一遍
examples: She looked at him with suspicion.
He was arrested on suspicion of theft.
semantic_expansions: 怀疑：心里存着事情不对，却拿不出证据
嫌疑：别人看你像是干了那件事的那种处境

words.root_logic: sub-（从下）+ spic（看，← specere）+ -ous → 老在暗中打量人的，或引人这么打量的
words.origin: 古法语 sospecious ← 拉丁语 suspiciosus（多疑的、可疑的）← suspicio ← suspicere：sub（从下）＋specere（看）
words.native_definition: feeling that something is wrong, or making other people feel that
words.core_concept: either doing the sidelong looking or drawing it – 要么在暗中打量别人，要么招来这种打量
words.core_image: 半夜有人在别人车边蹲着，路过的都要多看他两眼
examples: A suspicious man waited by the gate.
She was suspicious of his story.
semantic_expansions: 可疑的：样子招人从底下打量，觉得不对
多疑的：自己老在暗中打量别人
怀疑的：眼下就对某件事存着疑

words.root_logic: man（手，← manus）+ -age + -ment → maneggiare 本是用手驯马 → 把一摊事拿在手里打理
words.origin: manage（← 意大利语 maneggiare 驯马、经手打理 ← 拉丁语 manus 手）＋-ment
words.native_definition: the work of controlling and organizing a business or a group of people
words.core_concept: keeping the reins of a thing in your own hand – 把一摊事的缰绳收在自己手里
words.core_image: 一个人手里攥着几十根缰绳，马往哪边走全看他松紧
examples: The factory needs better management.
Management refused to meet the union.
semantic_expansions: 管理：把人和事拿在手里安排，松紧由你
经营：日常打理一门生意，让它转得下去
管理层：手里握着这些缰绳的那批人

words.root_logic: man（手，← manus）+ -age + -er → 缰绳握在他手里的那个人
words.origin: manage（← 意大利语 maneggiare 驯马、经手打理 ← 拉丁语 manus 手）＋-er
words.native_definition: the person in charge of running a business or part of one
words.core_concept: the one whose hand holds the reins – 缰绳在他手里的那个人
words.core_image: 车间里出了岔子，所有人都回头看门口站着的那个人
examples: Ask the manager for a refund.
She is the manager of two shops.
semantic_expansions: 经理：一家店或一个部门的负责人
管理者：手里管着人和事的那种人
主管：某一摊具体事务归他管

words.root_logic: manu（用手，← manus）+ opera（活儿）→ manuopera：手上的活 → 靠手上功夫一寸寸挪
words.origin: 法语 manœuvre（手上的活、操作）← 中世纪拉丁语 manuopera：manu（用手）＋opera（活儿）
words.native_definition: a careful or clever movement, or to move something with skill
words.core_concept: shifting a thing by handwork, inch by inch – 靠手上功夫把东西一寸寸挪到位
words.core_image: 车位只比车长半尺，他打了七八把方向才把车塞进去
examples: He maneuvered the car into the space.
The army began a night maneuver.
semantic_expansions: 机动：部队按计划挪动位置的那种行动
巧妙移动：在窄处一点点把东西挪进去
花招：把局面一点点挪到对自己有利，多含贬义

words.origin: 拉丁语 permanens（一直留着的）← permanere：per（贯穿到底）＋manere（停留、不走）
words.native_definition: lasting for a very long time, or meant never to change
words.core_concept: staying on all the way through – 从头到尾一直留在原处
words.core_image: 墙上那块牌子二十年没换过，钉子早锈进砖里
examples: She found a permanent job.
The damage to the wall is permanent.
semantic_expansions: 永久的：一直留着，不打算取消
长期的：很长一段时间里都不变，如长期职位
固定的：位置或身份定死了，不再挪动
words.decomposable_note: 拉丁借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.root_logic: act（驱动、做，← agere）+ -ive + -ate → 把停着的东西推成动着的
words.origin: active（← 拉丁语 activus 能动的 ← actus ← agere 驱动、做）＋-ate
words.native_definition: to make something start working or take effect
words.core_concept: pushing a thing from still into motion – 把停着的东西推成动着的
words.core_image: 按下开关，原本安静的机器灯亮起来，风扇跟着转了
examples: Press this button to activate the alarm.
Heat activates the chemical in the tube.
semantic_expansions: 激活：让原本闲着的东西开始起作用
启动：从关着的状态转到开始运转
使活跃：让人或反应变得活跃起来

words.root_logic: ag（驱动、办事，← agere）+ -ent（正在办的）+ -cy → 替你去动手办事的那一方
words.origin: 中世纪拉丁语 agentia（办事、代办）← agens（正在做的人）← agere（驱动、做）
words.native_definition: a business that acts for other people, or the power to act
words.core_concept: the party that does the acting for you – 替你去动手办事的那一方
words.core_image: 你不出门，柜台后的人替你把票订好、把手续跑完
examples: She booked the trip through an agency.
He acted through the agency of a friend.
semantic_expansions: 代理机构：受你委托去办事的公司或部门
中介：在两方之间跑腿、促成事情的那一方
作用力：促使事情发生的那股推动

words.root_logic: ambi-（两边）+ ig（驱动，← agere）→ ambigere：往两边都赶 → 两头都说得通
words.origin: 拉丁语 ambiguus（两义的）← ambigere：ambi（两边）＋agere（驱动、赶）
words.native_definition: having more than one possible meaning, so it is not clear
words.core_concept: driving both ways at once, so neither is settled – 同时朝两边赶，哪边都没定下
words.core_image: 路口那块牌子两头都写着字，站在下面的人不知该往哪边走
examples: His answer was deliberately ambiguous.
The wording is ambiguous here.
semantic_expansions: 含糊的：话没说定，听的人抓不住
有歧义的：一句话能读出两个意思
模棱两可的：故意两边都留口子，谁也不得罪

words.root_logic: don（给，← dare）+ -ate → 把东西白交出去，不要回报
words.origin: 拉丁语 donare（赠送）← donum（礼物）← dare（给）
words.native_definition: to give money or goods to a person or organization that needs them
words.core_concept: putting a thing into other hands and asking nothing back – 把东西交出去，不要回报
words.core_image: 他把一箱衣服搬到收集点，签个名就走，收条也不要
examples: She donated a thousand pounds to the school.
Many people donate blood here.
semantic_expansions: 捐赠：把财物无偿交给需要的一方
捐款：交出去的是钱
献：血、器官、力气这类也这么交出去

words.root_logic: per-（彻底）+ don（给，← dare）→ perdonare：把该追的整个送掉 → 不再向你追讨
words.origin: 古法语 pardoner（宽恕）← 中世纪拉丁语 perdonare：per（彻底）＋donare（给）← dare（给）
words.native_definition: to forgive someone, or an official decision to free them from punishment
words.core_concept: giving the debt away instead of collecting it – 把该追的那笔整个送掉
words.core_image: 判决书还摊在桌上，长官提笔在末尾签了一行，人当天走出大门
examples: Pardon me for interrupting you.
The governor pardoned two prisoners.
semantic_expansions: 原谅：不再追究对方的过失
赦免：官方正式免掉刑罚
请再说一遍：口语里说 pardon，是请对方把话再给你一次

words.root_logic: up（往前）+ date（日期，← 拉丁语 data「给出于某日」← dare 给）→ 把日子挪到今天
words.origin: up（往上、往前）＋date（日期）；date ← 古法语 date ← 晚期拉丁语 data（文书末尾「给出于某日某地」的那个词）← dare（给）
