words.native_definition: to add the newest information to something, or the newest information itself
words.core_concept: bringing a thing forward to today's date – 把东西的日子挪到今天
words.core_image: 表格右上角原先印着去年的日子，他划掉，改写成今天
examples: Please update your address here.
Here is an update on the storm.
semantic_expansions: 更新：把旧内容换成当下的
最新消息：换上来的那批新内容本身

words.root_logic: com-（一起）+ mit（送、交，← mittere）+ -ee → 事情被送到手上的那几个人
words.origin: commit（← 拉丁语 committere：com（一起）＋mittere（送、交付））＋-ee，本指受托的人
words.native_definition: a small group of people chosen to deal with a particular matter
words.core_concept: the few into whose hands a matter is sent – 事情被送到他们手上的那一小群人
words.core_image: 长桌两侧坐着七个人，一份卷宗推到中间，散会前得给出说法
examples: The committee meets every Tuesday.
A committee was set up to review the case.

words.root_logic: com-（一起）+ pro-（预先）+ mis（送出，← mittere）→ 双方各把话送出去 → 各让一步
words.origin: 古法语 compromis ← 拉丁语 compromissum（双方共同许下、交付仲裁）← compromittere：com（一起）＋promittere（送出承诺）← mittere（送）
words.native_definition: an agreement in which each side gives up part of what it wanted
words.core_concept: each side sending out part of its own claim – 双方各把自己那一部分让出去
words.core_image: 两人各把要价写在纸上推到中间，最后签的数字谁都不满意
examples: They reached a compromise after long talks.
Poor sleep compromises your health.
semantic_expansions: 妥协：各放弃一部分要求，换来能成的结果
折中：在两个方案中间取一个
危及：连该守的那份也让了出去，安全或原则因此受损

words.root_logic: pro-（预先）+ mis（送出，← mittere）→ 提前把话送出去，收不回来
words.origin: 拉丁语 promissum（许下的话）← promittere：pro（预先）＋mittere（送出）
words.native_definition: to say firmly that you will do something, or the words you say
words.core_concept: words sent out ahead, past taking back – 提前送出去、收不回来的话
words.core_image: 他说完伸出手，两只手一握，这句话就再收不回来了
examples: He promised to call me tonight.
She shows real promise as a singer.
semantic_expansions: 承诺：预先把我会做这句话送出去
答应：对别人的请求点头，把话给出去
前景：一个人身上先露出来的那份可期待

words.root_logic: a-/ad-（朝向）+ spire（呼吸，← spirare）→ 朝那个方向使劲喘气 → 心一直往高处
words.origin: 拉丁语 aspirare（向…吹气、渴求）：ad（朝向）＋spirare（呼吸）
words.native_definition: to want very much to achieve something important
words.core_concept: breathing hard towards a thing far above – 朝着高处那样东西使劲喘气
words.core_image: 他仰头看着那座山顶，胸口一起一伏，脚已经在往上迈
examples: She aspires to become a judge.
Many aspire to own a house.
semantic_expansions: 渴望：心里一直朝着那样东西
追求：不只是想，还一直往那边使劲
立志：把这口气定成长远的目标

words.root_logic: spir（呼吸，← spirare）+ -itus → spiritus：一口气 → 人活着靠这口气，气也是人的劲头
words.origin: 古法语 espirit ← 拉丁语 spiritus（呼吸、气、灵）← spirare（呼吸）
words.native_definition: the part of a person that is not the body, or the mood and energy someone shows
words.core_concept: the breath that keeps a body alive – 让身子活着的那口气
words.core_image: 老人躺着不动了，医生说最后那口气刚才走的
examples: The team played with great spirit.
He was in low spirits all week.
semantic_expansions: 精神：人身上那股看不见的劲头
灵魂：离开身体后仍被认为存在的那一部分
情绪：这口气的高低，如兴致低落
烈酒：蒸出来的那一口，旧时被看作酒的气

words.root_logic: spirit（气、灵，← spirare 呼吸）+ -al → 归于那口气，不归于肉身的
words.origin: 古法语 spirituel ← 拉丁语 spiritualis（属于气与灵的）← spiritus ← spirare（呼吸）
words.native_definition: relating to the human soul rather than to the body or material things
words.core_concept: belonging to the breath, not to the flesh – 归于那口气，不归于肉身
words.core_image: 屋里没有一件值钱东西，那人却说这些年过得比谁都饱
examples: She turned to spiritual matters late in life.
The song has a spiritual quality.
semantic_expansions: 精神的：与内在那一面有关，不涉物质
心灵的：关乎内心的感受与需要
宗教的：与信仰、教会那一套有关

words.root_logic: contra-（对着）+ dict（说，← dicere）+ -ion → 对着人家的话反着说 → 两句话对撞
words.origin: 拉丁语 contradictio（反驳）← contradicere：contra（对着）＋dicere（说）
words.native_definition: a statement or fact that goes against another one
words.core_concept: one saying set against another – 一句话正对着另一句说
words.core_image: 同一份报告里，前一页写着涨了，后一页写着跌了
examples: There is a contradiction in his story.
Her actions are a contradiction of her words.
semantic_expansions: 矛盾：两句话或两件事对撞，不能同时成立
反驳：当面把对着的那句话说出来
相互抵触：几项规定彼此顶着，照哪条都违另一条

words.root_logic: dict（说，← dicere）+ -ion（说出来的词）+ -ary（存放处）→ 一条条说法收在一处
words.origin: 中世纪拉丁语 dictionarium（词语集）← 拉丁语 dictio（说出来的话、措辞）← dicere（说）
words.native_definition: a book that lists words in order and explains what they mean
words.core_concept: a store of how each word is said and used – 把每个词怎么说都收在一处
words.core_image: 厚厚一本按字母排下来，每个词后头跟着一小段怎么说、怎么用
examples: Look the word up in a dictionary.
She keeps a dictionary on her desk.
semantic_expansions: 词典：收词并解释词义和用法的书
字典：以单字为条目的那一种

words.root_logic: grad（一步、一级，← gradus）+ -ate → 把台阶一级级走到最后那一级
words.origin: 中世纪拉丁语 graduatus（已授学位的）← graduari（升级、授级）← 拉丁语 gradus（一步、等级）
words.native_definition: to finish a course of study at a school or university, or a person who has done so
words.core_concept: having climbed the last of the steps – 把台阶一级级走到了最后一级
words.core_image: 最上一级台阶上站着穿黑袍的人，回头看走过的那一级一级
examples: She graduated from Oxford last year.
Every graduate gets a printed certificate.
semantic_expansions: 毕业：把规定的级数走完，课程算结束
毕业生：走完这些台阶的那个人
分等级：把刻度或程度一级一级标出来

words.root_logic: under-（在…之下）+ grad（一级，← gradus）→ 还停在最后那一级之下的人
words.origin: under-（在…之下）＋graduate（← 中世纪拉丁语 graduatus 已授学位的 ← 拉丁语 gradus 一步、等级）
words.native_definition: a student at a university who has not yet taken a first degree
words.core_concept: still below the last step – 还停在最后那一级之下
words.core_image: 楼梯还剩几级没上，他抱着书从穿黑袍的人身边挤过去
examples: He is an undergraduate at Leeds.
Undergraduates share the same library.
semantic_expansions: 本科生：还没拿到第一个学位的在校生
大学在读生：书还没念完，仍停在台阶中段

words.root_logic: nat（出生，← nasci）+ -io（一同生出来的一群）+ -ality → 你生在哪一群人里，就算哪一国的人
words.origin: 法语 nationalité ← 拉丁语 natio（同一出生的一群人、族）← natus（生出的）← nasci（出生）
words.native_definition: the status of belonging to a particular country
words.core_concept: which people you were born among – 你生在哪一群人当中
words.core_image: 边检翻开证件，看的是他生在哪里、算哪一国的人
examples: She has dual nationality and two passports.
People of many nationalities work here.
semantic_expansions: 国籍：法律上算你属于哪个国家
民族：同源同俗的一群人，如少数民族

words.root_logic: nat（出生，← nasci）+ -ura（生成的样子）+ -al → 生来就那样，不是后来做上去的
words.origin: 古法语 naturel ← 拉丁语 naturalis（天生的）← natura（生就的样子）← nasci（出生）
words.native_definition: existing or happening without being made or changed by people
words.core_concept: the way a thing comes out when born, not made – 生下来就是那样，不是后来做出来的
words.core_image: 山坡上的林子没人栽过，树间距歪歪扭扭，落叶自己烂成土
examples: The park is a natural woodland.
It is natural to feel nervous.
semantic_expansions: 自然的：不经人手，本来就有的
天然的：材料原样，没加工也没添东西
正常的：合乎本性、不值得奇怪，如紧张

words.root_logic: em-/in-（进去）+ ploy（折，← plicare）→ implicare：把人折进事里 → 被用上、有活干
words.origin: 古法语 emploier（使用、雇用）← 拉丁语 implicare（缠进、卷入）：in（进）＋plicare（折）
words.native_definition: the state of having paid work, or the act of giving people work
words.core_concept: being folded into someone's work – 被折进一摊活里，成了其中一层
words.core_image: 早上七点，一群人拿着卡在厂门口排队打卡
examples: Employment rose slowly last year.
She is looking for full-time employment.
semantic_expansions: 就业：有活干、被折进生产里的那种状态
雇用：把人折进自己的事里，付钱让他做
工作：具体那一份被雇来做的活

words.root_logic: un-（不）+ em-（进去）+ ploy（折，← plicare）→ 没被折进任何一摊活里
words.origin: un-（不）＋employment（← 古法语 emploier ← 拉丁语 implicare：in（进）＋plicare（折））
words.native_definition: the state of having no paid work, or the number of people in that state
words.core_concept: not folded into any work at all – 没被折进任何一摊活里
words.core_image: 上午十点，一排人坐在职介所的长椅上，手里捏着号码纸
examples: Unemployment fell to five percent.
He faced six months of unemployment.
semantic_expansions: 失业：想干活却没被任何一摊活收进去
失业率：这样的人在劳动人口里占的比例

words.root_logic: soci（同伴、结伴，← socius）+ -al + -ism → 要紧的东西与同伴共同占有的那一套主张
words.origin: 法语 socialisme ← social（← 拉丁语 socialis 结伴的 ← socius 同伴）＋-isme
words.native_definition: a political system in which the community owns the main means of production
words.core_concept: holding the main things in common with your fellows – 要紧的东西与同伴共同占有
words.core_image: 厂门口的牌子写着这厂不归一个人，做工的人共同占份
examples: He wrote a long book about socialism.
The party moved away from socialism.

words.root_logic: soci（结伴、人相联，← socius）+ -logia（…之学）→ 研究人怎么结成群的学问
words.origin: 法语 sociologie ← 拉丁语 socius（同伴）＋希腊语 -logia（…之学）
words.native_definition: the study of how human societies are organized and how people behave in groups
words.core_concept: the study of how people join into groups – 研究人怎样彼此相联成群的学问
words.core_image: 研究者拿着问卷进村，记下谁跟谁走得近、谁说话管用
examples: She teaches sociology at a small college.
His sociology paper won a prize.

words.root_logic: dis-（去掉）+ charge（装车，← carrus 货车）→ 把装上车的卸回地上
words.origin: 古法语 deschargier（卸下）← 晚期拉丁语 discarricare：dis（去掉）＋carricare（装车）← 拉丁语 carrus（四轮货车）
words.native_definition: to let someone leave, to send something out, or to carry out a duty
words.core_concept: taking the load back off the cart – 把装上车的东西卸回地上
words.core_image: 车斗后板一放，一车砖哗啦倒空，车身轻了就走
examples: The factory discharges waste into the river.
He was discharged from hospital on Friday.
semantic_expansions: 排出：把积在里面的东西放出去
解雇：把某人从岗位这辆车上卸下来
出院：医院把你从名册上卸下，让你走
履行：把肩上那份担子卸掉，等于办完

words.root_logic: ac-/ad-（朝向）+ claim（喊，← clamare）→ 冲着他喊出来 → 众人喊出来的那份好
words.origin: 拉丁语 acclamare（向…欢呼）：ad（朝向）＋clamare（喊、大声宣告）
words.native_definition: strong public praise, or to praise someone publicly
words.core_concept: shouting out towards someone in praise – 冲着某个人喊出好来
words.core_image: 幕布落下，台下站起来一片人，冲着台上又喊又拍
examples: The film won critical acclaim.
Crowds acclaimed the young champion.
semantic_expansions: 称赞：公开说他好，多见于评论界
喝彩：当场喊出来的那种叫好
欢呼：一群人同时喊，声势连成一片

words.root_logic: dom（屋、家，← domus）→ 意大利语 duomo：神的屋子、大教堂 → 教堂顶上那个半圆的盖
words.origin: 中古法语 dome ← 意大利语 duomo（大教堂，即神的屋子）← 拉丁语 domus（房屋）
words.native_definition: a rounded roof shaped like half a ball
words.core_concept: the rounded roof over a god's house – 神的屋子上那个半圆的顶
words.core_image: 抬头看，屋顶不平也不尖，是扣过来的半个球，正中开着天窗
examples: The cathedral has a huge dome.
Snow settled on the glass dome.
semantic_expansions: 圆顶：像半个球那样扣在建筑上的顶
穹顶：从屋里抬头看到的那面拱形天花

words.root_logic: fil（线，← filum）→ 法语 filer：把文书一张张串到线上 → 串在一处的那一叠，也指串成的一列
words.origin: 古法语 filer（把文书串到线上保存）← fil（线）← 拉丁语 filum（线）；与表「锉刀」的 file 不同源
words.native_definition: a set of papers or computer records kept together, or to put them in order
words.core_concept: papers strung on one thread and kept in order – 一叠纸串在同一根线上，按次序留着
words.core_image: 一根细绳穿过一叠单据的角，挂在钉子上，要查就顺着绳翻
examples: Save the file before you close it.
They walked in single file.
semantic_expansions: 文件：串在一处的那一份材料，电脑里也这么叫
档案：长期存着、按次序排好的那一叠
纵列：像串在一根线上那样一个跟一个排成的队
归档：把新的一张按位置串进去

words.root_logic: humus（泥土、地面）→ humilis（贴着地面的）+ -ate → 把人按到地面那么低 → 使屈辱
words.origin: 晚期拉丁语 humiliare（使低下）← humilis（低的，字面「贴着地面的」）← humus（泥土、地面）
words.native_definition: to make someone feel ashamed and foolish in front of other people
words.core_concept: pressing someone down to the ground – 把人按到贴着地面那么低
words.core_image: 他被叫到台前，当着满屋子人被数落了十分钟，头越垂越低
examples: He humiliated her in front of everyone.
She felt humiliated by the remark.
semantic_expansions: 羞辱：当众把人踩低
使丢脸：让他在人前抬不起头
使难堪：话说得让人只想找个地方躲

words.root_logic: loco（从某个地点，← locus 地点）+ motivus（能动的）→ 自己能从一处挪到另一处的那台机器
words.origin: 法语 locomotif ← 中世纪拉丁语 locomotivus：loco（从某地，locus 的夺格）＋motivus（能动的）
words.native_definition: a railway engine that pulls a line of carriages
words.core_concept: the engine that shifts itself from place to place – 能自己从一个地点挪到另一个地点的机器
words.core_image: 前头那台黑铁家伙喷着白汽，后面一串车厢被它拽着走
examples: The locomotive pulled twelve carriages.
An old steam locomotive stood in the shed.
semantic_expansions: 机车：铁路上出力牵引的那台动力车
火车头：挂在最前面拖动整列车的那一节

words.root_logic: e-/ex-（出）+ norm（角尺，← norma）+ -ous → 大出了那把尺能比的范围
words.origin: 拉丁语 enormis（超出常规的、极大的）：ex（出）＋norma（木匠的角尺）
words.native_definition: very much bigger than usual
words.core_concept: past what the measuring square can take – 超出了那把尺能比的范围
words.core_image: 尺子拿过去比了一下，东西一头还在尺外，只好扔下尺子改用脚步量
examples: They live in an enormous house.
The task took an enormous amount of time.
semantic_expansions: 巨大的：大到常用的尺度已经量不下
庞大的：体量或规模大得笨重，如机构臃肿

words.root_logic: com-（一起）+ pat（承受，← pati）+ -ible → 凑在一处彼此承受得住
words.origin: 中世纪拉丁语 compatibilis（能共处的）← compati：com（一起）＋pati（承受、忍耐）
words.native_definition: able to exist or be used together without problems
words.core_concept: able to bear each other side by side – 凑在一处彼此承受得住
words.core_image: 新插头往旧插座里一推就到底，机器照常亮灯
examples: This printer is compatible with both systems.
Their views are not compatible.
semantic_expansions: 兼容的：两套东西配在一起能正常用
相容的：两种说法或做法并存而不冲突
合得来的：两个人凑在一处也相处得下去

words.root_logic: pract（做、实行，← prassein）+ -ice → 把想法一遍遍真做出来，做出来的那一套也叫它
words.origin: 古法语 practiser ← 中世纪拉丁语 practicare（实行）← practicus ← 希腊语 praktikos（适于行动的）← prassein（做）
words.native_definition: doing something repeatedly to get better at it, or the usual way of doing things
words.core_concept: turning an idea into something actually done, again and again – 把想法一遍遍真做出来
words.core_image: 同一段谱他弹了两百遍，手指自己会走，谱子早就合上了
examples: She needs more practice at the piano.
It is common practice here.
semantic_expansions: 练习：为练熟而反复做同一件事
实践：把道理真做出来，与空谈相对
惯例：一直这么做下来，成了固定做法
业务：医生律师这类靠实做维持的行当

words.root_logic: ac-/ad-（朝向）+ quir（寻找，← quaerere）→ 朝一样东西找过去，找着了就归自己
words.origin: 古法语 aquerre ← 拉丁语 acquirere（取得）：ad（朝向）＋quaerere（寻找、求取）
words.native_definition: to get or come to have something, often after effort
words.core_concept: seeking a thing until it is yours – 一直找下去，直到那样东西归你
words.core_image: 他找了三年才把缺的那张邮票买到，放进册子最后一格
examples: The company acquired two small rivals.
Children acquire language very fast.
semantic_expansions: 获得：找着并归到自己手上
取得：经过努力拿到，如取得资格
学到：知识和习惯也这么一点点找来、留下

words.root_logic: space（撑开的距离，← spatium）+ craft（船、器）→ 开进天外那段空处去的船
words.origin: space（← 古法语 espace ← 拉丁语 spatium 跨开的距离）＋craft（船、飞行器，本义技艺，古英语 cræft）
words.native_definition: a vehicle built to travel beyond the earth's atmosphere
words.core_concept: a vessel for the open distance beyond the sky – 开进天外那段空处的船
words.core_image: 白色的舱体在没有空气的黑里滑行，窗外一颗星也不动
examples: The spacecraft reached Mars in seven months.
Engineers tested the spacecraft in a vacuum.
semantic_expansions: 航天器：能在大气层外飞行的器具
宇宙飞船：载人往来天外的那一种

words.root_logic: terr（吓住，← terrere）+ -fic（造成）→ 原意吓死人的 → 语气翻转，成了大得惊人、好得惊人
words.origin: 拉丁语 terrificus（引起惊惧的）← terrere（吓住）＋-ficus（造成…的）
words.native_definition: extremely good, or extremely great in degree
words.core_concept: so great that it once meant frightening – 大到当初是用来说吓人的
words.core_image: 散场后他一路说个不停，反复讲刚才那一段有多不得了
examples: We had a terrific time at the beach.
The car went at a terrific speed.
semantic_expansions: 极好的：好得让人吃惊，口语常用
了不起的：本事或表现远超一般
极大的：程度大得惊人，如速度惊人

words.origin: 古英语 trēg / trīg（浅边木盘）← 原始日耳曼语 *traujam（木制器皿），与 tree（树、木）同出一支
words.native_definition: a flat piece of wood, metal or plastic with a low rim, used for carrying things
words.core_concept: a flat board with a low rim for carrying – 一块平板，四边略翘，用来端东西
words.core_image: 一块平板四边翘起一指高，杯子和碗摆上去，端过走廊也不滑
examples: She carried the tray of cups upstairs.
Put the empty plates on the tray.
semantic_expansions: 托盘：端着走的那块平板
盘子：浅而平的一件器皿，同形的部件也这么叫
words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本身即词根，无拉丁词缀可拆

words.root_logic: con-（彻底）+ vict（战胜，← vincere）→ convincere：在庭上把对方的说法整个压过去 → 罪名就定下来
words.origin: 拉丁语 convictus（被证实有罪的）← convincere：com（彻底）＋vincere（战胜、压服）
words.native_definition: to decide officially in court that someone is guilty, or a person serving a sentence
words.core_concept: the other side's case fully overcome in court – 在庭上把对方的说法整个压过去
words.core_image: 法槌落下，被告的辩解一条条被驳倒，当天就换上囚服
examples: The jury convicted him of theft.
Two convicts escaped from the prison.
semantic_expansions: 定罪：法庭认定罪名成立
判定有罪：正式判下这个人有罪
囚犯：被这样判定、正在服刑的那个人

words.root_logic: at-/ad-（朝向）+ tent（伸，← tendere）+ -ion → 把心力朝一处伸过去
words.origin: 拉丁语 attentio（专心）← attendere：ad（朝向）＋tendere（伸展）
words.native_definition: the act of directing your mind or eyes towards something
words.core_concept: the mind stretched out towards one thing – 把心力朝一处伸过去
words.core_image: 教室里所有人的头齐齐转向门口那个人，笔都停在纸上
examples: May I have your attention for a moment.
The child craves his mother's attention.
semantic_expansions: 注意：把心朝某处伸过去，别处就顾不上
注意力：能这么伸出去的那份心力，有多有少
关注：长期把这份心力搭在某件事上

words.root_logic: ex-（往外）+ tens（伸，← tendere）+ -ion → 往外伸出去的那一截
words.origin: 拉丁语 extensio（伸展）← extendere：ex（往外）＋tendere（伸展）
words.native_definition: an added part that makes something longer or larger, or extra time granted
words.core_concept: the piece stretched out beyond the original – 从原来那截往外伸出去的部分
words.core_image: 桌子中间加进一块板，两头各多出一截，原先坐六人现在坐十人
examples: They built an extension at the back of the house.
He asked for an extension on the deadline.
semantic_expansions: 延伸部分：接在原物后面多出来的那一段
扩建：房子往外接出一块，占地变大
延期：时间也这么往外拉长一截
电话分机：总机往外接出去的那一条线

words.root_logic: ex-（往外）+ tent（伸，← tendere）→ 一样东西往外伸到哪里为止
words.origin: 盎格鲁法语 extente（丈量、估值）← 古法语 estendre ← 拉丁语 extendere：ex（往外）＋tendere（伸展）
words.native_definition: how far something reaches, or how large or serious it is
words.core_concept: how far a thing stretches before it stops – 一样东西往外伸到哪里为止
words.core_image: 火烧过的地界用绳子围起来，人拿尺子量出从这头到那头有多远
examples: The extent of the damage is still unclear.
To some extent I agree with you.
semantic_expansions: 程度：一件事到了多深多重的那个刻度
范围：从这头伸到那头所圈住的那一片
广度：伸得开不开，摊得大不大

words.root_logic: in-（朝一点）+ tens（绷，← tendere）→ 力气全绷向一处，不散开
words.origin: 拉丁语 intensus（绷紧的）← intendere：in（朝向）＋tendere（伸展、绷紧）
words.native_definition: very strong or extreme in degree, or very serious and concentrated
words.core_concept: all the force pulled tight onto one point – 力气全绷向一点上
words.core_image: 阳光被放大镜收到一个小点上，纸面立刻冒起一缕烟
examples: She felt an intense pain in her side.
He gave the map an intense stare.
semantic_expansions: 强烈的：程度高到压过别的感觉
剧烈的：来势又猛又急，如疼得受不住
专注的：整个人绷向一件事，别的都不进眼

words.root_logic: in-（朝向）+ tent（伸，← tendere）+ -ion → 心思先朝那个方向伸出去
words.origin: 拉丁语 intentio（用心、意向）← intendere：in（朝向）＋tendere（伸展）
words.native_definition: what you plan or mean to do
words.core_concept: the mind reaching toward a thing before the body moves – 身子没动，心思先朝那边伸过去
words.core_image: 他还没起身，眼睛已经盯住桌上那只杯子不放
examples: I have no intention of leaving early.
Her intentions were good from the start.
semantic_expansions: 意图：心里朝着的那个方向，还没做出来
打算：准备去做的那件事本身
用意：说这话做这事背后要达到的那点目的

words.root_logic: tens（绷紧，← tendere 伸展）→ 拉到不能再拉，一碰就弹
words.origin: 拉丁语 tensus（绷紧的，tendere 的过去分词）← tendere（伸展、拉紧）；表「时态」的 tense 另出拉丁语 tempus（时间），同形异源
words.native_definition: stretched tight, or nervous and unable to relax
words.core_concept: pulled tight, one touch away from snapping back – 拉到不能再拉，一碰就弹
words.core_image: 他坐在椅子边上，肩膀提着，手指扣住膝盖不松
examples: The rope was tense and hummed in the wind.
Everyone went tense when the phone rang.
semantic_expansions: 紧张的：人像被拉紧的绳，松不下来
绷紧的：说实物被拉得直挺挺，没有一丝松量

words.root_logic: tens（拉紧，← tendere）+ -ion → 两头对拉时中间那股劲
words.origin: 拉丁语 tensio（拉紧）← tendere（伸展、拉紧）
words.native_definition: the state of being stretched tight, or strained feeling between people
words.core_concept: the pull that builds when two ends draw apart – 两头往反方向拉时中间那股劲
words.core_image: 两人各拽住绳子一头往后退，绳子中段绷成一条直线，谁也不敢先松手
examples: Tension in the cable was measured hourly.
Tension between the two families grew.
semantic_expansions: 张力：物体被两头拉时内部那股力
紧张关系：人和人之间也这么互相拽着，随时会断
绷紧度：绳子或琴弦拉到多紧的那个量

words.root_logic: tent（撑开，← tendere 伸展）→ tenta：把布撑开绷住 → 撑开来住人的那件布屋
words.origin: 拉丁语 tenta（撑开的东西）← tendere（伸展、撑开）
words.native_definition: a shelter made of cloth stretched over poles
words.core_concept: cloth stretched over poles to live under – 把布撑开绷住，底下就能住人
words.core_image: 几根杆子支起来，布被拉开绷住，四角钉进土里就能睡人
examples: They pitched a tent by the river.
Rain drummed on the roof of the tent.

words.origin: 古法语 tendre ← 拉丁语 tener（软的、幼嫩的、年少的）；英语拼写里那个 -d- 是后来插进去的，与 tendere（伸展）不同词
words.native_definition: soft and easy to cut or chew, or gentle and full of care
words.core_concept: soft enough to yield at the lightest press – 软到轻轻一压就让开
words.core_image: 刀一压就断，肉在盘里散开，纤维不用嚼就化了
examples: The meat was tender and fell apart.
She gave him a tender look.
semantic_expansions: 嫩的：质地软，容易切开咬开
温柔的：待人的手法也这么轻，不硬来
一碰就疼的：皮肉发软发弱，一按就受不了
words.decomposable_note: 拉丁借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.root_logic: a-/ad-（朝向）+ vis（看，← videre）→ 把自己看到的摆到你眼前
words.origin: 古法语 aviser（细看、斟酌）← avis（看法）← 拉丁语 ad visum（照所见的）← videre（看）
words.native_definition: to tell someone what you think they should do
words.core_concept: setting what you have seen before another's eyes – 把自己看见的摆到别人眼前
words.core_image: 他把地图铺在桌上，手指点着其中一条路说走这边
examples: The doctor advised him to rest.
Please advise us of any change of address.
semantic_expansions: 建议：把你看到的路指给对方，让他自己走
劝告：对方要走错了，你出声拦一下
通知：正式把情况摆到对方眼前，让他知道

words.root_logic: pro-（预先）+ vid（看，← videre）→ 事先看出会缺什么，先备好摆出来
words.origin: 拉丁语 providere（预先看到、准备）：pro（预先）＋videre（看）
words.native_definition: to give someone what they need, or to state something as a condition
words.core_concept: seeing ahead what will be wanted and putting it there – 先看出要缺什么，把它备在那里
words.core_image: 出发前他按人头把水和饼装进包，半路上果然一人拿到一份
examples: The school provides free meals.
The contract provides that either side may quit.
semantic_expansions: 提供：把对方需要的东西拿出来交到手上
供给：持续不断地送来所需的东西
规定：文书里预先看到的情形，写成一条摆在那儿

words.root_logic: pro-（预先）+ vis（看，← videre）+ -ion → 预先看出来、事先备下的那些东西
words.origin: 拉丁语 provisio（预见、预备）← providere：pro（预先）＋videre（看）
words.native_definition: the act of supplying something, the supplies themselves, or a clause in an agreement
words.core_concept: what was seen ahead and laid in beforehand – 预先看出来、事先备下的那一份
words.core_image: 船舱里码着够吃三个月的箱子，旁边一纸文书写明谁能动它
examples: The provision of clean water is urgent.
One clause is a provision against late delivery.
semantic_expansions: 供应：把需要的东西预先备好送到
储备物资：备下的那批粮食器具本身
条款：文书里预先想到的情形，一条条写下来管着后事

words.root_logic: prud（← providens 预见的，缩合而来）+ -ent → 事情还没到就先看见，因而不冒进
words.origin: 拉丁语 prudens（明智的、慎重的），是 providens（预见的）的缩合形 ← providere：pro（预先）＋videre（看）
words.native_definition: careful and sensible, avoiding needless risk
words.core_concept: seeing the thing coming before it arrives – 事情还没到就先看见
words.core_image: 过河前他用棍子往前探了三下，才敢把脚落下去
examples: It would be prudent to keep a copy.
She is a prudent manager of money.
semantic_expansions: 谨慎的：先看清再动，不给自己留险
精明的：把利害都先看到了，因而不吃亏

words.root_logic: re-（再一次）+ vis（看，← videre）→ 回头再看一遍，看出该改的地方
words.origin: 拉丁语 revisere（再看、重访）← re（再）＋visere（细看）← videre（看）
words.native_definition: to look at something again in order to change or improve it, or to study again
words.core_concept: looking at a thing a second time and changing what shows – 回头再看一遍，看出要动的地方
words.core_image: 稿子放了一夜，第二天再看一遍，划掉三句，另添两句
examples: He revised the report before sending it.
She revises for the exam every evening.
semantic_expansions: 修改：再看一遍，把不合的地方改掉
修订：正式出一个改过的版本，如修订条文
复习：学过的东西回头再看一遍，让它留住

words.root_logic: super-（在上方）+ vis（看，← videre）→ 站在上头看着底下做
words.origin: 中世纪拉丁语 supervidere（在上察看）：super（在上）＋videre（看）
words.native_definition: to watch over people or work to make sure it is done properly
words.core_concept: watching from above while the work goes on – 站在上头看着底下做
words.core_image: 他站在二层走廊往下望，车间里谁一停手他都看得见
examples: A teacher supervises the children at lunch.
She supervises three research students.
semantic_expansions: 监督：在旁看着，出错就叫停
主管：整摊事在你眼下，由你看着办

words.root_logic: mot（推动，← movere）+ -ive（能动的）+ -ate → 在人心里装上一股推力
words.origin: motive（← 中世纪拉丁语 motivus 能推动的 ← 拉丁语 movere 移动）＋-ate
words.native_definition: to make someone want to do something
words.core_concept: fitting an inner push into someone – 在人心里装上一股推力
words.core_image: 教练在他耳边说了一句，那人转身就冲上跑道
examples: Good pay motivates the staff.
What motivated him to leave?
semantic_expansions: 激励：从外面给一把劲，让人自己动起来
使有动力：心里有了那股推力，不用催也肯做

words.root_logic: pro-（往前）+ mot（推，← movere）→ 从后面往前推一把
words.origin: 拉丁语 promotus（被推向前的）← promovere：pro（往前）＋movere（移动）
words.native_definition: to help something advance, to raise someone to a higher post, or to advertise
words.core_concept: pushing a thing forward from behind – 从后面往前推一把
words.core_image: 一只手在背后往前一送，人和事都往前挪了一格
examples: Exercise promotes good health.
She was promoted to head of sales.
semantic_expansions: 促进：给一把劲，让事情往前走得快些
晋升：把人往上一级推，位置比原先前
推销：把货往人前推，让它走出去

words.root_logic: re-（往回、离开）+ mot（挪，← movere）→ 被挪开到很远的地方
words.origin: 拉丁语 remotus（被挪开的）← removere：re（离开）＋movere（移动）
words.native_definition: far away in space or time, distant in manner, or worked from a distance
words.core_concept: moved right away from where things are – 被挪到离一切都很远的地方
words.core_image: 从山口望下去，那几户人家小得像米粒，公路到半山就断了
examples: They live in a remote mountain village.
Use the remote control to switch it off.
semantic_expansions: 遥远的：距离或年代离得很开
偏僻的：挪出人烟之外，路都难通
冷淡的：待人也像挪开了一段，不肯靠近
遥控的：人在远处，手不碰机器也能让它动

words.root_logic: re-（离开）+ mov（挪，← movere）→ 把东西从原处挪走
words.origin: 古法语 removoir ← 拉丁语 removere：re（离开）＋movere（移动）
words.native_definition: to take something away from where it is, or to dismiss someone from a post
words.core_concept: shifting a thing off the place it sat – 把东西从它待的地方挪开
words.core_image: 工人把堵在门口的箱子一只只搬到院外，门口空出来了
examples: Remove the pan from the heat.
He was removed from office last week.
semantic_expansions: 移开：把东西从原来位置挪到别处
去掉：连东西本身也不留，如去掉污点
免职：把人从那个位置上挪下来

words.root_logic: co-（一同）+ in-（落到上头）+ cid（落下，← cadere）→ 两件事落到同一个点上
words.origin: 中世纪拉丁语 coincidere：com（一同）＋incidere（落到某处上头）← in（上）＋cadere（落下）
words.native_definition: to happen at the same time, or to be the same or agree exactly
words.core_concept: two things falling onto the very same point – 两件东西落到同一个点上
words.core_image: 两张透明纸叠在一起，上面那个圆圈的边线正压住下面那个
examples: Her visit coincided with the storm.
Our views coincide on most points.
semantic_expansions: 同时发生：两件事的时间落在同一处
相符：两方的说法落到一处，对得上
重叠：两块范围落在一起，边界压住边界

words.root_logic: de-（去掉）+ cid（切，← caedere）→ 一刀把纠缠的那头砍断，事情就定了
words.origin: 拉丁语 decidere（字面「砍掉」，引申为裁定）：de（去掉）＋caedere（切、砍）；与 cadere（落下）那支同形而不同源
words.native_definition: to choose one thing after thinking, or to settle a question
words.core_concept: cutting the tangle so one way is left – 一刀砍断纠缠，只留下一条
words.core_image: 两条路摊在眼前，他抬手一挥，另一条从此不再提
examples: She decided to take the job.
The judge decided the case in an hour.
semantic_expansions: 决定：几个选项里砍掉别的，留一个
裁决：由有权的人一刀切开双方的争执
解决：把缠住不动的那一处砍开，事情能往下走

words.root_logic: de-（去掉）+ cis（切，← caedere）+ -ion → 砍断之后留下的那一条
words.origin: 拉丁语 decisio（裁断、了结）← decidere：de（去掉）＋caedere（切、砍）
words.native_definition: a choice or judgement that has been made, or the ability to make one firmly
words.core_concept: the one line left after the rest are cut away – 砍掉其余之后留下的那一条
words.core_image: 会开到最后，主持人在纸上划掉两行，只留一行，起身散会
examples: They reached a decision after long talks.
He acted with speed and decision.
semantic_expansions: 决定：定下来的那个选择本身
判决：法庭切开争执后给出的那个结果
果断：下手砍得快，不在几条之间来回磨

words.root_logic: af-/ad-（朝向）+ fect（做，← facere）+ -ion → 那个人在你心里做出了一道印子
words.origin: 拉丁语 affectio（心里被触动而生的状态）← afficere：ad（朝向）＋facere（做）
words.native_definition: a gentle feeling of liking or love for someone
words.core_concept: the mark another person works into your heart – 那个人在你心里做出的一道印子
words.core_image: 老人每天给那只跛脚的猫留半碗饭，猫一见他就来蹭裤腿
examples: She has a deep affection for her students.
He wrote of his affection in every letter.
semantic_expansions: 喜爱：心里对某人某物长出的那份暖意
情感：被触动后留下的那一类心绪
爱慕：这份心意偏向一个人，还带着仰望

words.root_logic: fashion（样式，← façon ← factio「做出来的样子」← facere 做）+ -able → 眼下大家都照着做的那副样子
words.origin: fashion（← 古法语 façon 样式、做法 ← 拉丁语 factio 做出来的样子 ← facere 做）＋-able
words.native_definition: following the style that is popular at the moment
words.core_concept: cut to the shape everyone is making just now – 眼下人人都照着做的那副样子
words.core_image: 街上一半人穿着同一种剪裁的外套，去年那款没人再拿出来
examples: Short coats are fashionable this winter.
They live in a fashionable part of town.
semantic_expansions: 时髦的：跟着当下的样式走，看着新
流行的：这副样子正被许多人同时照做
上流的：讲究这套样式的那一圈人和地方

words.root_logic: per-（彻底）+ fect（做，← facere）+ -ion → 一路做到底，再没有一处可添可减
words.origin: 拉丁语 perfectio（做成、完满）← perficere：per（彻底）＋facere（做）
words.native_definition: the state of being as good as it can possibly be
words.core_concept: worked all the way through, nothing left to add or take – 做到底了，添一点减一点都不行
words.core_image: 木工磨完最后一道边，指腹从头摸到尾，没有一处硌手
examples: The dish was cooked to perfection.
She strives for perfection in her work.
semantic_expansions: 完美：好到再挑不出可改的地方
完善：把余下的缺口一个个做齐
精通：同一件事做到底，手上再无生涩

words.root_logic: de-（明确地）+ not（做记号，← notare）→ 用一个记号把那样东西指出来
words.origin: 拉丁语 denotare（标明、指出）：de（明确地）＋notare（做记号）← nota（记号）
words.native_definition: to be a sign of something, or to stand for it
words.core_concept: a mark set down to point at one thing – 用一个记号把某样东西点出来
words.core_image: 地图上一个小三角压在等高线中间，旁边写着这里最高
examples: A red light denotes danger.
In maths, x denotes the unknown.
semantic_expansions: 表示：用符号或说法把某样东西摆明
指代：这个记号就替那样东西站在那里
意味着：见到这个记号，就知道背后是什么

words.root_logic: nota（记号）→ 在纸上或心里留一个记号，事后照着它把整件事想回来
words.origin: 拉丁语 nota（记号、字符、标记）
words.native_definition: a short record in writing, a musical sign, or to notice something
words.core_concept: a small mark left so the whole comes back later – 留一个小记号，回头凭它把整件事想回来
words.core_image: 听讲时他在纸角划下几个字，散会后照着那几个字把整段话想起来
examples: I made a note of the address.
Note the change in his voice.
semantic_expansions: 笔记：为记住而随手留下的那些字
便条：写给别人的短短一张，摆在他能看见处
音符：谱面上一个记号，指明该出哪个音
注意到：在心里给某处划上一道，不让它滑过去

words.root_logic: note（记号、记录，← notare）+ book（本子）→ 专供留记号用的那个本子
words.origin: note（← 拉丁语 nota 记号）＋book（本子）
words.native_definition: a book of blank pages for writing things down, or a small portable computer
words.core_concept: the book kept for setting marks down in – 专门用来留下记号的那个本子
words.core_image: 一本用橡皮筋箍着的册子，每页写满字，边角都卷了起来
examples: She wrote the number in her notebook.
He carries a thin notebook to meetings.
semantic_expansions: 笔记本：一页页留字用的空白本子
记事簿：专记事项和日程的那一种
笔记本电脑：外形像那个本子、合起来能带走的电脑

words.root_logic: contro-（对着）+ vers（转，← vertere）+ -ial → 两边各自转过身来对着对方，谁也不让
words.origin: 晚期拉丁语 controversialis ← controversia（争论）← controversus（转过来对着的）：contra（对着）＋vertere（转）
words.native_definition: causing a lot of public disagreement
words.core_concept: each side turned to face the other, neither giving way – 两边转过身对着对方，谁也不退
words.core_image: 一张桌子两边的人同时举手，都要先说，主持人敲了三下压不住
examples: The new tax is highly controversial.
He made a controversial remark on air.
semantic_expansions: 有争议的：一说出来就有人站对面反对
引起争论的：本身像个开关，一碰就把两边引到对立处

words.root_logic: con-（彻底）+ vers（转，← vertere）+ -ion → 整个翻过来，成了另一副样子
words.origin: 拉丁语 conversio（转变）← convertere：com（彻底）＋vertere（转）
words.native_definition: a change from one form, use or belief to another
words.core_concept: turned all the way over into another form – 整个翻过来，换成另一副样子
words.core_image: 旧仓库拆了隔墙装上窗，人再进去已看不出它原先做什么用
examples: The conversion of the barn took a year.
He spoke about his conversion to Islam.
semantic_expansions: 转变：从一种形态整个转成另一种
改建：房屋换个用途，里外重做
换算：把一种单位翻成另一种，量还是那个量
皈依：信从一边转到另一边

words.root_logic: di-/dis-（岔开）+ vers（转，← vertere）+ -ion → 从原来那条路上转开，岔到别处
words.origin: 中世纪拉丁语 diversio（转开）← divertere：dis（岔开）＋vertere（转）
words.native_definition: the act of turning something aside, a different route, or something that entertains
words.core_concept: turned off the line it was running on – 从原本那条线上转开，走到别处去
words.core_image: 路口立起牌子，车流被引进旁边一条小道，主路空着在铺沥青
examples: The fire was a diversion to draw the guards away.
Follow the diversion around the bridge.
semantic_expansions: 转移：把注意力或资源从这边引到那边
临时绕道：主路不通时给车走的那条旁路
消遣：心思从正事上转开一会儿，找点乐子

words.root_logic: re-（再一次）+ pro-（往前）+ duc（引，← ducere）→ 把同一样东西再引出来一遍
words.origin: re-（再）＋produce（← 拉丁语 producere：pro 往前＋ducere 引导）
words.native_definition: to make a copy of something, or to produce young
words.core_concept: drawing the same thing forth one more time – 把同一样东西再引出来一次
words.core_image: 版子往纸上一压再抬起，纸上又是同一幅图，连墨点都落在原处
examples: The picture is hard to reproduce in black and white.
Most fish reproduce by laying eggs.
semantic_expansions: 复制：照原样再引出一份，两份分不出
再现：把当时的情形原样引出来给人看
繁殖：生物把自己这一样再引出一代

words.root_logic: semi-（半）+ con-（一路）+ duct（引，← ducere）+ -or → 只肯半路引电过去的那种材料
words.origin: semi-（半）＋conductor（← 拉丁语 conductor 领路者、传导者 ← conducere：com 一起＋ducere 引导）
words.native_definition: a material that conducts electricity only under certain conditions
words.core_concept: a stuff that leads current only halfway – 只肯半路引电过去的那种料
words.core_image: 一小片灰亮的方块，通了电有时让它过去，有时又挡住，全看条件
examples: Silicon is the most common semiconductor.
The factory makes semiconductor chips.

words.root_logic: col-（一起）+ leg（拣选、择取，← legere）+ -ium → 一批人被挑到一处共事，成了那个团体
words.origin: 拉丁语 collegium（同僚的团体）← collega（共事的同僚）：com（一起）＋leg-（legare 择取、委派的词干），与 legere（拣选）同出一支
words.native_definition: a place of higher education, or an organized body of people with shared duties
words.core_concept: a set of people picked out to sit together – 被挑到一处共事的那一批人
words.core_image: 同一批被挑进来的人住在一个院子里，一起上课、一起吃饭、一起管院里的事
examples: She teaches at a small college in the north.
The college of cardinals met in Rome.
semantic_expansions: 学院：把学生挑进来集中教的那一处
大学：北美常拿它泛指本科阶段的学校
团体：因同一职分被挑到一起的那批人，如枢机团

words.root_logic: leg（读，← legere）+ -enda（该被…的）→ 该拿出来念给众人听的那些篇章
words.origin: 中世纪拉丁语 legenda（该读的东西，legere 的动形词中性复数）← 拉丁语 legere（拾取、挑选、读）；与 lex（法条）那支同出更早词根而各成一路
words.native_definition: an old story handed down, a very famous person, or the key to a map
words.core_concept: the passages read aloud year after year – 一年年被念给众人听的那些篇章
words.core_image: 修院饭厅里每天有人站着念一段旧事，念了几百年，听的人都当真
examples: Every village has its own legend.
He became a legend in his own lifetime.
semantic_expansions: 传说：口口相传、越传越远的旧事
传奇人物：名字被人反复讲起，像故事一样
图例：地图角上那一小块，专供人读符号的意思

words.root_logic: co-（一起）+ oper（劳作，← operari）+ -ate → 几方的力气搭到同一件活上
words.origin: 晚期拉丁语 cooperari（共同劳作）：com（一起）＋operari（劳作）← opus（工作）
words.native_definition: to work together with someone towards the same result
words.core_concept: several hands set to the very same job – 几方的力气搭到同一件活上
words.core_image: 四个人抬一根梁，谁也不敢先松手，脚步得一起迈
examples: The two firms cooperate on research.
He refused to cooperate with the police.
semantic_expansions: 合作：两方各出力气办同一件事
协作：分工不同却对着同一个结果使劲
配合：顺着对方的动作出力，不添乱

words.root_logic: oper（劳作、运转，← operari）+ -ator（做这事的人）→ 让机器或生意转起来的那个人
words.origin: 拉丁语 operator（劳作者）← operari（劳作）← opus（工作）
words.native_definition: a person who runs a machine or a business
words.core_concept: the one who keeps the thing running – 让那台东西或那门生意转起来的人
words.core_image: 控制台前的人手不离手柄，屏幕上的数字全跟着他的动作变
examples: The crane operator waved us back.
A local operator runs the bus route.
semantic_expansions: 操作员：亲手开机器的那个人
接线员：早年在总机前替人接通电话的人
经营者：把一门生意撑着转下去的一方

words.root_logic: post-（在后）+ pon（放，← ponere）→ 把这件事从眼前拿起来，放到后面去
words.origin: 拉丁语 postponere（置于其后）：post（在后）＋ponere（放置）
words.native_definition: to move an event to a later time
words.core_concept: taking a thing out of now and setting it further back – 把它从眼前拿走，放到后头去
words.core_image: 日历上原先圈好的那一格被划掉，圈重新画在下一周
examples: They postponed the match because of rain.
Let us postpone the decision until Friday.
semantic_expansions: 推迟：把原定的时间往后挪
延后：整件事的次序也跟着往后排

words.root_logic: pur-/por-（往前）+ pose（放，承 ponere 的义）→ 把要达成的那件事放到自己前头
words.origin: 古法语 porpos（意图）← porposer（往前放、提出）：por-（往前，← 拉丁语 pro）＋poser（放置）；法语 poser 形出晚期拉丁语 pausare（放下、停下），其义与形都并入了拉丁语 ponere（放置）
words.native_definition: the reason for which something is done or made
words.core_concept: the thing you set out in front of yourself – 放在自己前头、一路朝着走的那件事
words.core_image: 出门前他把要办成的那件事写在手心，路上别的都能放下，这一件不能
examples: What is the purpose of this meeting?
The room serves no useful purpose now.
semantic_expansions: 目的：做一件事所朝着的那个结果
意图：心里放在前头、还没说出的打算
用途：一件东西被放在那儿是要它派什么用

words.root_logic: aequi（相等，← aequus 两边一样平）+ valent（值、有力，← valere）→ 两边称出来的分量一样平
words.origin: 晚期拉丁语 aequivalens（价值相等的）← aequivalere：aequus（平的、相等的）＋valere（值、有力）
words.native_definition: equal in value, amount or meaning, or a thing that is equal to another
words.core_concept: both sides weighing out the same – 两边称出来的分量一样平
words.core_image: 天平一端放着金块，另一端堆着碎银，指针停在正中不偏
examples: Ten miles is roughly equivalent to sixteen kilometres.
There is no exact equivalent in Chinese.
semantic_expansions: 相等的：两样东西的量或值一样
等价物：另一边那件顶得上它的东西
相当于：换算过来正好抵上那么多

words.root_logic: artus（关节、接合处，与 ars 同源）+ -culus（小）→ articulus：一个小关节 → 整体上被分开的一小节
words.origin: 古法语 article ← 拉丁语 articulus（小关节、分节）← artus（关节、接合），与 ars（手上的门道）同出一支
words.native_definition: a piece of writing, a separate clause, a single item, or a grammar word like "the"
words.core_concept: one joint in a thing that is divided into joints – 整体被分成一节节，其中的一节
words.core_image: 一份文件被横线切成一条条，每条自成一段，能单独指着说就是这一条
examples: She wrote an article about city birds.
Article five of the treaty covers this.
semantic_expansions: 文章：报刊上自成一节的那一篇
条款：合约或法规里单独成立的一条
物品：清单上一件件分开数的东西
冠词：名词前那个小小的一节，如 the

words.root_logic: ec-/ex-（出来）+ centr（圆心，← centrum）+ -ic → 圆心跑出了它该在的位置
words.origin: 中世纪拉丁语 eccentricus ← 希腊语 ekkentros：ek（出）＋kentron（圆规的尖脚、圆心）
words.native_definition: behaving in a strange way, or not having the same centre
words.core_concept: the middle point sitting off where it belongs – 中点不在它该在的位置上
words.core_image: 两个圆套在一起，里面那个的中点偏出去一截，一转就一边宽一边窄
examples: Her eccentric neighbour paints at night.
The wheel runs on an eccentric shaft.
semantic_expansions: 古怪的：言行不落在常人那个中点上
离心的：机械里中心特意偏开，转起来产生往外的甩劲

words.root_logic: de-（彻底）+ clar（明亮、清楚，← clarus）+ -ation → 把话摆到亮处，人人都看得清
words.origin: 拉丁语 declaratio（说明、宣告）← declarare：de（彻底）＋clarare（使明亮）← clarus（明亮、清楚）
words.native_definition: an official or formal statement made in public
words.core_concept: words put where the light falls on them – 把话摆到亮处，谁都看得清
words.core_image: 一张纸贴在城门口，字大得站远也认得出，末尾落着印和日期
examples: The declaration was read out at noon.
You must sign a customs declaration.
semantic_expansions: 宣告：正式把一件事当众说明
声明：把自己的立场摆明，不留含糊
申报：向官方把该讲的情况一条条写清

words.root_logic: en-/in-（使…）+ dur（硬，← durus）→ 硬着不软，一直撑在那里
words.origin: 古法语 endurer ← 拉丁语 indurare（使变硬）：in（使）＋durus（硬的）；表「持续」的 durare 同出此源
words.native_definition: to bear something painful for a long time, or to last
words.core_concept: going hard and not giving way – 硬着不软，撑在那里不动
words.core_image: 他背着麻袋走了三十里，肩上压出两道红痕也没把袋子放下
examples: She endured years of pain without complaint.
Their friendship endured for fifty years.
semantic_expansions: 忍受：难受的事压在身上也不放手
持续：东西也这么硬撑着，多少年都还在

words.root_logic: flu（流，← fluere）+ -idus（有…性质的）→ 会自己往低处淌、不定形状的那种东西
words.origin: 拉丁语 fluidus（会流动的）← fluere（流动）
words.native_definition: a substance that flows, such as a liquid or gas, or moving smoothly and easily
words.core_concept: stuff with no shape of its own, always running downhill – 自己不定形状，总顺着低处淌
words.core_image: 倒进方杯是方的，倒进圆杯是圆的，杯子一斜就顺着壁往下走
examples: Drink plenty of fluids in hot weather.
Her movements were smooth and fluid.
semantic_expansions: 液体：能倒能流的那类东西
流体：物理上把液体和气体一并这么叫
流畅的：动作或线条像水那样接得上，不打顿

words.root_logic: ob-（对着、挡在前）+ ject（投，← jacere）+ -ion → 把话像石头一样扔到对方跟前挡住他
words.origin: 拉丁语 obiectio（挡在前、抗辩）← obicere：ob（对着）＋jacere（投、扔）
words.native_definition: a statement that you disagree with something, or the reason you give
words.core_concept: words thrown down in the other's path – 把话扔到对方跟前，挡住他往下走
words.core_image: 他话还没说完，对面站起一个人，把手里那张纸往桌上一摔
examples: She raised no objection to the plan.
My main objection is the cost.
semantic_expansions: 反对：明确站出来不同意
异议：与多数不同的那个说法本身
反对的理由：扔出去挡路的那块石头是什么

words.root_logic: ac-/ad-（朝向）+ com-（一起）+ mod（量度、尺寸，← modus）+ -ate → 按对方的尺寸把自己这边配上去
words.origin: 拉丁语 accommodatus（配得合适的）← accommodare：ad（朝向）＋commodus（合尺寸的）← com（一起）＋modus（量度、尺寸）
words.native_definition: to provide room or lodging for someone, or to fit in with their needs
words.core_concept: sizing your side to fit the other's measure – 按对方的尺寸把自己这边配上
words.core_image: 客人多来了两位，主人搬来两把椅子，桌子往外挪半尺，正好都坐下
examples: The hall can accommodate three hundred people.
We tried to accommodate his wishes.
semantic_expansions: 容纳：地方或器物装得下那么多
提供住处：把人安顿进屋里，给他一处睡
迁就：把自己的安排改一改，凑对方的尺寸

words.root_logic: pro-（当众、往前）+ nunci（报信，← nuntiare）+ -ation → 把字音像一则消息那样送到人耳前
words.origin: 古法语 prononciation ← 拉丁语 pronuntiatio（宣读、念出声）← pronuntiare：pro（当众）＋nuntiare（通告）← nuntius（信使）
words.native_definition: the way a word is said, or the act of saying words
words.core_concept: sending the sound of a word out to another's ear – 把字音像消息一样送到人耳前
words.core_image: 老师把同一个字念了三遍，嘴张多大、舌头搁哪儿都做给底下人看
examples: His English pronunciation has improved.
The two words share one pronunciation.
semantic_expansions: 发音：把音说出口这件事，也指说出来的效果
读法：某个字该怎么念的那一套定法

words.root_logic: physio（天然的本性与运作，← physis）+ -logia（…之学）+ -al → 讲这具身子本来怎么运转的那一门
words.origin: physiology（← 希腊语 physiologia：physis 自然、本性＋-logia …之学）＋-al
words.native_definition: relating to the way living bodies work
words.core_concept: about how a living body works of itself – 关于这具身子自己怎么运转
words.core_image: 医生指着挂图讲，心跳、出汗、饿了想吃，都是这具身子自己在按规矩办事
examples: Fear causes real physiological changes.
She studies physiological responses to cold.
semantic_expansions: 生理的：与身体天然的运作有关，不涉心理
生理学的：属于研究这套运作的那门学问

words.root_logic: pro-（在众人前）+ fess（承认、说出，← profiteri）+ -ion + -al → 当众认下这门本事，从此以它为业
words.origin: profession（← 拉丁语 professio 当众声明、所认下的名分 ← profiteri：pro 在众人前＋fateri 承认）＋-al
words.native_definition: relating to a paid occupation that needs training, or a person who does it
words.core_concept: standing on a skill you have owned out loud – 当众认下的那门本事，靠它立身
words.core_image: 他把执照挂在墙上，收钱只做这一件事，做坏了得自己担着
examples: She wants professional advice on the contract.
He turned professional at nineteen.
semantic_expansions: 专业的：手上这门本事是练过的，做得出规矩
职业的：以此为生，与业余相对
专业人士：靠这门本事挣饭吃的那个人

words.root_logic: sci（知道、分得清，← scire）+ -entia（所知）+ -ficus（造成…的）→ 造出确知的东西，不是随口说的
words.origin: 中世纪拉丁语 scientificus（属于学问的）← scientia（所知、学问）＋-ficus（造成…的）← scire（知道、分辨）
words.native_definition: relating to science, or done in a careful and systematic way
words.core_concept: making what is truly known, not what is merely said – 造出确知的东西，而不是随口说的
words.core_image: 同一个实验换三个人做，记下的数字对得上，才敢把结论写下来
examples: The claim has no scientific basis.
He takes a scientific approach to training.
semantic_expansions: 科学的：属于用实验和证据立起来的那套学问
严谨的：做法一步步可查，换人来做也一样

words.root_logic: de-（去掉、反向）+ sper（盼望，← sperare）+ -ate → 心里那份盼望被抽走，只剩豁出去
words.origin: 拉丁语 desperatus（丧了希望的）← desperare：de（去掉）＋sperare（盼望）
words.native_definition: feeling hopeless, or ready to do anything because of great need
words.core_concept: the hope pulled out, only the last try left – 盼望被抽走，只剩最后一搏
words.core_image: 水已经涨到胸口，他把最后一块板往前一推，闭上眼跳了下去
examples: He gave a desperate cry for help.
She is desperate for a job.
semantic_expansions: 绝望的：看不见还能盼的东西
拼命的：正因没得盼，什么险都敢冒
极想要的：缺到心里发慌，非弄到不行

words.root_logic: testi（见证人，← testis）+ -monium（表事物的后缀）→ 见证人当众说出来的那番话
words.origin: 拉丁语 testimonium（证词、见证）← testis（见证人）
words.native_definition: a formal statement of what someone saw or knows, or clear proof of something
words.core_concept: the words a witness says out in the open – 见证人当众说出来的那番话
words.core_image: 台前那人举手说完一段，书记员一字一句记下，纸上按了指印
examples: His testimony sent two men to prison.
The old bridge is testimony to their skill.
semantic_expansions: 证词：在法庭上正式说出的所见所知
证明：一样东西本身摆在那里替谁作证

words.root_logic: tribus（罗马最初划分出的一支人，与 tribuere 分派同源）→ 从整体里分出来、自成一支的那群人
words.origin: 拉丁语 tribus（部族、罗马人最初划分的一支），与 tribuere（分配、分派）同出一支
words.native_definition: a group of people of the same descent and customs, living under a leader
words.core_concept: one branch divided off from the whole people – 从整体里分出来、自成一支的那群人
words.core_image: 河谷里几百口人讲同一种话、认同一个长者，隔山那边是另外一伙
examples: The tribe moved south each winter.
Twelve tribes shared the same language.
semantic_expansions: 部落：靠血缘和习俗聚在一处、有首领的一群
部族：同一祖源分出的那一支，规模更大
族群：泛指分得出来的一群人，如各族群共处

words.root_logic: pro-（往前、朝外）+ vok（叫，← vocare）→ 冲着人喊，把他心里的反应叫出来
words.origin: 拉丁语 provocare（唤出、挑动）：pro（往前）＋vocare（呼叫）← vox（声音）
words.native_definition: to cause a reaction, or to make someone angry on purpose
words.core_concept: calling a reaction out of someone – 冲着人喊，把他的反应叫出来
words.core_image: 他一句接一句冲着对面喊，那人本来坐着，最后拍桌站了起来
examples: The remark provoked laughter in the hall.
Do not provoke the dog.
semantic_expansions: 激起：把某种反应从人身上引出来
挑动：有意去撩，让局面动起来
惹怒：叫出来的那个反应是火气

words.root_logic: ad-（朝、到）+ vent（来）→ 一件大事朝这边过来，已经到了眼前
words.origin: 拉丁语 adventus（到来）← advenire：ad-（朝向）＋venire（来）
words.native_definition: the arrival of an important person, thing, or period
words.core_concept: something important coming into view – 要紧的东西朝这边来了
words.core_image: 站台上的人都朝同一头张望，远处车头的灯已经能看见
examples: The advent of the internet changed everything.
People waited for the advent of spring.
semantic_expansions: 到来：一件大事走到眼前的那一刻
出现：原先没有的东西开始存在于世上

words.root_logic: ad-（朝）+ vent（来）+ -ure → 迎面撞上来的事，事先谁也说不准是什么
words.origin: 古法语 aventure ← 通俗拉丁语 *adventura（将要到来的事）← 拉丁语 advenire：ad-（朝向）＋venire（来）
words.native_definition: an exciting or risky experience
words.core_concept: walking into whatever comes at you – 迎面来什么全然不知地走进去
words.core_image: 两个人背着包走进没画在图上的岔路，路口连块牌子也没有
examples: They set off on an adventure in the mountains.
Her trip across Asia was a real adventure.
semantic_expansions: 冒险：明知说不准会碰上什么，还是往里走
奇遇：路上撞上来的一段稀罕经历

words.root_logic: con-（一起）+ ven（来）+ -ience → 需要的几样正好凑到一处来
words.origin: 拉丁语 convenientia（相合、适宜）← convenire：com-（一起）＋venire（来）
words.native_definition: the quality of being easy to use or well suited to your needs
words.core_concept: things coming together right where you need them – 要用的东西正好都凑到手边
words.core_image: 楼下拐角就有一家小店，深夜下楼两分钟能买到牙刷
examples: We chose the flat for its convenience.
The hotel has every modern convenience.
semantic_expansions: 方便：省时省力，用起来不费事
便利：条件都凑齐了，办事顺当
便利设施：为省事专门备下的那些东西

words.root_logic: con-（一起）+ vent（来）+ -ion → 众人聚到一处，以及聚起来定下的那套东西
words.origin: 拉丁语 conventio（集会、约定）← convenire：com-（一起）＋venire（来）
words.native_definition: a large formal meeting, or an accepted way of doing things
words.core_concept: coming together, and what the gathering settles on – 聚到一处，以及聚起来定下的东西
words.core_image: 几百人从各地赶到同一个场馆，散场时手里都拿着同一份签好的文本
examples: She spoke at the party's annual convention.
By convention, the host pays the bill.
semantic_expansions: 大会：众人从各处聚到同一场合
惯例：大家心里都认、不必再商量的那套做法
公约：多方聚拢后正式签下的那份约定

words.root_logic: con-（一起）+ vent（来）+ -ional → 众人聚起来认下的那一套，照它来的
words.origin: 晚期拉丁语 conventionalis ← 拉丁语 conventio（约定、成例）← convenire：com-（一起）＋venire（来）
words.native_definition: following what most people usually do
words.core_concept: going the way the gathering agreed on – 按众人聚起来定下的那套走
words.core_image: 一屋子人都穿深色西装，后进门的也解开外套换了同色的一身
examples: They had a conventional wedding in the village church.
He uses conventional methods only.
semantic_expansions: 传统的：跟着一直以来的那一套做
常规的：属于多数场合的通常做法
因循的：只肯照旧，不肯出格

words.root_logic: inter-（在中间）+ vene（来）→ 从两者中间插进来
words.origin: 拉丁语 intervenire：inter-（在中间）＋venire（来）——'走到中间来'
words.native_definition: to come between people or events in order to change what happens
words.core_concept: stepping in between – 走到两者当中去
words.core_image: 两人在街上推搡起来，第三个人挤进当中，两只手各挡一边
examples: The police had to intervene in the fight.
She intervened to stop the argument.
semantic_expansions: 干预：外人插手，把事情的走向改掉
调停：站在两边中间劝和
介入：本不相干的一方进到事里来

words.root_logic: re-（回）+ venue（来）→ 投出去以后又转回到手里的那一份
words.origin: 古法语 revenue（返回、收益）← revenir ← 拉丁语 revenire：re-（回）＋venire（来）
words.native_definition: the money that a business or a government takes in
words.core_concept: what comes back in – 转回到手里的那一份
words.core_image: 月底把柜台钱箱倒空，一张张点过，比进货那天出去的厚了一层
examples: The shop's revenue rose by ten percent.
Tax revenue fell sharply last year.
semantic_expansions: 收入：一段时间里进到账上的钱
税收：政府按法收进来的那部分
收益：一桩生意转回来的钱数

words.root_logic: ac-（ad- 的变体，朝向）+ cess（行走）→ 走到跟前去 → 进得去、够得着
words.origin: 拉丁语 accessus（走近、入口）← accedere：ad-（朝向）＋cedere（行走）
words.native_definition: the right or means of getting to something, or to get at it
words.core_concept: being able to walk up to a thing – 能走到它跟前
words.core_image: 门卫核过卡，闸机开了一条缝，他侧身进了只有少数人能进的那层楼
examples: The building has access for wheelchairs.
She could not access her own account.
semantic_expansions: 通道：能走进去的那条路或那个口子
使用权：许你去用、去看的那份资格
查阅：到库里把要的那条取出来看

words.root_logic: ex-（出去）+ cess（行走）→ 走到界线外头的那一部分
words.origin: 拉丁语 excessus（越出）← excedere：ex-（出）＋cedere（行走）
words.native_definition: an amount that is more than what is needed or allowed
words.core_concept: what has walked past the line – 越过线那一头的部分
words.core_image: 米倒进量杯，高过刻度线的那些顺着杯口淌到桌面上
examples: He drank to excess at the party.
You must pay for excess baggage.
semantic_expansions: 过量：多到超出该有的限度
超出部分：越过定额之外多出来的那些

words.root_logic: ex-（出去）+ cess（行走）+ -ive → 已经走过界的
words.origin: 古法语 excessif ← 中世纪拉丁语 excessivus ← 拉丁语 excedere：ex-（出）＋cedere（行走）
words.native_definition: much more than is reasonable or necessary
words.core_concept: gone well past where the line was – 早已走过那条线
words.core_image: 一整勺盐倒进汤锅，尝一口齁得咽不下去
examples: The noise from the bar was excessive.
She spends an excessive amount on clothes.
semantic_expansions: 过分的：超出常理能接受的那个度
过度的：量上多得压过了该有的分寸

words.root_logic: ne-（不）+ cess（让开、退走）+ -ary → 退不开、绕不过去的
words.origin: 拉丁语 necessarius（避不开的、不可少的）← necesse，一般析为 ne-（不）＋cedere（让开、退走）
words.native_definition: needed in order for something to happen or be done
words.core_concept: what will not step out of the way – 让不开也躲不过的那一样
words.core_image: 出门前摸口袋，钥匙不在就只能折回去拿，别的都可以不带
examples: Sleep is necessary for good health.
Take only what is necessary for the trip.
semantic_expansions: 必要的：少了它这件事就办不成
必需的：非得有，找不出东西替它

words.root_logic: ne-（不）+ cess（让开）+ -itate → 把局面逼到没有别条路可让
words.origin: 中世纪拉丁语 necessitare（使成为不可免）← 拉丁语 necessitas（避不开的处境）← necesse：ne-（不）＋cedere（让开）
words.native_definition: to make something necessary or unavoidable
words.core_concept: leaving no way to step aside – 把别的路都堵上，只剩这一条
words.core_image: 桥断了，所有车只剩绕山那一条路能走
examples: The heavy rain necessitated a change of plan.
His illness necessitated a long rest.
semantic_expansions: 使成为必需：让某件事从此非做不可
迫使：形势逼着人只能这么办

words.root_logic: ne-（不）+ cess（让开）+ -ity → 退不开的那种处境，也指退不开非要的东西
words.origin: 古法语 necessite ← 拉丁语 necessitas（避不开）← necesse：ne-（不）＋cedere（让开、退走）
words.native_definition: something you must have, or the state of being unavoidable
words.core_concept: the thing you cannot do without – 缺了就过不去的那一样
words.core_image: 逃难的包里最后只剩三样，水、药、一件外套
examples: Water is a basic necessity of life.
There is no necessity to hurry.
semantic_expansions: 必需品：日子过下去缺不了的那些东西
必要性：一件事到了非做不可的那种程度

words.root_logic: ad-（朝向）+ minister（居下承事的人，← minus 更小）+ -ation → 一批人在下面把事务承起来办
words.origin: 拉丁语 administratio（执行、经管）← administrare：ad-（朝向）＋ministrare（服事）← minister（仆从）← minus（更小）
words.native_definition: the work of running an organization, or the people who run it
words.core_concept: the below-stairs work of running a thing – 在下位把一摊事务承起来办
words.core_image: 一排桌子上摊着表格和印章，盖完的往左边推，没盖的还堆在右手边
examples: The company improved its administration of funds.
She works in hospital administration.
semantic_expansions: 管理：把一摊事务照章办下来
行政：机构日常的那些事务与手续
政府：在上位者之下具体执政的那一班人

words.origin: 意大利语 miniatura（手抄本上的小幅插画）← miniare（用红铅上色）← 拉丁语 minium（红铅）；'小'这一义出自插画本身细小，后又受 minor / minimus 一类 min- 词牵引，与 minus（更小）并非同源
words.native_definition: a very small copy or model of something
words.core_concept: a thing made small enough to sit in the palm – 缩到能托在掌心的一件东西
words.core_image: 火柴盒大小的一把椅子，扶手上的雕花要凑到眼前才看得清
examples: He collects miniature trains.
She painted a miniature of her mother.
semantic_expansions: 微型的：按原物缩小许多倍做出来的
小模型：照原样缩小的那件复制品
小画像：手掌大小的一幅人像，源出手抄本上的细画
words.decomposable_note: 拉丁借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.root_logic: minimus（最小，minus 一支的最高级）→ 一列量里最靠下的那一个
words.origin: 拉丁语 minimum（最少量）← minimus（最小的），与 minus / minor 同为一支的比较级形
words.native_definition: the smallest amount or level that is possible or allowed
words.core_concept: the lowest point of a range – 一列量里最靠下的那一点
words.core_image: 水表上那条红线画在最下面，水位再落就抽不上来了
examples: We need a minimum of ten people.
The minimum wage went up in April.
semantic_expansions: 最小值：一组数里最靠下的那一个
最低限度：再低就不许或办不成的那条线

words.root_logic: minister（居下承事的人，← minus 更小）+ -y → 承事者所司的那一摊，或他们合成的那个机构
words.origin: 古法语 menistere ← 拉丁语 ministerium（职事、服事）← minister（仆从）← minus（更小）
words.native_definition: a government department, or the work of a member of the clergy
words.core_concept: the office of those who serve under – 居下承事者所司的那一摊
words.core_image: 楼门口挂一块铜牌，进出的人都夹着盖了同一个章的文件
examples: He works at the Ministry of Education.
She entered the ministry at thirty.
semantic_expansions: 部：政府里分管一摊事务的那一级机构
牧师职务：在教会里服事众人的那份职分

words.root_logic: com-（合起来）+ put（点算）+ -er → 替人把各项合起来算的那件东西
words.origin: 拉丁语 computare（合算）：com-（一起）＋putare（清点、估算）；-er 表施事，17 世纪先指'做计算的人'
words.native_definition: an electronic machine that stores information and works on it
words.core_concept: the thing that reckons it all up for you – 替你把各项合起来算清的那件东西
words.core_image: 桌上一个方盒子嗡嗡响着，屏幕上的数字一秒钟跳过几百遍
examples: She bought a new computer for work.
The computer stores all our records.
semantic_expansions: 计算机：按指令处理数据的那台机器
电脑：同一样东西的日常叫法，多指桌上那台

words.root_logic: com-（合起来）+ put（点算）→ computare 经古法语 conter（数）→ 点数收钱的那张台子，也指替人点数的那件东西
words.origin: 古法语 conteor（算桌）← 中世纪拉丁语 computatorium（记账处）← 拉丁语 computare：com-＋putare（清点）
words.native_definition: a long flat surface where you are served, or a device that counts
words.core_concept: where things get tallied up – 把数目点清的那张台子或那件东西
words.core_image: 一张长台横在店里，客人把钱放上去，店主在这一侧一枚枚数过
examples: She waited at the counter to pay.
The counter showed three thousand steps.
semantic_expansions: 柜台：店里数钱交货的那张长台
计数器：把次数一件件自动累上去的那件装置

words.origin: 中古英语 putten / puten（推、放）← 古英语 putung（推动）与 pytan（戳出）一支，更早词源不明；与拉丁语 putare（清点）无关，只是拼写相近
words.native_definition: to move something into a particular place or position
words.core_concept: moving a thing to where it will stay – 把东西挪到它该待的位置
words.core_image: 他把杯子从托盘上取下来，稳稳搁在桌子正中
examples: Put the box on the top shelf.
She put it very clearly indeed.
semantic_expansions: 放：把东西挪到某处停下
使处于：把人或事弄到某种境地，如置于险境
表述：把想法安放成话，轻重全在怎么摆
words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本身即词根，无拉丁词缀可拆
collocations: put off sth / put off doing sth —— 推迟，off 是把它从当前时点挪开
put up with sb/sth —— 忍受，三个词是一体的，宾语只能放最后
put up sth —— 搭起、张贴，也指留宿某人，up 是把东西立起来
put forward sth —— 提出建议或方案，把它推到众人面前
put out sth —— 熄灭火或灯，也表发布，out 是让火从燃着的状态退出去
put sth into practice —— 付诸实施，把想法放进实做里

words.root_logic: re-（反复）+ put（点算、估量）+ -ation → 众人反复估量之后给出的那个数
words.origin: 拉丁语 reputatio（反复估量、思量）← reputare：re-（反复）＋putare（清点、估算）
words.native_definition: the general opinion that people have about someone or something
words.core_concept: the figure others arrive at after weighing you up – 别人反复估量后给你定的那个数
words.core_image: 街坊提起那家铺子都点头，还没进门就知道秤准不准
examples: The school has a good reputation.
He ruined his reputation in a week.
semantic_expansions: 名声：外人对一个人是好是坏的普遍说法
声誉：长年积下来、被人认下的那份好评价

words.root_logic: form（形状）+ -at → formatus（被塑成的）→ 定下来的那个式样
words.origin: 法语 format（开本、式样）← 拉丁语 formatus（被塑成的）← formare ← forma（形状、模子）
words.native_definition: the way in which something is arranged or presented
words.core_concept: the settled shape a thing is put into – 一样东西被定下来的那个样子
words.core_image: 同一份文字排成三种样子，一种窄栏、一种通栏、一种折成小册
examples: Please send the file in another format.
He formatted the disk by mistake.
semantic_expansions: 格式：内容按哪一套规矩摆放
版式：一页上字与图的大小和位置安排
格式化：把介质重新划出格子，原有内容一并清掉

words.root_logic: forma（形状、模子）+ -ula（小）→ 一个小模子，照它套就出同样的东西
words.origin: 拉丁语 formula（小模子、定式），是 forma（形状、模子）的指小形
words.native_definition: a fixed set of symbols or words used to state a rule or recipe
words.core_concept: a small mould others can be cast in – 一个小模子，照它套就出同样的东西
words.core_image: 黑板上一行符号，谁把数字填进去都能算出同一个结果
examples: The teacher wrote the formula on the board.
The drink is made to a secret formula.
semantic_expansions: 公式：把一条规律写成可代入的符号串
配方：照定量配料做出同一样东西的那份单子
套话：说过多次、照模子填词的那种话

words.root_logic: formula（小模子、定式）+ -ate → 把散着的想法灌进模子，成一句站得住的话
words.origin: formula（定式）＋-ate；formula 是拉丁语 forma（形状、模子）的指小形
words.native_definition: to express an idea or plan clearly and in an exact form
words.core_concept: pouring loose thought into a fixed mould – 把散着的想法灌进定了型的模子
words.core_image: 一整晚在纸上划掉又重写，最后那句删到只剩十几个字
examples: She formulated her question with care.
The team formulated a new plan.
semantic_expansions: 明确表达：把含混的意思整成一句准确的话
制定：把做法一条条定成成文的方案

words.root_logic: com-（一起）+ pete（追求）→ 几个人一起朝同一样东西扑过去
words.origin: 拉丁语 competere（一同追求、相争）：com-（一起）＋petere（追求、索求）
words.native_definition: to try to win something or to be more successful than others
words.core_concept: several going after the same one thing – 几个人同时朝一样东西扑过去
words.core_image: 起跑线上八个人同时冲出去，终点只有一根带子
examples: Small shops cannot compete with big chains.
She competes for her country.
semantic_expansions: 竞争：跟别人抢同一样东西，如客户或名额
比赛：在定好的规则里比谁更强

words.root_logic: com-（一起）+ pet（追求）+ -itive → 属于一起抢那一样东西的，或抢得下来的
words.origin: 拉丁语 competitus（competere 的过去分词）← competere：com-（一起）＋petere（追求）
words.native_definition: involving rivalry, or good enough to do well against others
words.core_concept: in the scramble for the same thing – 处在同抢一样东西的那个局里
words.core_image: 一间铺子把价签改到比隔壁低两毛，隔壁当天也换了签
examples: The market is highly competitive.
He is very competitive at games.
semantic_expansions: 竞争的：这个场合本身就是几方相争
有竞争力的：条件够好，抢得过别人
好胜的：性子上事事都要争先

words.root_logic: re-（再一次）+ peat（追求、去取）→ 再去取一遍，同一件事又走一趟
words.origin: 古法语 repeter（重说、重做）← 拉丁语 repetere：re-（再）＋petere（追求、取）
words.native_definition: to say or do something again
words.core_concept: going after the same thing one more time – 同一样东西再去取一遍
words.core_image: 电话那头没听清，他又把同一串号码从头念了一遍
examples: Could you repeat the last word?
The channel showed a repeat of the match.
semantic_expansions: 重复：把同样的话或动作再做一次
重播：同一段节目再放一遍

words.root_logic: certi（已定的，← certus）+ -ficate（做成）→ 把'已经查定'做成一张纸
words.origin: 中世纪拉丁语 certificatum（已证明之物）← certificare：certus（已定的）＋facere（做）
words.native_definition: an official paper stating that a fact is true
words.core_concept: a paper that makes a fact settled – 把一件事做成'已定'的那张纸
words.core_image: 一张硬纸边上压着钢印，指腹摸过去有一圈凸起
examples: She framed her teaching certificate.
You need a birth certificate to apply.
semantic_expansions: 证书：证明学过、够格的那张正式纸
证明：为某项事实出具的书面凭据

words.root_logic: certi（已定的，← certus）+ -fy（使成为）→ 把还在摇摆的说法弄成定下的
words.origin: 古法语 certefier ← 晚期拉丁语 certificare（使确定）：certus（已定的）＋facere（做）
words.native_definition: to state officially that something is true or meets a standard
words.core_concept: making a thing officially settled – 签个字把一件事定下来
words.core_image: 检验员看完仪表读数，在单子末尾签下名字，又压了一个印
examples: A doctor must certify the cause of death.
The lab certified the water as safe.
semantic_expansions: 证明：出面担保某事为真
认证：按标准查过后正式给出合格的判定

words.root_logic: ac-（ad- 的变体，朝向）+ cur（用心，← cura）+ -acy → 心思用足之后，处处都对得上
words.origin: 拉丁语 accuratio（用心、精细）← accuratus（费过心做出的）← accurare：ad-（朝向）＋cura（关切）
words.native_definition: the state of being exactly right
words.core_concept: what comes of taking pains – 心思用足之后处处对得上
words.core_image: 卡尺量过三遍，三次读数末位都一样，才写进单子
examples: The report's accuracy was checked twice.
He shoots with great accuracy.
semantic_expansions: 准确性：说法或数据与实情对得上的程度
精确度：测量或做工能细到哪一位

words.root_logic: se-（脱离）+ cure（挂心，← cura）→ securus：心上不必再挂着 → 拿得稳、不再疑
words.origin: 古法语 seur ← 拉丁语 securus：se-（脱离）＋cura（挂心、忧虑）——'无所挂心的'
words.native_definition: having no doubt that something is true or will happen
words.core_concept: nothing left to keep worrying about – 心里再没有要挂着的那件事
words.core_image: 出门前他没回头看门锁，钥匙在兜里响了一下就走了
examples: I am sure she will come.
Make sure the door is locked.
semantic_expansions: 确信的：心里认定如此，不再摇摆
肯定的：对一件事的判断不留余地
牢靠的：东西或办法稳当，不担心出岔

words.root_logic: fin（终结、结清）+ -ance + -ial → 与把账结到头那一摊有关的
words.origin: finance（← 中古法语 finance 结算 ← finer 终结、清账 ← 拉丁语 finis 界限、终点）＋-ial
words.native_definition: relating to money and the way it is managed
words.core_concept: to do with settling up – 与把账结到头有关
words.core_image: 桌上三本账簿摊开，最后一页两列数字终于对上，笔搁下了
examples: The company is in financial trouble.
She gave me financial advice.
semantic_expansions: 财务的：一家机构收支与账目那一摊
金融的：钱本身的融通与买卖那个行当

words.root_logic: fin（终点、界限）→ 做到了头、无可再加的；也指为了结一桩事一次付清的那一笔
words.origin: 古法语 fin（做到极处的、上等的）与中世纪拉丁语 finis（了结债务的那笔付款），同出拉丁语 finis（界限、终点）
words.native_definition: of high quality, or a sum of money paid as a penalty
words.core_concept: carried to the very end of a line – 走到线的尽头，或到尽头一次结清
words.core_image: 一块玉磨到再磨也磨不出更亮的那一步；另一张纸上写着停车超时要交多少钱
examples: This is a fine piece of silk.
He paid a fine for parking there.
semantic_expansions: 上等的：做到极处，再挑不出更好的
细的：分到极细的那一步，如细沙、细线
罚款：为了结一桩过失而交出去的那笔钱

words.root_logic: e-（出）+ merg（没入）+ -ency → 本来沉着看不见的事忽然冒出水面，逼你当下就应
words.origin: 拉丁语 emergentia（浮现）← emergens ← emergere：e-（出）＋mergere（没入水中）
words.native_definition: a sudden dangerous situation that must be dealt with at once
words.core_concept: what breaks the surface without warning – 忽然冒出水面、来不及等的那件事
words.core_image: 半夜走廊的红灯全亮起来，值班的人抓起外套就往楼梯口跑
examples: Call this number in an emergency.
She was taken to the emergency room.
semantic_expansions: 紧急情况：突然发生、必须立刻处置的局面
急诊：医院里专收这种当下就得治的那一科

words.root_logic: sub-（在下面）+ merge（没入）→ 按到水面以下去，直到看不出来
words.origin: 拉丁语 submergere：sub-（在下）＋mergere（浸入、没入）
words.native_definition: to go or to put something under the surface of water
words.core_concept: going down under the surface – 没到面下去
words.core_image: 河水涨过一夜，早上那排石阶连最上面一级都看不见了
examples: The boat submerged within minutes.
Floods submerged the whole village.
semantic_expansions: 淹没：水盖过某物，它就此看不见
下沉：整个没到水面以下去

words.root_logic: part（份，← pars）+ -ner（parçonier 分得一份的人）→ 与你分同一份的那个人
words.origin: 中古英语 partener，由 parcener（共分者）改拼而成 ← 古法语 parçonier ← 拉丁语 partitio（划分）← partire ← pars（部分）
words.native_definition: a person who shares work, business, or life with you
words.core_concept: the one who takes a share with you – 与你分同一份的那个人
words.core_image: 两人抬一张长桌，一头一个，谁松手另一头都得压下去
examples: She is my business partner.
He came to the party with his partner.
semantic_expansions: 伙伴：一同做事、共担一摊的人
合伙人：出资分利、共负盈亏的那一方
配偶：共过日子、分同一份家当的人

words.root_logic: part（分开，← pars）+ -y → 从整体分出来的那一伙人，或聚在一处的那一伙
words.origin: 古法语 partie（部分、一方）← partir（分开）← 拉丁语 partire ← pars（部分）
words.native_definition: a group with shared aims, one side in an agreement, or a social gathering
words.core_concept: a set split off from the whole – 从整体里分出来的那一伙
words.core_image: 一屋子人自然分成几堆，各堆手里端着同一种颜色的杯子
examples: The ruling party won again.
They threw a party for her birthday.
semantic_expansions: 党：主张相同、从众人里分出来的那一群
一方：契约或纠纷里对立的其中一边
聚会：一伙人聚在一处吃喝说笑

words.root_logic: portio（份，与 pars 同源）+ -ion → 按份切开后各得的那一块
words.origin: 古法语 porcion ← 拉丁语 portio（一份、份额），与 pars / partis（部分）同源；与 portare（运送）无关，同批族头误指为运送一支
words.native_definition: a part or share of something, especially of food
words.core_concept: the share that falls to one – 按份分下来落到各人手里的那一块
words.core_image: 一锅粥盛成六碗，每碗到同一道花纹处就停勺
examples: She ate only a small portion of the rice.
Each child gets an equal portion.
semantic_expansions: 一份：分给一个人的那个量，多用于食物
部分：整体里的一块，不是全部

words.root_logic: des-（离开）+ port（搬运，← portare）→ desporter：把心思从正事上搬开 → 消遣，后专指比力气的那类玩法
words.origin: 古法语 desporter（消遣、使人开心）：des-（离开）＋porter（搬、带）← 拉丁语 deportare ← portare（运送）；英语先作 disport，后截短为 sport
words.native_definition: a physical game or activity done for exercise or pleasure
words.core_concept: carrying the mind away from work – 把心思从正事上搬开
words.core_image: 下午四点操场上人跑成一片，书包全扔在树底下
examples: Football is his favourite sport.
They played sport every afternoon.
semantic_expansions: 运动：为了活动身体去做的那类事
体育：有规则、能比高下的那一整套活动
消遣：把注意力从正事上搬开的任何玩法

words.root_logic: bat（击打，← battuere）+ -ery → 一排炮一下接一下地砸；连排成组这层意思后来落到了蓄电装置上
words.origin: 古法语 batterie（击打、一组炮）← batre（打）← 拉丁语 battuere（击打）
words.native_definition: a device that stores electricity, a set of guns, or the crime of hitting someone
words.core_concept: a row of things delivering blow after blow – 一排东西一下接一下地砸出去
words.core_image: 城墙外一排铁炮轮着响，隔几秒就有一发砸在同一处
examples: The car battery is flat again.
He was charged with assault and battery.
semantic_expansions: 电池：一组单元串在一处连续供电，'连排成组'那层留了下来
炮组：连排在一起、轮番开火的那些火炮
殴打：法律上指一下下动手打人

words.root_logic: circul（小环，← circulus）+ -ate → 沿着环走一圈，又回到起点
words.origin: 拉丁语 circulari（成环、绕行）← circulus（小环）← circus（圆圈）
words.native_definition: to move round a closed path, or to pass from person to person
words.core_concept: going round and coming back to the start – 绕一圈回到出发那一点
words.core_image: 暖气管里的水从锅炉出去，绕过一圈屋子又回到锅炉口
examples: Blood circulates through the body.
The rumour circulated fast.
semantic_expansions: 循环：沿闭合的路一圈圈走，回到原处再来
流通：钱或空气在一个范围里来回走动
传阅：一份东西在人手里挨个转一遍

words.root_logic: cult（耕作、照管，← colere）+ -ivate → 年年翻这块地、照管到它长出东西；本事和关系也这么养
words.origin: 中世纪拉丁语 cultivare ← cultivus（可耕的）← 拉丁语 cultus ← colere（耕作、住下照管）
words.native_definition: to prepare and use land for crops, or to develop something by care
words.core_concept: tending the same ground until it yields – 守着同一块地照管到它出东西
words.core_image: 一块荒地被人年年翻整，第三季垄上冒出成片的苗
examples: They cultivate rice on the hillside.
She cultivated a habit of reading.
semantic_expansions: 耕种：翻土下种，把生地做熟
培养：像照管地一样，把习惯或本事养出来
结交：花心思一点点把关系养起来

words.root_logic: of-（ob- 的变体，对着）+ fens（击，← -fendere）+ -ive → 一下撞到人身上的，或主动打出去的那一路
words.origin: 古法语 offensif ← 中世纪拉丁语 offensivus ← 拉丁语 offendere（撞上、触犯）：ob-（朝向）＋-fendere（击）
words.native_definition: causing anger or hurt, or connected with attacking
words.core_concept: a blow struck at someone – 朝人身上打出去的那一下
words.core_image: 一句话出口，屋里人脸色都变了，被说的那个站起来就往外走
examples: His remarks were deeply offensive.
The army launched an offensive at dawn.
semantic_expansions: 无礼的：话或举动像迎面一击，撞了人
令人不快的：气味、画面之类让人受不了
攻势的：属于主动进攻那一路，与守相对

words.root_logic: gen（生、种类）+ -der（← genus 的斜格 gener-）→ 按'生成哪一类'分出来的那一档
words.origin: 古法语 gendre（种类）← 拉丁语 genus（属格 generis：种、类），与 gignere（生）同支
words.native_definition: the state of being male or female, or a class of nouns in grammar
words.core_concept: which kind a thing was born into – 生来被归进哪一类
words.core_image: 表格上那一栏只给两个方框，填表的人在其中一个里打了勾
examples: The form asks for your gender.
German nouns have three genders.
semantic_expansions: 性别：人或动物按雌雄分成的那一类
语法性：某些语言里名词分成的阴阳中几类

words.root_logic: just（合于法的，← jus 法、准）→ 不偏不倚、正对准 → 恰好、刚刚
words.origin: 古法语 juste ← 拉丁语 justus（合法的、正当的）← jus（法、权利）；副词'恰好、刚才'义由'正对准'引申
words.native_definition: exactly or only, or acting in a fair way
words.core_concept: sitting exactly on the mark – 正落在那道准线上
words.core_image: 秤杆抬起来，两头齐平，指针停在正中那一道刻线上
examples: She left just a minute ago.
It was a just decision.
semantic_expansions: 恰好：不多不少，正对上那个点
仅仅：只到这个限，再没有别的
公正的：依准而断，不偏向任何一边
collocations: just as —— 正如
just about —— 大约，差不多

words.root_logic: im-（in- 的变体，不）+ mune（公共职役，← munus）→ 不必分担那一份 → 免于，进而指外物侵不进来
words.origin: 拉丁语 immunis（免役的、免税的）：in-（不）＋munus（公共职役、赋税）；munus 也是 communis（共有的）的后一半
words.native_definition: protected against a disease, or free from something unpleasant
words.core_concept: left out of the common burden – 公共那一份摊派不到他身上
words.core_image: 一村人都摊派了徭役，只有一户门上贴着条子，收册的人过门不入
examples: She is immune to measles.
He seems immune to criticism.
semantic_expansions: 免疫的：身体里已有防备，病侵不进来
不受影响的：外面的压力或指责落不到身上

words.root_logic: nurs（喂养、照看，← nutrire）+ -ery（处所）→ 专管把小的喂大的那个地方
words.origin: 古法语 norricerie（哺育之处）← norrice（奶妈）← 晚期拉丁语 nutricia ← 拉丁语 nutrire（喂养、养大）
words.native_definition: a place where young children are looked after, or where plants are raised
words.core_concept: the room where small things are fed until they grow – 专门把小的喂大的那个地方
words.core_image: 一排小床挨着窗，墙角摞着奶瓶；另一处棚下一格格小盆里插着刚发芽的枝
examples: She leaves the baby at a nursery.
They bought the tree from a nursery.
semantic_expansions: 托儿所：白天替人看小孩、喂饭哄睡的地方
苗圃：把树苗一格格养到能移栽的那片地
育儿室：家里专给婴儿睡和喂的那间屋

words.root_logic: sup-（sub- 的变体，从下面）+ ply（填满，← plere）→ 从底下把缺的那块添齐
words.origin: 中古英语 supplien ← 古法语 souploier / soupleer ← 拉丁语 supplere（补足、填满）：sub-（从下）＋plere（填满）
words.native_definition: to give someone something they need, or the amount available
words.core_concept: filling up from underneath what is short – 从底下把缺的那块添齐
words.core_image: 货架上空出一段，理货员从后仓推来一车，一件件把那段填平
examples: The town supplies water to nearby villages.
Food supplies ran low.
semantic_expansions: 供应：把别人缺的东西送到手
补给：往已经见底的那一份里续上
供应量：眼下能拿出来的那个总数

words.root_logic: re（res 的变体，事物）+ public（属于众人的，← publicus）+ -an → 主张国事归众人的那一派或那种人
words.origin: 法语 républicain ← republic ← 拉丁语 res publica：res（事物）＋publica（公共的）← publicus ← populus（人民）
words.native_definition: supporting a state without a monarch, or a member of such a party
words.core_concept: holding that the state's business belongs to all – 国事是众人之事
words.core_image: 广场上一群人把王冠的画像取下来，换上一张写满签名的纸
examples: He holds strong republican views.
She votes Republican every time.
semantic_expansions: 共和的：国家不设君主，权由众人所出
共和派：主张这一套政体的那一群人
共和党人：某国共和党的成员或支持者

words.root_logic: pre-（在前）+ side（坐，← sedere）→ 坐在众人前面那个位子上掌事
words.origin: 拉丁语 praesidere（坐在前面、主持）：prae-（在前）＋sedere（坐）
words.native_definition: to be in charge of a meeting or ceremony
words.core_concept: sitting in the seat at the front – 坐在最前面那个位子上
words.core_image: 长桌一端那把椅子空着，直到有人走过去坐下，众人才安静
examples: The judge presided over the trial.
She presided at the annual meeting.
semantic_expansions: 主持：坐在前面掌着一场会或仪式的进程
担任主席：正式占着那个首位的职分

words.root_logic: re-（往回、持续）+ tent（握住，← tenere）+ -ion → 一直攥着不放这件事
words.origin: 拉丁语 retentio（保持、扣住）← retentus ← retinere：re-（往回）＋tenere（握住）
words.native_definition: the act of keeping something rather than losing it or giving it up
words.core_concept: keeping a grip and not letting go – 攥住不放开
words.core_image: 一只手把绳头攥在掌心，另一头有人拽，掌心的绳一寸也没滑出去
examples: The school works on staff retention.
Water retention made her ankles swell.
semantic_expansions: 保持：把人或物留在手里，不让它流失
记忆力：把学过的东西攥住不忘的那份能力
滞留：本该排出去的东西留在体内没走

words.root_logic: syn-（一起）+ thet（放置，← tithenai）+ -ic → 把几样东西放到一处拼成的，不是自己长出来的
words.origin: 法语 synthétique ← 希腊语 sunthetikos（善于组合的）← suntithenai：sun-（一起）＋tithenai（放置）
words.native_definition: made by combining substances, rather than produced naturally
words.core_concept: put together out of separate parts – 由几样东西凑放到一处做成
words.core_image: 一块布摸上去比棉滑，烧一角起了黑珠，不成灰
examples: The jacket is made of synthetic fibre.
This rubber is synthetic.
semantic_expansions: 合成的：把几种物质放到一起造出来的
人造的：不是自然生成，人手拼出来的那种

words.root_logic: turb（搅乱、旋动，← turba）+ -ulent（多…的）→ 里头一直翻着旋涡，静不下来
words.origin: 拉丁语 turbulentus（骚动的、混乱的）← turba（拥挤的人群、混乱）
words.native_definition: moving in a violent, unsteady way, or full of disorder
words.core_concept: churning without ever settling – 里头一直翻搅，定不下来
words.core_image: 飞机进了云层，杯里的水一路往外泼，机身上下颠了几十下
examples: The plane hit turbulent air.
They lived through turbulent years.
semantic_expansions: 湍急的：水或气流卷着旋涡乱冲
动荡的：一段时期里局面反复翻覆
骚乱的：人群挤成一团，秩序散掉

words.root_logic: dis-（取消）+ re-（再）+ gard（看守、注目，← *wardon）→ 把那道目光收回去，看也不看
words.origin: dis-（取消）＋regard ← 古法语 regarder（注视）：re-（再）＋garder（看守）← 法兰克语 *wardon（守望）
words.native_definition: to pay no attention to something, or a lack of attention
words.core_concept: taking the eyes off it on purpose – 把目光收回去，不再看它
words.core_image: 桌上那张通知他扫了一眼就推到一边，继续写自己的东西
examples: He disregarded the doctor's advice.
She showed complete disregard for the rules.
semantic_expansions: 忽视：该看的没看，把它放过去了
不顾：明知有规矩或危险还是不管
漠视：知道却当没看见，态度上不当回事

words.root_logic: 拉丁语 minus（更小、更少）直接入英语 → 让数目变小的那个记号 → 减去
words.origin: 拉丁语 minus（更少、更小），minor（更小的）的中性比较级；数学用法 15 世纪自拉丁语算书借入
words.native_definition: used to show that one number is being subtracted from another
words.core_concept: reduction by an amount – 从一个量里取走一部分
words.core_image: 账单上一行写着 100 减 20，笔尖点在那道短横上，数目往下走
examples: Seven minus three equals four.
The plan has one minus we should discuss.
semantic_expansions: 介词义「减去」是本义：拉丁语 minus 就是「更少」；名词义「不利之处」由「负号那一侧」引申，指一件事在账面上往下拉的那一项；形容词义「负的」直接取算术符号本身
collocations: five minus two —— 减去，介词义，用在两个数之间
minus five degrees / minus ten —— 零下、负的，说温度与负值
minus sign —— 负号、减号，此处作定语指符号本身
the pluses and minuses of sth —— 好处与不利之处，作名词时多用复数，与 plus 成对

words.origin: 中古英语 therfore：there（古英语 þǣr 那里 ← 原始日耳曼语 *thar-）+ fore（古英语 for 为了、因为），字面「为那个缘故」
words.native_definition: used to introduce a statement that follows logically from what was just said
words.core_concept: what came before leaves only this one outcome – 前面那些摆定了，后面只能是这一个
words.core_image: 前面几行条件一条条摆齐，笔尖落到最后一行，只剩这一个数能填进去
examples: The road was closed; we therefore turned back.
She was late and therefore missed the opening.
semantic_expansions: 因此：前面的条件已经把结论逼到只剩一个
所以：把上文当依据，顺着说出结果
collocations: Therefore, + 主句 —— 置于句首并加逗号，独立引出结论，书面正式
be/have + therefore + 补语 —— 插在助动词之后，是最常见的句中位置
and therefore + adj/doing —— 接在同一句内不另起句，比 so 正式
words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本身即词根，无拉丁词缀可拆

words.origin: 古英语 þus（如此、这样），与指示词 this 同一支，更早词源不明
words.native_definition: in this way, or as a result of this
words.core_concept: in this very manner, and so what follows – 就照这个法子，于是后面跟着来
words.core_image: 他把绳头绕两圈再一拉，示范给旁边的人看，说照这个手法来
examples: Hold the rope thus and pull it tight.
The talks failed, thus ending the deal.
semantic_expansions: 这样：手上就是这个做法，照它来
如此：把前面描述的样子整个指回去
因此：这个做法带出后面的结果
collocations: thus far —— 到目前为止，固定搭配，等于 so far 但更正式
thus + doing —— 用现在分词接结果，分词的主语与主句一致
and thus + 分句 —— 接在分号或逗号后引出推论，学术写作常见
words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本身即词根，无拉丁词缀可拆

words.origin: 古英语 on ōþre wīsan（以另一种方式）：ōþer（另一个）+ wīse（方式）← 原始日耳曼语 *anthera- 与 *wīsō
words.native_definition: if not, or in a different way
words.core_concept: the other branch of the road, the one you do not want – 岔路的另一条，那条不想走的
words.core_image: 她把伞塞进他包里，说记着带上，不带的话回来时半身都得淋透
examples: Write it down, otherwise you will forget.
The room was small but otherwise perfectly comfortable.
semantic_expansions: 否则：不照这条做，就落到另一条上
不然：把那条不想要的结果摆出来警示
在其他方面：把已说的那一点撇开，剩下的另作一说
collocations: 祈使句/陈述句 + otherwise + 结果 —— 前半是条件，后半是不照做的后果
otherwise + adj —— 在其他方面如何，把刚提的那一点排除在外
otherwise known as —— 又名、也叫作，用于引出别称
words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本身即词根，无拉丁词缀可拆

words.origin: 中古英语 where（古英语 hwǣr 何处 ← 原始日耳曼语 *hwar-）+ as（古英语 ealswā 同样地 的弱化形），本表「在……之处」，十四世纪转为表对比
words.native_definition: used to compare two facts that differ, or to open a formal preamble
words.core_concept: two facts laid side by side, pointing opposite ways – 两件事并排摆着，方向正相反
words.core_image: 两张成绩单并排摊在桌上，一张门门九十以上，另一张门门刚过及格线
examples: He likes crowds, whereas she prefers quiet.
Whereas the north had rain, the south stayed dry.
semantic_expansions: 然而：两句意思相反，用它把后一句接上
而：只标明两边不同，语气比转折轻
鉴于：合同、判决书开头引出既定事实的那一句
collocations: 分句 + whereas + 分句 —— 两个分句必须同句，不能像 however 那样独立成句
Whereas + 分句, + 主句 —— 置于句首时对比项先说，主句用逗号隔开
Whereas ...（法律文书） —— 鉴于，用于合同与决议的前言条款
words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本身即词根，无拉丁词缀可拆

words.origin: beside（古英语 be sīdan 在旁边：be 在 + sīde 侧边 ← 原始日耳曼语 *sīdō）加副词属格 -s
words.native_definition: in addition to something already mentioned, or as a further point
words.core_concept: one more thing set on top of what is already counted – 在已数过的那些之上再压一件
words.core_image: 账单上的项他都点过一遍了，又从口袋里翻出一张小票压上去
examples: Besides English, she speaks two other languages.
It is late, and besides, I am tired.
semantic_expansions: 除…之外：把它连同后面数进去，不是排除
而且：给前面的理由再叠一条
此外：把新添的那件另起一句说
collocations: besides + n/doing —— 后接名词或动名词，表把它一并算上，与 except（排除）方向相反
Besides, + 主句 —— 句首加逗号，独立追加一条理由，口语常见
nothing/no one besides —— 此时才等于 except，除它以外没有别的
words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本身即词根，无拉丁词缀可拆

words.origin: 中古英语 further more 两词连写：further ← 古英语 furþor（更向前）← 原始日耳曼语 *furþera-，more ← 古英语 māra（更多）
words.native_definition: used to add a further and usually stronger point to what has been said
words.core_concept: pushing the argument one stretch further on – 把论证再往前推一段
words.core_image: 论证写满一页，他翻到背面接着往下推，落笔比前面几条更重
examples: The plan is costly. Furthermore, it is slow.
The claim was false and, furthermore, easy to disprove.
semantic_expansions: 此外：把新的一条摆到已有那些旁边
而且：语气往上加，后一条比前一条重
进一步说：顺着原来的方向再深一层
collocations: Furthermore, + 主句 —— 句首加逗号，正式书面语中最常见的位置
分号/句号 + Furthermore —— 承接上一句独立成句，不与前句共用主语
..., furthermore, ... —— 插在句中用双逗号隔开，语气稍缓
words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本身即词根，无拉丁词缀可拆

words.origin: 古英语 hraþor（更快、更乐意），是 hraþe（快、乐意）的比较级 ← 原始日耳曼语 *hraþaz（迅速）
words.native_definition: to a noticeable degree, or in preference to something else
words.core_concept: the balance tipped one notch to this side – 秤往这一边压下去一格
words.core_image: 天平往一边压下去一格，看得出偏了，可也没到底
examples: It was rather cold for a swim.
I would rather walk than wait here.
semantic_expansions: 相当：那一格压得明显，程度到中上
有点：只压下去一点，够察觉
宁愿：两边比过，取压下去的这边
更确切地说：把刚说的那句往准的方向拨一下
collocations: rather than doing sth —— 而不是做某事，两者取前舍后
would rather do sth —— 宁愿做某事，表主观取舍，后接动词原形
rather + adj —— 有点、相当，强度 somewhat < fairly < quite ≈ rather < very；修饰不合心意的性质时带惊讶或不满
or rather —— 更确切地说，用来修正自己刚说的话
words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本身即词根，无拉丁词缀可拆

words.origin: 古法语 quite（了结的、清账的）← 拉丁语 quietus（安定、已清偿），十四世纪入英语，先作形容词后转副词
words.native_definition: completely, or to a fairly high degree
words.core_concept: settled through to the end, nothing left over – 一路结到底，没有余下的
words.core_image: 账本上最后一笔划掉，合上册子，桌上再没有要办的单据
examples: You are quite right about the dates.
The film was quite good, not brilliant.
semantic_expansions: 完全：结到底，没有留下一点
确实：把对方的话整个接住，不打折扣
相当：日常用得磨薄了，只剩程度偏高一档
collocations: quite a/an + n —— 冠词放在 quite 之后，表相当的一个、颇为可观的一个
quite + 不可分级 adj —— 如 quite right / quite impossible，此时是完全而非部分
quite + 可分级 adj —— 如 quite good，英式里弱于 very，与 rather 同档而语气中性、不含褒贬
not quite —— 还差一点、不完全，比 not very 委婉
words.decomposable_note: 拉丁借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.origin: 中古英语名词短语 sum what（某个分量、某些东西）转作副词：sum ← 古英语 sum（某个），what ← 古英语 hwæt ← 原始日耳曼语 *hwat
words.native_definition: to some small degree but not much
words.core_concept: past the first mark on the cup, far from full – 过了杯上第一道线，离满还远
words.core_image: 量杯里的水刚过第一道刻度线，离满还差着大半截
examples: The rules have changed somewhat since then.
He looked somewhat tired after the flight.
semantic_expansions: 有点：刻度上确实动了，动得不多
稍微：只走了最小的那一格
几分：说个大概分量，不给准数
collocations: somewhat + adj/adv —— 有点、略微，四词里最弱且语域最书面，弱于 fairly 与 rather
somewhat of a + n —— 算得上是个……，用来把断言说软
somewhat + 比较级 —— 如 somewhat better，稍微好一些，给出微小差量
words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本身即词根，无拉丁词缀可拆

words.origin: scarce（古法语 escars 稀少 ← 通俗拉丁语 excarpsus 被择走的）加副词后缀 -ly
words.native_definition: almost not at all, or only a moment before something else happened
words.core_concept: picked over until what is left hardly counts – 摘剩到剩下的这点算不上有
words.core_image: 果园早被人摘过一轮，篮底就剩一只，够不上分给两个人
examples: There was scarcely any bread left.
He had scarcely sat down when the bell rang.
semantic_expansions: 几乎不：那点程度低到可以不算
几乎没有：数量上剩到不够用
刚…就：前一件还没落定，后一件已经来了
collocations: scarcely any/ever —— 几乎没有、几乎从不，本身即否定，句中不再加 not；与 hardly 同档而更书面，barely 则偏重勉强够到
scarcely ... when/before —— 刚……就……，前半用过去完成时
Scarcely had + 主语 + done —— 句首倒装，语气正式，比 hardly 更书面
can scarcely + 动词原形 —— 简直无法，如 can scarcely believe
words.decomposable_note: 拉丁借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.origin: utter（古英语 ūtera 更外面的，是 ūt 出、外 的比较级 ← 原始日耳曼语 *ūt-）加副词后缀 -ly
words.native_definition: completely and without any qualification
words.core_concept: pushed all the way out to the far edge – 一直推到最外的边上
words.core_image: 杯里的水泼干，倒过来在桌上敲两下，一滴都没滴出来
examples: The plan was utterly useless from the start.
She was utterly exhausted by midnight.
semantic_expansions: 彻底：推到最外一层，中间不留
完全：整个如此，不剩例外
简直：话说到极处，不给余地
collocations: utterly + 负面 adj —— 如 utterly useless / utterly absurd，是它最常出现的位置；与 completely 同为满值，但它几乎只搭负面词并带说话人情绪
utterly + 过去分词 —— 如 utterly destroyed / utterly exhausted，表动作做到尽头
utterly different —— 完全不同，此处不能再加 very，程度已到顶
words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本身即词根，无拉丁词缀可拆

words.origin: 中古英语 al togedere 三部连写：eall（全）+ tō（到）+ gædere（一处）← 原始日耳曼语，与动词 gaderian（聚拢）同支
words.native_definition: in total, or completely
words.core_concept: everything raked into one heap and counted once – 全拢到一堆，只数一遍
words.core_image: 几个口袋里的零钱全掏出来堆到一处，最后只报一个数
examples: The trip cost three hundred pounds altogether.
He gave up smoking altogether that winter.
semantic_expansions: 总共：把各处的加到一起报总数
完全：做到没有留下的那一部分
总的来说：各方面合起来看的那个判断
collocations: 数量 + altogether —— 置于句末给出总数，等于 in total
stop/give up + altogether —— 彻底停掉、完全不再做，不留一点
altogether + adj —— 如 altogether different，完全地，语气强于 quite
Altogether, + 主句 —— 句首作总结，总的来说；注意与 all together（在一处）不同
words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本身即词根，无拉丁词缀可拆

words.origin: 由 some（古英语 sum 某个 ← 原始日耳曼语 *sumaz）与 how（古英语 hū ← 原始日耳曼语 *hwō）复合，十八世纪成词
words.native_definition: in a way that is not known or not stated
words.core_concept: the result is here, the route it took is missing – 结果摆在眼前，来路却没有
words.core_image: 门锁着，猫却蹲在屋里的椅子上，一家人谁也说不出它是从哪儿进来的
examples: The cat somehow got into the locked room.
We must somehow finish this before Friday.
semantic_expansions: 不知怎么地：事情成了，过程说不上来
以某种方式：路子是有的，只是不指明
想办法：路还没有，得凑出一条来
collocations: somehow + 动词 —— 事情成了但过程不明，重音落在结果上
must/will + somehow + do —— 无论如何要办成，路子还没定
somehow or other —— 不管用什么法子，口语里的加强说法
words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本身即词根，无拉丁词缀可拆

words.origin: 中古英语 thogh ← 古英语 þēah，并受古诺斯语 þó 影响 ← 原始日耳曼语 *þauh
words.native_definition: used to admit a fact that makes the rest surprising, or to soften what was just said
words.core_concept: admitting one thing, then leaning the other way – 先认下一件事，再把话往另一边靠
words.core_image: 他把凉透的菜吃完，碗一放，末了轻轻补上半句
examples: Though it was late, she kept reading.
The room is small, comfortable though.
semantic_expansions: 虽然：先摆出挡路的那件事，动作照旧
尽管：把那件事说得更让人意外，结果不变
不过：话说完了再补一句往回收，分量比 but 轻
collocations: though + 从句 —— 虽然、尽管，让步从句可置句首或句中
even though + 从句 —— 语气更重的让步，所述为既成事实
句末 though —— 不过，口语里补一句往回收，常用逗号隔开
as though + 从句 —— 好像，此处表比拟，不表让步
words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本身即词根，无拉丁词缀可拆

words.origin: 古英语 hwīl（一段时间）← 原始日耳曼语 *hwīlō；连词义出自 þā hwīle þe（在那段时间里）
words.native_definition: during the time that something happens, or used to set two facts against each other
words.core_concept: two things running side by side – 两样事在同一段时间里并着走
words.core_image: 两条车道并行了好一段，白线一侧的车快些，另一侧慢些
examples: She read a book while the soup cooked.
Wait here for a while, please.
semantic_expansions: 当…的时候：两件事占着同一段时间
然而：把两句并排摆出，让差别自己显出来
一会儿：把那段并行的时间本身当东西说
collocations: while doing sth —— 当…的时候，主语与主句一致时可省主语和 be
