words.core_concept: roomy enough to take the thing on – 容得下这件事，所以接得住
words.core_image: 别人都推给下一个人的那摊事，他伸手接过去，第二天就摊在桌上做完了
examples: She is quite capable of running the whole team.
This old engine is still capable of hard work.
semantic_expansions: 有能力的：本身具备做成这件事的本事
能胜任的：对着某个具体位置说，他接得住
可能做出某事的：也用于坏事，说他做得出来

words.root_logic: caps（capsa 箱、匣 ← capere 容纳）+ -ule（指小）→ 一只小到能吞下的匣子，把东西封在里头
words.origin: 拉丁语 capsula（小匣）是 capsa（箱、匣）的指小形 ← capere（容纳、装）
words.native_definition: a small container, especially one holding a dose of medicine
words.core_concept: a small box that holds a thing shut inside – 一只把东西关在里头的小匣
words.core_image: 两截透明的壳对扣上，里头白粉晃得见，落进温水就化开一层
examples: He swallowed the capsule with a glass of water.
The capsule landed safely in the ocean.
semantic_expansions: 胶囊：装一次药量的那只小壳，吞下去化开
太空舱：把人封在里头带上天的那一节
小容器：泛指这类合起来能封住东西的小壳

words.root_logic: caisse（钱箱 ← capsa 匣 ← capere 容纳）+ -ier（人）→ 看着那只钱箱的那个人
words.origin: 法语 caissier（管钱箱的人）← caisse（钱箱）← 意大利语 cassa ← 拉丁语 capsa（匣、钱柜）；另一个表「开革」的动词 cashier 出自中古荷兰语 casseren ← 拉丁语 cassus（空的），与本词同形而不同源
words.native_definition: a person whose job is to receive and pay out money in a shop or bank
words.core_concept: the one who keeps the money box – 守着那只钱箱的人
words.core_image: 柜台后那人一手接过钞票塞进抽屉，一手把找零和小票一起推出来
examples: The cashier handed me the receipt and my change.
She works as a cashier at the corner shop.
semantic_expansions: 收银员：店里柜台后收钱找零的那位
出纳员：银行或单位里经手现钱出入的那位

words.origin: 希腊语 katastrophē（翻转、突变）：kata-（向下）+ strephein（转）；本项目未为 strephein 一支建根
words.native_definition: a sudden event that causes great damage or suffering
words.core_concept: the whole thing turned upside down at once – 整局一下翻了个底朝天
words.core_image: 海水退开又立起来压回岸上，一条街的房顶在几分钟里全不见了
examples: The flood was a catastrophe for the whole valley.
One bad decision turned the plan into a catastrophe.
semantic_expansions: 灾难：突然砸下来、损失大到收不住的那桩事
大祸：着眼于它落到某人某家头上
惨败：把这个翻覆用在事情结果上，败得彻底
words.decomposable_note: 希腊借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.origin: 中世纪拉丁语 cathedralis（有主教座位的）← cathedra（座椅）← 希腊语 kathedra：kata-（向下）+ hedra（座）
words.native_definition: the main church of a district, where a bishop has his seat
words.core_concept: the church that holds the bishop's chair – 摆着主教那把椅子的那座教堂
words.core_image: 两排石柱直往上收，顶看不到头，彩玻璃把光切成一地碎片，说话有回音
examples: The cathedral took nearly two hundred years to build.
We heard an organ playing inside the cathedral.
semantic_expansions: 大教堂：一片地方里最大最正的那座教堂
主教座堂：点明它的身份，主教的位子设在这里
words.decomposable_note: 希腊借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.origin: 拉丁语 celebrare（人聚得多、传得广、称颂）← celeber（人来人往的、有名的）
words.native_definition: to do something enjoyable to mark a happy event or an achievement
words.core_concept: a crowd gathering to make much of one day – 一群人聚过来，把这一天做大
words.core_image: 屋里挤满人，杯子举起来碰到一处，桌上的蜡烛被一口气全吹灭
examples: They celebrated her birthday with a long dinner.
The whole town celebrated the end of the war.
semantic_expansions: 庆祝：为某件好事聚起来热闹一场
庆贺：着眼于对着某人道喜这一层
颂扬：把这份声势用在称赞上，广为称说
words.decomposable_note: 拉丁借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.origin: 晚期拉丁语 coemeterium ← 希腊语 koimētērion（安睡之处）← koiman（使入睡）
words.native_definition: a piece of ground where dead people are buried
words.core_concept: the place where the dead are laid to sleep – 把逝者安置下来长睡的那片地
words.core_image: 山坡上一排排石板顺坡下去，草修得齐，有几块前头摆着新花
examples: The old cemetery lies behind the village church.
We visit the cemetery every spring to clean the stones.
semantic_expansions: 墓地：埋葬逝者的那片地，可大可小
公墓：着眼于它是一片地方公用的，成排成片
words.decomposable_note: 拉丁借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.root_logic: charact（charassein 刻）+ -er → 刻下来的那个印记 → 一个人身上改不动的那些
words.origin: 希腊语 kharaktēr（刻下的印记、烙印）← kharassein（刻、划）；kharax（尖桩）更早词源不明
words.native_definition: the qualities that make someone or something what it is; also a person in a story, or a written sign
words.core_concept: a mark cut in so deep it cannot be rubbed off – 刻进去擦不掉的那道痕
words.core_image: 刀尖在木板上刻下一道，木屑翻起来，痕嵌进纹理里，擦不掉也改不动
examples: He has a quiet but very firm character.
Each character in the novel speaks differently.
semantic_expansions: 性格：一个人身上刻定了的那套脾性，不易改
角色：戏里书里被刻画出来的那一个人
字符：写下来的那一个记号，字母或汉字
特征：一样东西身上认得出它的那道印记

words.root_logic: char（carus 亲爱、贵重）+ -ity → 把别人看得贵重这份心 → 施予、慈善
words.origin: 古法语 charite ← 拉丁语 caritas（珍视、亲爱之情）← carus（亲爱的、宝贵的）
words.native_definition: kindness in giving help to people in need, or an organization that does this
words.core_concept: treating another as dear enough to give to – 把别人看得亲，才拿得出手
words.core_image: 门口的纸箱里堆着旧毛衣和罐头，谁放的都没写名字，晚上就被搬走了
examples: She gives money to charity every month.
The concert raised a lot for a local charity.
semantic_expansions: 慈善：出于把人放在心上而助人的那份心意
善款：拿出去的那笔钱物本身
慈善机构：专做这件事的那个组织
施舍：具体那个给出去的动作，带一点上下之分

words.origin: 中世纪拉丁语 alchimista（炼金者）← 阿拉伯语 al-kīmiyā（炼金术）；al-kīmiyā 更早词源不明，一说出自希腊语 khēmeia
words.native_definition: the science of what substances are made of and how they change
words.core_concept: the craft of turning one substance into another – 把一样东西变成另一样的那门手艺
words.core_image: 两管清水倒到一处，忽然涌起白沫，玻璃壁上糊了一层雾，管子发烫
examples: She teaches chemistry at a secondary school.
The two actors had obvious chemistry on stage.
semantic_expansions: 化学：研究物质由什么组成、怎样变的那门学科
化学性质：某样东西在这方面的表现
融洽投合：两人一碰就来电，借那个「一遇就变」说人
words.decomposable_note: 借自阿拉伯语，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.origin: 拉丁语 coalitus（coalescere 的过去分词）：co-（一起）+ alescere（得到养育而长大）← alere（养育）；本项目未为 alere 族建根
words.native_definition: a temporary union of parties or groups formed for a shared purpose
words.core_concept: separate growths knit into one body – 各自长着的几支合长成一体
words.core_image: 三面旗子并排插在桌上，各方分坐两边签了字，签完又各回自己那间屋
examples: The two parties formed a coalition after the election.
A wide coalition of groups opposed the new law.
semantic_expansions: 联盟：几方为一件事暂时合到一处
联合政府：这种合作专用在组阁上
联合体：泛指合起来的那个整体
words.decomposable_note: 拉丁借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.origin: 晚期拉丁语 collisio ← 拉丁语 collidere（撞在一起）：com-（一起）+ laedere（撞伤、损伤）；本项目未为 laedere 族建根
words.native_definition: an accident in which two moving things hit each other
words.core_concept: two moving things struck into each other – 两个动着的东西撞到一处
words.core_image: 两车迎头顶上，前盖拱起来，碎玻璃撒开一地，喇叭卡着响不停
examples: The collision damaged both cars badly.
Two ships narrowly avoided a collision in the fog.
semantic_expansions: 碰撞：两样动着的东西实实在在撞上
相撞：着眼于事故这一桩，车船飞机常用
冲突：把这个撞法用在主张和利益上
words.decomposable_note: 拉丁借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.origin: 古英语 biter（咬人的、辛辣的）← 原始日耳曼语 *bitraz ← *bītan（咬）
words.native_definition: having a sharp unpleasant taste; also full of anger or resentment
words.core_concept: a taste that bites and holds on to the tongue – 咬住舌头不放的那种味
words.core_image: 药汁一沾舌根，脸就皱起来，咽下去半天嘴里还发涩，喝水也压不住
examples: This coffee is far too bitter for me.
He was still bitter about losing the job.
semantic_expansions: 苦的：舌根被咬住那样的味道
苦涩的：这味道用在经历上，回想起来不好受
怨恨的：心里存着那股咬人的劲，对人不放过
严寒的：风冷得像咬在脸上
words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本身即词根，无拉丁词缀可拆

words.origin: 中古英语 brekefast，由 break（打断）+ fast（禁食）合成：一夜不吃，这一顿把它断开
words.native_definition: the first meal of the day, eaten in the morning
words.core_concept: the meal that breaks a night of not eating – 把一夜空腹断开的那一顿
words.core_image: 天刚亮，桌上一碗粥两个蛋，昨晚到现在肚里一直空着，第一口下去才暖过来
examples: We had breakfast on the balcony this morning.
He skipped breakfast and left in a hurry.
words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本身即词根，无拉丁词缀可拆

words.origin: 英语自身合成：broad（宽的）+ cast（抛撒 ← 古诺斯语 kasta 投掷）；本义是撒种时把籽扬开一大片
words.native_definition: to send out a programme by radio or television; also the programme itself
words.core_concept: flinging a thing wide so it falls everywhere – 一扬手撒得满地都是
words.core_image: 手一扬，籽粒扇形铺开落满整块地，没有一处特意瞄准，哪儿都落了几颗
examples: The match will be broadcast live tonight.
She listened to the morning broadcast on the radio.
semantic_expansions: 广播：把节目往四面送出去，谁都收得到
播送：着眼于送出这个动作本身
播放节目：那一段被送出去的东西
散布：把消息也这样扬开去，人尽皆知
words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本身即词根，无拉丁词缀可拆

words.root_logic: by-（在旁边）+ pass（passare 迈步经过）→ 不进城中心，贴着边走过去
words.origin: 英语自身合成：by-（在旁）+ pass（经过）← 古法语 passer ← 晚期拉丁语 passare（迈步、经过）
words.native_definition: a road that goes around a town; also to avoid something by going around it
words.core_concept: going past along the side instead of through – 不穿过去，从旁边过
words.core_image: 车流在城外画出一道弧，红灯和窄巷都留在弧里头，二十分钟后接回原路
examples: The new bypass keeps lorries out of the village.
He bypassed the manager and went straight to her.
semantic_expansions: 绕行公路：城外那条绕开中心的路
绕过：从旁边过去，不进那个地方
回避：把该经的环节从旁绕开，不走它
旁路：医学与工程里另接的一条通道

words.origin: 中古英语 casten ← 古诺斯语 kasta（投、抛）
words.native_definition: to throw something with force; also to pour hot metal into a mould, or to choose actors
words.core_concept: sending a thing out of the hand in one motion – 一下子把东西从手里送出去
words.core_image: 手臂往后一沉再甩出去，线在空中划一道弧，铅坠啪一声砸进水面
examples: He cast the net far out into the river.
The statue was cast in solid bronze.
semantic_expansions: 投掷：使力把东西甩出去
浇铸：把熔化的金属倒进模子，等它成形
选派角色：把演员一个个派到角色上，像分投出去
投射：光和影也这么被送出去，落在别处
words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本身即词根，无拉丁词缀可拆

words.root_logic: caut（cavere 提防）+ -ious → 一直盯着可能出岔子的地方 → 谨慎的
words.origin: 拉丁语 cautus（cavere 提防、留意 的过去分词）+ 英语 -ous
words.native_definition: careful to avoid danger or mistakes
words.core_concept: keeping watch for what could go wrong – 眼睛盯着可能出岔子的地方
words.core_image: 他先用脚尖点了点冰面，听有没有裂声，才把另一只脚慢慢移过去
examples: She gave a cautious answer to the question.
Be cautious when you drive on wet roads.
semantic_expansions: 谨慎的：动手前先掂量，不冒进
小心的：具体那个动作放轻放慢，怕出错

words.origin: 英语 chemic + -al；chemic ← 中世纪拉丁语 alchimista（炼金者）← 阿拉伯语 al-kīmiyā（炼金术）
words.native_definition: relating to substances and the way they react; also a substance used in or made by such a reaction
words.core_concept: belonging to the craft that turns substances – 属于那门改造物质的手艺
words.core_image: 架上一排棕瓶，标签上只有一串式子没有名字，拧开盖鼻子先辣一下
examples: The factory dumped chemical waste into the river.
Water is a simple chemical compound.
semantic_expansions: 化学的：与物质组成和变化这门学问有关
化学品：那门手艺里用的或造出的那些东西
化学制剂：配好待用的那一份，多指工农业用料
words.decomposable_note: 借自阿拉伯语，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.origin: 英语内部的拟声词，模仿硬物相击那一声，与 crash、clang 同类；更早词源不明
words.native_definition: to hit together with a loud noise, or to disagree strongly
words.core_concept: hard things meeting with a ringing noise – 硬碰硬，撞出一声响
words.core_image: 两片铜盘迎面撞上，一声脆响震得人耳里发麻，余音还在梁上打转
examples: The two armies clashed at dawn.
Those two colours clash badly.
semantic_expansions: 碰撞：两样硬东西实撞，带响
冲突：人和主张对上，也是这么硬碰
不协调：颜色声音摆在一起互相刺，看着别扭
words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本身即词根，无拉丁词缀可拆

words.origin: 中古英语 cliver（手上麻利、善抓），一说与古弗里斯语 klüfer（灵巧）相关；更早词源不明
words.native_definition: quick at learning and understanding, or skilful with the hands
words.core_concept: hands and mind that catch on at once – 手和脑一下就接上了
words.core_image: 别人还在翻说明书，他把零件颠倒过来一试就装上了，动作快得看不清
examples: She is clever at picking up new languages.
That was a clever way to open the jar.
semantic_expansions: 聪明的：学得快、想得通，说人的脑子
巧妙的：说办法本身取巧，绕开了难处
灵巧的：说手上麻利，做细活不费劲
words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本身即词根，无拉丁词缀可拆

words.origin: 古英语 clāþas 是 clāþ（布、一块织物）的复数 ← 原始日耳曼语 *klaithaz
words.native_definition: the things people wear to cover their bodies
words.core_concept: the woven pieces put on the body – 披到身上的那些织物
words.core_image: 椅背上叠着几件洗过的，袖子翻好，领口压出一道折，还带点晒过的味道
examples: Put your dirty clothes in the basket.
She bought new clothes for the trip.
semantic_expansions: 衣服：日常穿在身上的那些东西
服装：整套地说，着眼于样式和场合
words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本身即词根，无拉丁词缀可拆

words.origin: 中古英语 cors（寻常的、粗使的），一说是 cours（course 常规、常道）的形容词用法；那条链上语义已分，本词只余「粗」这一头
words.native_definition: rough in texture, or rude and unrefined in manner
words.core_concept: a surface too rough and thick to feel smooth – 粗得摸上去挂手的那种面
words.core_image: 麻布贴在颈上磨得发红，手掌一抹能刮到线头，砂纸似的一层
examples: The sack was made of coarse brown cloth.
He apologized for his coarse language.
semantic_expansions: 粗糙的：表面不平不细，摸着挂手
粗的：颗粒或纤维本身大，如粗砂粗盐
粗鲁的：把这个手感移到言行上，不讲分寸
words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本身即词根，无拉丁词缀可拆

words.root_logic: capit（caput 头）+ -al（属于…的）→ 居于头位的那一个
words.origin: 拉丁语 capitalis（居首的、关乎头的）← caput（头）；一国之首、一笔居首的钱、一行字里领头的字形，都从「头」分出
words.native_definition: the chief city of a country, money used to produce more money, or a large form of a letter
words.core_concept: the one that stands at the head of the rest – 处在头位的那一个
words.core_image: 地图上众多圆点里只有一个标着五角星，名单最上面一行也留给它
examples: Paris is the capital of France.
They raised capital for the new factory.
semantic_expansions: 首都：一国众多城市里排在头位的那座
资本：一笔钱被摆在头位，用来生出更多钱
大写字母：一行字里个头最大、领头的那种字形
主要的：同类之中最要紧、排第一的

words.root_logic: casual（casus 落下来的事）+ -ty（名词后缀）→ 事情落下来时被压在下面的那个人
words.origin: 中世纪拉丁语 casualitas（偶然事件）← 拉丁语 casualis ← casus（落下、意外）← cadere（落下）
words.native_definition: a person killed or injured in an accident, a disaster, or a war
words.core_concept: the one the falling event came down on – 落下来的那件事压到的人
words.core_image: 爆炸过后统计名单一行行拉长，每行后面写着送去哪家医院
examples: The bomb caused over thirty casualties.
Both sides suffered heavy casualties that winter.
semantic_expansions: 伤亡者：事情砸下来时正好在下面的那个人
伤亡人数：把压到的人数出来，一行一个
事故受害者：不限战场，任何落下来的意外都算

words.root_logic: cher（← chier ← carus 亲爱）+ -ish → 当贵重东西那样对待 → 珍爱
words.origin: 古法语 cherir（珍爱）← chier（亲爱的）← 拉丁语 carus（亲爱的、贵重的）；与 carrus（四轮货车）不同源，勿混
words.native_definition: to hold someone or something dear and look after them carefully
words.core_concept: holding a thing dear enough to guard it – 拿它当贵重的，看着护着
words.core_image: 一张旧照片夹在书里，边角磨白了还用软布垫着，搬几次家都没丢
examples: She cherished the letters from her mother.
We cherish the memory of that summer.
semantic_expansions: 珍爱：把人或物看得贵重，肯花心思待它
珍藏：贵重到要收起来，不轻易拿出
怀有：心里长久揣着一个念头或愿望

words.origin: 中古英语 bordure ← 古法语 bordeure（边饰）← bord（边、船舷）← 法兰克语 *bord（板、边），与古英语 bord（板）同支
words.native_definition: the line where one country or area ends and the next begins
words.core_concept: the edge where one thing stops and the next starts – 一样东西到头、下一样开头的那条边
words.core_image: 两国之间一道白线横过公路，一侧车牌全换了颜色，护照要拿出来
examples: They crossed the border at dawn.
France borders Spain in the south.
semantic_expansions: 边界：两片地之间划出来的那条线，过线要验证件
边缘：一块布或一页纸最外的一圈
镶边：沿最外一圈加上的一道装饰
毗邻：两块地共用那条线，也就是挨着
words.decomposable_note: 早期借词，经古英语或中古英语阶段传入，词形已归化，无可拆的词缀

words.origin: 法语 bureaucratie：bureau（写字台、办公室）← 古法语 burel（铺台面的粗毛呢）← 晚期拉丁语 burra（粗毛）；后半 -cratie ← 希腊语 kratos（权力），与 demos（民众）一支不同根
words.native_definition: a system of government or management run by many officials following fixed rules
words.core_concept: power that sits with the desks and their rules – 权力落在一排写字台和它们的规矩上
words.core_image: 一份申请在七张写字台之间挨个盖章，少一个红印就退回重来
examples: The bureaucracy delayed his visa for months.
She complained about hospital bureaucracy.
semantic_expansions: 官僚机构：一层层办公桌搭起来的那套管事班子
官僚作风：办事只认规矩不认事，推来推去
繁琐程序：一道章接一道章，走完要很久
words.decomposable_note: 希腊借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.origin: 美洲西班牙语 cafetería（卖咖啡的铺子）← café ← 法语 café ← 意大利语 caffè ← 土耳其语 kahve ← 阿拉伯语 qahwa（咖啡）
words.native_definition: a restaurant where you collect your own food at a counter and carry it to a table
words.core_concept: a place where you fetch your own tray – 自己端着盘子取食的地方
words.core_image: 端着托盘沿柜台一路挪，看中哪样自己夹，末端结账再找位子坐
examples: We ate lunch in the school cafeteria.
The hospital cafeteria closes at eight.
semantic_expansions: 自助餐厅：吃的摊在柜台上，取多少自己拿
食堂：机关学校里供人吃饭的那间大屋
words.decomposable_note: 借自阿拉伯语，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.origin: 拉丁语 candidatus（穿白袍的人）← candidus（雪白的）← candere（发白光）；罗马求官的人穿白托加站到人前
words.native_definition: a person who is trying to be chosen for a job, a position, or a prize
words.core_concept: the one standing out in white to be picked – 穿得雪白站出来等人挑的那个
words.core_image: 一群人穿着刚漂过的白袍站在广场上，谁都想让人一眼先看见自己
examples: Three candidates are running for mayor.
Each candidate gave a short speech.
semantic_expansions: 候选人：站出来让众人挑的那一个
候补者：名字排在单子上，等位子腾出来
应试者：来受考、听人挑选的人
words.decomposable_note: 拉丁借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.root_logic: capital（caput 头 → 居首的那笔钱）+ -ism（一套体制）→ 以那笔钱为轴心转起来的体制
words.origin: 英语 capital 加 -ism，十九世纪中期造词；capital ← 拉丁语 capitalis ← caput（头）
words.native_definition: an economic system in which businesses and property are privately owned and run for profit
words.core_concept: a system built around privately held money that must grow – 以私人手里那笔钱的增长为轴的体制
words.core_image: 工厂、店铺、田地都记在私人名下，谁投的钱多谁说话，年底看账上多出多少
examples: Capitalism rewards those who take business risks.
He wrote a long critique of capitalism.

words.origin: 古法语 carpite ← 中世纪拉丁语 carpita（拆绒织成的厚呢）← 拉丁语 carpere（拉扯、梳绒）
words.native_definition: a thick woven covering for a floor
words.core_concept: pulled wool woven thick and spread on the floor – 拆下来的绒毛织厚了摊在地上
words.core_image: 整间屋子的地板被一层厚绒遮住，光脚踩下去陷半分，脚步声也闷了
examples: They laid a new carpet in the hall.
Fallen leaves carpeted the whole path.
semantic_expansions: 地毯：铺在地板上的那层厚绒织物
铺满：像那层绒一样把地面整片盖住
words.decomposable_note: 拉丁借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.origin: 法语 cassette（小盒）← 古法语 casse（箱）← 拉丁语 capsa（箱、匣）；本项目未为 capsa 一支建根
words.native_definition: a small flat plastic case holding magnetic tape for recording sound or pictures
words.core_concept: a little box with the tape wound inside – 一只小盒，带子绕在里头
words.core_image: 巴掌大的塑料扁盒，两个齿轮中间绷着一条褐色带子，按下去就转
examples: He still keeps a box of cassettes.
She pushed the cassette into the player.
semantic_expansions: 盒式磁带：把磁带装进小盒，整盒取放
小盒：原义就是一只盛东西的小匣
words.decomposable_note: 拉丁借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.origin: 拉丁语 categoria ← 希腊语 katēgoria（指称、断言）← katēgorein：kata-（对着）＋ agorein（在集会上发言）
words.native_definition: a group of people or things that share the same features
words.core_concept: one name called out over a whole group – 对着一群东西叫出的那个名目
words.core_image: 报名表按项目分成几摞，每摞里的人条件相似，新来的先看归哪摞
examples: Books are shelved by category here.
This film won in three categories.
semantic_expansions: 类别：按共同特征分出来的那一摞
范畴：讨论时框定的一个大类
words.decomposable_note: 拉丁借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.root_logic: caut（cavere 提防）+ -ion → 落脚前先看清这件事 → 小心、警告
words.origin: 拉丁语 cautio（提防、担保）← cavere（当心、警惕），过去分词 cautus
words.native_definition: great care taken to avoid danger or mistakes, or to warn someone about them
words.core_concept: watching out before the step goes down – 落脚之前先看清
words.core_image: 脚下是薄冰，每一步先用鞋尖压一压，听见响就把脚收回来
examples: Handle the glass with great caution.
Police cautioned him about his speed.
semantic_expansions: 谨慎：动作之前先掂量，宁慢不错
小心：留着一分注意力在危险那头
警告：把该提防的地方指给别人

words.origin: 拉丁语 celebritas（人多、盛况、声名）← celeber（人来人往的、众口传说的）
words.native_definition: a famous person, or the state of being famous
words.core_concept: the crowd that gathers where a name is known – 名字一出口就有人围过来
words.core_image: 一个人刚下车，四周举起的手机把他围成一圈，谁都叫得出他是谁
examples: The party was full of celebrities.
He never wanted this kind of celebrity.
semantic_expansions: 名人：走到哪里都被围住认出的那个
名声：名字被许多人念着的那种状态
words.decomposable_note: 拉丁借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.origin: 古法语 chalenge（指控、争辩）← 拉丁语 calumnia（诬告、刁难）← calvi（欺骗）
words.native_definition: something difficult that tests your ability, or to question or invite someone to compete
words.core_concept: a claim thrown at you that must be answered – 有人把一句话丢过来，你得应下
words.core_image: 有人当面把话丢过来要你接住，接了就得拿出真本事，退一步也被看见
examples: The new job was a real challenge.
She challenged his version of events.
semantic_expansions: 挑战：被人当面叫住，要你比一比
质疑：把对方的说法当场提出来问
艰难任务：难度顶在前头，得使足力气
words.decomposable_note: 经法语入英语的借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.root_logic: charact（charassein 刻）+ -istic → 属于那个刻痕的 → 一眼认得出的特点
words.origin: 希腊语 charaktēristikos ← charaktēr（打上的印记）← charassein（刻、划）
words.native_definition: a feature that belongs to someone or something and helps you identify them
words.core_concept: the mark cut in that tells one from another – 刻上去的那道印，凭它认出是谁
words.core_image: 一枚印子按在陶坯上，凹痕的形状旁人仿不出，一看就知出自谁手
examples: Patience is a characteristic of good teachers.
He answered with characteristic calm.
semantic_expansions: 特征：能把这一个从同类里认出来的那一点
特有的：只在它身上出现，别处没有
典型的：与它一贯的样子对得上

words.origin: 法语 chimiste ← 中世纪拉丁语 alchimista（炼金术士）← 阿拉伯语 al-kīmiyā（炼金之术）
words.native_definition: a scientist who studies substances and how they react, or a shop selling medicines
words.core_concept: one who works at how substances turn into others – 专门摆弄物质变化的人
words.core_image: 台面上一排玻璃器皿，两种清水倒在一起忽然变绿，他低头记下时刻
examples: The chemist tested the water sample.
Buy the tablets at the chemist.
semantic_expansions: 化学家：研究物质怎样相互变化的人
药剂师：按方子配药的人
药店：英式说法里也指卖药的那间铺子
words.decomposable_note: 借自阿拉伯语，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.origin: 西班牙语 chocolate ← 纳瓦特尔语 xocolātl（可可豆做的饮料）
words.native_definition: a sweet brown food made from cacao beans
words.core_concept: ground cacao pressed into a dark block – 可可磨碎压成的深褐块
words.core_image: 一块深褐的方砖捏在手里就发软，掰断时脆响，入口先苦后甜
examples: She ate a whole bar of chocolate.
He wore a chocolate brown coat.
semantic_expansions: 巧克力：可可豆磨浆加糖压成的那种甜食
巧克力色：那块砖的颜色，深而偏红的褐
words.decomposable_note: 借自西班牙语，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.root_logic: co-（一同）+ in-（落到上头）+ cid（cadere 落下）+ -ence → 两件事同时落到一个点上
words.origin: 中世纪拉丁语 coincidere：co-（一同）＋ incidere（落到某处上头）← cadere（落下）
words.native_definition: the chance happening of two things at the same time or place
words.core_concept: two things falling on the same point – 两件事落在同一个点上
words.core_image: 两人在异国同一节车厢里碰上，谁都没约，票是各自买的
examples: Meeting you here is a strange coincidence.
By coincidence we chose the same hotel.
semantic_expansions: 巧合：两件不相干的事恰好落到一处
同时发生：两者在同一刻一起落下

words.origin: 晚期拉丁语 combinatio ← combinare：com-（一同）＋ bini（两个两个地）；本项目未为 bini 一支建根
words.native_definition: a joining of two or more things, or the result of joining them
words.core_concept: two taken two by two into one – 两个两个地凑到一处
words.core_image: 两股细线搓成一股，谁也拆不开；锁上三个数字按对次序才弹开
examples: The dish is a combination of spices.
He forgot the combination to the safe.
semantic_expansions: 结合：两样东西并到一处成一样
组合：几件按某种搭配摆在一起
密码：几个数字按定好的次序凑成一串
words.decomposable_note: 拉丁借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.origin: 古英语 betwēonum：be（在）＋ tweonum（成双的）← 原始日耳曼语 *twihna（两个一组）
words.native_definition: in the space, time, or range that separates two people or things
words.core_concept: in the gap that two things leave – 落在两者留出的那段空当里
words.core_image: 两棵树中间拉一根绳，晾的衣服全挂在这一段，两头各系一个结
examples: The shop sits between a bank and a cafe.
Choose between tea and coffee.
semantic_expansions: 在…之间：位置或时间落在两者当中
介于：性质、程度处在两者中间
collocations: between A and B —— 在两者之间，两端都要点明，不能只说一头
between you and me —— 你我之间说说，表示别外传
in between —— 夹在中间，可单用作副词
between 与 among —— between 用于分得清的两个或几个，among 用于混作一片的一群
words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本身即词根，无拉丁词缀可拆

words.origin: 英语 break（古英语 brecan 折断）＋ down（古英语 dūne 向下）复合，十九世纪成词
words.native_definition: a failure of a machine, a relationship, or health, or a division of something into parts
words.core_concept: something giving way and coming apart – 一样东西撑不住，散开了
words.core_image: 货车停在路肩不动了，机盖掀开冒白气；另一张纸上把总数拆成一条条
examples: The car had a breakdown on the motorway.
Give me a breakdown of the costs.
semantic_expansions: 故障：机器撑不住，当场停下
崩溃：人的身体或关系散了架
分项细目：把整块拆成一条一条摆开
words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本身即词根，无拉丁词缀可拆

words.origin: 英语 brief（文书）＋ case（箱）复合；brief ← 拉丁语 brevis（短的、简短文书），case ← 拉丁语 capsa（箱），本项目未为这两支建根
words.native_definition: a flat stiff case with a handle, used for carrying documents
words.core_concept: a stiff flat box for carrying papers – 装文书的硬扁箱
words.core_image: 一只扁而硬的皮箱提在手里，扣子一按弹开，里面竖着几叠纸
examples: He snapped his briefcase shut.
She carried a black leather briefcase.
words.decomposable_note: 拉丁借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.origin: 古英语 buttorflēoge：buttor（黄油）＋ flēoge（飞虫）；何以得名无定论，一说其粪色如黄油
words.native_definition: an insect with large coloured wings that flies by day
words.core_concept: wide patterned wings opening and closing in daylight – 白天里一开一合的两片花翅
words.core_image: 两片带斑纹的薄翅在花上一开一合，落下时几乎不压弯花瓣
examples: A butterfly landed on her wrist.
He swims butterfly better than freestyle.
semantic_expansions: 蝴蝶：白天飞的那种宽翅带斑纹的虫
蝶泳：两臂同时向后划，像那对翅膀开合的泳姿
words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本身即词根，无拉丁词缀可拆

words.origin: 中古英语 cart ← 古诺斯语 kartr（两轮车），取代了古英语 cræt；与拉丁语 carrus（四轮货车）无关
words.native_definition: a small vehicle with wheels for carrying goods, pushed or pulled
words.core_concept: a wheeled board you push or pull yourself – 装了轮子的板，靠人推拉
words.core_image: 两个木轮架着一块板，装满土豆后要弯腰使劲推，石子路上咯咯响
examples: He pushed the cart up the hill.
They carted the bricks to the site.
semantic_expansions: 手推车：靠人推着走的小车
大车：牲口拉的两轮货车
用车运：把东西装上车拉走
words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本身即词根，无拉丁词缀可拆

words.root_logic: cata-（往下）+ log（logos 说、逐条列举）→ 一条一条往下说，说成一份单子
words.origin: 希腊语 katalogos（清单）← katalegein：kata-（往下）＋ legein（说、逐条列举）
words.native_definition: a complete list of items, often with descriptions, or to make such a list
words.core_concept: saying items down one by one into a list – 一条一条往下报，报成一份单子
words.core_image: 一本厚册子，每页十几条，每条配一张小图和一个编号，翻到哪页都对得上
examples: She ordered the coat from a catalog.
They catalogued every book in the room.
semantic_expansions: 目录：按次序列出的条目单
产品名录：卖家把货一条条列出来的册子
编入目录：把一样东西加进那份单子里

words.origin: 英语 chair（座椅）＋ man（人）复合；chair ← 古法语 chaiere ← 拉丁语 cathedra ← 希腊语 kathedra：kata-（向下）＋ hedra（座）
words.native_definition: the person who leads a meeting or heads a company's board
words.core_concept: the one who holds the seat at the head – 坐在头把座椅上的那个人
words.core_image: 长桌一头那把带扶手的椅子只留给一个人，他一敲桌面全场就静下来
examples: The chairman opened the meeting at nine.
She was elected chairman last spring.
semantic_expansions: 主席：占着头把座椅、说话定调的人
董事长：公司董事会里坐那把椅子的
会议主持人：负责让会按次序走下去的人
words.decomposable_note: 希腊借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.origin: 英语 check 的英式拼法，受法语 chèque 影响 ← 古法语 eschec（棋局上的将）← 阿拉伯语 šāh ← 波斯语 šāh（王）；核对以防篡改一义出自「将住」那一截
words.native_definition: a printed form on which you write an amount to be paid from your bank account
words.core_concept: a slip that stops money and sends it on – 一张纸条把账上的钱截住，转给别人
words.core_image: 一张印好格线的纸条，填上数目签个名撕下来，对方拿去银行才取到钱
examples: He wrote a cheque for two hundred pounds.
The cheque bounced last Friday.
words.decomposable_note: 经法语入英语的借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.origin: 中古英语 claspe（金属搭扣），或为 clapse 的音位换位，与古英语 clyppan（抱紧）一支有关；更早词源不明
words.native_definition: a small fastening that holds two parts together, or to hold something tightly
words.core_concept: two parts biting shut and not letting go – 两边咬住就不松
words.core_image: 项链两端那个小铁件咔一声咬住，扳不开；也像手指把硬币攥进掌心
examples: The clasp on her necklace broke.
He clasped her hand tightly.
semantic_expansions: 扣子：把两头咬合住的小金属件
紧握：手指合上不放松
搂抱：两臂像那副扣件一样合住人
words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本身即词根，无拉丁词缀可拆

words.origin: 英语 clock（钟）＋ -wise（古英语 wīse 方式）；clock ← 中古荷兰语 clocke ← 中世纪拉丁语 clocca（钟、铃）
words.native_definition: in the direction that the hands of a clock move
words.core_concept: following the way the hands go round – 跟着钟面指针转的那个方向
words.core_image: 旋盖时手腕从上往右压，跟着表面那根长针走的方向，反过来就松了
examples: Turn the lid clockwise to close it.
The dancers moved clockwise around the fire.
semantic_expansions: 顺时针方向：与钟面指针一致的那个转向
顺时针的：形容按那个方向转的动作
words.decomposable_note: 早期借词，经古英语或中古英语阶段传入，词形已归化，无可拆的词缀
collocations: turn clockwise —— 顺时针转
clockwise direction —— 顺时针方向

words.origin: 古英语 clyster（一簇、一串）← 原始日耳曼语中与 clot（凝块）同支的词干
words.native_definition: a small close group of things or people of the same kind
words.core_concept: things bunched tight on one stem – 挤在一根梗上的那一把
words.core_image: 葡萄一颗挨一颗挤在同一根梗上，摘的时候整把拎起来，谁也不单独掉
examples: A cluster of houses stood by the river.
Reporters clustered around the entrance.
semantic_expansions: 簇：同类的东西紧挨成一小把
群：几个人或物凑在一小片地方
聚集：往一处挤拢的那个动作
words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本身即词根，无拉丁词缀可拆

words.root_logic: com-（一起）+ plic（plicare 折叠）+ -ated → 好几层折在一起，抖不开也数不清
words.origin: 拉丁语 complicatus（折叠起来的）← complicare：com-（一起）＋ plicare（折叠）
words.native_definition: made of many connected parts and therefore hard to understand or deal with
words.core_concept: folded over on itself many times – 自己折了好几层在一起
words.core_image: 一团耳机线在口袋里绕成一坨，抽哪一头都带起另外三处结
examples: The rules are far too complicated.
This makes my job more complicated.
semantic_expansions: 复杂的：层层折叠，一眼看不到底
难处理的：折在一起，牵一处动全身

words.origin: 古法语 coart（缩着尾巴的那个）← coe / cue（尾巴）← 拉丁语 cauda，加贬义后缀 -ard；与拉丁语 ars（技艺）无关，同含 -ar- 只是拼写偶合
words.native_definition: a person who lacks the courage to face danger or pain
words.core_concept: one who backs away when danger comes – 危险一来就往后缩的那个人
words.core_image: 狗见了人夹起尾巴往后退，主人一抬手它先钻到桌子底下
examples: He was called a coward for running away.
Only a coward would hit a child.
semantic_expansions: 胆小鬼：遇事就退、不敢往前的那一个
懦夫：该站出来时始终不肯站出来的人
words.decomposable_note: 拉丁借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.origin: 古法语 cortine ← 晚期拉丁语 cortina（帷幕）；与拉丁语 tenere（握住）、tangere（触）都不同源，拼作 -tain 纯属偶合，更早词源不明
words.native_definition: a piece of hanging cloth that covers a window or a stage
words.core_concept: hanging cloth that shuts off what is behind – 挂起来把后面遮断的那块布
words.core_image: 一块布沿轨道拉过去，窗外的光一下被挡住，屋里暗下来
examples: She drew the curtains before turning on the light.
The curtain rose and the play began.
semantic_expansions: 窗帘：挡在窗户上的那块布，拉上就看不见外头
幕布：戏台前面那块大布，升起来戏才开始
words.decomposable_note: 拉丁借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.root_logic: com-（完全）+ pli（plere 填满）+ -ment（物）→ 把礼数填够的那句话
words.origin: 意大利语 complimento ← 西班牙语 cumplimiento（礼数尽到）← 拉丁语 complere（填满）；与 complement 同出一源，后来分写两形
words.native_definition: a remark that expresses praise or admiration
words.core_concept: words that fill out what courtesy asks for – 把礼数填满的那句话
words.core_image: 有人夸你今天这身衣服好看，你听着不好意思又高兴
examples: She paid him a compliment on his cooking.
He complimented her on the fine speech.
semantic_expansions: 赞美：把好话说到位，听的人受用
夸奖：当面说对方哪里做得好
致意：见面时把该有的客套话补上

words.root_logic: con-（一同）+ junct（jungere 套到一处）+ -ion（事）→ 把两边套在同一副轭里的那一处
words.origin: 拉丁语 coniunctio ← coniungere：com-（一同）+ iungere（套到一处），过去分词 iunctus
words.native_definition: a word that links two clauses, or the state of things happening together
words.core_concept: the piece that yokes two parts into one – 把两部分套进同一副轭的那一处
words.core_image: 两个句子中间放一个小词，前后就接成一句话
examples: And is the commonest conjunction in English.
The two events happened in conjunction.
semantic_expansions: 连词：夹在两句之间把它们接起来的那个词
结合：两样东西合到一处的状态
同时发生：两件事凑在同一时候一起来

words.root_logic: con-（一同）+ tam（tangere 触）+ -inate（使…）→ 挨上了就跟着变脏
words.origin: 拉丁语 contaminare（弄脏）← contamen（接触、染上）← con-（一同）+ tangere 的词干 tag-（触）
words.native_definition: to make something dirty or harmful by adding a bad substance
words.core_concept: spoiling a thing by letting a bad one touch it – 让脏东西挨上，整样就跟着坏
words.core_image: 一滴墨掉进整桶清水，水色立刻发灰，整桶都不能喝了
examples: The leak contaminated the town water supply.
Do not let raw meat contaminate the salad.
semantic_expansions: 污染：坏东西掺进来，整批都不能用
弄脏：挨上一点就沾了，擦不干净
带坏：人挨着人，坏习气也跟着传过去

words.root_logic: con-（一同）+ vey（via 路）→ 一路陪着送过去
words.origin: 古法语 conveier（护送上路）← 通俗拉丁语 conviare：com-（一同）+ via（路）
words.native_definition: to carry something from one place to another, or to make an idea known
words.core_concept: taking a thing along the road to the other end – 顺着路把东西带到那一头
words.core_image: 传送带把箱子一路送到另一头，也能把一个眼神递到对面
examples: Pipes convey water to the whole village.
Her face conveyed more than her words.
semantic_expansions: 运送：把货物顺路带到目的地
传达：把话或消息一路递到人手里
表达：把心里的意思送到对方那边去

words.root_logic: de-（去掉）+ cis（caedere 切）+ -ive（有…性质的）→ 一刀切下去，再不回头
words.origin: 法语 décisif ← 中世纪拉丁语 decisivus ← 拉丁语 decidere：de-（去掉）+ caedere（切）
words.native_definition: settling a question, or able to make choices quickly and firmly
words.core_concept: cutting the matter off so it cannot drag on – 一刀切断，事情不再拖
words.core_image: 会开到一半有人拍下桌子定了方案，散会后没人再提别的
examples: That goal was decisive in the final.
A good leader must be decisive.
semantic_expansions: 决定性的：这一下切下去，结局就定了
果断的：该切就切，不在两头之间来回

words.root_logic: de-（离开）+ sir（sidus 星）+ -able（可…的）→ 值得抬头去望的那一个
words.origin: 古法语 desirable ← 拉丁语 desiderabilis ← desiderare（渴望）← de- + sidus（星）
words.native_definition: worth having or wanting because of its qualities
words.core_concept: worth reaching up toward – 值得伸手去要的那一样
words.core_image: 招聘栏里那个岗位人人都投，工资和地点都挑不出毛病
examples: A quiet flat is highly desirable here.
Fluent Japanese is desirable for this post.
semantic_expansions: 令人向往的：一看见就想要，人人都盯着
可取的：条件上站得住，值得选它

words.root_logic: de-（彻底）+ stin（sta 立定）+ -y（名词）→ 早就立定在那里、挪不动的那一条
words.origin: 古法语 destinee ← 拉丁语 destinata ← destinare（立定、钉住）← de- + stare（站立）的使动一支
words.native_definition: the events that will happen to someone, seen as already fixed
words.core_concept: what has been stood firm in advance – 事先立定、不再移动的那一条
words.core_image: 一条路上早钉好了木桩，走到哪一步都绕不开那几个桩子
examples: She believed it was her destiny to teach.
No one can escape his own destiny.
semantic_expansions: 命运：一生里绕不开的那条线
天命：被认作上头早已定下、由不得自己的安排

words.root_logic: e-（从中）+ leg（legere 挑选）+ -ant（…的）→ 一样样挑出来的，才这么讲究
words.origin: 拉丁语 elegantem ← eligere（挑选出来）：ex-（从中）+ legere（拣选）
words.native_definition: pleasingly graceful and simple in style or appearance
words.core_concept: made of picked-out choices, nothing left in by accident – 每一处都是挑过的，没有多余
words.core_image: 一身素色衣服剪裁贴身，只戴一只细表，进屋人人回头看
examples: She wore an elegant black dress.
He found an elegant solution to the problem.
semantic_expansions: 优雅的：举止和穿着都挑过，看着舒服
雅致的：器物花样不多而处处得当
简洁的：办法或证明里没有一步是多的

words.root_logic: e-（从中）+ lig（legere 挑选）+ -ible（可…的）→ 可以被从人堆里挑出来的
words.origin: 晚期拉丁语 eligibilis（可选出的）← 拉丁语 eligere：ex-（从中）+ legere（拣选）
words.native_definition: having the right qualities or conditions to be chosen or allowed
words.core_concept: fit to be picked out of the group – 条件够得上，能被挑出来
words.core_image: 报名表交上去，工作人员照条件核对一遍，在名字后打了勾
examples: Only members are eligible for the discount.
She is eligible to apply this year.
semantic_expansions: 符合条件的：门槛上的每一条都对得上
有资格的：够格进这个名单，可以来领或来考

words.root_logic: e-（向外）+ mot（mov 动）+ -ion（事）→ 心里被搅动起来的那一下
words.origin: 法语 émotion ← 拉丁语 emotio ← emovere：ex-（向外）+ movere（动）
words.native_definition: a strong feeling such as joy, anger, or fear
words.core_concept: something inside stirred out of its rest – 心里原本静着的东西被搅动起来
words.core_image: 听到那句话，胸口猛地一紧，手抖得握不住杯子
examples: He spoke with real emotion about his father.
She tried to hide her emotions.
semantic_expansions: 情绪：心里一时被搅起的那个状态
情感：长久存着、遇事就动的那一份
激动：动得厉害，身上也跟着显出来

words.origin: 拉丁语 corporatio ← corporare（结成一个整体）← corpus（属格 corporis：身体）；本项目未为 corpus 一族建根
words.native_definition: a large business or group that the law treats as a single body
words.core_concept: many people counted as one body before the law – 一群人在法律上算作一个身体
words.core_image: 几千人分散在各地上班，对外只用一个名字签合同
examples: He works for a large oil corporation.
The corporation was fined for the spill.
semantic_expansions: 公司：合起来做买卖的那个整体
法人团体：法律上当成一个人来对待的那一群
words.decomposable_note: 拉丁借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.origin: 古法语 cople ← 拉丁语 copula（把两样系在一起的带子）← co-（一同）+ apere（系住）；本项目未为 copula 一族建根
words.native_definition: two people or things taken together, or to join two things
words.core_concept: two things tied so they go as one – 两样被系住，从此一同走
words.core_image: 两只手扣在一起，也可以是两节车厢挂上同一个钩
examples: A young couple moved in next door.
They coupled the two carriages together.
semantic_expansions: 一对：数目上凑成两个的那一组
夫妻：结成一家的那两个人
连接：把两样挂上同一个扣
words.decomposable_note: 经法语入英语的借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.origin: 古法语 cort ← 拉丁语 cohortem（围起来的院子）：co-（一同）+ hort-（围场，与 hortus 花园同支）；本项目未为 cohors 一族建根
words.native_definition: a place where legal cases are heard, or an enclosed area for a ball game
words.core_concept: an enclosed yard where a fixed business is settled – 围起来的一块地，事情在里面按规矩了断
words.core_image: 四面围起来的一块空地，中间画着线，边上坐着一排人看着
examples: The case will go to court next month.
They booked a tennis court for Sunday.
semantic_expansions: 法庭：围起来的那间屋子，是非在里面判定
球场：围起来画好线的那块地，按规矩打球
宫廷：君主住的那个大院，臣子在里面听差
words.decomposable_note: 拉丁借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.origin: 拉丁语 curvus（弯的），名词一支经拉丁语 curva（弯线）入英语；本项目未为 curvus 一族建根
words.native_definition: a line or surface that bends smoothly without any sharp angle
words.core_concept: a line that bends without breaking – 一条不带折角地弯过去的线
words.core_image: 公路顺着山脚一路弯过去，没有一个直角
examples: The road curves sharply to the left.
She drew a smooth curve on the paper.
semantic_expansions: 曲线：图纸上圆顺地弯着的那条线
弯道：路上转过去的那一段
弯曲：让直的东西弯过来这个动作
words.decomposable_note: 拉丁借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.origin: 拉丁语 demonstrare（指明给人看）：de-（彻底）+ monstrare（指示）← monstrum（示警之物）← monere（提醒）；本项目未为 monere 一族建根
words.native_definition: to show clearly how something works or that something is true
words.core_concept: putting a thing where all can see it plainly – 摆到众人眼前，一步步指给人看
words.core_image: 店员把机器搬到台前，当众按一遍键，让围观的人看清每一步
examples: He demonstrated the machine to the buyers.
The results demonstrate that the method works.
semantic_expansions: 演示：当面做一遍给人看清楚
证明：把根据摊开，让人不得不信
示威：一群人走到街上，把主张摆给众人看
words.decomposable_note: 拉丁借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.root_logic: di-（分开）+ lute（luere 冲洗）→ 掺水把它冲淡 → 稀释
words.origin: 拉丁语 dilutus ← diluere：dis-（分开）+ luere（洗、冲）；luere 与 lavare（洗）同支
words.native_definition: to make a liquid thinner or weaker by adding water
words.core_concept: washing a thing out until it is thin – 兑水冲开，浓的变淡
words.core_image: 一勺蜂蜜倒进整壶水里搅开，尝一口几乎没味道了
examples: Dilute the paint with a little water.
Too many members diluted her influence.
semantic_expansions: 稀释：加水进去，浓度降下来
冲淡：颜色或味道被水带走一部分
减弱：不限液体，力量或影响也能被摊薄

words.origin: 法语 embarrasser（阻住、使为难）← 西班牙语 embarazar ← barra（横杠）；barra 更早词源不明
words.native_definition: to make someone feel awkward and self-conscious
words.core_concept: a bar thrown across so one cannot go on – 前面横上一杠，人卡在那里
words.core_image: 当着一屋子人说错了对方名字，脸一下发烫，话接不下去
examples: His question embarrassed the whole table.
She was embarrassed by the loud praise.
semantic_expansions: 使窘迫：让人当场卡住，不知怎么接
使难为情：戳到不好意思的地方，脸上挂不住
words.decomposable_note: 经法语入英语的借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.root_logic: co-（一同）+ ordin（ordinare 排成序）+ -ate（使…）→ 两把尺排进同一套次序，交出一个位次
words.origin: 拉丁语 co-（一同）+ ordinare（排列成序）← ordo（行列、次序）
words.native_definition: a set of numbers that fix the position of a point on a map or graph
words.core_concept: numbers set in one shared order to fix a point – 放进同一套行列里，用来定住一个点
words.core_image: 地图上横竖两把尺交出一格，报出两个数就找得到那一点
examples: He gave us the coordinates of the camp.
Enter the coordinates into the ship's computer.
semantic_expansions: 坐标：两条互相垂直的尺各报一个数，点的位置就定下来了

words.origin: 古法语 contree ← 通俗拉丁语 contrata（terra）（迎面铺开的那片地）← 拉丁语 contra（对面、正对着）；是拉丁借词而非日耳曼词，本项目未为 contra 一族建根
words.native_definition: a nation with its own government, or land away from towns
words.core_concept: the stretch of land lying out in front of you – 摊在面前的那一整片地
words.core_image: 站在坡上往前看，一整片田野铺到天边，远处立着一道界碑
examples: She has visited over thirty countries.
They moved to the country last spring.
semantic_expansions: 国家：一片地连着住在上面的人和管事的政府
乡下：城外那一片田野和村子
地区：一整片连着的地面，按地势或用途分开说
words.decomposable_note: 拉丁借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.origin: 中古英语 court（← 古法语 cort ← 拉丁语 cohortem 围起来的院子）+ yard（← 古英语 geard 围场）；前半是拉丁借词，后半是日耳曼词，两个同义成分叠在一起
words.native_definition: an open space enclosed by the walls of a building
words.core_concept: open ground fenced in on every side – 四面拦住、中间露天的一块地
words.core_image: 四面墙围出一块露天空地，中间一口井，晾着几件衣服
examples: Children were playing in the courtyard.
The hotel has a quiet inner courtyard.
semantic_expansions: 庭院：房子围出来的那块空地，自家人在里面走动
天井：屋子中间留出的一小方露天，光从上头下来
words.decomposable_note: 早期借词，经古英语或中古英语阶段传入，词形已归化，无可拆的词缀

words.origin: 中古英语 cupborde：cup（← 古英语 cuppe ← 晚期拉丁语 cuppa 杯）+ board（← 古英语 bord 板）；本义是摆杯盘的那层板，前半是经古英语传入的拉丁借词
words.native_definition: a piece of furniture with doors and shelves for storing things
words.core_concept: shelf boards shut behind a door – 关在门后的那几层板
words.core_image: 厨房墙上一排带门的格子，拉开门里面摞着盘子和罐头
examples: The plates are in the kitchen cupboard.
She hid the box in a cupboard.
semantic_expansions: 橱柜：带门带层板，用来收放东西的家具
壁橱：嵌在墙里的那一种，不占地方
words.decomposable_note: 早期借词，经古英语或中古英语阶段传入，词形已归化，无可拆的词缀

words.origin: 古英语 curs（诅咒的话），更早词源不明；与拉丁语 cursus（跑）同形而无关
words.native_definition: a word or wish calling harm down on someone, or to swear at someone
words.core_concept: harsh words sent out to bring harm down – 放出一句话，要祸事落到那人头上
words.core_image: 有人朝着背影狠狠说了一句狠话，旁边的人听了直摇头
examples: He cursed loudly and slammed the door.
She believed the old house was under a curse.
semantic_expansions: 诅咒：说出话来盼对方遭祸
咒骂：气头上骂出难听的话
祸根：像被那句话缠上一样，长久跟着的坏运
words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本身即词根，无拉丁词缀可拆

words.origin: 希腊语 diagignoskein（分辨清楚）：dia-（透过、分开）+ gignoskein（认知），经晚期拉丁语 diagnosis 入英语；是希腊借词而非日耳曼词。库中 gnoscere 根收的是拉丁一支，与本词同出印欧语「知」一根而分支不同，照 regula 与 rect 的先例不合并
words.native_definition: to find out what illness or fault someone or something has
words.core_concept: telling one thing apart from another until the cause is named – 一样样分开辨，直到认出是哪一种
words.core_image: 医生把片子举到灯前看了半分钟，在单子上圈出一处
examples: Doctors diagnosed a rare blood disorder.
The engineer diagnosed the fault in minutes.
semantic_expansions: 诊断：看过症状和片子，认定是哪一种病
判定病因：不限人身上，机器毛病出在哪也这么找
words.decomposable_note: 希腊借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.origin: 中古英语 doun（← 古英语 of dūne 从高处下来）+ stairs（← 古英语 stǣger 台阶）；两半都是日耳曼词，本是短语后写成一词
words.native_definition: on or to a lower floor of a building
words.core_concept: down the steps to the floor below – 顺台阶下到底下那一层
words.core_image: 脚步声顺着台阶一级级往下，最后停在门厅的地板上
examples: She ran downstairs to answer the door.
The downstairs windows were all shut.
semantic_expansions: 楼下：底下那一层，就在台阶下头
往楼下：动作朝下面那一层去
words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本身即词根，无拉丁词缀可拆
collocations: go downstairs —— 下楼
downstairs room —— 楼下的房间

words.origin: 中古英语 erthequake：earth（← 古英语 eorþe 土地）+ quake（← 古英语 cwacian 抖动）；两半都是日耳曼词
words.native_definition: a sudden violent shaking of the ground
words.core_concept: the ground itself shaking underfoot – 脚底下那片地自己抖起来
words.core_image: 吊灯突然乱晃，杯子从桌沿滑下去，墙上裂开一条缝
examples: The earthquake destroyed hundreds of homes.
A strong earthquake struck the coast at dawn.
semantic_expansions: 地震：地面自己抖动，上面的东西跟着乱
words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本身即词根，无拉丁词缀可拆

words.origin: 晚期拉丁语 edibilis ← 拉丁语 edere（吃）——与库中 edere-publish 那个同形的 edere（ex＋dare 交出）无关，勿混；是拉丁借词而非日耳曼词，本项目未为「吃」这一支建根
words.native_definition: fit or safe to be eaten
words.core_concept: safe to put in the mouth – 放进嘴里没问题的那一样
words.core_image: 野地里两朵相似的菌子，本地人拿起一朵咬了一口，另一朵扔开
examples: Not every wild berry is edible.
The flowers are edible and slightly sweet.
semantic_expansions: 可食用的：性质上没毒，人能拿来当食物
能吃的：眼前这一份没坏、下得了口
words.decomposable_note: 拉丁借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.origin: 古英语 elles（另外地）+ hwær（何处）；两半都是日耳曼词，中古英语时合成一词
words.native_definition: in, at, or to some other place
words.core_concept: at some other place than this one – 不在这儿，在另外的地方
words.core_image: 这家店门口贴着告示，要买的那样东西得往下一条街去问
examples: The book is not here; look elsewhere.
Many workers went elsewhere for better pay.
semantic_expansions: 在别处：人或物不在眼下这个地方
到别处：动作朝另一个地方去
words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本身即词根，无拉丁词缀可拆
collocations: go elsewhere —— 去别处
elsewhere in sth —— 某物的其他地方

words.root_logic: con-（一起）+ cil（concilium 召集到一处）→ 被召到一处议事的那群人
words.origin: 古法语 conseil / concile 在英语里混同，本词出拉丁语 concilium（集会、联盟）← com-（一起）+ calare（召唤）；与 consulere（商议、求教）不同源，counsel 才属那一支
words.native_definition: a group of people chosen to make decisions or give advice
words.core_concept: a body called together to decide – 被召集到一处做决定的一群人
words.core_image: 长桌两边坐满人，每人面前一份文件，主位敲一下木槌，逐项过一遍
examples: The city council voted against the new road.
She sits on the student council.
semantic_expansions: 委员会：为某事被召集起来的一小群人
议会：地方上有决策权的那个机构
理事会：一个组织内部定事的常设班子

words.origin: 古法语 cristal ← 拉丁语 crystallus ← 希腊语 krystallos（冰、水晶）← kryos（霜、冰寒）；与希腊语 krinein（判别）无关，不属 crit 一支
words.native_definition: a clear hard mineral that forms in regular flat-sided shapes
words.core_concept: clear stuff frozen into flat faces – 清透之物长成一个个平面
words.core_image: 一块透亮的石头，每个面都平，转一下角度就有一道光从里面折出来
examples: The cave walls were lined with tiny crystals.
Salt forms crystals as the water dries.
semantic_expansions: 水晶：透亮的那种石头本身
结晶：溶液里慢慢长出规整颗粒的过程
晶体：内部按规矩排列、外面带平面的那类固体
words.decomposable_note: 希腊借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.root_logic: domin（dominus 家主、主人）+ -arium（权限）→ 落进别人手里、由他处置
words.origin: 古法语 dangier ← 通俗拉丁语 *dominiarium（主人的权力、处置权）← 拉丁语 dominus（家主）
words.native_definition: the possibility that something bad or harmful may happen
words.core_concept: being in another's hands, not your own – 落在别人手里，由不得自己
words.core_image: 站在窄窄的檐口上，脚下没有东西托着，身子已经不由自己，全看下一步落在哪里
examples: The bridge is old and full of danger.
Smoking is a danger to your health.
semantic_expansions: 危险：处境已不受自己掌握，随时可能出事
危害：那股力量真的落到人或物身上

words.root_logic: prae-（预先）+ caut（cavere 当心、留神）→ 事情还没来，先留神着做点什么
words.origin: 拉丁语 praecautio ← praecavere：prae-（预先）+ cavere（当心、提防）
words.native_definition: something done in advance to stop a possible problem
words.core_concept: acting before the trouble arrives – 麻烦还没到就先动手
words.core_image: 出门时天还晴着，包里先塞了一把伞，因为昨夜听见过风声
examples: Take an umbrella as a precaution.
They locked the door as a precaution.
semantic_expansions: 预防措施：为挡住可能的坏事而先做的那件具体的事
防范：整体上先留着的那份戒心

words.origin: 古法语 conceler ← 拉丁语 concelare：com-（彻底）+ celare（藏起）；本项目未为 celare 一支建根
words.native_definition: to hide something so that it cannot be seen or found out
words.core_concept: putting a thing where eyes cannot reach – 放到眼睛到不了的地方
words.core_image: 把信塞进地板缝里，又把床单铺平压好，屋里看不出动过的痕迹
examples: He tried to conceal the letter in his coat.
She could not conceal her surprise.
semantic_expansions: 隐藏：把实物挪到看不见的地方
隐瞒：把消息或情绪扣住不让人知道
words.decomposable_note: 拉丁借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.origin: 拉丁语 connexio ← connectere：com-（一起）+ nectere（系、缚）；本项目未为 nectere 一支建根
words.native_definition: a link between two things, people, or ideas
words.core_concept: two things tied so one reaches the other – 两头系住，这边能通到那边
words.core_image: 两根电线的铜头绞在一处，缠上胶布，灯一下就亮了
examples: There is no connection between the two cases.
The train connection was delayed.
semantic_expansions: 连接：两个东西实际接上了
联系：人与人之间来往的那条线
关系：两件事之间说得出的那层牵连
words.decomposable_note: 拉丁借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.origin: 古法语 contraire ← 拉丁语 contrarius ← contra（对面、迎面）；contra 是前缀性成分，本项目未为其单独建根
words.native_definition: completely different, or the opposite of something
words.core_concept: facing the other way – 脸朝着另一边
words.core_image: 两个人背靠背站着，一个往东迈步，另一个同时往西
examples: His view is contrary to mine.
On the contrary, I enjoyed it.
semantic_expansions: 相反的：方向或说法正好倒过来
对立的：两者不只不同，还互相顶着
words.decomposable_note: 经法语入英语的借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.origin: 古英语 coper ← 晚期拉丁语 cuprum ← aes cyprium（塞浦路斯的金属），该岛古时产此矿
words.native_definition: a soft reddish-brown metal that carries heat and electricity well
words.core_concept: the red metal that came from that island – 从那座岛上来的红色金属
words.core_image: 一根旧水管刮掉锈，底下是红黄色的亮面，放久了又蒙上一层青绿
examples: The pipes in this house are made of copper.
He paid with a few coppers.
semantic_expansions: 铜：那种红黄色的软金属
铜币：用它铸的小面额钱
words.decomposable_note: 早期借词，经古英语或中古英语阶段传入，词形已归化，无可拆的词缀

words.root_logic: corr（currere 跑、来回走）+ -dor（处所）→ 供人来回走动的那条长条地方
words.origin: 法语 corridor ← 意大利语 corridore（可供奔走的长条地方）← correre ← 拉丁语 currere（跑）
words.native_definition: a long narrow passage inside a building with doors along the sides
words.core_concept: a long strip made for moving through – 专供人来回走的一条长地方
words.core_image: 楼里一条又长又窄的过道，两侧一排门，脚步声在头顶来回响
examples: Her office is at the end of the corridor.
We waited in the corridor outside.
semantic_expansions: 走廊：楼里连着各房间的那条长条空间
通道：任何供穿行的狭长路线

words.origin: 法语 coupon（剪下的一小片）← couper（剪、切）← 古法语 colp ← 晚期拉丁语 colpus（一击）；本项目未为这一支建根
words.native_definition: a small printed piece of paper that gives you a right to something
words.core_concept: a small piece cut off the sheet – 从整张上剪下来的一小片
words.core_image: 报纸角上印着一小块虚线框，沿线剪下来，到店里能抵一部分钱
examples: She cut out the coupon from the magazine.
This coupon gives you ten percent off.
semantic_expansions: 优惠券：剪下来能少付钱的那一小片
票证：凭它领取或兑换某物的凭据
words.decomposable_note: 拉丁借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.origin: 古法语 curteisie ← curteis（合乎庭中体面的）← cort（庭院、宫廷）← 拉丁语 cohortem（围起来的院子）；本项目未为这一支建根
words.native_definition: polite behaviour that shows respect for other people
words.core_concept: the manner kept in another's yard – 在别人的场面上该有的样子
words.core_image: 进门时替后面的人扶住门，等他走过去才松手
examples: He held the door open out of courtesy.
She greeted them with great courtesy.
semantic_expansions: 礼貌：待人时那份不抢先、不冒犯的态度
礼节：场面上照例要做的那些具体动作
words.decomposable_note: 拉丁借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.root_logic: domin（dominus 家主、主人）+ -arium（权限）+ -ous（有…性质的）→ 会把人攥在手里的
words.origin: 古法语 dangereus ← dangier ← 通俗拉丁语 *dominiarium（主人的处置权）← 拉丁语 dominus（家主）
words.native_definition: likely to cause harm or damage to someone
words.core_concept: able to take you out of your own hands – 能把人从自己手里夺走的
words.core_image: 那段路刚下过雨，路肩上没有护栏，车轮一偏就直接下去了
examples: It is dangerous to swim here alone.
He drove at a dangerous speed.

words.root_logic: de-（缺、去掉）+ fic（facere 做、造）→ 该凑够的没凑够，短了一块
words.origin: 拉丁语 deficit（它短缺，deficere 的第三人称单数）← deficere：de-（去掉）+ facere（做、造）
words.native_definition: the amount by which money spent is more than money received
words.core_concept: what was not made up to the mark – 该做够的地方没做够
words.core_image: 账本最后一行是个负数，进来的钱没盖住出去的钱
examples: The company reported a large deficit.
They cut spending to reduce the deficit.
semantic_expansions: 赤字：账上出的比进的多，那个差额
亏空：钱或物已经短了一块，补不上
逆差：一国对外买进多于卖出的那部分差数

words.origin: 中世纪拉丁语 deprivare：de-（彻底）+ privare（夺走、使孤单）← privus（各自的、单个的）；本项目未为 privus 一支建根
words.native_definition: to take something away from someone that they need or should have
words.core_concept: pulling away what was someone's own – 把本属于他的那份抽走
words.core_image: 原本攥在他手里的东西被人一件件拿走，最后摊开的手心是空的
examples: The new rule deprives them of their rights.
Lack of sleep deprived him of energy.
semantic_expansions: 剥夺：把权利或资格从人手里强行取走
使丧失：让人失去某种本有的东西或状态
words.decomposable_note: 拉丁借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.root_logic: de-（定住）+ stin（stare 站定）+ -ation → 出发前就已经定住不动的那个落脚处
words.origin: 拉丁语 destinatio ← destinare（定下、指定）← de- + *stanare ← stare（站立、立定）
words.native_definition: the place that someone or something is going to
words.core_concept: the point fixed before the journey starts – 出发之前就已经定住的那一点
words.core_image: 车票上印着一个站名，中途换几趟车都不算，最后停下的就是那一个点
examples: Their destination was a small fishing village.
The parcel reached its destination.
semantic_expansions: 目的地：人或物要去的那个地方
终点：一段路程最后停下的位置

words.origin: 拉丁语 determinare：de-（彻底）+ terminare ← terminus（界石、边界）；本项目未为 terminus 一支建根
words.native_definition: to decide something officially, or to find out something exactly
words.core_concept: driving in the stake that fixes the line – 把界桩钉死，线就定在那里
words.core_image: 在地上钉进一根木桩，绳子绕上去拉紧，从此这条边就不再挪动
examples: The court will determine who owns the land.
We must determine the cause first.
semantic_expansions: 决定：正式定下某事怎么办
确定：把原先不明的范围或数值定住
查明：把事实弄清楚到不再有疑
words.decomposable_note: 拉丁借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.origin: 法语 diplomatique ← 拉丁语 diploma（对折的官方文书）← 希腊语 diplōma ← diploun（对折）；与库中 plic 所据的 plicare（折叠）同出印欧折叠之义，但希腊与拉丁两支已分化，且今义要经 diploma（文书）才转得过来，故未并入
words.native_definition: relating to relations between countries, or skilled at handling people
words.core_concept: carrying the folded letter between states – 拿着对折的文书在两国之间走动
words.core_image: 两边隔着长桌说话，声音压得低，句子留半截，谁也不把话逼到没有退路
examples: The two sides resumed diplomatic talks.
She gave a diplomatic answer to the question.
semantic_expansions: 外交的：与国家之间往来事务有关的
圆通的：说话办事不把人得罪、留着余地的
words.decomposable_note: 希腊借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.origin: 拉丁语 elementarius ← elementum（构成万物的基本部分），更早词源不明；本项目未为 elementum 一支建根
words.native_definition: at the most basic level, or dealing with the first steps of a subject
words.core_concept: the first pieces a thing is built from – 一样东西最开头的那几块
words.core_image: 黑板上只留最开头那几个式子，底下写着先把这些背下来
examples: He made an elementary mistake in the calculation.
She teaches at an elementary school.
semantic_expansions: 基本的：属于最起头、再往下拆不动的那一层
初级的：面向刚入门的人、只讲开头部分的
words.decomposable_note: 拉丁借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.origin: 拉丁语 eliminare（赶出门槛外）：ex-（出）+ limen（门槛）；limen（门槛）与库中 limes（田界、边界）是两个拉丁名词，语义已分，本项目未合并
words.native_definition: to remove something completely, or to knock someone out of a contest
words.core_concept: putting it out over the threshold – 推出门槛，不让再进来
words.core_image: 名单上一行行划掉，划到最后只剩一个名字
examples: We must eliminate all errors before printing.
Their team was eliminated in the first round.
semantic_expansions: 消除：把某种东西彻底去掉
淘汰：在比赛或筛选中把人或物剔出去
排除：从考虑范围里把某项拿掉
words.decomposable_note: 拉丁借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.root_logic: e-（ex- 离开）+ migr（migrare 迁移）+ -ate → 从原处迁出去
words.origin: 拉丁语 emigratus ← emigrare：ex-（出）+ migrare（迁移）；本项目未为 migrare 一支建根
words.native_definition: to leave your own country in order to live in another one
words.core_concept: moving out of where you belonged – 从自己原属的地方迁出去
words.core_image: 钥匙交回房东，箱子一只只搬上船，岸上的人越站越小
examples: Her parents emigrated to Canada in 1980.
Many young workers emigrate for better pay.
semantic_expansions: 移居国外：离开本国到别国长住
外迁：整体上往外搬走这个动作

words.root_logic: emper（← imperator 发号令的统帅）+ -or（人）→ 发号令的那个人
words.origin: 古法语 empereor ← 拉丁语 imperator（统帅）← imperare（下令、统辖）：in-（向）+ parare（备置）；承义的是下令统辖这一支，不是备置，故未挂 parare
words.native_definition: the male ruler of an empire
words.core_concept: the one whose word moves everyone – 一句话就能调动所有人的那个人
words.core_image: 台阶最上面坐着一个人，下面几百人跪着，他只抬了一下手指
examples: The emperor ordered a new palace to be built.
He ruled as emperor for thirty years.
semantic_expansions: 皇帝：统辖整个帝国的最高统治者
君主：世袭掌国的那一类统治者

words.root_logic: co-（一同）+ oper（operari 劳作、投入工作）+ -ative → 力气往同一处使
words.origin: 中世纪拉丁语 cooperativus ← cooperari：com-（一同）+ operari（劳作）← opus（工作）
words.native_definition: willing to work together with others, or a business owned by its members
words.core_concept: effort put in alongside another – 力气跟别人使在一处
words.core_image: 两个人抬同一根木头，一个起身另一个立刻跟上，步子踩在一个点上
examples: The witness was very cooperative with the police.
They joined a farmers' cooperative.
semantic_expansions: 合作的：愿意与人一同出力的
乐于配合的：别人要做什么就顺着接上的
合作社：由社员共同出资共同经营的那种组织

words.origin: 古英语 cūðe（cunnan 知道、会 的过去式）← 原始日耳曼语 *kunnan；拼写里的 l 是后人比着 would / should 加进去的，本不发音
words.native_definition: used to say what someone was able to do, or to ask and suggest politely
words.core_concept: the knowing-how that was there then – 那时候手上有的那份本事
words.core_image: 年轻时一口气能爬到山顶，如今上两层楼就要停一停
examples: She could swim before she was four.
Could you pass me the salt?
semantic_expansions: 能：过去有这个本事或条件
可以：请求或提议时把话说软一格
可能：对眼下或将来的一种不很确定的估计
collocations: could have done sth —— 本来做得到却没做，含惋惜或责怪
Could you do sth? —— 请求对方做事，比 can 更客气
could hardly do sth —— 几乎做不到，程度贴近否定
if... could do sth —— 与现在事实相反的假设，虚拟语气
words.recall_hint: 同一个词既回头说从前办得到，也用来把话说得客气、把口气留出余地
words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本身即词根，无拉丁词缀可拆

words.origin: 英语内部合成：country + side；country ← 古法语 contree ← 通俗拉丁语 contrata（对面铺展开的那片地）← 拉丁语 contra（对面）
words.native_definition: land outside towns and cities, with fields, woods, and few buildings
words.core_concept: the land spread out over against the town – 跟城相对着铺开的那一片地
words.core_image: 车窗外一片片田挨着走，中间散着几棵树、几间矮房，很久看不见一个红灯
examples: They bought a small house in the countryside.
We drove through open countryside all day.
semantic_expansions: 乡村：城外那片以田野林木为主的地方
农村：以种田为生的人聚居的那一带
words.decomposable_note: 拉丁借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.origin: 古英语 crypel ← 原始日耳曼语 *krupilaz（爬行者）← *kreupan（爬）
words.native_definition: to damage someone or something so badly that it can no longer work properly
words.core_concept: brought down to crawling – 弄到只能爬着走
words.core_image: 一条腿拖在后面，每走一步都要把身子往旁边甩一下才带得动
examples: The accident crippled him for life.
Heavy debts crippled the small company.
semantic_expansions: 使丧失能力：把人的行动或机能弄坏
严重损害：把机构、经济等打到运转不起来
words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本身即词根，无拉丁词缀可拆

words.origin: 中古英语 crulle ← 中古荷兰语 krul（卷曲的）；英语里 r 换了位置成 curl
words.native_definition: to form into a curved or spiral shape, or a piece of hair in that shape
words.core_concept: turning in upon itself – 自己往里绕成圈
words.core_image: 刨下来的木片自己卷成一圈圈，松手就越缩越紧
examples: The paper curled up in the heat.
She has thick black curls.
semantic_expansions: 卷曲：边缘或整体绕成圈的这个动作或状态
卷发：头发天然或做成的那种圈状
words.decomposable_note: 早期借词，经古英语或中古英语阶段传入，词形已归化，无可拆的词缀

words.origin: 1982 年英语新造词：cyber-（截自 cybernetics 控制论，与 gubernare 掌舵 一支语义已分，今只作构词前缀）+ space；更早可溯希腊语舵手一词，但那层意思今义里已不可见
words.native_definition: the imagined space in which electronic messages and data move
words.core_concept: a place that exists only in the wires – 只存在于线路里的一个地方
words.core_image: 人坐在椅子上没动，屏幕那头是几千公里外的人，一来一往像面对面
examples: Millions of people meet daily in cyberspace.
Crime in cyberspace is hard to trace.
semantic_expansions: 网络空间：电子信息往来所构成的那个场域
虚拟空间：并非实体、只在设备中成立的空间
words.decomposable_note: 希腊借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.root_logic: dia-（来回、穿过）+ log（logos 话语）→ 话在两个人之间来回过
words.origin: 拉丁语 dialogus ← 希腊语 dialogos ← dialegesthai：dia-（来回）+ legein（说）
words.native_definition: a conversation between two or more people, especially in a book or play
words.core_concept: words passing back and forth – 话语在两边来回走
words.core_image: 剧本上一行接一行，左边名字换来换去，两个人一句顶一句地把事说开
examples: The novel is full of sharp dialog.
The two sides opened a direct dialog.
semantic_expansions: 对话：双方轮着说话，也指正式的会谈
对白：剧本或影片里人物所说的话

words.origin: 古英语 dūce（潜水的鸟）← *dūcan（俯身、扎入水中）← 原始日耳曼语 *dūkan
words.native_definition: a common water bird with a wide flat beak, or to lower your head quickly
words.core_concept: going head-down in one quick dip – 头一低，一下扎下去
words.core_image: 水面上的鸟一头扎下去，水圈还在晃，它已经从几步远的地方冒出来
examples: A row of ducks crossed the muddy path.
He ducked as the ball flew past.
semantic_expansions: 鸭子：那种扁嘴会潜水的水鸟
低头躲避：人把头猛一低让开的动作
words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本身即词根，无拉丁词缀可拆

words.origin: 古英语 ēasterne：ēast（← 原始日耳曼语 *aust- 日出那边）+ -erne（方位后缀）
words.native_definition: in or from the side of a country or area where the sun comes up
words.core_concept: the side the light comes from first – 光最先到的那一侧
words.core_image: 天刚亮那会儿，光先落在这一侧的山坡上，另一侧还是暗的
examples: They live on the eastern edge of the city.
Eastern winds brought colder weather.
semantic_expansions: 东部的：位于某地区靠日出那一侧的
东方的：属于地球上东边那一大片区域的
words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本身即词根，无拉丁词缀可拆

words.origin: 古英语 eahta ← 原始日耳曼语 *ahtōu ← 原始印欧语 *oḱtṓw
words.native_definition: the number 8
words.core_concept: two hands with the thumbs folded in – 两只手扣起拇指剩下的那些指头
words.core_image: 两只手摊开，把两根拇指往里扣住，剩下立着的指头就是这个数
examples: There are eight chairs around the table.
The train leaves at eight in the morning.
words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本身即词根，无拉丁词缀可拆

words.root_logic: emp（← imperium 号令之权）-ire → 号令所能统辖的那一整片
words.origin: 古法语 empire ← 拉丁语 imperium（号令之权）← imperare（下令、统辖）：in-（向）+ parare（备置）；承义的是下令统辖这一支，不是备置，故未挂 parare，与库中 emperor 同一处理
words.native_definition: a large group of territories or peoples ruled by a single supreme authority
words.core_concept: many lands answering to one voice – 许多地方听同一个声音发号令
words.core_image: 一张地图上十几块颜色不同的地界，箭头全指向中间那一座城
examples: The empire stretched from the sea to the mountains.
She built a publishing empire from one shop.
semantic_expansions: 帝国：许多地方被一个至高权力收在一起，令出一处
帝位：坐在那个至高位置上的身份
大企业集团：一人或一家把一大摊生意攥在手里，结构与前者同理

words.root_logic: en-（in- 在里头）+ gine（gen 生）+ -eer（做这行的人）→ 天生的那份巧思，做成器械，造器械的就是这行人
words.origin: 古法语 engigneor ← 晚期拉丁语 ingeniare ← 拉丁语 ingenium（天生的才具、巧思）：in-（在里头）+ gignere（生）；ingenium 到晚期拉丁语才转指攻城器械，engine 由此
words.native_definition: a person trained to design, build, or maintain machines and structures
words.core_concept: the inborn knack turned into built things – 生在里头的巧思做成实物
words.core_image: 图纸上几根线，最后变成一根压得住卡车的钢梁架在河上
examples: The engineer checked every bolt on the bridge.
They engineered the whole deal in one week.
semantic_expansions: 工程师：把图纸上的东西真造出来的那个人
技师：管着机器、让它一直转得动的人
策划：像装机器一样把事一环环安排上，用在人事上带贬义

words.root_logic: ex-（彻底）+ agger（土堆，出自 aggerere：ad-＋gerere 搬到一处）+ -ate → 一趟趟往上堆，堆得比实有的高
words.origin: 拉丁语 exaggeratus ← exaggerare（堆高、放大）：ex-（彻底）+ aggerare（堆积）← agger（土堆）← aggerere（ad-＋gerere 搬拢来）；英语先有「堆起来」义，1560 年代才转指说过头
words.native_definition: to represent something as larger or more extreme than it really is
words.core_concept: piling it higher than what is really there – 堆得比实有的高
words.core_image: 一筐土倒上去还嫌矮，又添两筐，堆头比原来那个坑挖出的土多出一半
examples: He tends to exaggerate the size of his catch.
Do not exaggerate the danger of the trip.
semantic_expansions: 夸大：把事情的分量往上添，添到超出实情
夸张：为了效果故意加码，听的人也知道有水分
言过其实：说出来的比实际撑得住的多

words.origin: 拉丁语 foederatio ← foederare（结盟）← foedus（属格 foederis：盟约）；foedus 与 fides（信任）虽同追到印欧语 *bheidh-，在拉丁已分化为两词，不同源，故不挂 fidere；与 ex＋dare（交出）一支也无关
words.native_definition: a union of states or organizations that keep some powers of their own
words.core_concept: separate parties bound by one covenant – 各方被同一份约绑到一起
words.core_image: 几家各自盖了章，章盖在同一张纸上，往后对外只认这一张
examples: The federation includes twelve independent states.
A new federation of unions was formed.
semantic_expansions: 联邦：各邦留着自己的权，对外却当一个整体行动
联合会：同类团体立约合成的一个组织
结盟：立约把彼此绑上的那个动作
words.decomposable_note: 拉丁借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.root_logic: fert（ferre 带出、生养）+ -ile（能够）→ 能一茬茬把东西生出来的
words.origin: 拉丁语 fertilis（多产的）← ferre（带、生养）；注意与拉丁语 ferire（击打）不同源，拼写相近而已
words.native_definition: able to produce a lot of crops, young, or ideas
words.core_concept: able to bring forth crop after crop – 能一茬接一茬地生出东西
words.core_image: 土捏在手里松散发黑，种子撒下去第五天就顶出一排绿芽
examples: The valley has deep fertile soil.
She went through a fertile period of writing.
semantic_expansions: 肥沃的：地力足，种什么都出得好
多产的：一茬接一茬地出，产量高
富于创造力的：脑子里点子一个接一个冒出来，与地里出产同理

words.origin: 希腊语 energetikos（能干活的）← energeia（在动的力）：en-（在内）+ ergon（活儿）；本项目未为 ergon 一支建根，该族在词表内只有 energy 一词相伴
words.native_definition: having or showing a lot of physical or mental force
words.core_concept: force at work inside, showing on the outside – 里头有劲在动，外头看得出来
words.core_image: 早上六点跑完一圈回来，进门还能一口气把桌子搬到墙边
examples: The energetic child never sat still.
She gave an energetic speech to the crowd.
semantic_expansions: 精力充沛的：身上力气用不完，做完一件还想做下一件
积极的：做事时劲头明显，肯往前顶
words.decomposable_note: 希腊借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.origin: 古法语 engagier（押上、许下）：en-＋gage（抵押物）← 法兰克语 *wadi（保证物），日耳曼源；与库中 engage 同一处理
words.native_definition: a formal promise or arrangement, or a period of active involvement
words.core_concept: a pledge laid down that cannot be pulled back – 押下去就抽不回的那句话
words.core_image: 戒指套上手指，日子写进本子，两边都知道这话收不回来了
examples: They announced their engagement last spring.
He had an engagement at three that day.
semantic_expansions: 订婚：把婚约先押下，众人都知道
约定：定好的那一次会面或安排
交战：两支队伍咬上了，抽不开身
参与：把自己投进去，不是站在旁边看
words.decomposable_note: 源头在日耳曼语支，经法语回流入英语，本项目未为其词族建根

words.origin: 法语 enthousiasme ← 希腊语 enthousiasmos（神灵附身的激动）← entheos：en-（在内）+ theos（神）；本项目未为 theos 一支建根。英语 theory 出希腊语 theorein（观看），与 theos 不同源
words.native_definition: a strong feeling of excitement and eagerness about something
words.core_concept: a larger force moving in you from inside – 身体里像住进一股更大的劲头
words.core_image: 一说起这件事眼睛就亮，手上比划起来，椅子都坐不住
examples: She spoke about the plan with great enthusiasm.
His enthusiasm for cooking never faded.
semantic_expansions: 热情：整个人为某事烧起来
热忱：这股劲一直朝一个方向使，不是一时冲动
极大兴趣：被某样东西攫住，一说起来就停不下
words.decomposable_note: 希腊借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.origin: 法语 environnement ← environner（围住）← environ（在周围）：en-（在内）+ viron（一圈）← virer（转）；virer 更早词源不明
words.native_definition: the surroundings and conditions in which a person or thing exists
words.core_concept: the full circle of what stands around you – 绕着你转一圈所见的全部
words.core_image: 站在原地转一圈，看见的树、墙、路面和空气里的味道全算在里头
examples: Children need a safe environment to grow in.
We must protect the environment from waste.
semantic_expansions: 环境：人或物身处其中的那一圈条件
自然环境：这一圈里属于山水草木空气的那部分
words.decomposable_note: 经法语入英语的借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.origin: 拉丁语 erroneus（走岔的）← errare（走岔、游荡）；本项目未为 errare 一支建根，该族在词表内只有 error 相伴，与库中 error 同一处理
words.native_definition: based on a mistake and therefore not correct
words.core_concept: having wandered off the right road – 从对的那条路上岔开了
words.core_image: 照着记下的门牌号找过去，站在门口才发现整条街都走岔了
examples: The report was based on erroneous data.
He drew an erroneous conclusion from one case.
semantic_expansions: 错误的：结论或说法本身岔了，站不住
不正确的：与事实对不上，需要改过来
words.decomposable_note: 拉丁借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.root_logic: es-（ex- 出来）+ cort（corrigere ← regere 引直、带正）→ 一路把人引着走、护着走的那个
words.origin: 法语 escorte ← 意大利语 scorta（引路）← scorgere（引导）← 通俗拉丁语 *excorrigere：ex-（出来）+ corrigere（com-＋regere 引直）；承义的是引导这一支，与库中 regula（木尺、准绳）那一支不同支
words.native_definition: a person or vehicle that accompanies another to protect or guide it
words.core_concept: one who leads another straight through – 一路引着别人走过去的那个
words.core_image: 两辆车一前一后夹着中间那辆，路口先停下来看一眼才让它过
examples: Two police cars escorted the truck to the border.
She arrived under a heavy escort.
semantic_expansions: 护送：一路跟着把人或物带到地方，防着出事
护送队：干这件事的那一队人马
陪同：出于礼数陪着走一段，不为安全

words.root_logic: estimat（aestimare 估价、定出值多少）+ -e → 不上秤先给它定一个数
words.origin: 拉丁语 aestimatus ← aestimare（估价、定值）；经古法语 estimer 入英语，与 esteem 同源双式
words.native_definition: to judge roughly the size, value, or cost of something
words.core_concept: putting a number on a thing without measuring it – 不量就给它标一个数
words.core_image: 手按在木箱上往上提半寸就放下，嘴里报出一个数，没上秤
examples: He estimated the crowd at two thousand people.
The builder gave us an estimate on Friday.
semantic_expansions: 估计：不精确的量，凭经验说个大概
估算：拿数字往下算一个近似结果
报价：把要花多少钱先定出来写给对方

words.origin: 拉丁语 evaporatus ← evaporare：ex-（出去）+ vapor（水汽）；本项目未为 vapor 一支建根，该族在词表内只此一词
words.native_definition: to change from a liquid into a gas, or to fade away gradually
words.core_concept: going off into the air until nothing is left – 化成气跑掉，原处什么也不剩
words.core_image: 一滴水落在烧热的铁板上，边缘往里缩，几秒后那块印子也没了
examples: The puddle evaporated within an hour.
His confidence evaporated before the interview.
semantic_expansions: 蒸发：液体变成气跑掉
消失：本来有的东西一点点没了，与前者同一个走法
words.decomposable_note: 拉丁借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.root_logic: ex-（出来）+ ampl（exemplum ← eximere：ex-＋emere 取出去）→ 从一堆里取出来给人看的那一个
words.origin: 古法语 example ← 拉丁语 exemplum（取出来作样子的那一个）← eximere（取出去）：ex-＋emere（取）；与 exempt、sample 同出一源
words.native_definition: a thing taken from a group to show what the rest are like
words.core_concept: one taken out of the lot to stand for all – 从一堆里取一个出来代表全体
words.core_image: 从一筐橘子里拿出一个剥开，说整筐都是这个甜度
examples: She gave three examples to make her point.
He set a good example for the team.
semantic_expansions: 例子：拿出来说明道理的那一个
榜样：拿出来给人照着做的那一个
实例：真发生过、可以指着说的那一件

words.origin: 拉丁语 excerptus ← excerpere（摘出来）：ex-（出来）+ carpere（摘、拉扯）；本项目未为 carpere 一支建根，与库中 carpet 同一处理
words.native_definition: a short passage taken from a longer text or piece of music
words.core_concept: a piece plucked out of a longer whole – 从整篇里摘下来的一小块
words.core_image: 整本书里划出半页抄到另一张纸上，前后都断着
examples: The paper printed an excerpt from her diary.
He excerpted two pages for the class.
semantic_expansions: 摘录：从长文里摘下来的那一段
节选：为某个用途挑出来的一部分，前后不全
words.decomposable_note: 拉丁借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.root_logic: ex-（出去）+ empt（emere 取，过去分词 emptus）→ 被从名单里取出去，那条规矩管不着他
words.origin: 拉丁语 exemptus ← eximere（取出去、免除）：ex-＋emere（取）；与 example 同出一源
words.native_definition: not required to do or pay something that others must
words.core_concept: taken out from what binds the rest – 从管着别人的那条规矩里取出去
words.core_image: 名单上一排人都得交，他那一行被划出来，笔尖跳过去接着往下走
examples: Small farms are exempt from the new tax.
The rule exempts children under six.
semantic_expansions: 免除的：不必照办、不必缴的那种身份
豁免：把某人从义务里取出去这个动作

words.origin: 古法语 espaundre ← 拉丁语 expandere（摊开）：ex-（出去）+ pandere（张开、铺开）；本项目未为 pandere 一支建根，该族在词表内只有 expansion 相伴
words.native_definition: to become larger, or to make something larger or fuller
words.core_concept: a folded thing opened out to take more room – 折着的东西摊开，占的地方变多
words.core_image: 折成八折的地图两手往两边一拉，桌面被它占满，边角垂到地上
examples: Metal expands when it is heated.
The company plans to expand into Asia.
semantic_expansions: 膨胀：本体自己往外长大
扩大：把范围或规模往外推
详述：把说得简略的地方一条条铺开讲全
words.decomposable_note: 拉丁借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.origin: 中世纪拉丁语 extravagans（走出界外的）：extra-（越出）+ vagari（游荡）；本项目未为 vagari 一支建根，该族在词表内只此一词
words.native_definition: spending or costing much more than is necessary or reasonable
words.core_concept: wandering out past where the line was drawn – 越过该有的界线往外走
words.core_image: 八个人点了十六道菜，最后剩下大半原样端走，还添了两瓶没开的酒
examples: He was extravagant with money after the win.
They held an extravagant wedding by the lake.
semantic_expansions: 挥霍的：钱流出去没个数
奢华的：用的东西远超需要的档次
过分的：言行超出常理该有的度
words.decomposable_note: 拉丁借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.origin: 古法语 faint（装的、装死的）← feindre ← 拉丁语 fingere（捏塑、假造）；本项目未为 fingere 一支建根，该族在词表内只有 fiction 相伴
words.native_definition: very weak, unclear, or to lose consciousness briefly
words.core_concept: so weak it can barely hold – 弱到几乎撑不住
words.core_image: 远处一声铃，得屏住呼吸才听得出；那人脸色发白，膝一软往下滑
examples: There was a faint smell of smoke.
She fainted in the crowded hall.
semantic_expansions: 微弱的：声音、光线弱到几乎抓不住
昏倒：人撑不住了，一下失去知觉
模糊的：轮廓淡得看不清，与前者同一个弱法
words.decomposable_note: 拉丁借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.root_logic: phan（phainein 使显现）+ -tastic → 只在心里现出来的那个影，因而离奇，后转指好得不像真的
words.origin: 古法语 fantastique ← 晚期拉丁语 phantasticus ← 希腊语 phantastikos（能想象的）← phantazein（使显现）← phainein（使显现）；与库中 fantasy、fancy 同出此支
words.native_definition: extremely good, or strange and hard to believe
words.core_concept: showing only in the mind, not outside – 只在心里现出来，外头并没有
words.core_image: 闭上眼就看见会飞的鱼和倒着长的树，睁眼一看窗外什么都没有
examples: The food at that place was fantastic.
He told a fantastic story about a talking dog.
semantic_expansions: 极好的：好到不像真的，日常用得最多
离奇的：离常理太远，听着像编的
幻想的：只存在于想象里的

words.origin: 古法语 festival ← 拉丁语 festivalis ← festivus ← festum（节庆的日子）；本项目未为 festum 一支建根，与库中 feast 同一处理
words.native_definition: a day or period of celebration, often with music and public events
words.core_concept: a day set apart when ordinary work stops – 定下来的那一天，平日的活都停下
words.core_image: 街口挂起一长串彩旗，店铺都关了门，人比平日多出三倍
examples: The village holds a music festival each June.
Shops close during the spring festival.
semantic_expansions: 节日：定期到来、大家一起过的那一天
节庆：那几天里的热闹场面
艺术节：为某一门类专设的一段集中活动
words.decomposable_note: 经法语入英语的借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.root_logic: em-（en- 在内）+ phas（phainein 显现）+ -ize → 把某一处特意显出来给人看见
words.origin: 英语 emphasis（← 希腊语 emphasis：en-＋phainein 使显现）加 -ize 构成，与库中 emphasis 同根
words.native_definition: to give special importance to something in speech or writing
words.core_concept: making one part stand out into view – 让其中一处特意露出来
words.core_image: 念到那句话时放慢下来，手指在纸上那一行底下重划一道
examples: She emphasized the need for more time.
He emphasized every word of the warning.
semantic_expansions: 强调：把某一点说重，让人别漏掉
着重：分配力气时偏向这一处

words.root_logic: en-（in- 在里头）+ gine（gen 生）+ -eering → 把天生的巧思用成一门造器械的手艺
words.origin: 英语 engineer 加 -ing 构成 ← 拉丁语 ingenium（天生的才具）：in-（在里头）+ gignere（生）
words.native_definition: the work of designing and building machines, structures, and systems
words.core_concept: the craft of making the inborn knack into structures – 把巧思做成实物的那门手艺
words.core_image: 一张剖面图旁边压着计算纸，纸上每根梁承多少重都写着数
examples: He studied engineering at a small college.
The tunnel was a feat of engineering.
semantic_expansions: 工程：按图把大件东西造起来的整件事
工程学：研究怎么造的那门学问
工程技术：真动手时用的那套办法

words.root_logic: e-（ex- 出来）+ scal（scala 梯子 ← scandere 攀登）+ -ate → 一级级往上爬，只上不下
words.origin: 由 escalator（1900 年 Otis 公司商名，取自 escalade）反推而成 ← 法语 escalade ← 意大利语 scalata ← scala（梯子）；scala 与拉丁语 scandere（攀登）相关，与库中 scale 同支
words.native_definition: to become or make something more serious or intense step by step
words.core_concept: climbing rung by rung with no step back – 一级级往上，没有退回那一步
words.core_image: 先是拍桌子，接着摔杯子，第三天两家门口各站了七八个人
examples: The quarrel escalated into a street fight.
Costs escalated after the delay.
semantic_expansions: 升级：事态往更严重的一级去
逐步加剧：一点点加重，不是一下爆开
上涨：数目一级级往上走

words.root_logic: esteem（aestimare 估价、定分量）→ 把这个人的分量估得高
words.origin: 古法语 estimer ← 拉丁语 aestimare（估价）；十六世纪起专指把人看高，与 estimate 同源双式
words.native_definition: respect and admiration for someone, or to regard someone highly
words.core_concept: reckoning a person's worth as high – 把这个人的分量估到高处
words.core_image: 他一进屋，屋里几个人都站起来，把靠里的位子腾给他
examples: She is held in high esteem by her students.
We esteem him for his honesty.
semantic_expansions: 尊重：把对方的分量摆在自己之上
敬重：不光认他的分量，还仰着头看
看重：认定他有分量，愿意为他费力

words.origin: 中古英语 every body 的合成：every（← 古英语 æfre ǣlc 每一个）+ body（← 古英语 bodig 躯干），日耳曼复合词，与库中 nobody 同一构法
words.native_definition: every person in a group, with no one left out
words.core_concept: every single one counted in – 一个一个数过来，谁也不落下
words.core_image: 点名单点到最后一行，每个名字后面都画了勾，没有空着的
examples: Everybody in the room stood up at once.
Everybody knows the shop closes at six.
semantic_expansions: 每个人：逐个算，一个不漏
人人：不必逐个点，泛指所有人
words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本身即词根，无拉丁词缀可拆

words.origin: 中古英语 every where 的合成：every（← 古英语 æfre ǣlc）+ where（← 古英语 hwǣr 何处），日耳曼复合词，与库中 anywhere 同一构法
words.native_definition: in or to all places
words.core_concept: in each place, none skipped – 每一处都算上，没有跳过的
words.core_image: 同一张海报贴在车站的柱子上、闸机旁、电梯里，抬头就撞见一张
examples: There was dust everywhere in the old house.
She looked everywhere for her keys.
semantic_expansions: 处处：着眼于每一个地方都有
到处：着眼于走动之中处处碰见
words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本身即词根，无拉丁词缀可拆
collocations: everywhere else —— 其他各处
be found everywhere —— 到处都能找到

words.root_logic: ex-（向外）+ cit（citare 唤起、催动）+ -ing → 把原本静着的那股劲唤起来，让人坐不住
words.origin: 英语 excite（← 拉丁语 excitare：ex-＋citare 唤起）加 -ing 构成，与库中 excite、excitement 同根
words.native_definition: causing strong interest and a lively happy feeling
words.core_concept: rousing a force that was lying still – 把本来不动的那股劲唤起来
words.core_image: 比分追平那一刻，看台上前排的人全站起来，手里的杯子都忘了
examples: The last ten minutes were really exciting.
They planned an exciting trip to the coast.
semantic_expansions: 令人兴奋的：让人心跳加快、想动起来
刺激的：那股劲来得猛，带点冒险味道

words.origin: 中古英语 ferther，是 further 的变体，受 far 的词形牵引而成 ← 古英语 furðor（更向前）← 原始日耳曼语 *furþera-；与库中 further 同源
words.native_definition: at or to a greater distance
words.core_concept: more forward along the same line – 顺着同一条线更往前一段
words.core_image: 同一条路上，从这块路牌走到下一块，回头看车已经缩成一个点
examples: We walked farther than we had planned.
The farther bank was hidden by fog.
semantic_expansions: 更远地：作副词，走得比原先更远
更远的：作形容词，两者之中离得远的那一个
words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本身即词根，无拉丁词缀可拆
collocations: farther away —— 更远
go farther —— 走得更远

words.root_logic: fert（ferre 带出、生养）+ -ilize（使能够）+ -er（那样东西）→ 撒下去让地能多生出东西的那样东西
words.origin: 英语 fertile（← 拉丁语 fertilis ← ferre 带、生养）加 -ize、-er 构成，与库中 transfer、offer 同根
words.native_definition: a substance added to soil to help plants grow better
words.core_concept: what is put in so the ground brings forth more – 添进地里让它多生出东西的那样东西
words.core_image: 一把灰白颗粒顺着犁沟撒下去，两周后那一行苗比旁边高出半个手掌
examples: The farmer spread fertilizer over the field.
Too much fertilizer can harm the soil.
semantic_expansions: 肥料：添进土里帮着长的东西，可以是天然的
化肥：工厂做出来的那种，成分是配好的

words.origin: 古英语 fyllan（使满）← 原始日耳曼语 *fullijan ← *fullaz（满的）；与库中 full 同源。拉丁语 plere（填满）虽同追到印欧语 *pele-，两支在各自语言内早已分开，本项目另有 plere 根，不合并
words.native_definition: to make something full, or to become full
words.core_concept: adding until no more will go in – 一直添到再添不进去
words.core_image: 水从龙头下来，桶里的水面一点点往上走，最后齐到桶口那道边
examples: She filled the glass with cold water.
Smoke filled the whole kitchen in seconds.
semantic_expansions: 填满：把缺口、空隙补上，不留空
装满：往容器里放到齐口
占满：人或物把整个空间挤住，不剩地方
words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本身即词根，无拉丁词缀可拆

words.root_logic: en-（使成为）+ force（fortis 强力）→ 在规矩背后加上一股力 → 使它落到实处
words.origin: 古法语 enforcier：en-（使）+ force ← 通俗拉丁语 fortia ← 拉丁语 fortis（强壮的、有力的）；与库中 fortuna（命运）不同支
words.native_definition: to make people obey a rule, or to make something happen by force
words.core_concept: putting force behind a rule – 在规矩背后加上一股力，使它落到实处
words.core_image: 路口立起一块牌子，旁边站着人，谁想绕过去都被拦下来
examples: Police enforce the speed limit here.
The court will enforce the agreement.
semantic_expansions: 执行：让写在纸上的条文真的发生
强制：对方不愿意也得照办，力从外面加上去
加强：给已有的东西再添一份力。三义共享「背后有力顶着」
words.recall_hint: en-（使）+ fort/forc（强力）→ 背后加上一股力，纸上的东西才动得起来

words.root_logic: fac（做）→ facilis（做得来的）→ facultas（做得来的本事）→ 一手拿得出的本事；校中掌某门本事的那批人
words.origin: 古法语 faculte ← 拉丁语 facultas（做得来的本事）← facilis（容易的）← facere（做）；拼写里的 cult 与 colere（耕作）无关，只是字母相含
words.native_definition: a natural ability, or a department of a university and its teaching staff
words.core_concept: what one can do, and those who hold that skill – 做得来的那点本事，以及掌着它的那批人
words.core_image: 同一门手艺的人聚在一栋楼里，各自都有一手拿得出的真本事
examples: She has a faculty for languages.
The faculty voted against the proposal.
semantic_expansions: 能力：天生就做得来的那一手
院系：一所学校里专掌某门本事的那一块
全体教员：那一块里的人合起来。三义共享「做得来的本事」，一个说本事本身，两个说掌着它的人
words.recall_hint: fac（做）→ facilis（做得来的）→ 做得来的那点本事，以及掌着这门本事的那批人

words.origin: 拉丁语 aeternus（永久的）← aevum（一个时代、极长的时间）；与库中 ternus 那支（externus / internus 的里外之分）无关，只是拼写相含
words.native_definition: lasting for ever, with no end
words.core_concept: lasting through age after age – 一个时代接一个时代地存在下去
words.core_image: 刻在石头上的字，风吹了几百年还在那儿，一笔没缺
examples: They swore eternal friendship that summer.
The city holds an eternal flame.
semantic_expansions: 永恒的：时间上没有尽头
永久的：定下之后不再更改
不朽的：留下的名声不随人消失。三义共享「一代接一代地留着」
words.decomposable_note: 拉丁借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.origin: 古法语 feminin ← 拉丁语 femininus ← femina（女子）；femina 出自原始印欧语 *dheh₁-（哺乳）一支，与 minus（更小）无关
words.native_definition: having qualities traditionally thought of as belonging to women
words.core_concept: of the woman's side of things – 归在女子那一边的那些特质
words.core_image: 衣料软软垂下来，线条一路圆过去，没有一处是硬角
examples: She has a soft feminine voice.
In French, the noun is feminine.
semantic_expansions: 女性的：属于女子这一边
阴性的：语法上归在那一类
柔美的：那一边被认作的样子。三义共享「归在女子那一边」，一个说人，一个说语法类别，一个说观感
words.decomposable_note: 经法语入英语的借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.origin: 希腊语 energeia：en-（在其中）+ ergon（干活、功）——里头有活在做；经晚期拉丁语 energia 入英语
words.native_definition: the power to do work, or the liveliness a person has
words.core_concept: work going on inside a thing – 一样东西里头有活在做，因此动得起来
words.core_image: 锅底火苗一直顶着，水在里头翻个不停，一夜没歇
examples: Solar panels turn sunlight into energy.
The children still had energy at midnight.
semantic_expansions: 能量：物里头做功的那份
精力：人身上能拿去做事的那份
活力：那份显在外头的样子。三义共享「里头有活在做」
words.decomposable_note: 希腊借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.origin: 古法语 engin ← 拉丁语 ingenium（天生的巧思）：in-（在内）+ gignere（生出）；由巧思转指巧妙的器械，再窄到机器，与「生出一类」那支语义已分
words.native_definition: a machine that turns fuel or power into movement
words.core_concept: a contrived thing that turns power into motion – 一台巧做出来的东西，把力变成转动
words.core_image: 铁壳子里活塞上下捣着，油送进去，轮轴就转起来
examples: The engine stalled halfway up the hill.
Mechanics rebuilt the old engine last winter.
semantic_expansions: 发动机：把力变成转动的那台东西
引擎：同一台东西的音译说法
机车：整车里以它为核心。三义共享「巧做出来、把力变成转动的那台东西」
words.decomposable_note: 拉丁借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.origin: 希腊语 enthousiastikos ← enthousiazein ← entheos：en-（在其中）+ theos（神）——像有神进了身
words.native_definition: showing strong eagerness and interest
words.core_concept: filled as if by something inside – 像有东西进了身，从里头把人推着往前
words.core_image: 讲到一半人已站起来，手比划得比嘴还快，眼睛发亮
examples: The crowd gave an enthusiastic welcome.
He is enthusiastic about learning Chinese.
semantic_expansions: 热情的：人被里头那股劲推着
热烈的：场面上显出来的那股劲
积极的：那股劲落到做事上。三义共享「里头进了一股劲」，分别说人、场面与行动
words.decomposable_note: 希腊借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.root_logic: epi-（另加）+ eis（进入）+ od（hodos 路）→ 正路之外另插进来的那一段
words.origin: 希腊语 epeisodion：epi-（另加）+ eis（进入）+ hodos（路）——原指古希腊戏剧里歌队之间插进来的那一段
words.native_definition: one part of a series, or a single event within a longer stretch
words.core_concept: one stretch inserted along a longer way – 长路上单独插进来的那一段
words.core_image: 连着播的片子今晚只放一段，看完停住，下一段要等明天
examples: The final episode airs on Sunday night.
That episode of his life stayed hidden.
semantic_expansions: 一集：连播的东西里单独一段
插曲：正事之外插进来的一段
事件：一长段经历里单独可讲的一段。三义共享「长路上单独的一段」
words.recall_hint: epi-（另加）+ od（路）→ 一条长路上另插进来、可以单独拿出来讲的那一段

words.origin: 古法语 eschaper ← 通俗拉丁语 excappare：ex-（出）+ cappa（斗篷）——身子从斗篷里滑出去，斗篷留在追者手上；cappa 更早词源不明，故本词不属 caput 族
words.native_definition: to get away from a place or a danger; the act of getting away
words.core_concept: slipping out and leaving the hold behind – 身子滑出去，被抓住的那层留在原处
words.core_image: 外套被人一把抓住，肩膀一缩，人从袖子里滑了出去
examples: Two prisoners escaped during the night.
She planned her escape for weeks.
semantic_expansions: 逃脱：从抓着自己的那处滑出来
逃跑：滑出来之后往远处去
避开：不等抓住就先滑开。三义共享「从箝制里滑出去」，按时机与远近分
words.decomposable_note: 拉丁借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.root_logic: sta（站立）→ stabilis（站得稳的）→ establish（使站稳）+ -ment（结果）→ 立起来并且站住了的那一摊
words.origin: 古法语 establissement ← establir ← 拉丁语 stabilire（使稳固）← stabilis ← stare（站立）
words.native_definition: the act of setting something up, or an organization and the people holding power
words.core_concept: something set up and made to stand – 立起来并且站住了的那一摊
words.core_image: 牌子钉上墙，门开了，桌椅摆定，从此天天照点开门
examples: The establishment of the fund took years.
He works at a small printing establishment.
semantic_expansions: 建立：把它立起来这个动作
机构：立起来之后站住的那一摊
权势集团：站得最稳、动不了的那一批人。三义共享「立起来站住」，一个说动作，两个说立成的东西
words.recall_hint: sta（站立）→ stabilis（站得稳）→ 立起来并站住了的那一摊，以及立它的那个动作

words.origin: 拉丁语 evacuare：e-（出）+ vacuus（空的）——把里头腾空；vacuus 一族在本词表内同支的只 void / avoid，且拼写上看不出，本项目未为它建根
words.native_definition: to move people out of a place because it is not safe
words.core_concept: emptying a place of what is in it – 把一处地方里头的东西腾出去
words.core_image: 警报一响，楼里的人一层层往外走，最后只剩空椅子
examples: Police evacuated the building after the alarm.
Residents were told to evacuate immediately.
semantic_expansions: 疏散：组织人往外走
撤离：人自己离开那处
腾空：结果是里头什么都不剩。三义共享「把里头腾空」，前两个说人怎么动，后一个说腾完的样子
words.decomposable_note: 拉丁借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.root_logic: ex-（出）+ ag（驱动）→ exigere（赶出来、称量）→ examen（天平的指针）→ 一样样称过，看针停在哪里
words.origin: 古法语 examiner ← 拉丁语 examinare ← examen（天平的指针）← exigere：ex-（出）+ agere（驱动、称量）
words.native_definition: to look at something closely in order to judge it
words.core_concept: weighing item by item until the needle settles – 一样样称过，针停住了才算数
words.core_image: 一件件举到灯下翻过来看，指甲刮一下，再放到另一堆
examples: The doctor examined her injured knee.
Examine the contract before you sign.
semantic_expansions: 检查：逐样看过有没有毛病
审查：看它合不合规矩，带判定
考核：拿题去称一个人。三义共享「逐样称过再判」，按被称的是物、事还是人分
